jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.descriptionHtml: At Provido, we’re more than a technology company. We are a global hub of innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence. Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world. As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact. You will lead and develop high-performance, visually polished, and accessible web experiences. handle real-time data via WebSockets or Server-Sent Events. * Code Quality - Write clean, testable code; conduct code reviews and uphold engineering standards using ESLint, Prettier, and automated testing frameworks. * AI-Enabled Development Practices - Lead effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity, code quality, test coverage, and delivery velocity while ensuring security, maintainability, and architectural standards are upheld. * Mentorship - Guide and mentor junior and mid-level front-end developers; jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will combine hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. Historically, our backend has been built on Groovy and Kotlin. Today we work AI-first, and much of our engineering work runs through AI-assisted development. As a result, we place far less weight on a specific stack than we used to. What matters is that you know your way around backend engineering and can apply sound judgment, whatever the language. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Lead, develop, and grow the GEO engineering team, starting with two engineers and scaling as the product grows. * Define how the team builds, reviews, evaluates, and ships, including how it uses AI-assisted development day to day. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- * Experience leading or mentoring engineers, whether as a tech lead or engineering manager, including hiring and developing team members. * Solid backend engineering experience with at least one object-oriented language (for example, Java, Kotlin, Groovy, C#, or Python). Prior experience with Groovy or Kotlin is helpful but not required. * Comfort working AI-first, using AI-assisted development as a core part of how you and your team build and ship. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks is beneficial but not essential. * No experience training foundation models is required; this is primarily a backend engineering and technical leadership role. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Bangkok, Thailand, Khon Kaen, Thailand Full-time Permanent employee **What We Need** ---------------- Oivan is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the platform that runs our internal technology, including the AI agents we build and operate for ourselves. You will report directly to the CTO and shape how Oivan ships, runs and secures its own systems. This is an internal technology role, not a client delivery position. You will build and run the platform behind Oivan's own products and internal systems, the pipelines, clusters, cloud infrastructure and observability that everything else depends on. A large part of the work is deploying and operating AI agents. Oivan builds AI into its own operations, and you will be the engineer who takes those agents from a working prototype to something that runs reliably in production, with the model endpoints, orchestration, data stores, guardrails and monitoring that requires. You report directly to the CTO, which means you have a real say in platform direction, technology choices and build-versus-buy decisions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a problem end to end rather than waiting for a ticket. We are offering relocation to **Khon Kaen** for people interested. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build and operate the CI/CD pipelines and deployment platform for Oivan's internal applications and services. * Deploy, run and monitor AI agents and LLM-backed services in production, model endpoints, orchestration layers, vector stores, evaluation and the guardrails around them. * Own our Kubernetes clusters end to end: provisioning, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, secrets and workload management. * Manage cloud infrastructure, with clear cost visibility and sensible guardrails. * Build observability that people actually use, metrics, logs, traces, alerting and dashboards. * Automate everything repeatable with Infrastructure as Code. * Harden the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network policy, patching and vulnerability management. * Support the internal front-ends and the services behind them through build, release and runtime. * Work with the CTO on platform roadmap, tooling decisions and where we build versus buy. * Act as the escalation point for internal platform incidents, and drive the follow-up that stops them recurring. **What You Have** ----------------- Must have * 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, operating at strong medior to senior level. * Hands-on Kubernetes in production, GKE, EKS or on-premise. Not just deploying to a managed cluster, but owning it * CI/CD ownership — designing and running pipelines, not only using them. * Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. * Cloud platform experience at production scale. * Linux administration and scripting — Bash and Python. * Containers and registries — Docker, image hygiene, supply chain basics. * Observability — Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging and alerting. * Secrets management and identity across services and environments. * Networking fundamentals — DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls. * Advanced English and strong communication. You will work directly with the CTO and across teams, and you will be expected to explain technical decisions clearly to non-specialists. * Based in Thailand, able to work from Khon Kaen. Bangkok is also a possibility for the right candidate. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **OWM Group** **Ltd** is a forward-thinking technology group comprising several innovative companies, including **OpenWeather Ltd** and **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, all headquartered in the iconic Gherkin, one of London’s most recognised business centres. **OpenWeather** is a technologically innovative company that specialises in the development of intelligent environmental data products. The UK-based company has been operating on the market for a decade, adhering to its mission to provide high-quality data and analytical products that assist customers in transforming their businesses for the better. The organisation is proficient in the practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and information technology (IT) in the context of environmental data. We are currently providing services to over 9 million consumers worldwide, with over 2 billion forecasts generated daily, and 5 PB of environmental data. **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, our AI-powered assistant platform, is the latest addition to the group and is experiencing rapid growth. Ulla represents the future of AI-led business support, and we are just getting started. Both products run on infrastructure we build and operate ourselves, mostly on bare metal. That’s where you come in. We’re growing and looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys running real infrastructure on real hardware. You’ll have genuine ownership and a real say in how we work, and you’ll join a team that values automation over manual work. **What you’ll do** * Run the fleet: deploy, maintain and operate Linux servers, mostly bare-metal, with automation and security built in from the start. * Keep services up: own internal and external services from deployment through day-to-day uptime. * Share on-call: take part in a rotating on-call schedule. * Handle incidents: join incident response and lead root cause analysis. * Work across teams: partner with engineering teams to deliver infrastructure and keep services available. * Build what’s next: contribute to infrastructure and security projects. **What you bring** * 3+ years of Linux administration. * A solid understanding of network services (DNS, VPN, firewalls) and the TCP/IP stack. * Confidence with Docker / docker-compose, Ansible and GitLab CI. * An automation-first mindset and the scripting skills to back it up. **Nice to have experience** * Running Kubernetes in production. * Applying SRE practices. * Operating high-load systems. **Why Join OWM Group** **Ltd?** ● Be part of a global company providing weather services to millions of customers. ● Collaborate with a team of talented professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of weather prediction. ● Opportunities for professional growth and development. ● Flexible working schedule ● Annual performance bonus. ● 25 days of annual leave + 8 UK bank holidays. **OWM Group** **Ltd** is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Work Location: Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml: **24Slides** is a leading presentation design company specializing in high-impact PowerPoint presentations. We are committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. We believe diversity drives innovation and success, and we strive to build an environment where every identity is valued. At 24Slides, we don't just celebrate differences—we make them central to our culture, ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. As our infrastructure and platform services expand, we are building operational coverage and infrastructure redundancy across global time zones. We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer based in our Malang office to join our Technology organization, working closely with your DevOps and Engineering colleagues in Europe. #### **About the Position** As a DevOps in 24Slides you will be part of a dynamic workplace, and engage with different stakeholders, across different offices, and participate in recurring tasks and ad-hoc projects across 24Slides. You will be working closely with 24Slides software engineers, our Data team and our QA team, and in collaboration optimize deployment pipelines, data pipelines and support increased levels of automation. We take pride in being curious, so we experiment with new technologies to help elevate our customers' experience, and being interested in new advancements within the DevOps/DevEx domain is a plus. #### **Responsibilities:** * Manage and maintain Kubernetes clusters across our primary hosting environment(s) * Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and containerization best practices to streamline resource management and ensure environment consistency. * Monitor cloud compute utilization and cost efficiency across production and non-production environments. * Maintain CI/CD build runners and automation pipelines * Conduct security patch updates. * Monitor system health, application metrics, and log pipelines * Participate in proactive troubleshooting, incident management, and post-incident root-cause analysis (RCA) * Conduct periodic Disaster Recovery (DR) drills to validate recovery objectives (RTO/RPO). #### **Requirements:** * Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Systems Engineering role supporting production applications. * Managing cloud infrastructure. Previous experience from DigitalOcean is a plus. * Building, maintaining and optimizing CI/CD pipelines * Experience with Infrastructure As Code (IaC) * Knowledge of Cloudflare, reverse proxies, and Linux system administration. * Familiarity with relational databases and Redis/Vkey caching engines. * Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English (both written and spoken) for cross-regional team collaboration. #### **A plus if you** * **Have experience operating under formal security compliance frameworks (SOC 2).** * **Are familiar with PHP/Laravel runtime environments and Node.js / React build systems.** * **Have experience with log management stacks.** #### **Benefits:** * **Salary & Insurances:** Enjoy a competitive salary with additional incentives, plus comprehensive health coverage, including BPJS and private insurance. * **Global & Flexible Work Culture:** Gain international experience in a multinational environment with a global team, a fun office vibe, casual attire, and a flexible hybrid working model. * **Continuous Growth & Development:** We invest in your future through professional training, clear career progression paths, and dedicated personal growth programs. * **Holistic Well-being:** We prioritize your happiness and mental health with access to psychological counseling, annual leave that increases with tenure, plus situational leave, and engaging "experience programs" (non-work activities). * **Operational Support:** Get the tools you need to succeed with the provided working devices. #### **Application & Recruitment Process:** Please submit your application as soon as possible. jobs.descriptionHtml: **PELUANG BERKARIR** PT Media Sarana Data merupakan perusahaan swasta yang bergerak di bidang teknologi informasi dan komunikasi. Dengan mengikuti tren teknologi yang berkembang pada saat ini, kami mulai menggarap sector jalur solusi komunikasi data dan IT langsung kepada konsumen akhir, terutama untuk layanan akses Internet dan komunikasi multimedia. Berdiri pada bulan januari 2009 di kota Yogyakarta, dan seiring meningkatnya permintaan di beberapa kota maka saat ini kami telah mempunyai kantor cabang di Solo, Pemalang, Purwokerto, Padang, Samarinda, Bandung dan Jakarta, dengan cangkupan area layanan seluruh Indonesia. Memberi kesempatan kepada para profesional di bidangnya yang terampil dan dinamik untuk bergabung dan berkembang menjadi bagian tim kami pada posisi : **Data Analyst** Kualifikasi : * Mengumpulkan dan mengolah data operasional (keluhan, coverage, pemetaan langganan, dll). * Mengidentifikasi masalah (bottleneck/titik kendala, selisih data, inefficiency). * Membuat laporan harian, mingguan, bulanan. * Melakukan cross-check dan rekonsiliasi data operasional. * Minimal D3/S1 Statistik. * Pengalaman 1–3 tahun di data analyst/operations analyst. * Menguasai minimal salah satu software pengolahan dan analisis data, seperti SmartPLS, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, atau Looker Studio. * Teliti, detail, dan mampu problem solving berbasis data. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Job Types: Full-time, Contract Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Industrial Engineering Staff
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Desc : * Melakukan pengukuran standar kerja operator produksi untuk menentukan standar kapasitas produksi, menghitung nilai *Standard Minute Value* (SMV). * Mengidentifikasi ketidakseimbangan alur kerja (*bottleneck*) di lini produksi. * Mengimplementasikan Lean Manufacturing * Perancangan Tata Letak (*Production Layout*) mesin serta area kerja produksi untuk memastikan aliran material (*material flow*) berjalan lancar dan meminimalkan jarak pemindahan. * Menghitung kebutuhan jumlah tenaga kerja (*manpower planning*) dan utilitas mesin berdasarkan target permintaan pasar (*demand forecast*). * Mengalanisa masalah produksi (menggunakan analisis Pareto atau Fishbone Diagram) bersama tim *Quality Control* untuk mengusulkan tindakan perbaikan atas defect/kecacatan produk yang tinggi. * Melakukan evaluasi berkala terhadap target efisiensi lini (*line efficiency*), memantau performa pencapaian target harian, dan melaporkan langsung hasilnya kepada Manajemen. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world. Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible. **Team Description:** You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which powers analytics, data science and AI tooling across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace to our OTA business, in markets worldwide. Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the data ingestion, platform and AI tooling work behind them. **The Role:** You will build and operate the ingestion systems and runtime infrastructure that support analytics, data science and AI tools across Wego. Your focus is reliable data movement from source systems and dependable operation of the services that consume it, and you will own pipelines and services through development, deployment and operation. You'll work closely with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to find bottlenecks and build practical solutions, and you'll connect AI tools to data and services with clear access boundaries, evaluations and operational ownership. **What you will be working on:** * Building reliable batch and streaming pipelines so data moves from source systems without being silently lost or duplicated * Running pipelines and services on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, with repeatable environments and safe release and rollback paths * Building the systems that let AI assistants and agents use Wego data and APIs reliably, with evaluations built alongside data scientists * Improving reliability and cloud cost against agreed service goals * Finding sources of data loss, operational toil and slow delivery, validating their impact with users and owning the fix end to end **Core Responsibilities:** * Data ingestion: Build pipelines from APIs, databases and event sources; handle schema changes, incremental loads and change data capture where needed * Recovery & data quality: Design retries, deduplication, backfills and replay; monitor freshness and completeness from source to consumer * Kubernetes & runtime: Deploy and operate containerized pipelines and services; manage resources, configuration, scaling and recovery with platform teams * DevOps & delivery: Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines; test changes and manage secrets and access * Observability & operations: Define metrics, logs and alerts; diagnose incidents and fix recurring failures * AI tooling & model services: Build tool and API integrations, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, prompts and guardrails; support model serving where needed * Evaluations: Build test sets, regression checks and monitoring of AI outputs with data scientists **Skills and experience:** * 3–8 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering or related infrastructure work * Experience owning ingestion systems in production, including failures, recovery and source schema changes * Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and cloud infrastructure * Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments and infrastructure as code * Fluency in Python and SQL, with practical Linux, networking and container skills * Experience with APIs, databases and event systems, including batch or streaming ingestion * Understanding of delivery guarantees, idempotency and schema compatibility, and how they affect downstream data * Experience with Kubernetes and container tooling such as Docker and Helm * Experience with a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS, and infr...

jobs.title: Data Center Engineer Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: The Lead Engineer is responsible for supervising daily engineering operations and maintenance activities within the data center facility. This role ensures the reliability, availability, and efficiency of critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire protection systems. The Lead Engineer also leads engineering technicians, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and ensures compliance with safety standards, operational procedures, and service-level requirements. **Key Responsibilities** 1. Engineering Operations * Supervise daily operations of critical data center infrastructure, including electrical distribution, UPS, generators, HVAC, cooling systems, fire protection, and other facility systems. * Monitor equipment performance and ensure the reliability and availability of critical infrastructure. * Conduct routine inspections and review operational parameters to identify potential risks or abnormalities. 2. Maintenance Management * Lead and coordinate preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance activities. * Ensure maintenance activities are completed according to approved schedules, SOPs, and manufacturer recommendations. * Troubleshoot equipment failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. 3. Team Leadership * Supervise and guide shift engineers, technicians, and other engineering personnel. * Assign daily tasks, monitor team performance, and ensure adequate shift handovers. * Provide technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to improve team competency. 4. Incident and Emergency Management * Respond to equipment alarms, system abnormalities, and infrastructure incidents. * Coordinate troubleshooting and recovery activities to minimize downtime and operational risks. * Participate in emergency response drills and ensure compliance with incident escalation procedures. 5. Safety and Compliance * Ensure all engineering activities comply with HSE requirements, electrical safety standards, and site operating procedures. * Ensure proper implementation of Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and risk assessment procedures. * Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, incident reports, and operational logs. 6. Coordination and Reporting * Coordinate with the Facility Manager, Shift Lead, technicians, contractors, and other relevant departments. * Prepare daily operational reports, maintenance reports, incident reports, and equipment performance updates. * Support audits, equipment testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.title: Senior Software QA - 2 Openings
jobs.descriptionHtml: About us: At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. What you'll do: We are seeking 2 Senior Software QA to support quality assurance activities across Enterprise Business applications, with primary focus on Oracle, SAP, Billing, and related enterprise platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, automation opportunities, AI-assisted testing practices, and end-to-end validation across integrated business processes. You will partner with Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and Business stakeholders to ensure high-quality delivery of Global IT solutions. jobs.descriptionHtml: Reference No. : SVN/2026/045 Position Title : Programme Associate (Refugee Care) Duty Station : Medan Organization Unit : Refugee Care Classification : G-5 Type of Appointment : Special Short-Term Contract Report to : Senior Programme Associate Estimated Start Date : As soon as possible Closing Date : 11 November 2026 Established in 1951, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) is a related organization of the United Nations (UN), and as the leading UN agency in the field of migration and works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants. Operational in Indonesia for more than 40 years, IOM Indonesia is working on a wide range of activities in partnership with the Government of Indonesia, civil society, private sector actors, migrants and communities. IOM Indonesia is engaged in several thematic areas, including: Counter-Trafficking (CT), Labour Migration and Social Inclusion (LMSI), Disasters, Climate and Resilience (DCR), Immigration and Border Governance (IBG), Refugee Care, Migration Health, Migration Governance and Resettlement and Voluntary Returns. IOM Indonesia aims to ensure quality of care for refugees and asylum seekers referred to IOM by the Government of Indonesia according to applicable international humanitarian and human rights standards. The Programme supports refugees through healthcare, education basic needs, and contributes to the increased protection of vulnerable subgroups, such victims of sexual and gender-based violence, among others, through referral mechanisms involving the active participation of specialized state and non-state service providers. It also contributes to supporting them with the eventual sustainable pathways. Under the direct supervision of the Senior Programme Associate, and under the overall supervision of the Head of Sub-Office, working closely with Health Care, Community Liaison Officers, Resource Management, as well as the Community Accountability Coordinator and team in Jakarta, the Programme Associate (Refugee Care) will be responsible for assisting in the implementation of refugee care activities in line with programme requirements and as part of the Programme’s strategy on community engagement and accountability to affected populations, and in line with IOM policies, standards and commitments **RESPONSIBILITIES Responsibilities and Accountabilities** * Assist in the implementation and monitoring of programme activities in line with the RCA programme procedures and mechanisms. * Undertake regular visits to gather information on beneficiaries’ situations, document their needs or concerns, and relay this information to the supervisor and relevant colleagues for follow-up; identify and promptly report any observed protection, security, or health-related concerns to the supervisor in line with established procedures. * Maintain updated files and information for assigned beneficiaries in the case management system and follow up as per programme setup. * Act as a focal point for routine operational workflows related to protection and care coordination activities, guided by the RCA management team at the Country Office. * Monitor basic service-related information and activities, document gaps or issues observed during routine duties including those reported by beneficiaries and partners, share these with the supervisor and provide inputs on corrective actions. * Organize meetings, workshops, training and other events; assist with logistical, arrangements, outreach, participation lists, basic facilitation support, and communication with refugee communities and local stakeholders as part of the community engagement activities. * Support updating and routine verification of data and relevant information for monthly and other reports in the Refugee Registration and Assistance Monitoring Syst...

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About the Role** BYD is seeking an experienced and hands-on **HR Generalist** to manage end-to-end Human Resources operations for our growing organization. This role plays a key part in establishing and maintaining operational excellence across HR functions, ensuring full compliance with Indonesian employment regulations, and supporting business scaling. The ideal candidate brings comprehensive, multi-disciplinary HR expertise—spanning talent acquisition, total rewards, labor relations, statutory compliance, and expatriate management—with the autonomy to drive daily operations with minimal supervision. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Talent Acquisition & Development:** Lead end-to-end recruitment processes, manage smooth onboarding programs, and coordinate employee training and career development initiatives. * **Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:** Oversee monthly payroll processing, tax calculations (PPh 21), statutory benefits administration (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan), and employee welfare schemes. * **Employee Relations & Manpower Compliance:** Oversee labor relations, handle employment contracts (PKWT/PKWTT), manage employee grievances, and ensure strict alignment with Indonesian labor laws and company regulations (PP/PKB). * **Expatriate Management:** Coordinate expatriate administration, including end-to-end processing of work permits (RPTKA, IMTA/Notifikasi), visas, ITAS/KITAS, and local residency compliance. * **Policies, SOPs & Documentation:** Maintain accurate employee database records, draft and update HR policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and safeguard confidential HR files. * **HR Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Generate comprehensive HR metrics and operational reports, identifying continuous process improvements to support operational efficiency and business growth. ### **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Position:** HR Generalist * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology, Human Resource Management, Law, Business Administration, or related disciplines. * **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of proven, hands-on experience across full-spectrum HR operations; prior experience in manufacturing or large-scale multinational enterprises is highly preferred. * **Functional Expertise:** Strong mastery of end-to-end payroll computation, C&B structures, Indonesian manpower regulations (UU Ketenagakerjaan & UU Cipta Kerja), and grievance handling. * **Certifications:** Brevet A/B tax certification or formal training in Indonesian payroll/employment taxation is a plus. * **Language Skills:** + Fluent professional working proficiency in **English** (written and verbal). + Professional working proficiency in **Mandarin** is an advantage for cross-border alignment. * **Core Competencies:** Strong analytical thinking, solid cross-cultural communication, structured organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

From his origins as a master trunk maker, manufacturing boxes used to pack both everyday objects as well as voluminous wardrobes, Louis Vuitton and his successors introduced numerous innovations including the advent of the flat-top trunk, lightweight canvas, signature patterns, and the tumbler lock. Today, Louis Vuitton’s legacy is expressed through its rigorous spirit of innovation, the boldness of its creations and an uncompromising demand for excellence.

jobs.title: HRBP - HR People Management
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department People LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor) LocationJakarta The People team plays a crucial organisational role in Shopee by channeling important resources to key functions in the company. People are key to Shopee’s growth, and as our business expands, so does the need to develop and support our employees. Job Description: * Drive and socialize Human Resource (HR) standards and strategic practices by providing tailored guidance, data-backed insights, and solutions on People matters to business leaders, ensuring all strategic decisions align with HR perspectives within the project period. * Maintain annual and quarterly manpower planning, oversee employee selection, orientation, onboarding, offboarding, and internal transfers, ensuring complete alignment with company policies and prevailing Indonesia Labor Law. * Generate regular analytical reports and updates regarding HR metrics, operational issues, and project milestones for both the HR Lead and Business Leaders. * Evaluate and resolve complex Legal or Industrial Relations issues to maintain strict compliance with internal regulations and statutory labor standards. * Conduct thorough, objective, and efficient workplace investigations for HR-related concerns, formulating comprehensive action plans and corrective measures. * Perform deep-dive operational analytics and gap analyses on existing business processes to enable HR to design, launch, and execute targeted programs, initiatives, and organizational solutions. * Collaborate closely with the HR Lead and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve intricate HR business issues that require specialized functional expertise and strategic intervention. * Formulate, review, and revise department-specific HR policies and operational guidelines for assigned business units to maintain organizational scalability. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Industrial Engineering, Law, or a related field. * Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in human resources business partnering, organizational development, or HR generalist area. * Hands-on experience in managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, manpower planning, industrial relation, organization structure analysis and performance management.

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

jobs.descriptionHtml: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Regional Director of Enterprise Sales, you act as the primary catalyst for RobCo's enterprise growth across the German market, driving large-scale industrial adoption of our Autonomous Manufacturing Platform. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets.

  • Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises.

  • Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience.

  • Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.

  • Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles.

jobs.title: Recruiter, Commercial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Your mission

Our market moves fast, and so do we. As our business continues to scale, we're looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Commercial Recruiter to take ownership of hiring across the DACH region.

You'll be the driving force behind building our commercial powerhouse — attracting and securing exceptional talent across Sales, Account Management and Business Development.

From the initial hiring kick-off to the final signed contract, you'll own the entire recruitment journey. You'll partner closely with business leaders, shape hiring strategies, identify outstanding talent and turn ambitious growth plans into reality.

This isn't just about filling vacancies. It's about building the people, teams and capabilities that will define our next chapter.

If you love moving fast, building relationships and making great hires happen, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

  • Own the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close.

  • Hunt passive talent via LinkedIn, referrals, events and direct approach.

  • Interview in German and English and deliver sharp shortlists, fast.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

Compensation: $90K – $100K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • $180-200 OTE 50/50 split. Uncapped with accelerators above 100%

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The Role

The Head of Operations reports to Sauraj (Co-CEO, GTM and Operations) and take ownership of operational excellence company-wide. As Finance, Legal, People, IT and InfoSec, and Compliance grow into their own functions, this person partners with each lead on the operational side of their work and holds the whole together as one system. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig.

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Entwicklung neuer Produkte von der Rohware bis zum Endprodukt

  • Bearbeitung / Erstellung von Musteranfragen / Mustern

  • Begleitung von Erstproduktionen und Linientests

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich, z. B. Fachkraft für Lebensmitteltechnik, Fleischer, Tierwirt,

  • Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsfelds Landscape Transformation

  • Perspektivisch Übernahme von Planungs-, Koordinations- und Kontrollaufgaben von nationalen und internationalen SAP Transformationsprojekten mit Fachbereich und IT unserer Kunden

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant SAP Authorizations / Berechtigungen (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Im Geschäftsfeld SAP Authorizations bieten wir unseren Kunden innovative und hochindividuelle Konzeptlösungen für die Administration der Berechtigungen in ihren Systemlandschaften. Unser Expertenteam unterstützt Kunden auf verschiedenste Art und Weise auf der Suche nach der jeweils optimalen Lösung. Unsere ganzheitliche Betrachtung der Berechtigungskonzepte bringt Systemsicherheit, Audit-Compliance und eine möglichst optimierte User Experience mit ein.

Den IT-Teams unserer Kunden bieten wir Support bei einer großen Vielfalt von Systemen und SAP-Technologien, von klassischen ECC-Systemen bis zu den neuesten SAP Public Cloud-Versionen, inklusive S/4 HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, GTS, u.v.m.

Eine weitere Stärke unseres Teams ist das Fortbildungsangebot für Administrationsteams, Key-Usern, SAP-Moduls SpezialistInnen, und weitere InteressentInnen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir derzeit mehrere Beraterpersönlichkeiten (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung im Bereich SAP-Berechtigungen, die sich sowohl für klassische als auch für innovative SAP-Technologien begeistern und die Chance nutzen möchten, mit uns zusammen die Gestaltung der Kundenlösungen der Zukunft voranzubringen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Erstellung von prozessübergreifenden SAP Berechtigungskonzepten für SAP Systeme diverser Art (vorrangig S/4 und ECC-Systeme, jedoch auch BW, HCM, GTS, EWM, etc.)

  • Umfangreiche Analyse von bestehenden SAP Berechtigungskonzepten

  • Umsetzung des technischen Rollen-Customizing nach Anforderungen des Kunden

  • Behebung von Berechtigungsproblemen: Ursachenforschung, Erstellung und Umsetzung von Lösungsvorschlägen

  • Wartung von bestehenden Rollenkonzepten: Rollenänderungen, Rollenerweiterungen sowie periodische Wartungsaktivitäten

  • Durchführung von Präsentationen und Workshops bei Kunden und Interessenten

  • Kontinuierliche Fortbildung in den neuesten Themen rund um das SAP-Berechtigungswesen

  • Mitarbeit in einem gut eingespielten, internationalen Team von erfahrenen ExpertInnen


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Erstellung, Umsetzung und Wartung von SAP-Berechtigungskonzepten

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse und Behebung von Berechtigungsfehlern

  • Konzeptionell ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft, auch für gelegentliche Auslandseinsätze

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an stetiges Weiterlernen und Weiterentwickeln von den eigenen Kenntnissen im Bereich SAP-Berechtigungswesen.

  • Hybride Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität hinsichtlich Präsenz (Kombination aus Home-Office und Bürotagen)

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

Im Umfeld globaler SAP-Lösungen ist professionelles Master Data Management (MDM) die Grundvoraussetzung für einen nachhaltig tragfähigen und effizienten Lösungsbetrieb. Richtig eingesetzt, ist MDM ein starker Hebel zur Standardisierung, zur Verschlankung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen und zur Kostensenkung im globalen Application Management. Mit umfassender Expertise und spezifischen Services verhelfen wir unseren Kunden zu einer höheren Datenqualität bei den Stammdaten und schaffen so die Grundlage zur Erreichung der Digitalisierungsziele.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Technische Beratung und Entwicklung in großen und mittelgroßen Industrieunternehmen mit dem Schwerpunkt Stammdatenmanagement in der produzierenden Industrie

  • Eigenständige Analyse von funktionalen Anforderungen und Konzeption sowie Realisierung von Lösungskonzepten für das SAP Stammdatenumfeld mit ABAP 7.4+, HANA, BRF+ und SAPUI5

  • Evaluierung von Integrationsplattformen, neuen SAP-Technologien (z.B. Data Intelligence) und Unterstützung des gezielten Know-how-Aufbaus im Geschäftsfeld Master Data Management

  • Weiterentwicklung von Konzepten und Strategien zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der cbs eigenen Stammdatenprodukte

  • Selbstständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise im Projektteam Test und Dokumentation der entwickelten Softwarelösungen

  • Coaching von Mitarbeitern in fachlichen und methodischen Fragen

  • Unterstützung des Vertriebs unserer Beratungsleistungen/-lösungen und bei der Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Angeboten für künftige Kundenprojekte

  • Unterstützung des internen Wissensaufbaus und Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung des Competence Centers


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Hochschulstudium, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Mathematik oder Naturwissenschaften oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • (Mehrjährige) Berufserfahrung als SAP Entwickler (m/w/d) oder SAP-Architekt (m/w/d)

  • (Mehrjährige) Erfahrung im Bereich Master Data Management bzw. sehr gute Kenntnisse in SAP MDG Master Data Governance oder anderen führenden MDM Technologien und Lösungen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der SAP Entwicklung und in SAP-Technologien (ABAP, ABAP/OO, HANA, AMDP, BRF+, Fiori / SAPUI5, OData)

  • Zusatzkenntnisse in weiteren Programmiersprachen, wie JavaScript, HTML5, CSS wünschenswert

  • Erfahrungen im Schnittstellendesign und -implementierung (z. b. SRM, Salesforce, ARIBA, SAP CX, ECTR)

  • Grundkenntnisse in der Anwendung in mindestens einem SAP Modul im Bereich Logistik

Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei globalen SAP Rollouts und kennen die Herausforderungen und Konfliktpotentiale der lokalen Anforderungen durch legale Verpflichtungen und der Complianceanforderungen globaler Templates. Für unsere Kunden sind wir ein erfahrener, kompetenter und zuverlässiger Partner und agieren als strategische Schnittstelle zwischen den Prozessen des SAP ERP / S/4 Backends und den lokalen Partnern und Behörden.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Durchführung von SAP ERP bzw. S/4HANA Projekten im Bereich E-Invoicing

  • Tracking und Validierung legaler Anforderungen im Bereich E-Invoicing, Legal Reporting oder E-Governance

  • Know-How-Aufbau und Verwaltung legaler Anforderungen

  • Option auf Teilprojektleitung von E-Invoicing Projekten im SAP ERP und S/4HANA Umfeld


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Strukturierte, organisierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Als marktführende SAP Prozess- und Technologieberatung im Bereich Supply Chain Management bereiten wir unsere Kunden auf den Wandel der traditionellen Supply Chain Planung zur erweiterten, digitalen Supply Chain Planung vor. Hierbei gestalten, optimieren und transformieren wir unternehmensweite logistische Prozesse unserer Kunden mit Unterstützung neuester SAP Lösungen S/4 HANA (S/4 Supply Chain, S/4 Logistics, S/4 Manufacturing) und SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP S&OP, IBP Demand Planning, IBP Inventory, IBP Response and Supply und IBP Supply Chain Control Tower). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung der unternehmensweiten, neuen Planungslandschaft.

Wir suchen ab sofort SAP Senior Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich IBP (Integrated Business Planning) für unsere Standorte Heidelberg, Hamburg, Dortmund, München, Stuttgart, Berlin, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und Freiburg. 

Was Dich erwartet

  • Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung von SAP SCM Projekten bei großen national und international agierenden Industrieunternehmen

  • Arbeiten mit zukunftssicheren, State of the Art- Planungstools

  • Konzeption, Design und Implementierung von komplexen Planungsprozessen mit SAP IBP

  • Konzeption und Modellierung von effizienten Planungs- und Logistikprozessen entlang der gesamten Supply Chain und deren technischen Umsetzung im SAP System

  • Du transformierst die Planungsprozesse unserer Kunden von SAP SCM APO nach SAP IBP in Verbindung optimierst diese in den zukunftsorientierten Planungsapplikationen 

  • Übernahme von Modul- bzw. Projektverantwortung in komplexen und anspruchsvollen SCM Projekten in einem abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Kundenumfeld   

  • Entwicklung bestehender und Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen     

  • Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen

﻿

  • Erstklassiger Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Logistik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Berater, Anwender oder Key User im Planungsumfeld (IBP, APO oder non-SAP Planungslösungen) ·        

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von SCM Projekten in den Bereichen Demand Planning, Supply Network Planning, Sales and Operations Planning oder Detailed Production Planning  

  • Kreativität zur Erarbeitung kundenspezifischer Lösungsansätze ·
