Die Wertschöpfungskette ist das Rückgrat eines jeden Industrieunternehmens. Hier wird der Unterschied gemacht: Von der Beziehung zu den Zulieferern, über die Logistik und die Herstellung des eigentlichen Produktes, bis hin zur nachhaltigen Kundenbeziehung. Unsere Kunden haben diesen End-2-End Prozess über Jahrzehnte verfeinert und optimiert. Als marktführende Prozess- und Technologieberatung im Bereich Supply Chain Management helfen wir ihnen dabei, diesen auch in einer zukunftstragenden digitalen ganzheitlichen Target-Landscape durchgehend, resilient und innovativ als auch ergebniswirkend zu gestalten

Wir suchen ab sofort mehrere Senior Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain Planning aus dem Beratungsgeschäft sowie Prozessexperten aus der Industrie.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Die Chance, die Zukunft von Weltmarkführern in abwechslungsreichen und herausfordernden Projekten aktiv und nachhaltig mitzugestalten

  • Prozessberatung im Bereich Supply Chain Planning, Logistics & Manufacturing, mit Fokus auf die taktische Planungsebene zur Unterstützung der Strategieumsetzung

  • Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung von SCM Projekten bei großen national und international agierenden Industrieunternehmen

  • Konzeption und Design von effizienten Prozessen, Organisations- & Governance-Strukturen sowie Kennzahlensystemen zur Realisierung der integrierten Geschäftsplanung

  • Implementierung und technische Umsetzung der Ergebnisse entlang der gesamten Supply Chain gemeinsam mit Technologieexperten

  • Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Erstklassiger Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik,

  • (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Logistik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Berater oder Experte im Bereich Supply Chain Management

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von SCM Projekten

  • Kreativität zur Erarbeitung kundenspezifischer Lösungsansätze

  • Erfahrungen in der  Anwendung von  Prozessmanagement Methoden, wie bspw. Lean / Six Sigma, Kaizen, Proessmodellierung, Organisationsentwicklung und Change Management

  • Interesse an innovativen Themen sowie die Bereitschaft, sich in neue Lösungen einzuarbeiten  

  • Die Fähigkeit Prozessverständnis und IT-Innovationen/Technologien kundenwirksam und zukunftsorientiert integrativ zu vereinen

  • Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten und ein hohes Maß an Abstraktionsvermögen

  • Reisebereitschaft, auch für gelegentliche Auslandseinsätze

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Der Bereich System Landscape Transformation (SLT) der cbs ist eine der tragenden Säulen unseres Beratungs- und Produktangebots. Dabei bietet cbs einen ganzheitlichen Transformationsansatz – von der Strategieableitung über die Prozessdefinition bis hin zur Implementierung und Transformation liefern wir alles aus einer Hand. Dabei ist unseren Kunden unter anderem eins besonders wichtig: minimale Systemausfallzeiten. Unsere SLT Berater mit Fokus auf SAP System Performance Optimierung unterstützen das Team und den Kunden bei der Minimierung der Migrationslaufzeit. Ob Datenkonvertierungen, Migrationen zwischen SAP-Systemen oder von non-SAP nach SAP – der Bereich SLT begleitet und berät unter Einsatz unserer Standardsoftware cbs ET Enterprise Transformer for SAP S/4HANA® unsere Kunden auf fachlicher und technischer Ebene auf ihrem individuellen Weg der digitalen Daten- und Systemtransformation.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort erfahrene (Senior) Consultant SAP System Performance Optimisation (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich SLT (System Landscape Transformation). Werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und genieße die damit verbundenen Freiheiten innerhalb des Unternehmens.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Gestalte die Zukunft moderner SAP-Landschaften in anspruchsvollen Transformations- und Innovationsprojekten im Cloud- und On-Premise-Umfeld

  • Trage mit System-Performance-Analysen und nachhaltigen Optimierungen zu effizienten und zukunftssicheren SAP-Systemlandschaften bei

  • Erweitere gemeinsam mit uns das Know-how im Bereich SAP System Performance und System Landscape Transformation

  • Entwickle innovative Strategien für eine proaktive und automatisierte Performance-Optimierung

  • Werde Teil eines motivierten Teams, das Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und persönliche Entwicklung lebt

  • Teile Dein Wissen in Trainings und Coachings und präge die Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden und Best Practices


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich SAP Basis / SAP Performance Optimierung und Know-how in SAP-Architekturen

  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Unix-, Windows und Datenbankadministration

  • Grundlegende ABAP-Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus

  • Technisches Verständnis auf Ebene von SAP-Tabellen

  • Erfahrung mit SAP-Installationen und Systemkopien sowie modernen Cloud-Technologien (z.B. SAP RISE) ist wünschenswert

  • Eigeninitiative, Neugier und Lernbereitschaft sowie Interesse an Projektarbeit, Prozessoptimierung und der erfolgreichen Einführung von KI-Lösungen im Unternehmensumfeld.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems ...

jobs.title: Montageplaner (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du arbeitest gerne genau, strukturiert und praxisnah? Du kennst dich mit HKLS-Materialien, Montageabläufen und technischen Details aus und möchtest Pläne erstellen, die auf der Baustelle wirklich funktionieren?

Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig.

Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Montageplaner (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS), der Materialverständnis, eine genaue Ausarbeitung mit einer ausführungsreifen Planung verbindet. Bei uns geht es nicht nur darum, Leitungen zu zeichnen, sondern durchdachte, umsetzbare und nachvollziehbare Montageunterlagen zu erstellen.

Aufgaben:

  • Du erstellst Montagepläne und Ausführungsunterlagen im Bereich HKLS in 2D und 3D.
  • Du arbeitest technische Vorgaben, Schemata, Grundrisse, Modelle und Planungsunterlagen in umsetzbare Montagepläne aus.
  • Du achtest auf Leitungsführungen, Einbausituationen, Kollisionspunkte, Revisionsmöglichkeiten und eine praxisgerechte Ausführung.
  • Du berücksichtigst Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formstücke, Armaturen, Dämmungen, Befestigungen, Brandschutzanforderungen und bauliche Gegebenheiten.
  • Du prüfst Planungsstände auf Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit und technische Umsetzbarkeit.
  • Du koordinierst dich persönlich, telefonisch oder online mit Projektbeteiligten und hältst die wesentlichen Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar fest.
  • Du dokumentierst offene Punkte, Änderungen und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar, forderst notwendige Entscheidungen proaktiv ein und schaffst die Voraussetzungen, um selbstständig weiterarbeiten zu können.
  • Du arbeitest mit CAD-/BIM-Tools und hilfst mit, unsere digitalen Planungsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation:

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich HKLS, Gebäudetechnik – idealerweise aus einem Installationsunternehmen, der Montage, Bauleitung oder Baustellenpraxis.
  • Du kommst aus der Ausführung und möchtest dich stärker in Richtung Technik, Planung und Montageplanung weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Montageplanung, Ausführungsplanung oder als Bauleiter im Bereich Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung und Sanitär.
  • Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Normen, Produkte, Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formteile, Befestigungen, Dämmungen, Armaturen und Montageabläufe mit.
  • Du kannst 2D Pläne lesen und Zusammenhänge verstehen und Details so ausarbeiten, dass sie ohne Rückfragen mit dem Plan auf der Baustelle baubar sind.
  • Du denkst nicht nur zeichnerisch, sondern auch baustellen-, montage- und ausführungsorientiert.
  • Du arbeitest genau, strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit AutoCAD, Revit, Plancal Nova oder vergleichbaren CAD-/BIM-Systemen.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits:

  • Anspruchsvolle HKLS-Projekte mit hoher technischer Tiefe, bei denen Genauigkeit zählt und es ausdrücklich erwünscht ist, Fehler, Unklarheiten und Verbesserungspotenziale aktiv anzusprechen.
  • Ein Aufgabenbereich, in dem Genauigkeit, Erfahrung und Materialverständnis wirklich zählen.
  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel, digitale Planungsprozesse und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich BIM.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung und Technik.
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem praxisnahes Denken, saubere Ausarbeitung und technische Qualität geschätzt werden.
  • Die Möglichkeit, Standards, Vorlagen und Arbeitsabläufe aktiv mitzuverbessern.
  • Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur Pläne erstellt, sondern technische Details versteht und Montageunterlagen so ausarbeitet, dass sie für Projektteam und Baustelle echten Nutzen bringen.

Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Bolt, Statista, Neura Robotics and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base, with well over 100 in the DACH region, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about shaping the future of lottery experiences.

 

LOTTO24 is Germany’s leading online provider of state-licensed lottery products, offering customers convenient and secure access to popular games like LOTTO 6aus49, Eurojackpot, and GlücksSpirale. As a trusted partner of the state lotteries, LOTTO24 ensures that every ticket sold helps support charitable, social, and community projects across Germany. By combining ease of play, trusted security, and meaningful social contributions, LOTTO24 exemplifies ZEAL’s vision of making lottery participation more accessible while giving back to society.

The role:

As our Senior Brand Manager, you take end-to-end ownership of bringing our brand and marketing strategy to life through impactful, large-scale consumer campaigns. You translate strategic priorities and brand challenges into concrete campaign strategies and own their end-to-end execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, agencies, and external partners, you combine strategic thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making to strengthen brand positioning, drive growth, and deliver measurable business impact.

Your tasks:

• Translate brand and marketing priorities into campaign strategies, creative concepts and actionable briefs

• Collaborate closely with Media, CRM, Creative and Product teams to ensure a consistent brand experience

• Own and execute large-scale, integrated consumer campaigns across high-reach channels such as TV, online video and OOH

• Own creative development and production, managing agencies, partners and our internal Creative Studio

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

The Vice President of Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in our marketing strategy through the positioning and packaging of our products and services. They will play an integral part in shaping and executing our go-to-market strategy, driving product adoption, enabling our GTM teams, and ensuring our solutions meet the evolving needs of our customers, members and providers. This role requires a visionary leader with a deep passion for mental health, exceptional marketing acumen, and a proven track record of success in B2B environments. Our category is an increasingly competitive one and it will be your responsibility to ensure we bring differentiation to life in novel, and inspiring stories that solidify our position as the category leader.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive product marketing strategy that aligns with the company's business objectives and growth targets.

  • Partner closely with the CxO and broader extended leadership team to position us for future horizons and new audiences in a way that builds brand credibility and opportunities.

  • Lead and develop a team of product marketers across positioning, enablement,competitive intelligence and market research, and operations to execute on our ambitious growth goals and innovation strategy.

  • Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and potential threats in the mental health sector.

  • Define and communicate the unique value proposition of our products, ensuring clear and compelling messaging across all channels.

  • Lead the development and execution of go-to-market plans for new product launches, ensuring successful adoption and market penetration.

  • Work closely with product management, sales, customer success, and other departments to ensure alignment and drive cohesive marketing initiatives.

  • Leverage customer feedback, data analytics, and industry insights to inform product development and marketing strategies.

  • Oversee the creation of high-impact marketing materials, including sales collateral, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership content.

  • Provide the sales team with the tools, training, and resources they need to effectively sell and position our products.

  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of product marketing efforts and drive continuous improvement.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We’re looking for an HR Generalist who can support our team members and help ensure our HR processes run smoothly. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key HR functions, including benefits administration, payroll support, employment law compliance, and employee relations. You’ll serve as a trusted resource for team members, helping navigate HR-related questions while ensuring our policies and processes are consistent, compliant, and effective. As part of a small, growing company, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving our HR processes and helping create a positive team member experience.

This fully remote role reports to our Director of Operations, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for team members, answering questions and providing guidance on company policies and other employment-related matters

  • Administer employee benefits in partnership with brokers and vendors, including open enrollment, qualifying life events, and resolving benefits-related issues

  • Maintain accurate, confidential employee records in HR systems and assist the payroll team with payroll adjustments

  • Manage HR compliance with federal and state employment laws, unemployment insurance, workers' compensation, accommodation requests, and leave administration, involving legal counsel when appropriate and making informed recommendations to leadership

  • Stay current on federal and state employment laws and HR market trends

  • Coordinate state registrations for our fully-remote organization across multiple jurisdictions, using our existing systems and vendors

  • Review and update the employee handbook, HR policies, and internal documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance

  • Handle day-to-day employee relations matters, supporting team members and managers in addressing workplace concerns, documenting issues and resolutions, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.

  • Support performance management, compensation reviews, and employee engagement initiatives, including surveys and feedback analysis

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the overall team member experience

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR administration, or a related HR generalist role.

  • Hands-on experience administering employee benefits, supporting payroll processes, and managing employee relations.

  • Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws, including ADA, FMLA, workers' compensation, and multi-state HR compliance requirements.

  • Experience supporting performance management processes, including performance reviews, talent assessments, and employee engagement initiatives.

  • stark wachsender Bereich in dem Du eine zentrale Rolle spielst

Wir suchen nicht einfach jemanden, der Projekte verwaltet, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen, technische Herausforderungen lösen und gemeinsam mit einem Team etwas bewegen möchte.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit und Teilzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Joberg

Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte.

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode (Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment und die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass sie mit jedem neuen Kunden besser werden und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

  • Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews.

  • Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen.

  • Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten.

  • Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten.

  • Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make.

  • Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen.

Woran wir merken, dass du es bist

  • Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage.

  • Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten.

  • Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr, desto besser.

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :)

Was du von uns bekommst

jobs.title: Principal Field Engineer, US Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:

  • Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships

  • Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them

  • Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room

  • Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is

  • Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa

  • Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help

  • Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one

  • Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline

  • Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it

  • 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or de...

In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations across Outbound, Inbound and Delivery. Your responsibilities will include people management, health and safety, workforce scheduling, and ensuring efficient processes and continuous improvement. Your leadership skills will be essential in supporting our sustainable growth in a dynamic environment.

  • €45 monthly tax-free allowance (via become.1)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations — from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering thousands of products same-day requires an operational backbone built on advanced warehouse automation, goods-to-person (G2P) systems, and highly efficient intralogistics.

The Automation department leads large-scale warehouse projects across the Group, enabling safe, high-performing, and customer-centric fulfillment operations in all our markets. As Head of Warehouse Projects, you will own the delivery execution of major CapEx implementation projects — from retrofits and G2P integrations in legacy sites to full layout rollouts for new expansion sites across Europe.

You are the single point of accountability for bringing approved designs to life. Taking an signed-off operational layout, you will drive the entire program through site readiness, vendor management, budget control, and commissioning — delivering fully operational sites on time, on budget, and ready for local teams.

Why this role is exciting

  • Single point of ownership: You own the delivery execution end-to-end — holding ultimate accountability for whether complex, multi-million euro automation projects land on time and perform as expected.

  • Cutting-edge automation: Direct hands-on delivery of large-scale CapEx projects involving advanced goods-to-person (G2P/AS-RS) systems, conveyors, racking, and automated material handling.

  • European expansion scope: Play a central role in scaling Rohlik’s operational footprint across multiple European countries.

  • High organizational visibility: Interface directly with leadership across Automation, Engineering, Procurement, Facilities, and Operations.

  • High-impact execution: Transform theoretical engineering designs into fully functioning, high-throughput fulfillment hubs.

  • Program & Schedule Management: Drive project plans, schedules, budgets, resourcing, and critical-path milestones, taking accountability for keeping all deliverables on track.

  • Vendor & Site Governance: Manage external contractors, equipment vendors, and integrators on-site, ensuring quality standards and delivery commitments are met.

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Manager (Last Mile)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Our mission is simple to make everyday shopping faster, easier, and more sustainable. We combine smart technology, efficient logistics, and a genuine love for great food. From local bakeries and farmers to our own private labels, we make sure every product that reaches our customers is fresh, safe, and top-quality.

We’re committed to sustainability and supporting local communities, reducing packaging, and working closely with small producers. For our customers, Rohlik Group is more than just shopping, it's a better way to enjoy good food every day.

Department Overview

The Operational Excellence team drives continuous improvement, process standardization, and innovation across Last Mile operations. We support local teams in implementing group standards, solving systemic challenges in routing, loading, and delivery, and enabling sustainable growth as we scale.

 

Role Overview

As Operational Excellence Manager for Last Mile, you will own the design and delivery of a 3 to 6 month continuous improvement roadmap for last mile operations. You will lead adoption of group standards, embed best practices, and deliver sustainable improvements in delivery efficiency, cost per order, and on-time performance. You will partner with central and local stakeholders to find the real bottlenecks in the last mile flow, from route assignment and loading through to the delivery itself, and roll out scalable solutions across sites.

 

What we expect from you

  • Owns the last mile improvement roadmap and makes sure initiatives are delivered on time.

  • Owns initiatives end to end, including group-wide projects: frames the problem, builds and defends the business case, runs the pilot, measures and evaluates the impact, and scales what works across sites.

  • Leads adoption of operational best practices in loading, routing, and delivery through coaching and influence.

  • Partners with group-level development and performance management teams and local site teams to coordinate projects and current performance.

  • Reads the problem in the real operation as well as in the data, tells the true cause apart from the noise, and turns the fix into a standard.

  • Documents processes (VSM, process maps).

 

What we look for

 

Required

  • 5+ years of operational experience owning projects or programs in the last mile for retail.

  • Strong leadership and coaching capability.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.

  • Analytical thinker who can define metrics, read data, and separate cause from correlation.

  • Project management experience.

  • Willingness to travel 2 to 3 days per week across sites.

jobs.title: Sales Business Development Representative - German Speaking (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Compliance is what stands between a European company and its next enterprise deal. Kertos clears it. Information security, data protection, and AI management run in one system covering ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, the EU AI Act, and more, with certified experts on the project from start to finish.

 

KAIA, our AI assistant, drafts the policies, checks the evidence, and monitors the controls, eliminating roughly 80% of manual work.

 

400+ customers, including Personio, Enpal, Flink, and Blacklane use Kertos. Every audit with us has been successful. A powerhouse of 75+ people in Munich and Berlin and a €14M Series A behind us. We are hiring for what comes next!

Deine Mission bei Kertos

Du wirst ein wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Growth Teams und bist Ambassador unserer Mission, Europas führende SaaS-Lösung für eine vollautomatische Compliance zu etablieren. Unterstützt von führenden VCs, haben wir letztes Jahr ein Wachstum von 4x erzielt und sind nun auf dem Weg die führende Compliance Plattform in Europa zu werden - und dafür brauchen wir dich! Du sorgst für eine volle Pipeline, qualifizierst und begeisterst Leads im Erstkontakt von unserer Lösung und treibst so gemeinsam mit dem Team unser Umsatzwachstum voran.

  • Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du generierst Opportunities über Messages, Calls oder andere kreative Kampagnen und bringst sie durch geschicktes Prospecting in unsere Pipeline

  • Strategische Lead-Generierung: Du nutzt moderne Tools wie Cognism, Amplemarket, Clay und HubSpot, um zielgerichtet und effizient neue B2B-Kunden zu identifizieren und für uns zu begeistern

  • Pitching auf C-Level: Du sprichst mit Entscheider*innen aus Startups, Scale-ups und Mittelstandsunternehmen und überzeugst sie von unserem Produkt

  • Data-Driven Selling: Du analysierst Metriken, optimierst deine Outreach-Strategie und lernst, datenbasiert bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales & Marketing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und dem Growth-Team zusammen, um eine nahtlose Customer Journey zu schaffen

 

Deine Skills, Motivation und Mentalität, die dich erfolgreich machen

 

  • Du hast idealerweise bereits erste Sales / Business Development Erfahrung im B2B SaaS gesammelt, z. B. als SDR, BDR oder in einer ähnlichen Position

  • Du musst (noch) keine Closing-Erfahrung haben – aber gerne die Motivation, dich in Richtung Account Executive weiterzuentwickeln

  • Dank deiner starken zwischenmenschlichen und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten fällt es dir leicht, Beziehungen aufzubauen

  • Dein Denken ist unternehmerisch geprägt – kreativ und stets auf der Suche nach neuen Business Opportunities

  • Du hast ein High-Performance-Mindset und bist gerne Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das sich ständig pusht, Best Practices teilt und sich gegenseitig zum Erfolg treibt

jobs.title: Python Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du hast in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python gearbeitet – Code geschrieben, Anwendungen automatisiert, vielleicht sogar objektorientiert entwickelt – und willst dieses Wissen jetzt weitergeben, statt es nur für eigene Projekte zu nutzen? Als Python-Tutor/Lehrkraft begleitest Du unsere Teilnehmenden fachlich und didaktisch durch ihre Programmier-Weiterbildung: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen, hilfst ihnen über die Hürden bei Übungen und Projekten hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass sie am Ende nicht nur Python verstehen, sondern selbstständig damit arbeiten können.

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback. Durch den engen Kontakt zu den Lernenden trägst Du außerdem aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Trainingsprogramme bei – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Coaching Team Lead, dem Learning Team und weiteren Schnittstellen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung von Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich)

  • Vermittlung und Vertiefung von Trainingsinhalten in Live-Sessions, Webinaren, Classrooms und individueller Lernbegleitung

  • Begleitung bei Unsicherheiten im Lernprozess sowie in Übungen und Projekten

  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen sowie Entscheidung über den Trainingserfolg

  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Weiterentwicklung von Lernmaterialien rund um objektorientierte Programmierung, Python, Jupyter Notebooks, Entwicklungsumgebungen (z. B. VS Code), Git, Bash/Scripting sowie GenAI-Tools; Kenntnisse in SQL sind ein Plus

  • Qualitätssicherung bestehender Trainings inkl. Feedback ans Learning-Team

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions und Unterstützung neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eines fach verwandten Bereichs oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Praxiskenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung (z. B. Webentwicklung, Datenverarbeitung, Automatisierung) sowie Kenntnisse in objektorientierter Programmierung

  • Sehr gute Programmierfähigkeiten in Python, Vertrautheit im Umgang mit Jupyter Notebooks und IDEs (z. B. VS Code) sowie gute Praxiskenntnisse in Bash/Scripting

  • Erfahrung mit Versionskontrolle (Git/GitHub) und gängigen Entwicklungsumgebungen

  • SQL-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung im Einsatz von GenAI-Tools sind von Vorteil

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen

  • Verständnis für didaktische Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Kenntnisse in Python, SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind ein Plus

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

 

Das bieten wir Dir

jobs.title: Sales Manager – SaaS/B2B (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

 

Als Sales Manager (f/m/d) bist du ein zentraler Treiber des Umsatzwachstums bei plancraft. Du arbeitest mit qualifizierten, eingehenden Leads und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.



Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du bearbeitest qualifizierte Leads mit erkennbarem Bedarf.

  • Du führst Produktdemos durch, analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

  • Du berätst potenzielle Kund:innen strukturiert und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess.

  • Du schließt Deals eigenständig ab – vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick und arbeitest strukturiert mit unserem CRM.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Kundenerfahrung zu schaffen.

Bei plancraft erwarten dich klare und transparente Karrierepfade – z. B. von Junior Sales Manager bis Senior Sales Manager – und du kannst dich bei uns mit klarer Perspektive und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Unsere Gehaltsstruktur ist transparent aufgebaut: Je nach Erfahrungslevel liegt dein On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 60.000 € und 87.500 €, bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 62.500 € sowie einer variablen Komponente zwischen 15.000 € und 25.000 €.

 

DEIN PROFIL

 

Must-haves

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B- oder SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umgang mit warmen Leads oder Closing.

  • Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, API Integrations (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.


We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager, API Integrations to join our Supply domain, more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonizing data structures and building revenue-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scale our business, therefore our focus is on innovation and automation.

What you will do:

  • Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities.

  • Automate and innovate our existing inventory (our API product is already used by big players).

  • Own scoping and management of onboarding new carriers; establish wider scope throughout Asia.

  • Take a lead role in defining and challenging strategic decisions.

  • Contribute to the team with process improvements (e.g. Jira, reporting etc.).

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders (internal/external – C-level).


Workplace: Berlin- hybrid, Germany - remote.


Who you are:

  • Product Management background: 3+ years of professional experience, with hands-on exposure to the technical side of the product (APIs / data products) — experience with complex products is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: strong track record influencing without direct authority, while comfortably context-switching and showing proactivity and ownership across your responsibilities.

  • Management skills: solid grounding across product, process, project, developed within cross-functional teams.

  • Background: technical or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; fluent in English, both verbal and written.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with exciting opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. We work with a diverse range of clients, including startups, digital agencies, and technology-driven businesses across industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and AI.

Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with our clients, where you become an integral, in-house member of their team.

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Job Summary

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. You will collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data is reliable, accessible, and of high quality across the organisation.

This is a great opportunity for professionals who enjoy tackling complex data challenges and building robust systems that power business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL and ELT data pipelines.
  • Develop and optimize data architectures, databases, and data warehouses.
  • Integrate data from various sources, APIs, and third-party platforms.
  • Maintain data quality, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and security.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data pipelines and workflows.
  • Work closely with analytics, engineering, and business teams to identify and meet data requirements.
  • Establish data governance standards and best practices for data management.
  • Improve data storage, processing speeds, and query performance.
  • Support business intelligence, reporting, and analytics projects.
  • Maintain documentation of data models, workflows, and technical processes.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or a similar field.
  • Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of database management.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, Scala, or other relevant programming languages.
  • Practical experience with ETL/ELT tools and building data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks.
  • Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect.
  • Understanding of data modelling, governance, and data quality best practices.
  • Experience handling large datasets and working with distributed systems is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication abilities.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Benefits

💰 Competitive compensation: Tailored to your experience, technical skills, and location.

🌎 Fully remote work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.

🚀 Career development: Join innovative companies and contribute to meaningful, high-impact projects.

📈 Long-term potential: Grow your career alongside ambitious, expanding global organisations.

🧠 Ongoing learning: Gain exposure to emerging data technologies, cloud platforms, and large-scale data environments.

🤝 Collaborative environment: Work with skilled engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.

⚙️ Modern tech stack: Work with cutting-edge data tools, technologies, and cloud-based solutions.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Germany.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Germany.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

  • Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Germany.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.


Accountabilities

You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

  • Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do
  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems.
  • Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware.
  • Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems.
  • Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces.
  • Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning.
  • Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error.
  • Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software.

    • Who you are
  • An senior embedded software engineer with 8+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems.
  • Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints.
  • Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers.
  • Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them.
  • Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour.
  • Curious about FPGA-adjacent workflows and comfortable interfacing with low-level logic when required.
  • Motivated by building flight-critical software in a small team where your code directly affects system behaviour.

    • What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

jobs.title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Build what most people think is impossible.

Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability.

We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people.

Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before.

We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment.


The Opportunity

This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do.

You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes.

Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as:

  • Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations.

    • The exact problem matters less than how you approach it.

    You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions.

    If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it.


    Who we are looking for

    We are not simply looking for the highest grades. We are looking for people with exceptional potential. People who are deeply curious. People who ask why something has to be done a certain way. People who are not restricted by what they already know, what has been done before, or what others believe to be possible.

    You might be a great fit if:

  • You learn extraordinarily quickly.
  • You enjoy solving difficult problems with incomplete information.
  • You naturally break problems down to first principles.
  • You build things because you are curious about whether they can be built.
  • You are comfortable being wrong, learning quickly and trying again.
  • You care deeply about the quality of your work.
  • You want feedback and are equally comfortable giving it.
  • You can communicate clearly with people very different from yourself.
  • You want responsibility rather than supervision.
  • You would rather create something than inherit a finished system.

    • What we value
  • Mission alignment.
  • Exceptional subject matter ability.
  • The ability to execute in ambiguity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼
Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im eigenen Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt nach Hause: einfach, schnell und stilvoll. Unsere Projekte und Brand-Kampagnen wachsen rasant, und dafür brauchen wir vor allem eines: mehr Execution Power.

Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.
 
Als Senior Brand Activation Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Community-Brand-Aktivierungen und Offline-Kampagnen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Setups, steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen echte, messbare Brand-Momente werden. Die Rolle ist hands-on und operativ stark und gleichzeitig strategisch entscheidend dafür, wie Doonails als Marke wahrgenommen wird.

Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️
Du bringst Struktur, Klarheit und Energie in unsere Brand-Projekte und ermöglichst eine starke Zusammenarbeit im Team. Mit hochwertigen Offline-Aktivierungen machst du Doonails erlebbar und steigerst unsere Brand Awareness spürbar. Gleichzeitig baust du Brand Activation als skalierbaren Bereich mit klarer Ownership weiter aus – für Qualität, Konsistenz und Tempo in allem, was wir gemeinsam umsetzen.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Brand Activation & Campaign Management

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Planung von Events, Pop-ups, Tours, Launches und Offline-Kampagnen.

    • End-to-End-Projektmanagement

  • Von der ersten Timeline über die Budgetüberwachung bis hin zum finalen Qualitätscheck behältst du alle Fäden sicher in der Hand.

    • Koordination externer Partner & Dienstleister

  • Das lückenlose Briefing und die Verhandlung externer Partner, darunter Locations, Messebauer, Produktionsteams, Deko und Technik, fallen voll in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.

    • Markenauftritt

  • In engem Schulterschluss mit dem Brand Design Team stellst du sicher, dass Doonails an jedem physischen Touchpoint konsistent, hochwertig und stilvoll erlebbar wird.

    • Steigerung der Brand Awareness

  • Die gezielte Steigerung unserer Brand Awareness treibst du aktiv voran, machst Erfolge anhand klarer KPIs messbar und leitest wertvolle Reportings ab.

    • Stakeholder Management & Kommunikation

  • Sowohl intern über verschiedene Departments hinweg als auch extern gegenüber Kooperationspartnern fungierst du als souveräne, lösungsorientierte Drehscheibe.


    • Das bringst du mit 🤝

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Beauty, Fashion oder Lifestyle und nachweisbare Erfahrung in Brand Activation & Event Management

  • Projektmanagement: Exzellente Projektmanagement-Skills im Multi-Projekt-Setup

  • Partner- & Netzwerkkompetenz: Erfahrung im Vendor-, Agentur- und Dienstleister-Management

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Starkes Stakeholder Management

  • Reisebereitschaft: für den Aufbau, die Begleitung und das Monitoring unserer Events, Pop-ups und Kampagnen direkt am Geschehen, damit jeder Markenmoment perfekt sitzt.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Westernacher’s SAP Transportation Management practice and help leading companies transform complex transportation and logistics processes. You will work on end-to-end SAP TM implementations across different industries, contributing your expertise within an experienced international consulting team.


How You’ll Make an Impact
  • Design and implement end-to-end transportation management processes using SAP TM.
  • Take ownership of functional workstreams, from requirements analysis and solution design through configuration, testing and go-live support.
  • Translate business requirements into practical SAP TM solutions and functional specifications.
  • Facilitate customer workshops, evaluate solution options and provide clear recommendations for process improvement.
  • Collaborate with customers, developers and cross-functional SAP teams to ensure integrated, high-quality solutions.
  • Plan and deliver project work packages while contributing to knowledge sharing and the development of less experienced colleagues.

    • Your Expertise
  • At least 5 to 7 years of relevant SAP TM consulting experience.
  • Functional expertise demonstrated across at least three full-cycle SAP implementations.
  • Strong SAP TM configuration and solution design skills.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end transportation and logistics processes, supported by relevant cross-module knowledge.

    • Competitive remuneration package.

As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Platform & Partner Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.


What You Will Do
  • Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and development of systems that enable and enhance partner and platform experiences across devices and integrations
  • Drive complex technical initiatives that span multiple studios or a full mission — particularly where coordination cost, architectural sprawl, or competing local optimizations are part of the problem
  • Create leverage by unifying fragmented approaches, retiring duplicative systems, and establishing the standards and platforms that enable multiple studios move faster without reinventing foundations — judging where consolidation creates leverage and where local autonomy is the better choice
  • Define and influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries and bring other senior engineers along in executing it
  • Collaborate with engineering, product and design leaders across the Experience Mission and beyond to identify shared opportunities, align technical direction and reduce duplication
  • Shape how AI transforms the software development lifecycle and pioneer AI-native workflows and capabilities that bridge engineering, product, and design

    • Who You Are
  • You have deep experience designing, building and operating distributed systems that serve users at scale
  • You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built
  • You thrive in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and can identify where technical investment will create the greatest leverage across teams and systems
  • You care deeply about reliable, high-quality user experiences powered by data and personalization
  • You actively explore how AI reshapes how we build, not just what we build, and can turn emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how teams work
  • You bring a thoughtful, collaborative, inclusive mindset and actively contribute to a positive team culture

    • Where You Will Be
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. For this role, you can be based anywhere in EMEA where Spotify has a work location (excluding France due to on-call restrictions).
  • The team collaborates within Central European and GMT time zones.

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum Recruiting & KI (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben im Praktikum

Ich bin Leon, selbstständiger Personalvermittler im Raum München. Ich besetze Stellen vom Handwerk bis IT, dazu Projekte im Executive Bereich. Bei mir lernst du das komplette Handwerk der Personalvermittlung von innen, nicht als Zuschauer, sondern mit eigener Verantwortung ab Woche eins.

Dein Kernprojekt ist der Ausbau unserer Neukundengewinnung über persönlich adressierte Briefe an Geschäftsführer, gestartet in der Region München, inzwischen deutschlandweit im Ausbau. Ein Kanal, der bei uns nachweislich funktioniert.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du steuerst die Firmenrecherche: Die Fleißarbeit übernimmt KI, du prüfst die Ergebnisse und entscheidest, wer angeschrieben wird. Wie das geht, zeige ich dir

  • Du bereitest die Briefe vor, bis zum druckfertigen Dokument

  • Du übernimmst die Nachfässe über LinkedIn und andere Kanäle und hältst nach, wer reagiert

  • Du hältst unsere Pipeline sauber und weißt jederzeit, welche Firma wo im Prozess steht

  • Claude, Gemini und Co sind bei uns Standardwerkzeuge, die Abos bekommst du von mir gestellt

Weil du Vollzeit dabei bist, bleibt es nicht bei einem Thema. Je nachdem, was dir liegt, übernimmst du mit der Zeit weitere Bereiche: Aufbau unseres Instagram Kanals, Kandidatensuche über Indeed und LinkedIn, erste eigene Ansprachen, später auch Telefonate und Kandidatengespräche. Du siehst bei mir, wie Akquise, Kundengespräche und Mandatssteuerung in der Praxis laufen und machst Schritt für Schritt selbst.

Was du mitbringst

  • Dein Studium sieht ein Pflichtpraktikum oder Praxissemester vor, bevorzugt in Psychologie, BWL oder Sales

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und prüfst KI Ergebnisse, statt sie blind zu übernehmen

  • Erfahrung mit Claude / (Code), Gemini, Higgsfield oder ähnlichen Werkzeugen ist ein Plus

  • Telefonerfahrung aus Vertrieb oder Service ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

Was ich dir biete

  • 99% remote, alternativ gern vor Ort in Grafing bei München, auf Wunsch mit Platz im Coworking

  • Bezahltes Pflichtpraktikum

  • Flexible Zeiten, Klausuren und Uni gehen vor

  • KI Abos gestellt, und darüber hinaus: Willst du ein neues Tool ausprobieren, übernehme ich die Kosten bis zu einem festen Budget. Du arbeitest mit dem modernsten Setup, das es im Recruiting gerade gibt

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

  • Bonus bei Erfolg: Trägst du zu einer Vermittlung bei, beteilige ich dich zusätzlich am Honorar

  • Direktes Feedback vom Inhaber statt von einer Abteilung, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Abschlussarbeit bei uns: Du kannst im Anschluss deine Bachelor oder Masterarbeit in Kooperation mit uns schreiben, mit Praxisthema aus Recruiting oder Personalmarketing, Zugang zu anonymisierten Daten und mir als festem Ansprechpartner im Unternehmen.
