jobs.title: Construction Project Manager, Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for an experienced Development/Construction Lead to manage clinic development projects across Germany. This role will oversee the full lifecycle of projects, from concept and planning through to operational delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The role requires strong knowledge of the German construction environment, particularly building permits and local project processes.

What You'll Delivery in the First 6-12 Months

  • Lead clinic construction and development projects across Germany from concept through to operational handover.

  • Manage contractors, architects, and consultants while ensuring quality and timeline delivery.

  • Navigate German building permit processes and local regulatory requirements.

  • Monitor project budgets and capital expenditure, ensuring cost control on projects typically ranging from €5M–€15M.

  • Report project progress, risks, and issues to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Coordinate site preparation and oversee construction activities across multiple clinic locations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10–15 years’ experience in construction, development, or project management.

  • Fluent German speaker with strong understanding of local construction and permit processes.

  • Background in commercial, retail, or real estate development environments (e.g., flexible office, commercial fit-outs, retail spaces).

  • Proven experience delivering projects from concept through to operational launch.

Your work will directly shape how we understand acquisition performance, allocate budgets, and scale efficiently across markets. You will join a lean, 4 person team working on mission-critical initiatives in a fast-growing, design-driven environment.

At PERGOLUX, we value integrity, innovation, ambition, and unity — and we build systems with the same care and precision as our products.

  • Implement Multi-Touch Attribution models and lay the groundwork for Marketing Mix Models that inform budget allocation and channel-level investment.

jobs.title: Senior Global Controller
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Global Controller, you will help build the financial foundation that supports PERGOLUX’s global expansion. You’ll work at the intersection of analysis, structure, and strategy — contributing directly to the financial clarity and operational excellence of a premium outdoor-living brand inspired by Scandinavian design. As we continue scaling across Europe, Australia, North America, and South America, your analytical mindset and precision will play a key role in strengthening our financial processes and insights.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

  • Participate in budgeting and forecasting processes to support strategic planning.

  • Perform variance analysis, KPI reporting, and ad-hoc financial evaluations.

  • Maintain and enhance controlling processes, tools, and standardized reporting structures.

  • Assist with liquidity planning and cash-flow forecasting in a high-growth environment.

What You’ll Bring

  • Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Controlling — or relevant advanced training in accounting/controlling.

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in controlling or finance.

  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel; experience with BI tools is a plus.

  • Basic knowledge of HGB or IFRS is advantageous.

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a structured, solution-oriented working style.

  • Experience working with Lucanet.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary – Your success is rewarded with strong compensation.

  • Real Ownership – Take meaningful responsibility in your role and directly influence key business outcomes.

  • International Team – Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and ideas.

  • Outdoor Lifestyle Discounts – Enjoy exclusive discounts on PERGOLUX products.

  • Fast-Track Career Opportunities – As we scale quickly, you’ll have significant opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles.

  • Team Culture – Be part of regular team events, retreats, and a culture that celebrates wins—big and small.

  • Bike Leasing Program – Benefit from a sustainable and cost-effective bike leasing option to support commuting and an active lifestyle.

  • Company Pension - Plan for a stable future.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application and resume!
Learn more about life at PERGOLUX on PERGOLUX LinkedIn or apply via our PERGOLUX Career Page.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Patronus

Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Mehr als 25.000 Menschen verlassen sich bereits auf uns. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Als (Senior) Operations Manager – Abrechnung Pflegekassen Health Tech (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Partner & Payments Management Teams (aktuell 5 Personen) und berichtest direkt an unsere Senior Team Lead Partner & Payments Management. Wenn Pflegekassen die Kosten für die Patronus-Uhr übernehmen, steckt dahinter ein komplexer Prozess: vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme über die Bestätigung und die Abrechnung bis zum Zahlungseingang. Genau diesen geschäftskritischen Prozess verantwortest du – mit direktem Einfluss auf unseren Cashflow.

Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist. Wenn es dir genauso geht, bist du bei uns richtig!

Deine Mission

  • Du verantwortest die Abrechnung mit Pflegekassen End-to-End – vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme bis zum Zahlungseingang – und packst dabei selbst operativ mit an.

  • Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du prüfst Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und finanzielle Risiken früh und machst Zahlen und Prozesse mit einem aussagekräftigen Reporting transparent.

  • Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie sich unsere Abrechnung in Zukunft aufstellt – nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch in der Umsetzung.

Dein Talent

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld.

  • Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert.

  • Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern.

  • Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Plus:

  • Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Zapier, n8n) oder SQL-Grundkenntnisse

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

jobs.title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role:

You will join Quantum Systems’ Aircraft Domain, where we develop large airborne systems and bring them to operational readiness. At the heart of the domain is our multi-role aircraft programme, serving both civil and military applications. The Pulse P19, is our flagship product, with additional airborne system developments set to expand the domain’s product portfolio in the near future.

As a Front End Engineer, you will play a key role in our Aircraft Domain team, being responsible for building sleek, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces to enable real-time control and monitoring of our mission aircraft and their related systems.

While this role focuses on the development for the P19 and related aircraft, your work is conducted in close collaboration with the core development team, which drives the whole swarm robotics and sensor control distributed over multiple domains. Your work will directly contribute to the usability and efficiency of our cutting-edge robotics solutions.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and optimize frontend applications for controlling and visualizing robotic swarms and sensor data.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend systems.

  • Build intuitive, performant, and responsive user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks such as React or comparable web component frameworks.

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate designs into functional applications.

  • Ensure code quality, maintainability, and scalability through clean coding practices and code reviews.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize frontend performance for real-time applications.



What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and web component frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of modern web development tools, concepts, and practices.

  • Basic knowledge of backend systems and API integration.

  • Experience with custom web-based rendering engines.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and data visualization tools.

  • Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building user-friendly applications.

  • Nice-to-Have:

    • Experience with robotics, sensor data visualization, or real-time control systems.

    • Knowledge of state management libraries (e.g., Redux, MobX) and frontend build tools.

    • Familiarity with backend technologies such as Node.js or similar.

    • Understanding of testing frameworks and tools for front-end development.

    • Passion for aviation systems and experience with piloting or flight simulation.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and k...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes-AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

Your team ensures that enterprise customers are successful and happy using Sanity. This means working closely with technical leaders at our customers to align their strategic goals with implementation details; facilitating brainstorming sessions between editors, designers, and developers; and helping developers make decisions for their unique business needs.

In this role, you will take ownership of your customer relationships and drive both internal and external conversations. You'll also have the opportunity to learn more and develop expertise on the people's side of technology.

What you would do:

  • Lead onboarding workshops that are customized to each customer’s needs and background.

  • Proactively develop relationships with technical and product stakeholders at our customers.

  • Meet regularly with technical customers to demonstrate how new features work for the customer’s specific needs, answer their questions, and help them plan their Sanity implementation.

  • Work with account managers to develop expansion opportunities at existing customers

  • Support the new account sales cycle through technical workshops and proof of concept development

  • Create and share examples to help customers understand concepts and implement more quickly

  • Develop and maintain guides and learning modules to address common topics

  • Develop and maintain plugins for common integrations and implementation patterns

  • Represent clients’ requests and requirements to the internal product team

  • Work with Support Engineering to work through customer challenges and unblock specific scenarios

  • Support marketing and product research teams to connect with relevant customers and plan events and webinars


About you:

  • Based in Germany or the United Kingdom

  • You're fluent in both German and English

  • 3-5 years of experience in a software development role

  • Advanced experience with at least one of the following frameworks: React, Vue, Angular, Astro

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

You're early in your sales career and you'd like a product you can actually get curious about. We're hiring a German-speaking SDR to open up conversations with the teams building the next wave of content and AI products in the DACH region.

SDRs are the front door to Sanity. You'll start the conversations that become pipeline, and because we're growing quickly, you'll also help decide how those conversations should go. No script handed down from three years ago.

What you will do

  • Own your pipeline from day one
    You're not waiting for leads to land in your lap. You'll be out there, on the phone, in inboxes, sliding into LinkedIn DMs (professionally), starting real conversations with people who have real problems Sanity can solve. You find them, you qualify them, you build the pipeline.

  • Become the person who gets it
    Sanity isn't your average SaaS pitch. We're selling a new way of thinking about content: treat it like data, so AI and teams can actually do something with it. You'll get deep on the product, then put it in language that makes both developers and execs lean forward. In German and in English.

    This isn't a smile-and-dial role. Your frontline conversations shape messaging, strategy and the product roadmap. Marketing wants your feedback. Sales needs your handovers to be tight. Leadership is listening. What you hear on calls travels.

    Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn. You'll know your tools cold and use them to run a clean, sharp operation. Good data hygiene isn't glamorous, but it's what separates good SDRs from great ones.

    We're growing fast and the playbook isn't finished, because you'll help write it. Spot a better way to run outreach? Say so. We'll try it.

About you

  • You have previous experience in an SDR role or similar, out-bounding prospects, preferably in SaaS

  • You speak fluent German, and English

  • A target motivates you more than it worries you

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Director of B2B Marketing & Communications

100% ﻿Remote

We are seeking a Director of B2B Marketing & Communications to lead our B2B brand, content, communications, and industry presence.

This is a hands-on marketing leadership role focused on how the company is positioned and perceived externally across the legal and financial services industries. This is not a traditional social media role. You will own the broader B2B marketing strategy and help build the company's visibility, credibility, and reputation with key industry decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the company's B2B marketing and communications strategy.
  • Own the company LinkedIn page, organic content strategy, and content calendar.
  • Develop thought leadership and LinkedIn content for company executives.
  • Turn case studies, company milestones, performance data, and industry insights into compelling content.
  • Manage website content, company updates, and other external communications.
  • Develop and execute conference, sponsorship, booth, and event marketing initiatives.
  • Plan company-hosted industry events and targeted partner dinners.
  • Manage the PR agency relationship and coordinate media opportunities.
  • Identify and manage awards, rankings, speaking opportunities, and industry panels.
  • Develop industry reports and proprietary-data content.
  • Build an email/newsletter strategy as the B2B marketing program grows.
  • Coordinate designers, video/creative resources, agencies, and internal teams.
  • Maintain consistency in the company's brand, messaging, and external presence.

Ideal Background

  • 5–10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, brand, communications, or content.
  • Experience owning B2B marketing for a growing company, not simply managing social media.
  • Strong LinkedIn, content, and thought leadership experience.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills.
  • Ability to interview executives and turn their ideas into compelling content.
  • Experience managing PR agencies and external creative resources.
  • Experience with conferences, sponsorships, events, and industry marketing.
  • Experience developing case studies, reports, thought leadership, and marketing collateral.
  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on, with the ability to develop strategy and execute quickly.
  • Comfortable building credibility and visibility within a focused B2B market.

Example Projects

You might:

  • Build and execute a 90-day LinkedIn content calendar.
  • Turn a successful client case study into a LinkedIn carousel, website article, executive posts, email content, and conference collateral.
  • Interview an executive for 20 minutes and turn the conversation into several thought-leadership posts in their voice.
  • Coordinate the company's presence at a major industry conference, including the booth, sponsorship, pre- and post-event content, and a private dinner for prospective partners.

Experience in legal tech, legal marketing, performance marketing, lead generation, fintech, financial services, B2B SaaS, or agencies serving these industries is a strong plus.

Job Title: Data Science & Analytic Methodology SME

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Data Science & Analytic Methodology Subject Matter Experts to contribute to a high-impact project focused on advanced analytical pipelines and large language models (LLMs). In this role, you will apply your domain expertise to evaluate AI-generated outputs, assess analytical workflows, and help improve the accuracy, reliability, and performance of next-generation AI systems. Prior experience in AI is not required, although relevant technical experience is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Map large-scale analytical and pipeline integration scenarios to established taxonomies across key evaluation areas.

  3. Evaluate and grade responses based on source handling, reasoning quality, understanding of limitations, and practical utility.
  4. Identify and flag instances of model over-refusal that may disrupt legitimate analytical workflows or pipeline continuity.
  5. Document complex edge cases, emerging methodological challenges, and opportunities for improvement, providing actionable recommendations.
  6. Deliver clear, insightful written and verbal feedback to support iterative development and high-quality project outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  2. Proven experience conducting analysis at scale, with a strong understanding of automation failure modes and relevant evaluation metrics.
  3. Experience in teaching, mentoring, or providing technical leadership in data science or related analytical disciplines.
  4. Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to document methodologies clearly and communicate complex concepts in English.
  5. Familiarity with designing evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or assessment systems.
  6. Experience in defense, intelligence, or government analytical environments is highly valued.
  7. Ability to work effectively in distributed, international project environments with minimal clearance-related constraints.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines strong data science expertise with practical experience in analytical methodology, automation, and LLM integration. They can assess complex workflows, identify limitations and failure patterns, evaluate model performance, and provide actionable feedback to improve the reliability and effectiveness of AI-driven analytical systems.

jobs.title: Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Portugal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Portugal

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Technical Writer - End User Documentation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Technical Writer - End User Documentation develops and manages product training and knowledge content for a complex clinical trial technology platform. This role goes beyond technical writing. It requires understanding how functionality fits into end-user workflows and the broader content ecosystem. The Technical Writer - End User Documentation works closely with product owners, Customer Engagement, and technical team members to ensure training and knowledge materials are accurate, well-structured, and developed to a high standard.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, job aids, user guides, and training resources alongside each of the four annual software releases.

  • Use release overviews and release notes as the source of truth so content is complete and accurate at the time of each release.

  • Write clear, precise technical documentation that translates complex functionality into language users can understand.

  • Determine where new content belongs within the knowledge base, and how functionality connects across the platform, user roles, and processes.

  • Create training assets such as training presentations, training manuals, curriculum materials, and competency assessments. These are delivered as completed assets, not presented live.

  • Work with product owners, who serve as subject matter experts, to confirm accuracy. Incorporate review feedback from product owners and the Manager, Technology Training.

  • Work with the Customer Success team to build an understanding of clinical research context and the platform.

  • Keep team templates and existing materials current with the Technology Training team.

  • Support monitoring of knowledge base effectiveness.

  • Over time, grow into e-learning development, video tutorials, and other learning formats

Role Clarifications

  • This role does not include instructor-led training, in person or virtual.

  • This role does not interact directly with external customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical writing or documentation experience for software or SaaS platforms, including long-form technical documentation.

  • Proven ability to translate highly technical information into clear, user-friendly content.

  • Experience with a knowledge base or content management platform such as Zendesk, Confluence, or SharePoint.

  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and the ability to learn complex software quickly.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and critical thinking. Understands context rather than only transcribing requirements.

  • Collaborative and comfortable asking subject matter experts questions, and receptive to review and feedback.

  • A disciplined self-starter who can work independently in a remote environment.

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet release deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, science, health-related, or technical communication field.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wiser Solutions is hiring a Senior ML Engineer to help build our customer-facing AI platform and get the first features into customers' hands.

Our data runs at real scale: well over 100 million product and pricing records a day from retailers and marketplaces worldwide. The problems are concrete ones like product matching, classification, and attribute extraction. The right answer is often a mix of trained models, embeddings, retrieval, and LLMs, and cost per record matters as much as accuracy.

We want someone who uses AI first, moves fast, and would rather show a working prototype than a slide deck. You'll own ML systems end to end, from idea to experiment to production, and keep improving them once they're live. You don't need to be a data engineer. You need to be the person who turns a customer problem into a model that works.

What You Will Do

  • Take customer problems from idea to working prototype quickly, prove or kill an approach with data, and move what works into production

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for matching, classification, and extraction problems. This covers classical ML, embedding models, and LLMs, and you pick the simplest approach that meets the quality and cost bar

  • Design and ship RAG systems, embedding-based retrieval, and LLM-powered features on AWS

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining

  • Build evaluation that tells us whether something works: labeled golden sets, offline metrics (precision, recall), LLM-as-judge where it fits, and shadow or A/B testing before rollout

  • Monitor models in production for drift, output quality, latency, and cost per prediction, and fix what you find

  • 7+ years in ML engineering, applied data science, or AI engineering

  • A track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production and owning them after launch. You can walk us through the architecture, the tradeoffs, and the metrics that showed it worked

  • Hands-on experience training and evaluating models: feature engineering, experiment design, choosing metrics, handling class imbalance and noisy labels, and knowing when a model is good enough to ship

  • Hands-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings, and vector databases

  • Working knowledge of MLOps practices and tooling, such as MLflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Weights & Biases, or similar

  • Experience with AWS for ML workloads (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3)

  • Strong Python and solid engineering habits: version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review

  • A habit of building quickly to learn: you'd rather test an idea in two days than debate it for two weeks

  • Daily use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and curiosity about new AI tools as they come out

Preferred:

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, and a clear sense of when to fine-tune versus prompt engineer versus train a smaller task-specific model

  • Experience keeping inference cost down at high volume through distillation, quantization, caching, or tiered model routing

  • Background in retail, e-commerce, or product data (catalog matching, taxonomy mapping, attribute extraction)

  • Experience with entity resolution or similarity search at scale

  • Comfort working with data pipelines and orchestration tools like Airflow (helpful, not required)

jobs.title: Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Italy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Italy

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Italy. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Personal Financial Advisor

Role Type: Contractor
Location: North America and Latin America

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Personal Financial Advisors to contribute their expertise to a project focused on improving individual financial wellness and advancing AI systems.

In this role, you will evaluate personal financial planning scenarios, review investment strategies, and provide expert insights into financial decision-making. You will apply your practical experience advising individuals and families to assess financial recommendations, validate planning materials, and help improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated financial guidance.

No prior AI experience is required. Your professional expertise, client-facing experience, and knowledge of personal financial planning are the key requirements. This engagement involves collaboration between financial professionals to compare approaches and develop high-quality insights for AI training.

Scope of Work

  1. Review personal financial planning scenarios and provide expert feedback based on practical experience advising individual clients and families.
  2. Evaluate investment strategies, retirement plans, and financial recommendations to determine their suitability for individual client needs and objectives.
  3. Analyze financial situations involving savings, investments, debt management, tax planning, and long-term financial goals.
  4. Apply insights from one-on-one client advisory experience, including assessing financial needs, risk tolerance, investment preferences, and financial objectives.
  5. Review financial planning materials and recommendations for accuracy, regulatory compliance, and alignment with industry best practices.
  6. Explain financial concepts, planning strategies, and recommendations clearly through written assessments and verbal discussions.
  7. Collaborate with another financial expert to discuss alternative approaches, compare recommendations, and contribute practical insights to AI training.
  8. Provide clear, structured feedback to help improve the quality, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated financial guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Professional experience working directly with individuals or families in a personal financial advisory or financial planning role.
  2. Experience as a Personal Financial Advisor, Financial Planner, Wealth Manager, Investment Advisor, or in a similar client-facing position.
  3. Strong knowledge of personal financial planning, including retirement planning, investments, tax planning, estate planning, and wealth management.
  4. Hands-on experience developing personalized financial plans and investment recommendations based on individual client goals and circumstances.
  5. Experience evaluating clients' financial situations, risk tolerance, investment objectives, and long-term financial needs.
  6. Good understanding of financial products, portfolio management, asset allocation, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly and effectively.
  8. Ability to collaborate professionally with another financial expert, compare different perspectives, and provide constructive feedback.
  9. Availability to work during overlapping North American or Latin American time zones.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced financial advisor with a strong background in client-focused financial planning, investment analysis, and wealth management. They can evaluate financial recommendations in the context of individual circumstances, explain the reasoning behind their decisions, and collaborate effectively with other professionals to improve AI-generated financial guid...

jobs.title: Desktop Publisher Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Challenge:

Official publications must be accurate, readable, accessible, and ready for release under demanding timelines. What if you could use your desktop publishing and editing expertise to help the U.S. Coast Guard produce high-quality directives, forms, messages, and other mission-critical publications?

Build Your Career:

At JCTM we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects:

As a Desktop Publisher Specialist with JCTM, you will support the production, editing, formatting, and finalization of Coast Guard publications in a high-volume environment. This role requires mastery of editing and layout tools, strong command of written English, experience applying templates and publication standards, and the ability to help deliver polished, compliant products across the publishing lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Desktop Publishing and Formatting: Prepare, edit, and format directives, forms, general messages, and other publication artifacts using approved templates, layouts, and standards.
  • Copyediting and Proofreading: Correct grammar, punctuation, usage, consistency, readability, and technical writing issues across draft and final publication products.
  • Line Editing Support: Improve sentence-level readability, clarity, tone, and structure for publication content, especially for general messages and other time-sensitive products.
  • Template Application and Standards Compliance: Ensure correct template usage, proper structure, formatting consistency, and alignment with Coast Guard correspondence and publishing requirements.
  • Section 508 and Plain Language Support: Apply accessible writing and basic remediation practices, including document cleanup, alternative text insertion, artifact tool usage, and identification of non-compliant content for correction or escalation.
  • Publication Processing Support: Assist with pre-publication final checks, version control, release-readiness reviews, and coordination with sponsors or team leads to resolve errors or missing components.
  • Library and Database Maintenance: Maintain accurate publication metadata, titles, coding, categorizations, and archive information to support reliable searchability and records integrity.
  • General Message Processing: Support regular business-hour processing, maintenance, and archiving of message products in accordance with required system formats and records processes.
  • Production Tracking: Keep publication status current in trackers and support reporting of edits, publications processed, remediation actions, and related production metrics.

State-of-the-Art Technology:

Expand your expertise by working with current versions of Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Acrobat Pro, Microsoft SharePoint, and connected collaboration and publishing systems in a virtual, cloud-enabled environment.

New Skills:

Work alongside experienced publishing and compliance professionals while building your expertise in government publishing workflows, accessibility support, records accuracy, metadata management, and publication lifecycle operations.

Room to Grow:

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to JCTM’s strategic goals through increasingly complex publishing assignments, process improvement efforts, and broader support to enterprise publication management.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

As a Sales Director at Earnix, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth within the Canadian insurance sector. You will be responsible for owning complex sales cycles end-to-end, developing executive-level relationships, and positioning Earnix’s intelligent decisioning solutions as transformational assets for Canadian insurers navigating digital and operational evolution. This role requires a strategic, highly motivated hunter with deep industry understanding and a relentless drive to win.

What you’ll do

Own the full sales cycle from lead to close, driving pipeline generation, qualification, solution positioning, and deal negotiation using a structured MEDDPICC approach. You will work closely with Canadian insurance prospects to understand their business challenges and articulate how Earnix can deliver measurable value.

Develop and execute territory and account strategies, focusing on expanding Earnix’s footprint within the Canadian insurance market. You will leverage market insights and customer intelligence to identify opportunities and strengthen Earnix’s competitive positioning.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across actuarial, product, underwriting, pricing, IT, and executive leadership. You will lead conversations that help Canadian insurers modernize and transform their operations through intelligent decisioning.

Collaborate with global remote teams in product, marketing, presales, and delivery to ensure a seamless customer journey. You will drive alignment across multiple time zones and functions to deliver an exceptional prospect experience.

Represent Earnix at Canadian industry events, conferences, and customer engagements, delivering compelling presentations and communicating Earnix’s value proposition. You will be a visible ambassador of the brand in the Canadian insurance ecosystem.

Requirements

You’ll do it using

8+ years of proven, successful sales experience in the Canadian P&C Insurance space, ideally gained at a fast-growing startup or scale-up, demonstrating the ability to navigate complex organizations and close strategic deals in a high-growth, less-established environment.

A strong understanding of how Canadian insurers operate today, combined with deep knowledge of the digital transformation challenges and opportunities across the sector. You will use this knowledge to influence strategic discussions and guide prospects toward modern, analytics-driven decisioning.

Hands-on experience running deals through a MEDDPICC (or comparable) qualification methodology, with fluency in metrics, economic buyer identification, decision criteria/process mapping, pain identification, and champion building.

A passion for hunting and new business acquisition, consistently driving pipeline growth, identifying new revenue streams, and generating momentum in the competitive Canadian insurance market.

Experience operating within global, distributed teams, using collaboration tools and communication best practices to ensure cohesion and momentum across regions.

A highly motivated, results-oriented work style, committing to doing what it takes to win while upholding Earnix values and delivering a world-class customer experience.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, enabling you to convey complex concepts with clarity and build trust with diverse stakeholders.

Willingness to travel extensively across Canada ...

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Strategic Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Financial Data Analyst to join our Finance team in a role that spans financial planning & analysis and capital markets. You will own core pieces of our forecasting and planning cycles, build portfolio- and merchant-level analytics that drive strategic decisions, and support the execution of our funding strategy and lender relationships. Reporting to the Director of FP&A and partnering day-to-day with the VP of FP&A and VP of Capital Markets, this role offers unique breadth for an analyst seat: forecasting & statistical modeling, unit economics, asset backed financing in one role.

Forecasting & Financial Planning

  • Support quarterly Outlook forecasts and the annual budget and plan, spanning originations, portfolio performance, and profitability
  • Build and maintain components of the corporate forecasting model, including portfolio performance analysis across payment behavior, delinquency roll rates, and charge-offs
  • Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decisions and stress-test liquidity positions
  • Analyze variances versus budget and outlook, translating drivers into clear narratives for senior leadership

Capital Markets

  • Support the VP of Capital Markets in managing Koalafi’s asset-backed debt facilities, including covenant compliance monitoring, borrowing base reporting, and analyses supporting draws and repayments
  • Help prepare investor and lender communications, portfolio analyses, and materials for investor meetings
  • Develop credit performance forecasts (e.g., delinquency, prepayment behavior) to inform funding strategy and capital planning
  • Research capital markets trends, funding innovations, and peer strategies

Business & Portfolio Analytics

  • Build merchant- and product-level unit economics and net cash flow analysis to inform pricing, growth, and capital allocation decisions
  • Leverage SQL and large operational datasets to build data models, dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Snowsight), and self-serve reporting
  • Support monthly financial review materials and ad-hoc analyses of executive questions
  • Monitor competitor and market performance and synthesize implications for the business

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Risk, Accounting, Sales, and Operations teams to align forecasts, metrics, and reporting logic
  • Improve internal processes, automate workflows, and leverage modern tooling (including AI) to increase the speed and accuracy of analysis

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative field
  • 2 - 5 years of experience in data/business analytics, FP&A, strategic finance, capital markets, investment banking, or financial services analytics
  • Expertise in writing SQL for data analysis, metric reporting/tracking, and creating datasets

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Learning Architect to join our global Learning & Development organization. In this role, you will translate business and performance needs into effective learning strategies and high-level solution designs, helping create learning experiences that deliver measurable business impact.

You will partner closely with Talent Development, business stakeholders, and Instructional Design teams to take learning initiatives from initial needs analysis and solution architecture through development and evaluation. Working across a global organization, you will collaborate particularly with colleagues in North America and India and play an important role in keeping projects aligned and moving forward across regions and time zones.

This position is fully remote in Poland and follows standard Polish working hours, with some flexibility needed for occasional collaboration with North American colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Translate business, performance, and capability needs into learning strategies and high-level learning solution designs.
  • Conduct front-end analysis and needs assessments to identify performance gaps, learning requirements, and appropriate solutions.
  • Architect curricula and learning experiences grounded in adult learning principles and aligned with business objectives.
  • Partner with Talent Development, business stakeholders, and Instructional Design teams to guide learning solutions from concept through development.
  • Develop evaluation approaches using the Kirkpatrick model and leverage learner feedback, proficiency results, and performance metrics to measure effectiveness and inform improvements.
  • Collaborate across global teams, particularly in North America and India, to maintain alignment and facilitate smooth delivery across time zones.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to instructional designers and trainers to strengthen the quality and consistency of learning solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging learning technologies and multimedia approaches, including audio, video, and animation, to enhance digital and blended learning experiences.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education and relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of related professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business or performance needs into learning strategies, curricula, and solution designs.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design methodologies, and learning evaluation practices.
  • Experience designing solutions across multiple learning modalities, including instructor-led, eLearning, and simulation-based learning.
  • Proven program or project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

We are looking for a skilled L2 System Administrator to support enterprise backup and storage infrastructure. The role is responsible for backup administration, storage provisioning, incident resolution, capacity monitoring, backup failure troubleshooting, restore operations and infrastructure availability. The administrator will work closely with L1 operations, L3 SMEs, Server, Database, Virtualization and Application teams to ensure data protection, storage availability and SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Backup Operations

  • Provide L2 support for backup incidents, job failures, alerts and service requests.

  • Troubleshoot storage connectivity, path failures, mount issues and capacity-related incidents.
  • Coordinate with Server, VMware, Database and Network teams for storage-related issues.
  • Support storage expansion, migration, maintenance and approved configuration changes.
  • Monitor storage thresholds and identify capacity risks before they affect production services.

Operations & Service Management

  • Resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Support major incident restoration, root-cause investigations and corrective actions.
  • Execute approved changes and validate service health after maintenance activities.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation, incident records and shift handover notes.
  • Coordinate with L1/L3, Server, VMware, Database, Network, Security and Application teams.
  • Support backup compliance reporting, capacity reporting and continuous service improvement.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM follow-the-sun handovers.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of experience in enterprise backup administration, storage operations and infrastructure production support
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise backup and/or storage operations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help Provide Voices – Join PRC‑Saltillo as a Software Engineer!

Remote position available – location in Wooster, Ohio not required

At PRC‑Saltillo, our mission is to provide voices to children and adults who are unable to communicate effectively with their natural voices. Through innovative hardware and software working seamlessly together, we empower individuals to live fuller, more independent lives. Our technology supports people with complex communication needs and opens doors to education, employment, and meaningful connection.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll be part of an agile, collaborative team building and enhancing the software that powers PRC‑Saltillo’s communication devices and internal support tools. Your work will directly contribute to giving individuals a voice—while solving interesting technical challenges and collaborating across Engineering, Product, and other departments.

Go to our website to apply:

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Mission‑Driven Impact: Use your engineering skills to create technology that truly changes lives.
  • Meaningful Technical Work: Design and improve software that enables communication and independence.
  • Collaborative Agile Team: Work closely with product managers and fellow engineers in a supportive, team‑focused environment.
  • Remote Flexibility:
    Contribute from anywhere—no requirement to live near Wooster, Ohio.
  • Continuous Improvement: Be part of a company that’s constantly evolving its technology and expanding who it can serve.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers and other software engineers to turn ideas into working software for dedicated hardware and personal computers.
  • Design, implement, and document new software features and enhancements to existing products.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs in existing software.
  • Write clean, well‑documented, and maintainable code that follows established team coding standards.
  • Provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews to support quality and knowledge sharing across the team.

Education and Experience

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent education and experience.
  • At least three years of experience in:
  • Python, C++, or C# for PC applications and/or
  • Python, JavaScript, or C# for full‑stack web development
    (Relevant internships, co‑ops, or similar experience may be considered.)
  • Experience with software and product systems design, including object‑oriented design and MVC.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Sound decision‑making and problem‑solving abilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Enthusiasm for engineering solutions that support individuals with complex communication needs.
Salary: $85,000 - $106,000

Job Title: Mathematics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Compensation: $80–$120 per hour
Location: Global — Fully Remote
Employment Type: Contractor
Workload: Approximately 15 hours per week
Schedule: Flexible, with the option to work on weekdays or weekends, subject to availability requirements.

Job Summary

We are seeking highly skilled Mathematics Experts to contribute to an AI training project focused on advanced mathematical problem-solving, computational mathematics, numerical methods, and Python programming.

The role involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating mathematical tasks using computational and command-line-based workflows. Candidates will translate mathematical problems into executable procedures, implement algorithms, generate reproducible results, test special cases, and verify mathematical and numerical accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Solve and validate advanced mathematical and computational problems.
  2. Translate mathematical requirements into precise, executable workflows.
  3. Implement mathematical algorithms and workflows using Python and command-line tools.
  4. Automate calculations, numerical experiments, parameter sweeps, and result validation.
  5. Review computational outputs for mathematical correctness, numerical stability, and reproducibility.
  6. Use scientific computing tools and relevant libraries to support complex mathematical analysis.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master's degree or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field; or
  2. A bachelor's degree in Mathematics or a related quantitative field, along with at least 1–2 years of mathematics-focused professional or research experience at a leading company or institution.
  3. Strong expertise in at least one mathematical discipline, such as:
    • Applied mathematics and numerical analysis
    • Optimization and operations research
    • Probability and statistics
    • Discrete mathematics
    • Algebra and geometry
    • Mathematical modeling and dynamical systems
  4. Strong computational problem-solving and analytical skills.
  5. Ability to implement, test, and validate mathematical solutions using Python or equivalent computational tools.

Relevant Tools & Technologies

Experience with one or more of the following tools is beneficial:

  • Programming and scientific computing: Python, Julia, GNU Octave
  • Mathematical computation: SymPy, SageMath
  • Numerical analysis: NumPy, SciPy
  • Optimization: CVXPY and related optimization libraries
  • Data analysis and visualization: pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter
  • Statistical modeling and network analysis: statsmodels, NetworkX

Equivalent command-line-accessible mathematical software is also acceptable. No single library is mandatory.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Apply for the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. AI Interview: Complete an interview lasting approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Hiring Manager Review: Undergo a final review of your qualifications and expertise.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided for each task that meets the project's specifications. Task completion time may vary depending on the complexity of the problem, the expert's experience, and the chosen workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Legal Director, Global Trade Compliance Counsel


Job Description:

The person hired for the position of Legal Counsel Director, Global Trade Compliance will provide subject matter expertise and legal advice to Arrow Electronics and its global trade compliance organization regarding various U.S. and international trade laws, in particular import and export controls, sanctions and antiboycott laws. In addition to providing legal counsel, this person will lead the global trade compliance organization.

  • Provide advice and counsel on trade compliance matters, including activities relating to U.S. and international sanctions regimes, the Harmonized Tariff Schedule, customs federal regulations, NAFTA, entry processes, valuation, and informed compliance methods.
  • Advise on export licensing and other authorizations, coordinating with the business leadership to identify compliant solutions.
  • Provide guidance on State and Commerce Department export license applications, Commodity Jurisdictions, Advisory Opinions, Commodity Classifications, and other export compliance documents.
  • Respond promptly to requests from internal clients and summarize and clearly communicate legal risks.

  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization with an open, honest and direct communication style that establishes an empathetic and effective relationship with front-line and mid-level personnel.
