jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Some engineering teams reach a point where technical leadership and people leadership need to be owned separately. That’s the opportunity here.

We’re partnering an experienced a product-led software business to recruit an Engineering Manager, responsible for around 12 engineers working across multiple teams.

The Tech Leads own the technical direction. This role gives dedicated ownership to how engineers are managed, developed, challenged and supported as the team continues to grow.

Location & working arrangement

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland.

There is also office space available in Belfast for anyone who prefers occasional in-person working.

What you’ll own

  • Regular 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback
  • Performance management, including difficult conversations when needed
  • Career development, progression and promotions
  • Engineering career frameworks and review processes
  • Hiring and onboarding
  • Team health, retention and remote culture
  • Helping shape how engineering management works as the organisation grows

You’ll work closely with the Head of Engineering and Tech Leads, but your focus will be firmly on the people side of engineering.

What they’re looking for

This isn’t a first move into management.

You’ll need:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers
  • Experience supporting engineers across more than one team or product area
  • A strong track record of developing engineers from mid-level through senior
  • Hands-on experience managing underperformance
  • Experience with progression, promotions and career frameworks
  • Experience hiring software engineers
  • Enough technical depth to read code, follow pull requests and understand the engineering context
  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Practical experience using AI tools in your own work

Ruby or Rails experience would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

The priority is someone who is genuinely strong at managing engineers while remaining technically credible.

Package

  • Negotiable salary reflecting your experience level
  • Private health insurance for you and your family
  • Company pension
  • 35 days’ annual leave including applicable public/statutory holidays
  • Learning and development support
  • Share options
  • Work-from-home budget

Next steps

If you’ve already led engineering teams and enjoy the people leadership side of engineering as much as the technical environment around it, we’d be keen to hear from you!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and we aim to move quickly where there is a strong match.

Equal opportunities

Enably is committed to fair, inclusive hiring and we work with clients who take the same approach seriously. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruitment experience for everyone. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, please let us know.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Company

Cineflix Media

Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long-running shows.

The Services

The independent contractor will provide remote YouTube Channel management, optimisation and audience-development services from Brazil for Cineflix You Tube channels. The services will support the growth of those channels in reach and revenue through publishing, packaging, testing, community management and performance analysis.

The contractor will provide the services independently, using their own professional judgement and methods, in line with agreed channel plans, deliverables, quality standards and timelines.

Scope of Services and Deliverables

  • Publish and optimise content on designated YouTube channels, including metadata, thumbnails, playlists, scheduling, community engagement in line with agreed publishing plans.
  • Analyse audience profiles, channel performance and content gaps to identify practical opportunities for growth.
  • Define, test and evaluate content formats, volumes and publishing frequencies, including full episodes, compilations, clips, cutdowns, YouTube Shorts and other digital derivatives.
  • Recommend and apply optimisation for monetisation, search, discovery and audience retention using platform analytics and best-practice packaging.
  • Extract actionable insights from YouTube analytics and translate them into clear recommendations for programming, metadata and format testing.
  • Manage content pipelines of various content types.
  • Assist with resolving limited monetisation issues and claims plus updating video policies or sunsetting video.
  • Liaise with designated Cineflix contacts on publishing plans, approvals, feedback and delivery.

Required Professional Qualifications and Experience

  • Strong conversational written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely with Cineflix contacts, using designated systems and agreed communication and delivery schedules.
  • Demonstrated professional experience managing YouTube channels.
  • Demonstrated professional knowledge of YouTube Studio, metadata optimisation, thumbnails, playlists, analytics, monetisation policies and community tools.
  • Comfortable using data to spot patterns, diagnose performance issues and recommend practical next steps.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage recurring publishing, optimisation and reporting workflows.
  • Strong editorial judgement and an understanding of how packaging, titles, thumbnails and formats affect audience behaviour.

Desired Experience

  • Written and spoken language skills in LATAM and European languages.
  • Experience working with factual, documentary, lifestyle, true crime, science, engineering, property or archive television content.
  • Experience running A/B tests or structured content tests across titles, thumbnails, formats or scheduling.
  • Interest in audience behaviour, YouTube trends and competitor channel analysis.

If you are interested in this independent contractor opportunity, please submit your resume and a brief summary of relevant channel management experience, including examples of channels you have managed, through the application link. No phone calls please. We thank all candidates for their interest, but only those invited to the next stage will be contacted....

jobs.title: Sales Manager/Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our client, Imper, is looking for reinforcement of their sales team, hence we are searching for the Manager/Director of Imper's Sales Function.

Location: Prague | Seniority level: Senior | Allocation: Full-time

About Imper:

The business works very well for us, we have a great sales team, we are fast-growing (currently the 21st fastest growing tech company in CEE according to Deloitte), profitable. We have a very fast sales process and immediate delivery.

Currently it is the time for us to be looking for an energetic leader who will help our business efforts and capitalize on previous experience in B2B business.

He/she will take responsibility for meeting the business goals and help us maintain the significant growth we have enjoyed in recent years .

We offer a job that you will enjoy, above-standard financial proposal, the opportunity to participate directly in the success of the company and, last but not least, self-realization without corporate games.

We are a technology company, profitable and growing!

Half of the team takes care of the product development part and the other half tends to its sales, marketing and client satisfaction.

We are creating web applications:

  • Leady - generates new clients for companies,
  • Merk - the largest database of Czech companies and
  • Monitora - a tool for monitoring and analysis of media.

We supply these applications to companies in both the Czech Republic and abroad, for a monthly fee. It works quite quickly, we currently have over 10,000 users and most of the banks or operators like HP, Canon, IKEA, Avast, Total, AVG, CzechInvest, Tatra, TPCA, Ogilvy and other over 2000 companies build their business, marketing or PR on our data.

Main tasks for the Sales Manager role:

  • Responsibility for leading the sales team
  • Scaling our business activities to new markets
  • Participation in company management and process creation
  • Active participation in the sales process and the company's sales team

Who are we looking for?

  • We expect an energetic leader who has successful experience in leading a larger sales team (15+ team members)
  • Common sense and empathy are important
  • An advantage is represented by the analytical thinking capabilities and experience with team management outside the Czech Republic.
  • Experience in business management
  • Drive and proactive attitude
  • Very good communication, organizational and presentation skills in Czech and English
  • Ability to create a friendly and informal atmosphere.

Why should you join us?

  • Development: What you can't do, we'll teach you. You don't have to worry about that. We will be happy to help.
  • Environment: Feel like home, in a smaller team (about 40 people, 1-2 dogs).
  • Freedom: You will have a free hand at work.
  • Project: Interesting and rewarding work.
  • Overlap: Our data helps to make the environment more transparent, to uncover corruption and clientelism. Also, we are proud to support several non-profits.
  • Freedom: Arrivals, departures, home office, sick days, leave - if everything works, we don't deal with it much.
  • Friends: You will be working in a nice group of people.
  • Money: Above-standard reward. We know that there are only a few people like you and we can appreciate it.
  • Culture: Admission to conferences, workshops, concerts, exhibitions for you and your friends or family.
  • Others: Super coffee, foosball, PC / Mac, free refreshments at our bar, offices in Smíchov, near the metro and other small pleasures.

jobs.title: Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Portugal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Portugal

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

As an Account Manager, Programmatic, you will support the execution and optimization of programmatic campaigns within our retail vertical. You’ll work closely with Account Leads, Coordinators, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work, drive performance, and ensure strong client satisfaction. You bring a mix of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Central, Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. jobs.title: Sr. API Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Anika Systems is seeking an experienced Senior API Engineer to develop, maintain, and enhance an enterprise Semantic Layer supporting data access, analytics, and AI-enabled applications for a federal client.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on Python backend engineer with strong experience designing and implementing secure, scalable APIs, integrating enterprise data sources, and supporting cloud-based services on AWS.

The role requires an understanding of data modeling, metadata, and semantic data integration, along with familiarity with emerging AI integration patterns, including LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

The Engineer will work collaboratively with data architects, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure the Semantic Layer provides reliable, consistent, and governed access to enterprise information.

This position is 100% remote.

Candidates must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a government suitability clearance.


Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or enterprise data management.
  • Experience developing and maintaining secure API’s within the AWS API Gateway.
  • Expertise in data modeling, data integration, metadata management, governance, and AWS-based data platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, APIs, and serverless architectures.
  • Experience implementing LLMs, RAG solutions, AI agents, MCP integrations, and AI evaluation methodologies.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting federal agencies.
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector).
  • AWS certifications in Data Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Machine Learning, or Generative AI.
  • Experience with Agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD practices.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Analyst- Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security is seeking a Cloud Security Operations Analyst to support the day-to-day business and delivery operations of our Cloud Practice. This role helps keep pipeline and project information accurate, produces useful reporting, coordinates across teams, and supports consistent processes that help our consultants and sales partners deliver exceptional client experiences.

The analyst will work closely with Cloud Practice leadership, delivery teams, Account Executives, and business operations partners. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, follow-through, comfort working with operational data, and the ability to identify issues and communicate them clearly. This is an individual contributor role focused on execution, analysis, and coordination rather than practice strategy, P&L ownership, or personnel management.

About the Cloud Practice

GuidePoint Security’s Cloud Practice helps clients strengthen security and improve outcomes across cloud platforms, SaaS environments, and automation and AI initiatives. The practice brings together specialists across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, SaaS, and Automation & AI.

Our operations function supports the teams behind this work by improving visibility into opportunities, project delivery, resource needs, and client follow-up. We partner with practice leaders, consultants, sales teams, and other internal stakeholders to maintain reliable information and make routine work more consistent and effective.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, and trackers covering pipeline health, project activity, staffing, utilization, and other practice performance measures; highlight missing data, exceptions, and emerging trends.
  • Support resource planning and delivery forecasting by collecting availability, project timing, and demand inputs from practice leaders and delivery teams; flag potential conflicts or gaps for review.
  • Track stale or inactive opportunities, outstanding actions, and client follow-up activities.
  • Administer and summarize internal and client feedback surveys, identify actionable themes, and maintain trackers for improvement items and follow-through.
  • Support the Project-to-Partnership process by tracking project outcomes, follow-on opportunities, and engagement closeout actions in coordination with consultants and sales teams.
  • Maintain Cloud Practice operating procedures, shared documentation, templates, and reporting standards; identify practical ways to reduce manual effort and improve data quality.

Required Experience and Education

  • 5+ years of experience supporting business operations, project coordination, reporting, sales operations, or professional services delivery operations; applicable education or equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including organizing data, maintaining trackers, and presenting clear, accurate summaries.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple priorities, meet deadlines, maintain detailed records, and communicate professionally with technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Comfort learning and using CRM, project tracking, collaboration, and reporting platforms.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team.   • Maintain clear submission and production status, communicate priorities and risks to deadlines early, and recommend practical improvements that reduce avoidable rework and turnaround time.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Experience supporting biopharmaceutical promotional review, MLR submissions, editorial operations, or medical and marketing production, with examples of delivering accurate work against deadlines.
  • Experience proofreading documents for print production, ensuring accuracy in spelling, grammar, punctuation, formatting, and consistency with final approved content before release to print vendors.
  • Familiarity with preparing submission packages, managing references, and linking claims to supporting source documentation. Hands-on experience with Veeva PromoMats and Veeva MedProduction is required.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software QA & Testing Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software through robust manual and automated testing processes, as well as adopting modern testing tools including Artificial Intelligence (AI) for enhanced efficiency and accuracy. You will lead the testing efforts to identify and resolve issues, optimize performance, ensure cross-browser compatibility, and verify the scalability and resiliency of software capabilities under load.

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. If you have hands-on experience with automation, cross-browser testing, performance testing, and industry-leading tools (including AI-based solutions), this is the perfect opportunity for your career growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Planning & Strategy

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define test objectives.
  • Develop and document comprehensive and efficient test plans, strategies, and exit criteria.
  • Ensure alignment with Agile frameworks for CI/CD processes to maintain quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

2. Manual Testing

  • Perform detailed manual testing on new features, functional flows, and regression cases.
  • Conduct comprehensive exploratory testing for edge-case scenarios to uncover potential issues early.
  • Ensure test data coverage for all features, workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

3. Automation Testing

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for both web and mobile applications using leading tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, and/or similar.
  • Write efficient and reusable automated test scripts to conduct functional and end-to-end testing.
  • Work on integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline).

4. Cross-Browser & Device Testing

  • Perform cross-browser testing on modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge using tools like BrowserStack, Lambdatest, or CrossBrowserTesting.
  • Validate software compatibility across various operating systems and devices (desktop and mobile).

5. Performance Testing

  • Design and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests for high-traffic systems using tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Monitor application response time, throughput, and behavior under heavy load scenarios.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations to development teams.

6. AI-Driven Testing

  • Utilize AI-powered test case generation tools like Testim, Applitools, or Tricentis Tosca to design smarter and faster test cases.
  • Work with AI-based tools for visual regression testing and intelligent defect identification.
  • Stay up to date on emerging trends in AI-driven QA solutions to enhance testing strategies.

7. Defect Reporting & Debugging

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver...

jobs.title: Community Management Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.</p> <p>Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)</p> <p><strong>Ideally You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Digital Culture Native:</strong> Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.</li> <li><strong>A Strong Communicator:</strong> Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.</li> <li><strong>An Organized Framework Builder:</strong> Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.</li> <li><strong>A Community Connector:</strong> Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Aware Learner:</strong> Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Community Engagement & Copywriting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.</li> <li>Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.</li> <li>Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Trends & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.</li> jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikipedia and its sister projects are among the most popular media properties in the world, visited by over 1 billion people a month across over 300 different languages. These sites generate a tremendous amount of data on how people learn and collaborate.  The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a group product manager to guide the development and evolution of our <a href="https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Data_Platform">data platforms</a>, the collection of technologies we use to understand how Wikipedia works, improve its experiences, and spread free knowledge.</p> <p>The group product manager is a leader in the strategic decision-making and tactical execution for the Data Engineering, Experimentation, Search, and Data Platform Site Reliability teams. This role shares leadership responsibility with the Director of Engineering for Data Platform Engineering, and works in collaboration with data analysts, researchers, and product teams building user-facing features for reading and editing Wikipedia on the web and mobile apps. This is a people management role, managing two individually-contributing product managers.</p> <p>In this role, you and your group of product managers will guide the evolution of our data pipelines, data lake, experiment platform, and analytics tools.  This includes ingestion, orchestration, computation, and serving data using a variety of technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, Kubernetes, Superset, dbt, and OpenSearch. A strong candidate will have deep experience building a data platform to serve product analytics and production needs, and be technically conversant in the relevant technologies.</p> <p>This position will report to the Senior Director of Product, Core Experiences.</p> <p><strong>Candidates must be available for critical meetings and synchronous work between 15:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC, and open to traveling internationally up to four times per year.</strong></p> <h4>This role is accountable for:</h4> <ul> <li>Ensuring the accuracy, usefulness, reliability, and accessibility of our data products</li> <li>Defining and setting priorities and roadmaps for Data Platform Engineering teams across four domains: data engineering, search, experimentation, and site reliability</li> <li>Product products</li> </ul> <h4>Expected skills and experience include:</h4> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of product management experience with data or infrastructure products</li> <li>Experience hiring and managing product managers</li> <li>Success delivering data and analytical products and services depended on by multiple product teams</li> <li>Expertise in data analytics, A/B testing, search, and jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Summary</strong></span></h2> <p>Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product & Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices.</p> <p>This is a business partnering role first and an FP&A role second. You will sit alongside product and engineering leaders, help them weigh investment tradeoffs before decisions are made, and turn roadmaps into financial plans. You will work directly with the Chief of Product and Technology (CPTO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and the broader executive team. This is a chance to have an outsized impact on a mission-driven organization that operates one of the most visited websites in the world.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates between UTC-8 and UTC+1.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why this role</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Be the trusted finance advisor to Product & Technology leadership, with a real voice in how we invest more than $100M in people, infrastructure, and partners.</li> <li>Work on infrastructure that serves more than 20 billion views per month.</li> <li>Drive projects with impact and executive visibility, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Shape the future of our business partner function by leading projects, setting standards, and mentoring other analysts.</li> <li>Join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Be the Finance Partner to Product & jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikipedia is a trusted source of knowledge the world over, read by over a billion people a month in over 300 languages. It’s offered for free and operated independently by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation (that’s us), powered mainly by small donations.</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help guide Wikipedia’s anti-abuse and security strategy as a member of our <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Analytics">Product Analytics</a> team. In this role, you will inform our product development strategy by collaborating with product managers, engineers, and others to help our features and interventions make the impact they should. </p> <p>As the Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security, you will partner closely with the <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity">Product Safety and Integrity team</a>, whose strategy is built around bringing <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity/Detecting_abusive_content">cutting-edge AI</a> and <a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/2026/05/04/better-detecting-bots-and-replacing-our-captcha-part-2/">machine learning</a> techniques to bear on difficult problems in the field of safety and security. You will amplify the impact of the safety and security roadmap through creative data analysis, identifying the right metrics for the job, and developing data strategies that advance our product decisions.</p> <p>This role is an opportunity to be at the center of a pivotal time for Wikipedia, as AI changes how people access knowledge and presents new risks and opportunities in online safety and security.</p> <p>Examples of the kinds of projects you may work on include:</p> <ul> <li>Setting the strategy for how we measure the success of efforts to detect bots and inauthentic account activity (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sockpuppetry">sockpuppetry</a>, in wiki terms).</li> <li>Providing analysis to inform the development of new heuristics and approaches to detect potentially abusive activity on the platform.</li> <li>Collaborating with research scientists and security engineers to develop and evaluate AI models to find malicious user-authored code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note that this role requires availability for critical meetings and synchronous collaboration between 13:00 and 19:00 UTC.</strong></p> <p><strong>You are responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serving as a strategic partner for product managers, engineers, designers, and other colleagues in product development teams.</li> <li>Proactively making recommendations on product direction and data strategy, surfacing insights and interpreting results.</li> <li>Timely delivery of accurate quantitative data and insights to inform strategy, guide product decisions, and assess the impact of product development work – balancing the need to operate in a fast-changing environment with appropriate rigor.</li> <li>Clearly communicating results and data-backed jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Senior Program Officer, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Remote and must be based in a country within our <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/jobs/#section-13">current hiring locations</a> in the Sub-Saharan Africa region</p> <h3><strong>Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. At the core of the projects are volunteers who curate the knowledge that the world has come to rely on.  </p> <p>The Community Resources team is the primary funding function of the Wikimedia Foundation ensuring that we support the Affiliates and volunteer contributors of the Wikimedia Movement by offering institutional and individual funding to help achieve the Movement’s goals. To support the movement’s commitment to Knowledge Equity, the team prioritizes proactive outreach to communities that structures of power and privilege have left out.</p> <p>The Senior Program Officer will implement the regional funding programs serving Wikimedian communities in Sub-Saharan Africa. </p> <p><strong>Roles and Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Funding Strategy & Portfolio Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement the Community Resources grantmaking strategy while taking into consideration community needs, opportunities, movement trends, and the regional geopolitical and cultural context.</li> <li>Analyze regional and global patterns to shape funding rationales and priorities.</li> <li>Design program activities with colleagues to achieve significant, scalable impact.</li> <li>Manage, implement and monitor the regional grant portfolio to ensure alignment with strategy, criteria, and impact goals.</li> <li>Lead annual grant planning: identify and support prospective and returning grantees, review proposals, co-develop funding rationales with the regional funding committee. This also includes conducting organizational assessments (financial and narrative) to inform funding rationales. </li> <li>Work collaboratively across Foundation teams to support implementation of funding program and team objectives.</li> <li>Represent the Foundation internally and externally as an ambassador for regional knowledge, priorities and insights.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Committee Development</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Build, onboard, and develop regional funding committees aligned with regional needs and opportunities to enable transparent decision-making as part of participatory grantmaking approaches.</li> <li>Set agendas for committee discussions (priorities, financial analysis, partner and regional insights) and facilitate inclusive funding deliberations.</li> <li>Provide context, analysis, and synthesis of committee feedback into funding recommendations and decisions.</li> <li>Provide constructive feedback to applicants and grantees on outcomes and expectations linked to funding decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Community & Funding Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and sustain trust-based relationships with communities, grantees, and applicants across the region; act as primary liaison between WMF and partners.</li> <li>Understand community needs, dynamics, and challenges; support conflict resolution or sensitive discussions when required.</li> <li>Support community, organizational/institutional strengthening of grantee partners; connect them with relevant a...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong><a href="https://foundation.mozilla.org/en/">Mozilla Foundation</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong> </strong>is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!</span></p> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Team</strong></span></h2> <p><a href="https://www.mozillafoundation.org/en/meet-mozilla/nabiha-syed/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our CEO</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.</span></p> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Job responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">first 6 months</span>:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which dec...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Data Sanitization Frameworks:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Behavioral Inference Reports:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Scope</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.</span></p> <h3><strong>Required Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Technical:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Soft Skills:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Independent problem solving:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources</span><span style="font-weight: 400;&...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will help reduce Firefox’s WebCompat bug backlog by finishing or verifying the diagnosis of the long tail of site-breakage bugs, and by writing interventions or simple fixes (often with AI assistance). Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p> <p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li> <li value="2">Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li value="3">Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li> <li value="4">Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.<...

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.</p> <p>Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>As a Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering, you will lead a team of frontline leaders, driving account strategy, deal execution, operational excellence, and team development across your region. </p> <p>This is a strategic leadership role with regional impact within North America. You will act as a force multiplier by owning team and region performance, shaping execution standards, and partnering closely with Sales leadership to influence go to market strategy, improve outcomes, and scale impact beyond individual deals. </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own in-field execution at a regional level by taking an executive presence role in strategic and high-impact opportunities and providing senior-level stakeholder alignment and technical credibility alongside your team. </li> <li>Develop and operationalize a repeatable formula and methodology that can scale across a large customer base, enabling Datadog to accelerate enterprise growth by illustrating to customers how Datadog’s observability and security solutions quickly, simply, and efficiently deliver measurable business outcomes especially in a world increasingly dominated by Agentic AI.</li> <li>Partner confidently with senior Sales leadership on regional strategy, multi-quarter planning, annual capacity planning, and forecast alignment operating 2-3 quarters ahead to anticipate resourcing needs and business priorities.</li> <li>Oversee consistent, high-quality delivery across technical sales cycles in the region, including evaluations, customer engagements, and deal progression.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Engineering leaders, driving performance, engagement, and long-term career growth through regular feedback and structured development.</li> <li>Hire and operations including resource allocation, utilization, KPI tracking, productivity, and skills development to ensure effective coverage across the territory.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Enablement, and Support at a senior level to align on regional strategy, GTM execution, and customer experience.</li> <li>Drive operational excellence across the region by improving processes, maintaining data quality, scaling evaluation frameworks, and contributing to initiatives that improve team effectiveness and business impact.</li> <li>Track competitive jobs.descriptionHtml: <h1>Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)</h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.</li> <li>Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.</li> <li>Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. jobs.descriptionHtml: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.</p> <p>As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success & Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. jobs.title: Support Engineer (APAC - Weekends)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams. You will: Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions. Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members. Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues ). Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency. Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing. You are: Experienced in customer support, with 3+ years of experience providing developer support to technical customers. Proficient in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL). You feel comfortable with complex SQL queries. If you have a database administration experience, it’s a plus. Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. Skilled in using Linux/Unix operating systems and the command line. Experienced working with GitHub Issues and Discussions. Bonus points if you're familiar with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte and have some experience with Node.js. Having a degree in Computer Science is a plus too. Timezones & Logistics It’s a full-time position permanently, with four 10-hour shifts covering weekends during APAC Hours: 00:00-10:00 UTC We are primarily looking for someone in Southeast Asia or India time zones for this shift. This position covers Friday → Monday based on the above UTC times, so this may vary slightly for your specific timezone. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.descriptionHtml: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customisation to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Account Managers to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Our world-class sales organization is looking for self-motivated teammates with high social intelligence and a natural inclination for selling and partnering to accelerate our growth as we scale rapidly! Individuals who are eager to learn, embrace challenges, and passionate about succeeding will thrive at Ramp. Our Partner Development Representatives act as the initial point of contact and are responsible for hunting and qualifying partners to build new partnerships that drive sales opportunities for Ramp.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and source new partner opportunities with the accounting sector through inbound qualification and direct outreach

  • Engage and qualify prospective partners via a variety of methods, including but not limited to: emails, calls, social channels, conferences and events

  • Conduct in-depth primary and secondary research to understand service offerings, firmographics, organizational structure and key stakeholders to assess potential fit

  • Collarboate cross-functionally with Channel partner Managers, Marketing, Operations and Direct Sales to strategically grow Ramp’s Partner ecosystem

  • Educate accounting leaders and firm stakeholders on Ramp’s partnership program and convey the value Ramp can provide to the prospective partner firm and their clients 

  • Ideate on new and unique ways to build and develop partner relationships

  • Maintain accurate partner relationship data within Salesforce

What You Need

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent listening skills and energetic and professional phone and Zoom presence

  • High level of comfort with sales, prospecting and both virtual and in-person

  • Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis

  • Deep interest in understanding specific business challenges with the different verticals

  • Sense of entrepreneurship: a self-starter with a high sense of urgency, ability to work within undefined processes and a will to find a way

About the Role

You will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Executives (AEs) who will be hunting, pitching, and closing new business for Ramp. You will be responsible for 1:1 coaching, mentoring, and strategy development, working closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and the executive team to drive positive outcomes for this segment. As a key member of the sales leadership team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s sales development motion.

What You'll Do

  • Manage, develop and execute career development and leadership plan for a group of Account Executives and provide daily 1:1 mentoring and coaching

  • Set and maintain a high-performing culture and morale by overseeing the daily activities and quota performance management of individual AEs to ensure key performance metrics are met

  • Hire and train new AEs on Ramp’s product, buyer personas, competition, and tools through various methods (ie. role-plays)

  • Strategize with sales and marketing counterparts on pipeline and prospecting initiatives to meet company objectives

  • Build dashboards and report on customer and team performance and forecast to senior leadership

  • Improve team output and efficiency over time by optimizing systems and processes

  • Build and execute on pipeline with new clients and partners to run the end-to-end sales process

  • Establish a library of playbook resources for the AE team

  • Partner with Ops to create and polish existing metrics that evaluate the individual and team’s performance

  • Represent the AE team cross-functionally with leaders of other departments

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of quota carrying sales experience as an individual contributor

  • Minimum 3 years of experience building and leading successful, high-performing sales teams

  • Demonstrated success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS companies, and history of consistently performing above quota in an outbound sales environment

  • Passion and excitement for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development
