jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Sentry Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building. Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future. About the role Sentry already sees the moment software breaks: the error, the trace, the replay, the commit that caused it. Seer, our AI debugger, uses all of that to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. We're looking for a Staff engineer to help decide how that system should evolve as models improve every few months. Some of what we build today will be obsolete by next spring. Part of the job is knowing which parts, and building the rest to last. In this role you will Build state-of-the-art agentic AI systems to triage, debug, and solve real production issues Set technical direction for how our agents get context, use tools, and decide when they're done Build the evals that tell us whether a new model or prompt actually helped, fast enough that people use them Decide when to use a frontier model, a smaller one, or one we trained, and revisit that as cost and capability shift Leverage Sentry’s novel (and massive) dataset of errors, spans, and profiles Own major AI initiatives end to end, alongside the developers and product teams shipping them Run what you ship in production and debug it with Sentry You'll love this job if you Are driven by impact and enjoy working on high-stakes, high-visibility projects Enjoy building things. You will have the opportunity to join the AI/ML team as one of its foundational members Thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy building features alongside developers and product teams Qualifications You've shipped an LLM-backed system people depended on, and can tell us what broke You have strong opinions on agent design and have changed at least one in the last year You've trained or fine-tuned models when it was the right call, and you know when it isn't You write solid production Python You've owned a system or component and led work across multiple engineers and teams, with a design doc people actually read You write clear technical documentation, mentor other engineers, and present to technical audiences The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $240,000 to $400,000. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs. Equal Opportunity at Sentry Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PostHog

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

  • A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics, replay vision, AI observability, and error tracking

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

  • Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

  • Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-eff...

About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.

You will:

  • Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

  • Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

  • Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

  • Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

  • Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

  • Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions

Required skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

  • Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

  • Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

  • Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. About the Role: We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team. This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal. This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations. The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer. What the Role Is: A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you. A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed. A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences. What the Role Is Not: A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores. An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth. A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people. An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it. A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job". What You'll Achieve: Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product Work with Sales, Soluti...

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.
 
That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.
 
We are looking for a motivated Account Manager in the Asia-Pacific region who will be responsible for managing existing client accounts and generating additional revenue by working with customers on upselling, cross-selling, and retention. Account managers will work with a dedicated group of clients (known as their book of business) for the entirety of the client's time at Kinsta to help achieve the client’s goals and represent Kinsta in non-technical support customer interactions. Account managers are also tasked with retaining the client’s business and growing these accounts through upsells and cross-sells. 
 
An ideal candidate is someone who is proactive and has a knack for building relationships. Also, someone who is tech-savvy, process-driven, and loves the thrill of seeking out additional revenue and closing deals!

jobs.descriptionHtml: Requisition ID: 147951 Location: Papua, ID, 99967 Category: Engineering Services The Underground Geology Group has a major role in the success of PTFI as it continues to operate the mines and bring new mines in development and production; ensuring that the geological models and ore body knowledge underpinning the underground operations are reliable; that structural, lithological and mineralization controls are understood and communicated to design and operating teams; and, that the mines are supported by geological data and reconciliation to deliver the expected revenue stream. The work carried out by the group includes drilling and core logging, geological mapping, structural interpretation, 3D geological modelling, resource and reserve support, grade control and reconciliation, geometallurgical characterization, and integration of geological data with geotechnical, hydrology and cave performance evaluation. ***Additional Responsibilities:*** * The Technical Expert Geology role exists to provide technical leadership in geology to PTFI’s mines. The intent of the role is provide: * Core underground geological expertise and ore body knowledge across operating and developing mines, including KL’s transition from development to production. * Reliable geological models, structural interpretation and domain definitions that underpin mine design, ground support and draw control in an operational environment * Assist in the development of the Underground Geology group that provides key technical advice and support to the Grasberg Underground Operations. * Geological interpretation, modelling and reconciliation for the GBC, DMLZ and Kucing Liar (KL) caving operations and for the Big Gossan stoping operation, all within PTFI’s Grasberg business unit. * Own geological data quality, including drilling, core logging, mapping, sampling and QA/QC, and the integration of structure, lithology, alteration and mineralization domains with geotechnical and hydrology teams. * Assist in the development of partnering arrangements with key specialist providers, such as drilling contractors, assay laboratories and geological technology vendors. * Provide expert advice to ensure that best geological practice in drilling, logging, mapping, modelling and interpretation is applied to the underground mines. * Provide expert advice to ensure that appropriate geological decisions are undertaken. These will range from infill drilling design and geological model updates to structural and lithological controls on cave behavior, to ore/waste reconciliation and draw control. * Develop, coach and mentor national staff to build capacity, ensure knowledge transfer and that geological analyses follow international best practices. * Provide professional advice/recommendations to PTFI leadership and supervisory staff. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geological Engineering or Earth Science, or acceptable Tertiary qualifications, with at least ten (10) years of working experience in the application of geology to underground mining. * Demonstrated expertise in structural geology, 3D geological modelling and ore body knowledge as applied to underground mining, preferably block or panel cave operations in porphyry and skarn copper-gold systems. * Demonstrated ability to work with others and communicate complex issues. * Highly focused on geological interpretation and modelling as applied to underground mining and assessing geological aspects of underground mine production. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness...

jobs.title: Internship
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.


Recent projects run by interns:

  • Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

  • Took a new product from first customer call to production launch.

  • Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy.

  • Built the sales case behind our largest deals.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.

  • Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.

We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

We’re looking for three engineers to join each cohort of the Augustus Engineering Fellowship. You’ll spend 3–6 months in Berlin working on agentic projects with the team building our bank - the infrastructure connecting economies to the Western financial system.

We have a backlog of problems we want to solve, and you’re welcome to bring your own ideas. You might build background coding agents, work on the infrastructure they need to run reliably, or use agents to solve a problem in banking operations.

During the fellowship, you’ll own one project or several smaller ones. You’ll figure out what to build, make the technical decisions, and see it through to use. Our engineers will work with you, review your code, and help when you get stuck. You’ll have room to experiment, with a dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage.

What we look for

You’re smart, work hard, and get things done without needing someone to map out steps for you. When you don’t understand something, you dig into it.

You don’t need years of experience. We’d like to see something you’ve built and hear how you approached it: what you did yourself, what was difficult, and what you’d do differently now.

We explicitly want to convert exceptional fellows into full time engineers. We look at the quality of your work, how independently you work, and how much agency you show paired with if you follow through.

Details

  • Three fellows per cohort, with two cohorts each year.

  • 3–6 months, in person in Berlin.

  • A dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage for your work.

  • Full-time offer, if you perform.

jobs.title: Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | Field Sales Bayern, München
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) ...

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

Saviynt is looking for a professional, highly motivated, and energetic Strategic Account Executive  to drive regional sales for our disruptive IaaS Cloud Security, Access Governance & Privileged Access Mgmt. (PAM) solutions. The Strategic Account Executive will combine a good working knowledge of (IaaS & SaaS) Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM with prospecting and sales skills. You will ultimately be responsible for the entire enterprise sales cycle and meeting or exceeding territory quota. Strategic Account Executives are the primary interface to both Prospects and Customers and are responsible for actively driving and managing day-to-day prospecting and selling activity in the region. This activity includes opportunity Discovery, Demo, RFP/RFI, Evaluation & POC stages of the sales process, and working in conjunction with Sales Engineering & Product Management Teams to identify and close new deals.  This job is located remotely in Germany.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
  • Effectively interact with Field Sales, Cloud Team, and Line of Business decision makers.
  • Learn and maintain knowledge of Saviynt’s solutions, focused on Cloud.
  • Security, Cloud Access Governance and PAM
  • Aggressively identify qualified sales opportunities across all assigned accounts.
  • Develop and leverage all lead sources (personal and partner contacts, inbound leads, events, and outbound prospecting) to generate a meaningful pipeline.
  • Maintain disciplined, detailed, and up-to-date records on Lead and opportunity activity in SFDC to ensure effective leadership development, proper team communication, and executive visibility.
  • Be diligent in timely follow-up and provide quality work products.
  • Attend and assist with corporate and field sales and marketing events.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue objectives.

    • WHAT YOU BRING
  • 7+ years sales experience in enterprise Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM Sales preferred
  • Possess a knowledge base of Cloud Identity Management, Cloud Privileged Access Management, and/or Cloud Security Governance technology.
  • Cloud Security domain knowledge helpful, including AWS, Azure, Google, IBM, Chef, and Puppet.
  • Strong cybersecurity territory contacts at VP, SVP, CxO levels
  • Successful history of working with Resellers, SI’s, and Advisories.
  • Strong Customer Service orientation, persistence, and ability to follow through.
  • Proven ability and skill to navigate through all levels of an enterprise organization to drive sales.
  • Professional, ambitious, determined, and results-oriented mindset.
  • Positive attitude, team-oriented, self-starter who can work alone and in a collaborative manner to achieve regional goals.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Verifiable track record of results.
  • Travel will be required to appropriately manage your assigned territory.

jobs.title: (Senior) Solutions Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Be bold, think big and grow with us!
 

We are one of the fastest growing B2B scale-ups in Germany, creating real value for the engineering industry. With our software, we are setting a new standard in the spare parts business, enabling comprehensive market transparency for the first time. To achieve this, we challenge the status quo every day and support our employees in actively shaping their careers and pushing their own boundaries. Become part of a team that can't be stopped, that overcomes challenges together and celebrates success together.

Be part of our success story and join us as Senior Solutions Engineer (f/m/d)!

You will own the bridge between our customers’ business requirements and MP ONE’s commercial and technical capabilities, leading discovery, demos, and proof-of-value work that moves complex deals across the finish line.


Your Mission
  • Lead customer discovery, technical presentations, tailored demos, and proof-of-value engagements for MP ONE.
  • Collaborate with prospects to understand their business and pricing challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and align MARKT-PILOT solutions with their objectives.
  • Partner with Sales to build and present compelling technical and business cases to executive stakeholders, clearly demonstrating how MARKT-PILOT drives revenue growth and strengthens competitive advantage.
  • Design and deliver personalized product demonstrations that address specific customer needs and showcase clear ROI and measurable business outcomes.
  • Plan, execute, and evaluate proof-of-value trials, ensuring a seamless process, well-defined success criteria, and actionable insights that validate impact.
  • Serve as the go-to expert on MP ONE’s solutions, integrations, and capabilities, translating technical features into tangible business results.
  • Support strategic sales cycles by providing hands-on technical guidance and proactively addressing challenges to keep deals moving forward.
  • Work closely with Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to share field insights, shape product improvements, and inform roadmap priorities.

    • Your Skills
  • You bring at least five years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales or solutions engineering, ideally in B2B SaaS, manufacturing or data-driven industries.
  • You bring practical knowledge of pricing strategies, competitive analysis and ROI-driven business cases, ideally from a manufacturer or relevant pricing context. Pricing is core, aftermarket experience is not required, and you can contribute without learning pricing fundamentals from scratch.
  • You have led enterprise discovery, technical presentations, tailored demonstrations and proof-of-value or proof-of-concept engagements.
  • You explain complex technical concepts as clear business value for diverse audiences, including senior decision-makers, and build strong customer relationships.
  • You understand enterprise integrations such as ERP, CRM and APIs; familiarity with HubSpot and SaaS delivery models is a plus.
  • You collaborate effectively with Sales, Product, Professional Services and Customer Success, bringing curiosity, creativity, strong problem-solving skills and a proactive scale-up mindset. A relevant degree in engineering, business, computer science or a related field is a plus.
  • You are fluent in German and English.
  • You are willing to travel to customer locations and to the Stuttgart office as required.

    • Your Benefits
  • Our modern and open scale-up culture gives you the freedom to unleash your creativity within a dynamic and agile team. 💡

We are looking for a Senior Development Manager to join our Hunt: Showdown team in our state-of-the-art Frankfurt studio. As Senior Development Manager, you will drive the delivery of one or more sub teams, ensuring alignment with Hunt: Showdown’s overall strategy and milestones. jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Microsoft 365, Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Kigen IT-Systemhaus
Kigen IT-Systemhaus ist ein auf Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit spezialisiertes Unternehmen mit Standorten in Engstingen und Stuttgart. Wir betreuen Unternehmen von der Kanzlei bis zur Unternehmensgruppe und legen Wert auf saubere, sichere IT-Umgebungen. Bei uns gibt es kurze Wege, Vertrauen und echte Weiterentwicklung statt Konzernstrukturen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du bist fester technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Raum Stuttgart. Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen im First und Second Level, richtest Arbeitsplätze, Drucker und Besprechungsräume ein und bist bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden. Im laufenden Betrieb verwaltest du Benutzer, Geräte und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online und Teams und unterstützt in hybriden Umgebungen mit Active Directory.

Das bringst du mit
Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung und bereits im IT-Support oder in der Administration gearbeitet. Windows Clients und Active Directory sind dir vertraut, Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Intune ist ein Plus. Du hast einen Führerschein und gehst ruhig und freundlich mit Kunden um. Du erfüllst nicht alles? Wenn du motiviert bist, dich einzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine ersten Monate
Du lernst unsere Kunden und deren Umgebungen kennen, übernimmst Schritt für Schritt den Support und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Gründer zusammen. So bekommst du direkten Wissenstransfer, auch in Themen wie Security und Compliance.

Was wir bieten

  • Teilzeit (ab 20 Stunden) oder Vollzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt

  • Remote-Arbeit, vor Ort nur bei Kundenterminen im Raum Stuttgart

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne Ausstattung

  • Echte Lernkurve in Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit

Vergütung
45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto jährlich bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit anteilig.

jobs.title: Qualitätsmanager:in Projekte Lebensmittel (m/w/d) | Region Rheintal, Österreich
jobs.descriptionHtml:
In einem international tätigen Unternehmen der Lebensmittelindustrie betreust du Projektgruppen mit Qualitätsfokus und sicherst die Produktqualität über mehrere Standorte hinweg. Du arbeitest eng mit Standorten, Lohnherstellern und Lieferanten zusammen und bist dafür regelmässig in Europa unterwegs.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

  • Bis zu 50 % Reisetätigkeit in Europa, am Wochenende meist zuhause
  • Schnittstelle zwischen Standorten, Lohnherstellern und Lieferanten

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektgruppen zu Qualitätsthemen betreuen und die Produktqualität gemeinsam mit den Standorten absichern
  • Standorte, Lohnhersteller und Lieferanten im Qualitäts- und Prozessmanagement operativ begleiten und weiterentwickeln
  • Fehlermeldungen und Reklamationen analysieren, Ursachen klären und gezielte Massnahmen mit den Beteiligten anstossen
  • Audits bei Standorten, Lohnherstellern und Lieferanten durchführen oder begleiten und Qualitätsstandards sichern
  • Lieferanten vor Ort besuchen und Qualitätsthemen direkt mit den Partnern klären
  • Qualitätsdokumentationen pflegen und für Audits und Projekte stets aktuell halten

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich oder technischen Bereich, ein Studium ist von Vorteil
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement, idealerweise in der Lebensmittelindustrie
  • Sicheres Deutsch und Englisch, auch in der Zusammenarbeit über Landesgrenzen
  • Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %, vor allem innerhalb Europas
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office und SAP oder einem vergleichbaren ERP
  • Selbstständige, organisierte und genaue Arbeitsweise mit viel Eigeninitiative

Das erwartet dich

  • Dienstwagen und Verpflegung
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Entlohnung über dem Kollektivvertrag, je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung

Arbeitsort: Raum Rheintal, Österreich (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

jobs.title: Senior Projektmanager:in Umspannwerke (m/w/d) | Region Ostschweiz, Schweiz
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Für ein Unternehmen der Energieversorgung verantwortest du Projekte für Unterwerke (Umspannwerke) von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung. Du führst Projektteam und Lieferanten, leitest Bewilligungsverfahren und hältst Termine, Kosten und Schnittstellen im Griff. Im Zentrum stehen Netzprojekte, in denen Spannung und Leistung steigen und Betriebsmittel ersetzt werden.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

  • Langfristige Netzausbau-Projekte, teils mit Laufzeit bis 2032
  • Technische Tiefe in Hochspannung sowie Leit- und Schutztechnik

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projekte für Unterwerke über alle Phasen führen und das Ergebnis gesamthaft verantworten
  • Technische Spezifikationen und Konzepte für Hochspannungsanlagen erarbeiten und mit den Fachbereichen abstimmen
  • Termine, Kosten und Schnittstellen laufend steuern, damit Projekte im Plan bleiben

jobs.title: Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. You will join our international Team Network Planning - Europe North & UK.

This position is part-time (20 hours per week), based in our Berlin office (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Perform data entry, tracking, and validation across tools (Excel, Planr, Salesforce, backend systems, etc.), including regular data updates and quality checks
  • Support preparation of presentations, reports, analyses, and maps
  • Support the team in network planning activities in order to open sales and adapt our offer to transportation demand
  • Take meeting notes, clean up content, and provide concise summaries
  • Support the analysis of our network with various datasets and reports in order to continuously improve our service
  • Prepare important documentation for the authorization of new bus lines
  • Provide operational support throughout the annual timeline

About You

  • Enrolled student or graduate in Transportation Planning, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Urban Planning, Geography, Tourism or similar
  • You're passionate about the transportation sector and show a keen interest in schedule and network planning
  • Strong analytical skills, readiness of mind and a goal-driven personality
  • Fluent in English, all other European languages are considered as a plus
  • Accurate work style as well as strong communication skills
  • Skilled user of the MS Office programs, especially Word and Excel

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior CRO & Funnel Marketing Manager (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du hast schon Onlineshops zum Wachsen gebracht und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du auf höchstem Niveau arbeiten kannst? Dann übernimm bei EVOLVE die Conversionrate-Optimierung und Funnelentwicklung von E-Commerce-Brands, von der ersten Analyse bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Unser Name ist Programm: Wir entwickeln uns, unsere Dienstleistung und unsere Kunden ständig weiter. Das spiegelt sich auch in unserer Mitarbeiterbewertung auf kununu mit 4,8 von 5 Sternen wider.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Positionierung: Du deckst die entscheidenden Hebel in der Customer Journey auf und entwickelst Positionierungen, die Marken klar vom Wettbewerb abheben

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst conversionstarke Shop- und Landingpage-Konzepte und steuerst die Umsetzung mit UX-Design und Copywriting

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

jobs.title: Tester
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About pkconsult

We design and build business-critical information systems that help our clients to improve their business intelligence. Operating as a tight-knit team in Berlin, we focus on delivering reliable software that powers core operations for our partners.

What you will do

  • Evaluate business-critical information systems to verify functionality and performance against client requirements.

  • Identify defects and edge cases through systematic testing before features reach production.

  • Collaborate directly with developers to isolate issues and trace root causes in complex software environments.

  • Maintain test documentation and report findings clearly to keep engineering cycles on track.

What you bring

  • Demonstrated experience in software quality assurance and systematic testing methodologies.

  • Familiarity with inspecting business-critical systems and identifying functional discrepancies.

  • Strong analytical approach to troubleshooting and documenting technical issues.

  • Clear communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Your first months at pkconsult

You will take ownership of testing our current release cycle, running systematic checks on active client projects, and setting up structured test cases alongside the development team. If you match most of these requirements and are ready to dig into complex software systems, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation and benefits

EUR 42,000–58,000 per year

  • 24 vacation days per year

jobs.descriptionHtml:
🌐 We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform to provide fair, clean energy to everyone. ⚡

We’re a diverse team of 50+ employees, with 46% being female and from 16+ nationalities, and steadily growing. Having raised of over €40 M in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission! 🚀

🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um faire und saubere Energie für alle zugänglich zu machen. ⚡

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!
Mit über 40 Mio. € an Finanzierung suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen. 🚀

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day operations and key account relationships with our sales partners, ensuring smooth collaboration and ongoing support

  • Plan and coordinate sales campaigns with partners to drive customer acquisition and channel performance

  • Manage the rollout of new offers & partners across the direct sales channel

  • Improve existing processes, reporting, and performance tracking to make channel operations more efficient and scalable

  • Support other acquisition channels and cross-functional growth initiatives as needed, acting as a versatile all-rounder within the Growth team in Berlin

    What We're Looking For

  • 0–2 years of experience in Growth, Sales Operations, Business Development, Account Management, or a similar field (relevant internships or working student experience count!)

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously

  • An analytical mindset and confidence working with data, reporting, and operational processes

  • A proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to take initiative

  • A proactive mindset towards using AI and automation to improve efficiency, while being mindful of potential risks and limitations

  • Must-have: Fluent German (C2, ideally native-level) and excellent written and spoken English (C1/C2)

🌐 About Us

We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp™ , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive.

How? Through variable tariffs, dynamic pricing, smart EV charging, heat pump and solar optimization, and Germany’s first virtual power plant: NeoGrid™.

At Ostrom, you’ll work in a dynamic, open environment where you can be yourself, take on challenges, and grow both personally and professionally.

🌱Environmental Impact: Each customer who switches to Ostrom on average helps offset 1.5 tons of CO2 emissions per year compared to the average German energy mix.

jobs.title: C&I Sales Lead (Commercial & Industrial Energy)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🌐 We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform to provide fair, clean energy to everyone. ⚡

We’re a diverse team of 50+ employees, with 46% being female and from 16+ nationalities, and steadily growing. Having raised of over €40 M in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission! 🚀

🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um faire und saubere Energie für alle zugänglich zu machen. ⚡

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!
Mit über 40 Mio. € an Finanzierung suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen. 🚀

Your mission

  • We are looking for an entrepreneurial C&I Sales Lead (m/f/d) to bring Ostrom's green energy revolution from households to businesses.

  • Ostrom is one of Germany's fastest-growing digital energy suppliers, with a proprietary Virtual Power Plant (VPP), AI-driven trading and award-winning customer service. Now we are bringing this full stack to commercial and small-scale industrial (C&I) customers.

  • You own the sales side of this new business line end to end: go-to-market, pipeline, winning and growing our first C&I clients and building the sales team.

Your tasks

  • Go-to-market: Define target segments and sales approach for commercial and small-scale industrial customers (e.g. SMEs, multi-site businesses, manufacturing, data centers)

  • Pipeline: Generate leads through your network and partner channels (e.g. energy consultants, hardware providers, brokers)

  • Deals: Close deals with our first C&I clients and onboard them

  • Key account management: Build long-term relationships with our C&I clients and grow them over time

  • Team: Build and lead the C&I sales team as the business grows

Your profile

  • 3+ years in C&I energy sales, key account management or origination (e.g. at a utility, supplier, trading house or flex aggregator), with a strong track record of closing deals

  • Independent and hands-on: you love building a new business line from scratch

  • Understanding of C&I sourcing strategies and energy cost optimization (e.g. storage, grid fees, flexibility)

  • Open to using AI and modern CRM tools in your daily sales work

  • Willingness to travel within Germany to visit clients and attend industry fairs and events

  • German (C1 to C2) and English (C1)

Nice to have

  • Strong network in the German energy and industrial sector

  • Previous start-up experience or experience building up a new business line

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!
Mit über 40 Mio. € an Finanzierung suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen. 🚀

Your mission

  • We are looking for a motivated Trading Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) to support us in the green revolution of the electricity market as a digital and smart electricity provider.

  • As a key member of our Trading team, you will take full ownership of the infrastructure that powers our trading platform.

Your tasks

  • Provide and maintain compute infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, logging, and monitoring for our trading systems, and manage associated cloud costs

  • Own system architecture for our trading platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and low-latency performance

  • Manage exchange connectivity and provide engineering support across our trading infrastructure

  • Drive how we build with AI: roll out coding agents, set shared agent rules and guardrails, and keep MCP integrations and context docs consistent across repos

Your profile

  • Degree in Computer Science or similar and 4+ years of experience in trading infrastructure engineering or a related field

  • Proven ability to write production-grade code (Python or similar), following best engineering practices (Git, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews)

  • Hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure, including operating compute (e.g. ECS, Lambda), data and messaging services (e.g. Firehose, SQS, Postgres, DynamoDB, S3), and monitoring (CloudWatch)

  • Experience with containerization (e.g. Docker) and observability tools (logging, metrics, alerting)

  • Experience with MLOps and ML infrastructure, e.g. model training, deployment, scheduling, data processing and monitoring in cloud environments

  • Strong understanding of system architecture design for high-availability, low-latency systems

  • Familiarity with AI coding tools and AI-assisted workflows

  • Excellent communication skills in English (B2–C1)

Nice to have

  • Experience with exchange connectivity (e.g. EPEX / EEX or ISVs)

  • Experience with Ray and Airflow

  • Experience with Terraform

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Product Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

We are hiring a Product Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships in the German market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will identify and manage relationships with strategic product partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership sourcing and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Over time, lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in product partnerships or partnership business development within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

jobs.title: International Expansion - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France and Europe?

Do you thrive in a trustful, fast-paced environment?

Then Pennylane might be the right place for you — and you, might be the perfect fit for this role 🙂

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of European SMEs.

We help business owners get rid of the time consuming hassle of handling accounting and finance, while giving them access to key information that they can use to make better decisions.

Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and we're accelerating in Germany 🇩🇪)

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

About Strategy & Operations at Pennylane:

At Pennylane, being part of the Strategy & Operations team means deeply understanding operational realities. As we launch our German entity, we design and implement efficient, scalable solutions that enable Pennylane to reach and exceed its ambitious expansion targets. Your role will be pivotal in structuring local operations from scratch, scaling existing processes, and tailoring our operating model to the specificities of the German market. To make this launch a success, our Strategy & Operations teams work daily alongside Business teams (Sales, Success Managers), Tech teams (Developers, Product Managers), and Data teams (Data Scientists, Data Analysts).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Verantworte CAM-Programmierung und Bearbeitungsstandards in unserer Hamburger Fabrik, vom Toolpath über die Erstmusterfreigabe und Zykluszeitoptimierung bis zur Produktionsübergabe.

Du baust das Programmier-Playbook, nach dem unsere deutschen Standorte arbeiten. Du programmierst es, du fährst es ein, du produzierst es.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Toolpaths für 3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Fräsen programmieren, simulieren und optimieren.

  • Jobs nach Luft- und Raumfahrt- und Verteidigungsstandards einrichten, einfahren und produzieren.

  • Werkzeuge, Schnittparameter und Spannstrategien für Aluminium, Stähle, Titan und Inconel auswählen.

  • Toolpath-Bibliotheken, Programmiervorlagen und Dokumentation von Grund auf aufbauen.

  • Maschinisten auf unsere Programmierstandards schulen, wenn das Team wächst.

Was du mitbringst

  • Fundierte CAM-Programmierung in Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX oder vergleichbar.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Toleranzen von ±0,01 mm oder enger.

  • Erfahrung im Einrichten und Fahren von High-End-Maschinen wie Hermle oder DMG Mori: Du programmierst und fährst die Maschine selbst.

  • Tiefes Verständnis von Vorschüben, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstrategie und Spanntechnik.

  • Sicheres Lesen komplexer Zeichnungen und GD&T, saubere Dokumentation und Revisionsdisziplin.

Schön wäre

  • Luft- und Raumfahrt- oder Verteidigungsfertigung.

  • Simultane 5-Achs-Bearbeitung.

  • Titan, Inconel und hochfeste Legierungen.

  • NC-Simulation, z. B. Vericut.

  • EN 9100 oder AS9100.

Warum Isembard

  • Technische Verantwortung für die Programmierstandards an unseren deutschen Standorten.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Moderne 5-Achs-Werkzeugmaschinen und wachsende Automatisierung.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Verfolge jeden Auftrag bis zur Lieferung und bau gleichzeitig die Lieferantenbasis auf, die wir dafür brauchen. Wir kaufen Kapazität, statt jede Maschine zu besitzen. Die Lieferantenbasis ist deshalb ein Produktionsmittel und keine Einkaufsfunktion. Heute arbeiten wir mit einer Handvoll Lieferanten, bis April sollen es acht sein, qualifiziert für Dreh- und Frästeile und Oberfläche.

Du berichtest an den Head of Operations und arbeitest täglich mit dem Operations Manager. Passend für jemanden, der nachfasst, ohne dass man ihn daran erinnert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Auftragsstatus von Anfang bis Ende verantworten, belastbar genug, dass andere ihre Entscheidungen darauf stützen.

  • Den Anfrageprozess selbst führen: Zeichnungen und STEP paketieren, anfragen, nachfassen, vergleichen, vergeben.

  • Lieferanten qualifizieren (ISO 9001, eigene Messtechnik, Erstmusterprüfbericht, Werkszeugnis 3.1) und Rahmenverträge mit Abruf aufsetzen.

  • Oberfläche und Wärmebehandlung steuern (Eloxal Typ II und III, Passivieren, 17-4PH H900) sowie die Materialversorgung unserer Maschinen.

  • Sicherstellen, dass ohne Exportkontroll- und Geheimhaltungsfreigabe nichts rausgeht, und bei jedem Wiederholteil fragen: selber machen oder kaufen?

Was du mitbringst

  • Organisation und Detailgenauigkeit, während sich die Prioritäten um dich herum verschieben.

  • Du liest eine technische Zeichnung und siehst, was den Preis treibt.

  • Anfragen und Verhandlungen selbst geführt, nicht über einen Zentraleinkauf.

  • Klar im Schreiben und im Reden, analytisch und souverän, wenn die Lage unklar ist.

  • Deutsch Muttersprache, Englisch sicher.

Schön wäre

  • Drehteile und Langdrehen.

  • Oberfläche und Wärmebehandlung.

  • ERP oder MES.

  • Luft- und Raumfahrt oder Verteidigung mit EN 9100.

  • Ein Lieferantennetz in Norddeutschland.

Warum Isembard

  • Ein Lieferantennetz aufbauen, das Teil unserer Produktion ist.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Arbeiten in MasonOS, unserer eigenen Software.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Steuere den Betrieb in Hamburg: von der Bestellung bis zur Auslieferung. Termin, Durchsatz, Material. Heute zwei Maschinen, im April sieben. Dazu Partnerfabriken der Gilde und Lieferanten, die uns nicht gehören. Du entscheidest, welcher Auftrag auf welcher Maschine liegt, was nach draußen geht und was wir zusagen.

Zerspanung, Engineering und Qualität sind eigene Teams auf Augenhöhe. Du führst sie nicht, du arbeitest mit ihnen. Dein Bereich ist Fertigungssteuerung, Wareneingang und Warenausgang, und du berichtest an den Head of Operations. Passend für jemanden, der einen Plan lieber verantwortet als kommentiert.

Was du verantwortest

  • Liefertreue und Durchsatz: Reihenfolge und Belegung über alle Maschinen, geplant in MasonOS.

  • Liefertermine setzen und halten, auch bei Schnellanfragen: Angebot in 12 Stunden, Lieferung in 3 Wochen.

  • Wareneingang, Warenausgang und Materialfluss, von Stangen und Rohteilen bis zum versendeten Teil.

  • Arbeit an Partnerfabriken der Gilde und qualifizierte Lieferanten routen und sie auf unserem Standard halten.

  • Taktzeiten, Auslastung, Ausschuss und Liefertreue: wöchentlich berichtet und abgestellt, nicht gesammelt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Operative Führung in der Produktion: hohes Tempo, lange Durchlaufzeiten, kleine Lose.

  • Termin- und Kapazitätsplanung selbst gemacht, nicht delegiert.

  • Lieferanten und Unterauftragnehmer gesteuert, inklusive Eskalation.

  • Du denkst in Systemen: Kapazität, Restriktionen, Reihenfolge, Durchsatz.

  • Deutsch und Englisch sicher: Die Halle läuft auf Deutsch, die Gruppe auf Englisch.

Schön wäre

  • Zerspanung oder ein anderes spanendes Verfahren.

  • EN 9100 oder ISO 9001.

  • Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung oder Energie.

  • Aufbau einer neuen Linie oder eines zweiten Standorts.

  • ERP oder MES, Lean oder Theory of Constraints.

Warum Isembard

  • Den Plan einer Fabrik verantworten, die schnell wächst.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Abläufe prägen, nach denen unsere deutschen Standorte arbeiten.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg, täglich in der Halle.

jobs.title: CMM-Programmierer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Du verantwortest die Messtechnik in unserer Hamburger Fabrik, von der CMM-Programmierung über die Erstmusterprüfung bis zur Ursachenanalyse bei Abweichungen und der Audit-Vorbereitung.

Du baust die Qualitätssicherung auf, statt eine bestehende zu übernehmen: Prüfprogramme, Tast- und Bezugsstrategien, Messmittelüberwachung und wie Qualitätsdaten zurück in die Zerspanung und in MasonOS fließen. Du programmierst es, du misst es, du gibst es frei.

Deine Aufgaben

  • CMM-Prüfprogramme in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso oder vergleichbar für komplexe Teile mit engen Toleranzen entwickeln und optimieren.

  • Erstmusterprüfungen (EN 9102), fertigungsbegleitende Prüfungen und Endfreigaben für Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung und Energie durchführen.

  • Taststrategie, Spannkonzept und Bezugssysteme festlegen und Prüfvorrichtungen bei Bedarf selbst auslegen.

  • Ursachen von Abweichungen finden und die Korrekturmaßnahme mit Zerspanern und CAM-Programmierern zurück an die Maschine bringen.

  • Kalibrierung aller Messmittel verantworten und die Dokumentation nach EN 9100 audit-fest führen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der CMM-Programmierung in der Präzisionsfertigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt oder einem Zerspanungsbetrieb.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit PC-DMIS und/oder Zeiss Calypso.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in GD&T und ISO GPS, sicher mit 3D-CAD-Modellen der Kunden.

  • Prüfdokumentation aus der Luft- und Raumfahrt: FAI, AS9102 oder EN 9102.

  • Du prüfst und sicherst Toleranzen von ±0,01 mm und enger ab.

Schön wäre

  • Aufbau einer Qualitätssicherung von Grund auf oder eine begleitete EN 9100- oder AS9100-Zertifizierung.

  • GD&T-Zertifizierung oder eine Qualifikation in Qualitätssicherung.

  • Werkzeugmaschinenintegriertes Messen auf 5-Achs-Maschinen mit Regelkreis-Korrektur.

  • SPC und Prozessfähigkeitsanalyse.

  • Etwas Englisch, für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams in Großbritannien und den USA.

Warum Isembard

  • Die Qualitätssicherung einer neuen Fabrik ab Tag eins verantworten.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Prüfstandards setzen, die unser Netzwerk übernimmt.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

jobs.title: CMM Programmer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Own dimensional inspection at our Hamburg factory, from CMM programming and first article inspection to non-conformance root cause and audit readiness.

You will build the metrology function rather than inherit one: inspection programmes, probing and datum strategy, gauge calibration, and how quality data flows back into machining and MasonOS. You program it, you measure it, you sign it off.

What you'll do

  • Program and optimise CMM inspection routines in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso or equivalent for complex, tight-tolerance parts.

  • Run first article inspection (EN 9102), in-process inspection and final sign-off for aerospace, defence and energy work.

  • Set probing strategy, fixturing and datum schemes, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

  • Find the root cause of non-conformances and take the corrective action back to the machine with our machinists and CAM programmers.

  • Own calibration of all measuring equipment and keep records to EN 9100 standard, ready for customer and certification audits.

What we're looking for

  • Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

  • Strong practical command of PC-DMIS and/or Zeiss Calypso.

  • Deep working knowledge of GD&T and ISO GPS, and confident with customer 3D CAD models.

  • Aerospace inspection documentation: FAI, AS9102 or EN 9102.

  • Able to measure and verify tolerances of ±0.01 mm and tighter.

Nice to have

  • Building a quality function from scratch, or taking a site through EN 9100 or AS9100.

  • GD&T certification or a quality management qualification.

  • In-process probing on 5-axis machines with closed-loop correction.

  • SPC and process capability analysis.

  • Some English, for working with our UK and US teams.

Why Isembard

  • Own the quality function of a new factory from day one.

  • Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components.

  • Set inspection standards that our network will use.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Hamburg factory.

Applications in German or English are welcome. Lieber auf Deutsch? Hier bewerben.

Isembard is an equal opportunity employer.
