jobs.title: Rollout Manager Europe (gn) – KI-Anwendungen
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du weißt, wie Software in vielen Ländern wirklich ankommt? Dann bring jetzt KI in den Alltag einer europäischen Gruppe.

Arbeitsort: Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 10 bis maximal 15 Prozent.

​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.

Die beste KI-Anwendung bringt allerdings wenig, solange sie nur in der Zentrale funktioniert. Ob die Transformation gelingt, entscheidet sich im Alltag der Landesgesellschaften, und genau dort setzt diese Rolle an.

​

Deine Aufgaben

Du berichtest direkt an den CTO, arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem Produktteam und bringst die eigene KI-Anwendung in die Länder.

  • Du machst Länder und Standorte startklar, planst die Rollouts, behältst Risiken im Blick und bereitest die Go/No-Go-Entscheidung vor.

  • Du klärst lokale Besonderheiten und nötige Anpassungen mit dem Produktteam.

  • Du gewinnst lokale Führungskräfte für die Veränderung, misst die Nutzung und räumst Hürden aus dem Weg.

  • Du organisierst Trainings gemeinsam mit Trainer:innen und Key Usern vor Ort.

  • In der Hypercare bist du erste Anlaufstelle und übergibst stabile Nutzung an die Länder.

  • Mit jedem Release bringst du weitere Features und Agenten in die Fläche und verbesserst dabei das Vorgehen.

​

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst rund 3 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit und hast mehrere Software-Einführungen in verschiedenen Ländern oder an vielen Standorten selbst gesteuert, etwa ERP, CRM, HCM oder SaaS, ob im Unternehmen, beim Softwareanbieter oder beim Implementierungspartner.

  • Du kennst Change, Training und die Arbeit mit Key Usern aus der Praxis.

  • Du verbesserst Adoption anhand von Nutzungsdaten und Feedback.

  • Du verstehst operative Geschäftsprozesse und kannst Menschen für Neues begeistern.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

  • Von Vorteil: erste Praxis mit KI-Anwendungen oder Agenten, Erfahrung in einem Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten, eine Sprache aus Mittel- oder Osteuropa.

Zur Einordnung: Du steuerst Rollouts selbst und hands-on. Wenn du heute vor allem als Programmdirektor:in große Teams und Budgets führst, ist die Rolle vermutlich nicht der passende Zuschnitt.

​

Wir bieten

  • Dein Einstieg ins KI-Thema: Deine Rollout-Erfahrung ist das Entscheidende, KI lernst du hier in der Praxis.

  • Viel Gestaltungsraum: Du entwickelst das Vorgehen für die ganze Gruppe mit.

  • International, aber planbar: Du arbeitest mit vielen Ländern, ohne ständig unterwegs zu sein.

  • Sichtbarkeit: direkter Draht zum CTO und zu den Führungskräften in den Ländern.

  • Eine Perspektive in Richtung Programmleitung.

  • Ein attraktives Paket aus Fixgehalt und variablem Anteil.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nah an den Entscheidungen: die rechte Hand des CTO in einer europaweiten KI-Transformation

Arbeitsort: Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 5 bis 10 Prozent.

​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.

Bei so vielen parallelen Vorhaben wird schnell zur entscheidenden Frage, wer alles zusammenhält und Entscheidungen rechtzeitig reif macht. Genau dafür entsteht jetzt direkt beim CTO die Rolle des Chief of Staff.

​

Deine Aufgaben

Als rechte Hand des CTO bist du Dreh- und Angelpunkt zwischen Vorstand, Führungskräften und Engineering und koordinierst übergreifende Projektteams.

  • Du bringst die wichtigsten Vorhaben des CTO ins Ziel.

  • Du entwickelst mit, wie die Technologieorganisation aufgebaut ist und gesteuert wird (Operating Model).

  • Du prägst mit, wie KI die Arbeit verändert, von der Softwareentwicklung bis zum Alltag in den Ländern.

  • Du bereitest Entscheidungen für den Vorstand vor und vertrittst dabei eine eigene Meinung.

  • Du sorgst für eine belastbare Faktenbasis: Was kosten Technologie, Partner und Anwendungen, und wer arbeitet woran?

  • Mit HR entwickelst du Rollen, Skills und Talente im Technologiebereich.

​

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst rund 5 bis 9 Jahre Erfahrung mit, in denen du bereichsübergreifende Themen vorangetrieben hast, etwa im Konzernstab oder Strategiebereich, im Inhouse Consulting, in einem Tech-Bereich, in großen Transformationsprogrammen oder in der Beratung.

  • Du hast Projektteams koordiniert und willst jetzt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen und Themen bis zur Umsetzung tragen.

  • Du hast Strukturen und Prozesse in Technologiebereichen mit aufgebaut.

  • Du hast generative KI praktisch eingesetzt und weißt, was es braucht, damit sie in einer Organisation trägt.

  • Du verstehst IT-Landschaften, Architekturen und moderne Softwareentwicklung gut genug, um sie kritisch zu hinterfragen.

  • Du baust Business Cases und Vorstandsvorlagen und vertrittst sie auch im Gegenwind.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Zur Einordnung: Die Rolle passt, wenn sie dein nächster großer Verantwortungsschritt ist. Wenn du heute schon auf Director-, Bereichsleitungs- oder Partner-Ebene arbeitest, ist sie vermutlich nicht der richtige Schritt.

​

Wir bieten

  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du formst Modell und Kultur mit.

  • Wirkung: Was du entwickelst, kommt in den Ländern an und verändert dort den Alltag.

jobs.title: AI Security Researcher
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role



As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats—model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection—and translating them into practical security defenses.

You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adversarial Threat Research: Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis: Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle—from data ingestion to deployment—to prioritize security investments.
  • Developing Defenses & Guardrails: Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats.
  • Collaborating with Engineering Teams: Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public.
  • Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends: Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research.

Requirements

  • University degree in AI/ML or relevant discipline.
  • Current residence in Germany or Austria.
  • Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only.

jobs.title: Registered Dietician - Part Time, Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ubique Group

Ubique Group is a privately held furniture company serving consumer and commercial markets through a portfolio of recognized brands, digital commerce relationships, dealer and reseller networks, and direct business channels. For more than 25 years, we have built brands from inception to success and offered furniture solutions that balance form, function, and style.

We are a community of passionate, hard-working, and supportive people who believe in our business and one another. We value individual capability, the collective power of the team, and a shared commitment to the communities around us.

The Opportunity

The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis leads how Ubique Group plans, measures performance, and makes decisions. This role owns the company planning cycle and serves as a senior financial partner to leaders across sales, operations, supply chain, sourcing, and marketing.

You will lead the Annual Operating Plan, rolling forecast, long-range planning, and the financial view used by the executive team, board, and lenders. As a hands-on player-coach in a lean organization, you will develop models and analysis directly, coach the Sr. Manager, FP&A, and help shape pricing, channel, inventory, sourcing, capital, and growth decisions.

What You Will Do

Planning Forecasting and Reporting

  • Own the company-wide Annual Operating Plan, rolling forecast, and multi-year long-range plan across revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount, and EBITDA.
  • Lead the monthly and quarterly planning cadence, including forecast calls, variance analysis, and monthly business reviews.

Job Title: Business Operations Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, Global

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Business Operations Experts to contribute to an AI training project by designing realistic, multi-step operational tasks with objective grading criteria. The role involves transforming real-world business workflows into structured benchmark tasks that evaluate AI systems' reasoning, accuracy, and practical decision-making. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design multi-step tasks based on real business operations, including reporting, process design, and workflow management.
  2. Develop clear instructions and objective grading criteria to ensure consistent evaluation.
  3. Create tasks that require operational judgment, analytical thinking, and accurate interpretation of reference materials.
  4. Prepare supporting materials, including spreadsheets, system exports, process documentation, and operational reports.
  5. Identify ambiguous or ungradable tasks and refine them before submission.
  6. Deliver high-quality, approved tasks within project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 5 years of hands-on experience in business operations, operations reporting, process design, or workflow management.
  2. Experience developing or applying structured standards, including SOPs, QA checklists, process documentation, service-level definitions, or training assessments.
  3. Strong Excel skills and the ability to analyze information across multiple documents.
  4. Strong written and spoken English proficiency (B2 minimum; C1 preferred).
  5. Experience with AI or LLM evaluation is a plus but not required.

Project Details

  • Engagement: Project-based, with payment per approved task.
  • Compensation: Up to $90/hour equivalent.
  • Estimated Time: Approximately 10 hours per task.
  • Work Mode: Fully remote, with no geographic restrictions.
  • Language Requirement: B2-level English minimum; C1 preferred.

Selection Process

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete the role-specific AI interview to demonstrate your expertise.
  3. Complete onboarding with the Talent Operations team.

jobs.title: Operations Research Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Operations Research Engineer to join the Workforce Management (WFM) product stream and help build the optimization capabilities behind workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource allocation for a large-scale contact center environment.
The role focuses on applying operations research, mathematical optimization, and algorithm design to solve complex workforce planning problems at enterprise scale. You will work closely with Product, Workforce Management experts, Architects, and Engineering teams to transform business requirements into optimization models and production-grade optimization services that support scheduling, staffing, coverage management, and operational efficiency.
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong expertise in optimization, constraint programming, mathematics, and software engineering who enjoys solving real-world planning and resource allocation challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop optimization models for contact center workforce planning, scheduling and resource allocation.
  • Design and implement the schedule optimization engine using OR-Tools/CP-SAT.
  • Own the constraint model end to end: formalize business rule into a solvable, maintainable model.
    Build the production-grade solver as a service within the WFM platform that meets latency targets for real forecast group volumes.
  • Define and validate schedule quality metrics (coverage attainment, constraint violations, solve time, solution stability across re-solves) and instrument the service so quality can be monitored in production.
  • Build and execute tests and validation of optimization algorithms to deliver performance, scalability, and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to integrate optimization models into an enterprise-grade optimization engine of the workforce management platform.
  • Partner with workforce-planning and real-time-analyst stakeholders to validate that generated schedules are operationally usable.
  • Effectively communicate and present findings, methodologies, and results to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • 6+ years of professional experience designing and implementing optimization solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with OR-Tools (CP-SAT), or a comparable constraint-programming / mixed-integer-programming solver.
  • Strong foundation in linear programming, integer programming, or stochastic optimization.
  • Direct experience modeling and solving workforce or resource scheduling problems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and solving large scale optimization problems.
    Proficiency in Java, Python, or C++.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into mathematical models and optimization objectives.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to build production-ready services and validation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of WFM domain.
  • Experience building optimization solutions for workforce planning, scheduling, logistics, transportation, or resource allocation.
  • Knowledge of forecasting and decision-support systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot.

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.

Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.

Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.

What does a Freelance Online German Teacher do at Busuu?

As a Freelance Online Teacher at Busuu, you’ll play a key role in helping students learn language effectively and confidently. On a day-to-day basis, your responsibilities will likely include:

  • Planning, preparing, and teaching online lessons (45 minutes each) for corporate clients.

  • 1:1 Lessons: Deliver private lessons that include both language teaching and personalised coaching- conducting needs analyses, assessing levels, creating bespoke learning paths, checking progress during lesson time, and setting clear goals.

  • Group Lessons: Teach online group classes that focus on active learning and communication.

What we’re looking for in a Freelance Online German Teacher:

  • C2 Level of German

  • Valid teaching certificate such as TEFL/CELTA or related university degrees

  • Experience in online teaching and providing 1:1 coaching or personalised learning support

  • Fluency in additional languages:

    • B2 or above in an additional language

    • Bonus: Speaking more than two languages

  • Comfortable teaching: presentation skills, negotiations, business email etiquette, meeting management, multicultural communication, etc.

  • Excellent communication skills to engage and teach students

  • High-Speed Internet, Modern Laptop / PC with a microphone and camera

  • Must comply with local freelance/contractor regulations

What are the terms of this freelance role?

  • $17 paid per lesson taught

  • Materials Provided

  • Remote position

  • Freedom to set your own schedule

  • Access to Busuu Premium, to continue your own language learning

  • Opportunity to interact with and teach students from around the world

  • Valuable teaching experience with one of the industry’s leading companies

What happens next?

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around. The hiring process for the freelance online role are the following 3 steps:

  1. CV application review - We will review it as quickly as possible and update on the next steps

  2. Let’s chat - Quick interview with the teacher operations manager about your experience and the role

  3. Short onboarding course

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious, or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgment-free zone to speak freely.

jobs.title: Director/a Técnico/a (Software Architecture & Technology Strategy)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
En knowmad mood seguimos impulsando proyectos de alto impacto tecnológico y buscamos incorporar un/a referente técnico crosspara participar como responsable técnico de las iniciativas/proyectos que llevamos a cabo en clientes estratégicos.

Esta figura tiene como objetivo dar visión, alinear y potenciar todas las actividades técnicas horizontales de la compañía tanto en ejecución de servicios como en elaboración de preventas técnicas.

Los proyectos suelen estar liderados técnicamente por un technical leader de la comunidad tecnológica correspondiente. Estas figuras de referentes técnicos entran a más alto nivel, más a nivel cross de cliente y no tanto a nivel proyecto.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

  • Participación como referente técnico de knowmad mood en clientes donde tenemos servicios de alto valor, acompañado de perfiles multidisciplinares (líderes técnicos, arquitectos, Project managers, etc), con interlocución directa con el cliente. Todo lo que está dentro de la operación de un cliente estamos involucrados en ello (cobertura completa del cliente), desde la planificación del proyecto, preventa, ejecución, …

  • Interlocución técnica con cliente. Participarás en elaboración de preventas, definición de soluciones, presentaciones ante clientes de las capacidades globales/específicas de knowmad mood, PoCs y pilotos de ciertas soluciones.

  • Entrar en proyectos/clientes en los que una solución se está complicando para desbloquearlo. Intentamos llegar muy cerca, entender el problema a bajo nivel.

  • Promover las mejores prácticas e infraestructura para la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo (Ecosistema de desarrollo: repositorio de código, IaC,...).

  • Participar en reuniones de estrategia técnica con representantes técnicos de las diferentes comunidades tecnológicas, para ver sinergias así como decidir estrategias técnicas.

  • Proponer nuevas iniciativas y liderarlas técnicamente en colaboración con otros Líderes Técnicos y miembros de Centro Experto de otras Comunidades (Iniciativas de Inteligencia Artificial, nuevas tecnologías, etc).

  • Diseño y definición de arquitecturas robustas y escalables, alineadas con las necesidades del negocio y los estándares de calidad.

  • Análisis de viabilidad técnica de soluciones, evaluando tecnologías, enfoques arquitectónicos y trade-offs.

  • Traducción entre negocio y tecnología, asegurando una comunicación fluida y expectativas realistas.

¿Qué estamos buscando en ti?

  • Experiencia como arquitecto de software/soluciones de, al menos, 10 años en el diseño, estimaciones, gestión de riesgos e implementación de soluciones empresariales de diferentes tecnologías.

  • Experiencia mínima de 3 años como Referente técnico para clientes (no solo proyectos), con líderes técnicos a cargo en los mismos, y, habilidades para el liderazgo de equipos así como amplia experiencia en metodologías ágiles.

  • Experiencia trabajando con IA Generativa aplicada al desarrollo de software.

  • Creatividad y sensibilidad por la innovación y con iniciativa para proponer y liderar nuevas formas de trabajo u organización de equipos.

  • Capacidad demostrada para asumir responsabilidades de gestión, liderazgo de equipos y relación con cliente.

  • Experiencia en proyectos cerrados.

  • Experiencia en preventa técnica: diseño de soluciones, estimaciones, documentación, gestión de riesgos y defensa ante cliente.

  • Amplia experiencia definiendo arquitectura de software (patrones de arquitectura, arquitectura hexagonal, principios SOLID, microservicios, EDA, ...)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust and ease seamlessly co-exist. Today, BioCatch counts over 25 of the top 100 global banks as customers who use BioCatch solutions to fight fraud, drive digital transformation, and accelerate business growth. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry-led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting-edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit www.biocatch.com.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (GTM and Business)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.

DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally.

We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys.

If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place.

The Role

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to lead recruitment across Go-to-Market (GTM) and Business functions, including Marketing, Growth, Sales, Partnerships, and other business-critical roles.

If you're great at partnering with hiring managers, building strong talent pipelines, finding talent beyond traditional sourcing channels, and bringing fresh ideas for employer branding and community building, we'd love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

  • Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for GTM and Business roles, from sourcing and screening to offer acceptance

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs, define candidate profiles, and align recruitment strategies with business priorities

  • Proactively identify and engage top talent through creative sourcing strategies, networking, and relevant professional communities

  • Drive employer branding initiatives and bring fresh ideas to strengthen our presence in the talent market

  • Plan, attend, and represent Infomediji (DeoVR) at industry events, conferences, and community meetups to expand our talent network

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience independently managing full-cycle recruitment for GTM and Business roles, particularly across Marketing, Growth, Sales, Partnerships, or related functions

  • Strong sourcing skills and a strategic understanding of where and how to identify and attract business talent, including hard-to-find profiles

  • Proven experience partnering directly with hiring managers and stakeholders at different levels, from Team Leads to Executives

  • Good understanding of GTM functions, business roles, and the skills required to succeed in them

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a proactive, independent, and ownership-driven mindset

  • Experience or interest in employer branding, event management, and community engagement

  • Fluent in English (B2+); Russian language skills are a plus

Hiring Process

  • Team Interview (45 min)

  • Case Task (1-3 hours)

  • Chief of Staff Interview (45 min)

  • CEO call (45 min)

💼Explore our hiring process

What We Offer

Please note, that this is a fully remote contract role. B2B cooperation only – you will work with us as an independent contractor operating through your own legal business entity (e.g., sole proprietorship, limited company, or equivalent).

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering team in a rapidly evolving industry

  • Direct impact on the future of immersive media

  • Flexible working hours and remote-first culture

  • A team that values initiative, clarity, and collaboration

  • Access to all tools and tech you need

  • Unlimited DeoVR Premium

  • A work environment where ideas matter and people are treated with respect

Stay Connected

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Game Designer / Gameplay Developer (AI Video Annotation)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote — North America, Latin America, Europe, UK, and Oceania

We are engaging Game Designers and Gameplay Developers to support an AI video annotation project focused on robotic systems. You'll apply your understanding of actions, states, interactions, and outcomes to analyze and accurately label robotic activity. No prior AI or robotics experience is required.

Scope of Work

  • Review video footage of robotic arms performing real-world tasks.
  • Identify and label actions, object interactions, state changes, outcomes, and errors.
  • Apply systems thinking to understand action sequences, cause and effect, and success or failure conditions.
  • Use annotation tools to label video content accurately and consistently.
  • Flag ambiguous events and document observations clearly.
  • Review annotations and provide quality-control feedback.
  • Complete assigned annotation tasks accurately and on time.

Required Skills

  • Game Development
  • Video Annotation
  • Analytical Skills
  • Gameplay Analysis
  • Systems Thinking
  • Attention to Detail
  • Visual Analysis

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in game design, gameplay development, technical game design, or game QA.
  • Strong understanding of actions, states, interactions, rules, and cause-and-effect relationships.
  • Experience testing, debugging, or documenting gameplay behavior.
  • Excellent attention to detail and consistency.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Experience with data annotation, visual QA, AI training, or robotics is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior SEM Strategist, O&O
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Overview

Forbes Advisor is looking for a Senior Strategist of Growth to join the Forbes Advisor Performance Marketing team, focusing on new owned and operated products in Financial Services and Company Formation spaces. A proven track record of driving business growth through SEM and other channels is required for this role. If you're looking for challenges and opportunities similar to those of a start-up, with the benefits of an established, successful company, read on.

The position, reporting into the SVP of Marketing, will own the development and execution of the performance marketing strategy for the owned and operated products. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in PPC advertising with an emphasis on SEM, a hands-on and proactive mindset, and the ability to make sound decisions and move initiatives forward. They are detail-oriented, action-driven, and eager to personally contribute to the success and growth of our business.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop growth strategy and oversee the of day-to-day execution of performance marketing for the products
  • Direct and support team members in determining the optimal tactics and approach to realize the commercial priorities
  • Coordinate with product and finance teams to develop a clear understanding of product LTVs to ensure media channels are operating at target ROI
  • Utilize data-driven analysis insights, identify opportunities, and make recommendations for performance optimizations
  • Evaluate and improve attribution models used to measure channel performance
  • Advise the team on findings from regular performance reviews to set appropriate actions to be taken to drive growth
  • Work closely with product managers to align paid strategy with on-site experience
  • Explain variance in performance against target to leadership and other stakeholders in management commentary (and in other forums as required)

Professional Competencies:

  • Passion for performance marketing
  • Highly motivated individual with a proven track record for exceeding expectations
  • Outstanding ability to think creatively and identify and resolve problems
  • Attention to detail and the ability to effectively multi-task in a deadline-driven atmosphere
  • High levels of autonomy and self-motivation
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, project management, and time management skills

Requirements:

  • Proven 8+ years’ experience in PPC/SEM/Social/Display
  • Experience with customer acquisition leveraging LTV models for business services products
  • Strong knowledge of smart bidding strategies, including Google Ads’ TROAS and TCPA

We’re currently hiring a Seasonal Customer Service Specialist. In this role, you’ll provide exceptional service through both inbound and outbound communications. As part of a company focused on delivering exceptional service and value to our customers, your impact will matter - both to your team and our organization. Why You’ll Love Working Here

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Where Trust Leads, Bold Ideas Grow, and Community Thrives

Paula’s Choice, a global skincare leader founded in 1995, empowers individuals to define beauty on their own terms through science-backed products. Our mission comes to life through four core values that guide our actions, decisions, and impact:

  • Build Trust: We set the standard for skincare, transparency, and shared knowledge.
  • Be Bold: We lead through innovation and by challenging the status quo.
  • Act with Kindness: We operate with respect and care—for our customers, colleagues, and the planet.
  • Create Community: We believe in the power of connection—whether educating customers, supporting each other, or giving back, we grow stronger together.

Our team spans North America, Australia/New Zealand, Europe, and the broader APAC region, collaborating globally to drive innovation. We offer space to thrive—personally, professionally, and through our comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at every stage:

  • Generous paid time off, including time off to volunteer
  • Learning and development resources to support personal and professional growth
  • Wellness benefits like meditation app memberships, product discounts, and free samples of our amazing products
  • Most roles are fully remote (roles that are required to be at our Seattle HQ can be found in the details section of this job post)
  • Great location – for roles that are hybrid or fully onsite, we’re in the heart of Seattle’s beautiful International District 
  • Did we mention we’re a dog-friendly office? 

Our culture encourages continuous learning and is fueled by connection, curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration. Whether onsite, remote, or hybrid, we stay connected through shared initiatives that bring our teams together. If you’re inspired by transparency, driven to make an impact, and eager to help foster community—we’d love to have you join us.

How you’ll have at Paula’s Choice: This role is responsible for elevating demand planning from a fragmented, channel-by-channel activity into a single, disciplined global process. You’ll own the demand step of S&OP, drive a consistent forecasting methodology across NAM, APAC, EU and ANZ, and lead the aggregated, category-level global demand plan in partnership with regional planners who own SKU-level forecasts. Working with Commercial, Marketing, Finance and Supply, you’ll build the consensus demand plan, sharpen launch and in-month forecasts, and surface demand shifts early enough for the business to act. You’ll also be a pivotal member of the implementation team for our new demand planning solution.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain an accurate rolling 18-month global demand plan, keeping assumptions consistent across base trends, new launches, samples, promotions, retention strategy changes, and holiday and peak volumes.
  • Own the aggregated, category-level global demand plan for revenue-generating units, partnering with category and regional/market planners who own SKU-level forecasts so the two levels reconcile.
  • Lead the demand step of a newly formalized, integrated S&OP process spanning Demand, Supply, Commercial, Marketing and Finance, including monthly demand reviews with regional partners.
  • Build the consensus demand plan with Commercial, Marketing, Finance and Supply, and represent demand planning at the consensus and executive tiers of S&OP, clearly communicating risks, opportunities and key assumption changes.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Standard Metrics is an AI-driven financial data platform that helps investors and their portfolio companies make more informed, forward-looking decisions with automated reporting and benchmarking tools. We’re a team of optimistic product builders on a mission to accelerate innovation in the private markets. Standard Metrics is backed by 8VC and Spark Capital, along with other leading VCs and angels, and is currently a trusted partner for many of the top VC/PE firms in the world.

Come Build With Us

We are building out our Deployment team to onboard and train new customers and to ensure they are positioned for success. You will become a trusted advisor for some of the top venture capital firms and startups in the world, deeply understanding their business goals in order to implement best practices and ensure that our customers have a seamless onboarding experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Implementation function end to end: strategy, process, tooling, staffing, and results for every customer deployment
  • Build and lead the Implementation team, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members and setting clear goals and performance standards
  • Set, track, and report on the function’s KPIs (time-to-value, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and resource utilization) and use them to drive continuous improvement
  • Design scalable, repeatable implementation playbooks, and leverage tooling to automate processes to drive efficiency
  • Serve as the lead point of contact and escalation owner for strategic and complex deployments, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at our customers
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Data teams to scope deals accurately pre-sale, define clear hand-offs, and ensure seamless transitions post-implementation
  • Own capacity planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent deployments, balancing customer commitments with internal resources
  • Bring the voice of the customer to Product to inform roadmap

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in implementation, professional services, or customer onboarding, ideally within financial services, enterprise B2B SaaS, or consulting
  • 2+ years leading a team or function, with a track record of building processes and scaling a team from the ground up
  • Demonstrated ownership of a function’s outcomes and metrics, not just individual projects
  • Strong finance knowledge; familiarity with venture capital fund and portfolio company reporting is a strong plus
  • Expert program and project management skills, with the ability to oversee a large portfolio of concurrent deployments
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functionally, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Data teams
  • Outstanding communication skills, including comfort presenting to executives and senior customer stakeholders
  • A builder’s mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure where little exists
  • Passion for technology, startups, entrepreneurship, and/or venture capital

For our employees located in the USA, we aim to pay at or above the market rate of US-based tech hubs like San Francisco or NYC. For international roles, we aim to pay top of market for your country. The estimated annual salary for this role is between $115,000-$145,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Blue Ridge

Blue Ridge is a Supply Chain Intelligence company. We help distributors and the businesses that supply them turn everyday demand, inventory, and replenishment decisions into freed-up working capital and stronger service levels. Our AI-native platform, powered by Blu (our Generative AI) and Built on Databricks, pairs nearly two decades of distribution and supply chain expertise with modern, explainable AI. Every customer is backed by our Strategic Success practice: embedded former practitioners who make sure the platform delivers value, not just goes live.

We win in complex distribution environments, from automotive aftermarket and CPG to wine and spirits, food and beverage, HVAC, electrical, and industrial. In those businesses, forecasting and replenishment are the line between cash trapped in inventory and healthy, profitable growth. It is a strong moment to join: the market need has never been sharper, and we are investing in the sellers who can meet it.

The Role

We are hiring an Account Executive who can build and win complex sales in supply chain across mid-market and enterprise accounts. You will work pipeline from every source, co-sell with partners, and carry an executive-level business case from first meeting to signature. You will own new-business growth in a defined territory, backed by a full go-to-market engine: Marketing-generated demand, channel and ecosystem partners, SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and our Strategic Success team.

What You'll Do

Build pipeline from every source

  • Turn Marketing-generated demand and partner-sourced opportunities into qualified pipeline and add to it through the network you build and keep warm.
  • Build and execute account plans that open and penetrate target distributors and suppliers.
  • Run disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecast your business accurately, quarter over quarter.

Run complex sales cycles

  • Lead multi-stakeholder deals from discovery and qualification through business case, negotiation, and signature.
  • Build ROI and business cases that hold up to CFO and executive scrutiny, grounded in working capital, service levels, and forecast accuracy.
  • Deliver value-driven demonstrations tailored to each customer's operation, alongside Solutions Consultants.

Co-sell with partners

  • Build and work joint pipeline with our channel and ecosystem partners through sell-with and sell-through motions, with services attach.
  • Bring the right partner into the right deal at the right time, and be a seller partners want to work with.

Build and work your network

  • Develop relationship capital across the distribution markets we serve.
  • Represent Blue Ridge at industry events, trade shows, and customer gatherings, and turn that presence into pipeline.
  • Stay current on distribution industry trends and the forces shaping our customers' businesses.

Be a trusted advisor

  • Bring a point of view on the challenges distributors face and connect them to outcomes rather than features.
  • Maintain deep command of the Blue Ridge platform, Blu, and the value we create.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota in new-business acquisition....

About the Role:

We are hiring a Paid Media Creative Strategist for our client, a digital marketing agency, to support ad concept ideation, creative briefing, and performance analysis across multiple brands. Nice to Haves:

jobs.descriptionHtml:
French Bilingual Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Description

We are seeking French Bilingual Experts to contribute to an AI training project focused on advancing next-generation AI technologies.

In this role, you will use your French and English language expertise to evaluate audio content and help improve AI language understanding and generation. No prior AI experience is required—your language proficiency and domain knowledge are what matter.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with strong written and verbal communication skills who are passionate about contributing to the future of AI.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Listen to French audio clips and evaluate the nativeness and fluency of speakers or AI-generated speech.
  2. Assess pronunciation, intonation, and linguistic authenticity according to established guidelines.
  3. Document evaluations through clear and concise written feedback in English, highlighting key linguistic factors.
  4. Provide detailed justifications for each evaluation to ensure clarity and consistency.
  5. Collaborate with project coordinators to clarify requirements and resolve ambiguities in language content.
  6. Share insights to help improve AI model performance in French language understanding and generation.
  7. Complete assigned audio review tasks accurately and on time while maintaining high-quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Native-level proficiency in French, with clear enunciation and natural fluency.
  2. Minimum B2-level proficiency in English, particularly in written and verbal communication.
  3. A background in voice specialization, linguistics, phonetics, music/audio engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  4. Experience in audio analysis, transcription, or linguistic assessment is highly valued.
  5. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and explain nuanced language differences.
  6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and accuracy.
  7. Familiarity with media, communications, or teaching is considered an added advantage.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

Business Analyst

We are seeking a Business Analyst to support a modernization initiative within a public sector organization. This role will lead business analysis, requirements gathering, process documentation, and testing for a comprehensive system replacement project. The ideal candidate will work closely with the client department and multiple internal teams to validate business processes, design solutions, and ensure successful system implementation and adoption.

This position requires someone who can lead requirements validation and business process analysis to support a system modernization initiative replacing legacy capabilities with updated workflows and new functionality. The role encompasses facilitating workshops and interviews to gather and document business requirements, supporting system configuration and customization, guiding data migration activities, developing test cases and conducting functional testing, and creating project artifacts including workflows, use cases, requirements documents, fit-gap analysis, and business process models. The Business Analyst Level 2 will also support change management and training activities, work with business representatives on process redesign, and assist with other project deliverables as directed by project leadership.

This position is open to remotecandidates however hybridin St. John is preferred.

  • 7+ years - business analysis experience in requirements gathering, process documentation, and system implementation
  • 7+ years - developing and documenting statements of requirements for considered alternatives
  • 7+ years - performing business analyses of functional requirements to identify information, procedures, and decision flows
  • 7+ years - evaluating existing procedures and methods and documenting database content, structure, and application subsystems
  • 7+ years - developing data dictionaries
  • 7+ years - defining and documenting interfaces between manual and automated operations, external systems, and new and existing systems
  • 7+ years - identifying candidate business processes for redesign, prototyping solutions, and providing trade-off analysis
  • 7+ years - establishing acceptance test criteria with clients
  • Experience with agile methodologies and project management lifecycle frameworks
  • Experience writing test cases, executing functional testing, and identifying and prioritizing defects
  • Experience developing training materials and supporting user training activities
  • Experience with Oracle databases and APEX reporting
  • Experience with .NET Framework environments
  • Experience with data migration activities including data cleansing, conversion, and validation

Preferred Qualifications

Every employee must understand, comply with and attest to the security responsibilities and security controls unique to their job, and comply with all applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements and internal policies and procedures

Every employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the job and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship. Potential pay for this position ranges from $17.85 - $25.48 based on experience and skills.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are Local Infusion.

Local Infusion is the fastest growing infusion provider in the United States, with a mission to transform the specialty infusion industry, because patients deserve better. By providing both exceptional, patient-centered care and the proprietary, AI-driven technology powering it, Local Infusion accelerates access, simplifies workflows, and improves outcomes for everyone in the infusion journey — from patients and clinicians to health plans, health systems, employers, and pharma.

Clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients, bringing comfort, connection, and community back to healthcare. With Local Infusion, every patient and every care team is fully supported, every step of the way.

Role Overview: Infusion Nurse Practitioner

We are seeking a skilled and compassionate Nurse Practitioner (NP) to support the clinical launch of our new infusion centers. This part-time (approx. 8 hours/week or 1 day/week) role is dedicated to providing high-quality patient care and support through the launch of our new centers. The ideal candidate will bring clinical expertise, attention to detail, and a commitment to patient safety and operational excellence.

Location: Remote - Work from Home

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Ensure effective communication with patients across all aspects of their care (scheduling, symptoms, inquiries, etc.)

  • Strong clinical judgment, experience in IV therapy preferred.

About the Role

Join a B2B AI communications SaaS team as a Senior Fullstack Engineer, building voice AI products for businesses. You will own customer-facing features from concept through deployment and help shape the product roadmap.

What You'll Do

  • Build and evolve full-stack product features using NestJS, TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Take features from discovery and prototyping through production release.

  • Engage with customers through support, feedback sessions, and user testing to understand their needs.

  • Prioritize and scope work around immediate customer value, then iterate based on feedback.

  • Contribute to feature prioritization and product roadmap decisions.

  • Ship improvements frequently while maintaining focus on reliable, customer-facing software.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of full-stack engineering experience building and delivering SaaS products.

  • Strong hands-on experience across both backend and frontend engineering, including TypeScript, React, and Node.js; NestJS experience is preferred.

  • Experience owning end-to-end features, from technical and product decisions through deployment.

  • Experience working directly with customers and using feedback, experiments, and metrics to inform product decisions.

  • Native German proficiency and fluent English.

  • Experience with AI or LLM integrations, fast-moving product teams, or European AI and data privacy considerations is useful.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual base salary: €80,000 to €120,000. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote within Germany.

jobs.title: Senior HR Generalist / HR Business Partner 80–100% (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Affidea ist der führende Anbieter von diagnostischer Bildgebung und ambulanter medizinischer Versorgung in Europa. In der Schweiz betreiben wir rund 40 medizinische Zentren mit über 1000 Mitarbeitenden in den Bereichen Radiologie, medizinische Zentren und Labore. Unsere Organisation wächst, befindet sich in einer spannenden Transformationsphase und legt grossen Wert auf Qualität, Compliance und ihre Mitarbeitenden.

Ihre Rolle

Diese Position verbindet operatives HR mit Business Partnering. Von Beginn an sind Sie Ansprechpartner/in und Sparringspartner/in für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in allen personalrelevanten Fragen und verantworten ausgewählte operative HR-Prozesse. Mit dem Ausbau unseres HR Shared Services Centers wird der administrative Anteil schrittweise reduziert. Der Fokus verlagert sich dann zunehmend auf HR Business Partnering, die Beratung von Führungskräften und strategische HR-Themen.

Sie berichten direkt an die Lead HR Business Partner East und werden im Tagesgeschäft von einer HR Assistant unterstützt.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Hands-on HR-Administration, Arbeitsverträge, Reglemente sowie Koordination der Lohnverarbeitung (initiale Phase)

  • Zentrale HR-Ansprechperson für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycles

  • Beratung von Führungskräften in personalrelevanten Fragen sowie Betreuung von Employee-Relations-Themen im regulierten Gesundheitsumfeld

  • Fachliche Mitwirkung bei der Harmonisierung von HR-Richtlinien, Arbeitsverträgen und Vorsorgelösungen

  • Unterstützung von Rekrutierungs-, Onboarding- und Personalentwicklungsinitiativen

  • Mitarbeit in Change-, Integrations- und HR-Transformationsprojekten

Wir bieten

  • Die Möglichkeit, echten Impact zu leisten und HR-Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Mitwirkung an Transformations-, Integrations- und strategischen HR-Initiativen

  • Ein professionelles, kollegiales Umfeld, das Fachkompetenz, Eigenverantwortung und Engagement schätzt

  • Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektiven in einem dynamischen Gesundheitsumfeld

  • BVG-Beiträge ab dem ersten Franken (kein Koordinationsabzug)

  • Kostenlose Untersuchungen für Mitarbeitende und im selben Haushalt lebende Familienmitglieder

  • Sponsoring von Anmeldungen zu Sportveranstaltungen

  • Flottenrabatte bei AMAG und weiteren Garagen

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Weiterbildung in Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion

  • Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung im operativen HR, inklusive Administration und Payroll-Koordination

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse des schweizerischen Arbeitsrechts und bewährter HR-Praktiken

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem anderen regulierten Umfeld bzw. starke Affinität dazu

  • Fliessend Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit auf Gruppenebene

  • Ausgeprägtes Business-Verständnis und Sicherheit in einem dynamischen, sich wandelnden Umfeld

  • Pragmatische, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Sie haben Freude daran, Fundamente aufzubauen, mit Unklarheiten umzugehen und Ihre HR-Expertise in nachhaltige Strukturen einzubringen.

Diese Stelle wird in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Rekrutierungspartner Michael Page besetzt. Bitte bewerben Sie sich ausschliesslich über die Stellenanzeige von Michael Page unter folgendem Link:

Highlights

HR Business Partnering mit Hands-on-Anteil in einem wachsenden Gesundheitsnetzwerk. Bewerbung über Michael Page – Link in der Stellenbeschreibung.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Agent Marketplace
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Architect the future of machine-to-machine commerce as a founding member of a zero-to-one engineering squad. You will design, build, and scale the coordination fabric for agent-to-API and agent-to-agent transactions—spanning discovery, identity, billing, and settlement—built directly on top of Kong’s world-class runtime stack. Operating as an autonomous startup unit inside Kong, this team is responsible for lowering organizational drag, unlocking engineering velocity, and establishing Kong’s absolute leadership in the Agentic Era.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and own the end-to-end full-stack surfaces of the marketplace loop, delivering high-performance tools, the underlying REST API substrate, and developer-facing onboarding systems.

  • Design the foundational agent-native user experience, creating robust Model Context Protocol (MCP) server capabilities, sandboxed test environments, and elegant CLI/SDK generation workflows.

  • Scale and protect the transaction infrastructure by building high-reliability pipelines for programmatic identity verification, usage attribution, granular metering, and complex multi-party settlement.

  • Drive cross-functional execution across Kong's engineering ecosystem, partnering with gateway runtime, security plugins, and global core teams to smoothly integrate marketplace features.

  • Lead architectural design reviews and champion a zero-technical-debt culture while proactively preventing scaling bottlenecks across distributed backend components.

  • Mentor engineers across the organization, multiplying the team's output by translating ambiguous product bets into highly defined, modular, and shippable technical milestones.

  • Own the technical lifecycle completely by writing crystal-clear engineering documentation and product specifications for every system you architect.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience engineering enterprise-grade production software with a proven capability to design, build, and support complex distributed systems from scratch.

  • Master-level expertise with a modern backend stack (such as Golang or similar systems languages) alongside deep architectural command of API infrastructure, Kubernetes, and cloud-native patterns.

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing autonomous agent applications, tool-calling systems, prompt loops, or systems designed explicitly for machine consumption.

  • Deep operational familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, usage-based metering pipelines, billing integration patterns, or secure data exchange layers.

  • Strong written communication and technical articulation skills, with an unwavering comfort operating within remote, globally distributed engineering environments (West Coast/Bay Area alignment preferred).

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. jobs.title: Founder's Office Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What We're Looking For 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions

Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The role

You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Environment & Sustainability Expert — PowerPoint Review & Reconstruction

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

We are engaging Environment & Sustainability Experts to contribute to a project focused on improving the clarity, accuracy, and impact of environmental and sustainability presentations.

In this role, you'll apply your domain expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will contribute to how AI models learn, reason, and perform using high-quality, real-world professional input. No prior AI experience is required — your subject-matter expertise is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Reconstruct business slides on environment and sustainability topics accurately in Microsoft PowerPoint.
  2. Improve slide quality through effective data visualization, visual storytelling, and presentation design while maintaining factual accuracy.
  3. Review and refine content to align with scientific standards, regulatory terminology, and industry-specific considerations.
  4. Create a detailed slide-by-slide log documenting modifications, improvements, and intentional non-changes, along with the rationale for each decision.
  5. Apply sound judgment when strengthening weak slides while preserving and defending strong, well-supported original choices.
  6. Work with materials including sustainability reports, ESG presentations, environmental compliance documents, emissions summaries, and corrective action plans.
  7. Complete each assignment within approximately 1–2 hours, with flexible, sprint-based project volumes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 3+ years of experience in EHS, sustainability, ESG, environmental engineering, environmental compliance, or a related field.
  2. Experience creating executive-level or client-facing presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint.
  3. Strong skills in slide reconstruction, data visualization, visual storytelling, and presentation design.
  4. Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear message hierarchies, evidence-based titles, and appropriate visual exhibits.
  5. Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to explain content and design decisions clearly.
  6. Strong understanding of environmental terminology, regulatory language, sustainability concepts, and factual accuracy.
  7. Experience in AI training, evaluation, or rubric development is a plus, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Slide Reconstruction
  • Presentation Design
  • Data Visualization
  • Visual Storytelling
  • Content Editing
  • Critical Thinking
  • Attention to Detail
  • Written Communication
  • Environment & Sustainability
  • Environmental Compliance
  • ESG
  • EHS

Job Title: Senior Associate, Finance

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Senior Associate, Finance

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen is searching for a Senior Associate, Finance who will play a key role in financial support of the Global Markets and Policy (Global Markets) organization. The Senior Associate will be part of the Global Markets Finance team and help support financial consolidation of worldwide Amgen sales. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Finance in the Global Markets Finance group.

Key activities for the Senior Associate, Finance include:

Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa – überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. Ein zentraler Hebel für unser Wachstum ist eine konsequent getestete Customer Experience – vom ersten Besuch über die Planung im Konfigurator bis zur Bestellung. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland – eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d).

das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.

  • Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.
  • Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests
  • Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen – und nicht nur, was gut aussieht

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich

  • Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms – inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren – und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (U.S.)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
beehiiv is where the world's best newsletters, podcasts, and digital products are built, grown, and distributed. The platform combines email, podcast hosting, websites, community, and digital products — connected to a single audience and a single set of tools to publish, grow, and monetize. As we approach $50M in annualized revenue and continue to grow almost 100% YoY, our rapidly growing product suite and incredibly strong brand position us for the next stage of hypergrowth.

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative. Our customers are newsletter-first media companies, publishers, and brands, many of them moving off tools that weren’t purpose-built for media-first operators, like Sailthru, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, and Mailchimp. Inbound demand is strong, and we’re scaling our outbound program.

We already have the tools, process, and infrastructure to find the right people at the right companies. Your job is simple: be extremely good at talking to prospects over the phone, write really good emails, and book qualified meetings for our AEs.

Top performers have a clear path to AE. We look for creative, hungry people who aren't afraid to pick up the phone, can write like a human, and are extremely driven.

Candidates must be based in the U.S. Compensation depends on experience. To apply, you must complete our Values Assessment Questionnaire here. We will consider your responses alongside your qualifications and experience as part of our overall hiring process.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • 1-2 years as an SDR/BDR at a B2B SaaS company, ideally selling to mid-market accounts with multiple stakeholders
  • A track record of generating qualified meetings and pipeline through cold outbound, not just inbound qualification
  • A love of prospecting: you find creative ways into target accounts instead of waiting for leads
  • Comfort on the phone: cold calls don't scare you, and you treat them as a core channel
  • You write like a human: you can write a personalized email in under 10 minutes that a buyer will open and reply to
  • Research instincts: you can dig into a company, find the right buyer and build a credible point of view (POV) on why they should care about beehiiv
  • Coachability: you ask for feedback, act on it fast and can show how you've improved
  • Media, publishing, creator economy or martech experience is a huge plus

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Owning your number: Hit monthly goals for qualified meetings and new pipeline.
  • Cold calls: you will spend a lot of time on the phone
  • Emails / Socials: Run multi-channel sequences across email, and socials. Test, iterate and double down on what works.
  • Qualifying and handing off: Qualify fit, urgency and decision process, then hand off to AEs with the context they need to win.
  • Triaging inbound: Qualify inbound interest quickly, route what's ready to AEs and nurture what isn't.
