jobs.title: Customer Care Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
matelso ist ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches MarTech-Unternehmen aus Kaiserslautern in der Pfalz. Unser Team aus rund 40 Mitarbeitern in den Bereichen Product Management, Tech und Marketing arbeitet jeden Tag gerne und voller Leidenschaft daran, für unsere Kunden zukunftsfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die einen echten Mehrwert bieten.

Du hast Spaß daran, Kunden weiterzuhelfen, findest für jedes Problem eine Lösung und interessierst dich für digitale Technologien? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!

Als Specialist im Customer Care (m/w/d) bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden. Du unterstützt sie bei Fragen rund um unsere MarTech-Lösungen, sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe und stellst sicher, dass sie das Beste aus unseren Produkten herausholen.

Aufgaben

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und kümmerst dich um ihre Anliegen – kompetent, freundlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du unterstützt bei Fragen zur Nutzung unserer Produkte und Services und hilfst dabei, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen.

  • Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und findest passende Lösungen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, um Kundenanliegen effizient zu bearbeiten.

  • Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Customer Care, Customer Support, Customer Success oder in einer vergleichbaren Position.

  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher verständigen.

  • Du kommunizierst gerne, bist serviceorientiert und hast Freude am Umgang mit Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Software und MarTech.

  • Du bist neugierig, lernbereit und hast Lust, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.

Was Du von uns erwarten kannst

  • Attraktives Gehalt: Deine starke Performance belohnen wir mit einem attraktiven Fixum

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: Mit unserem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell und einer vollumfänglichen Vertrauensarbeitszeit kannst Du deine Work-Life-Balance miteinander in Einklang bringen.

  • Energie für Dich und Dein Auto: Ob Kaffee, kühle Getränke oder Snacks – bei uns ist für Deine Stärkung gesorgt. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von kostenlosen Mitarbeiterparkplätzen und E-Ladestationen.

  • Zusatzleistungen, die sich lohnen: Sachbezugskarte und exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte

  • Unbefristete Anstellung: Alle Zeichen stehen auf Wachstum. Daher erhältst Du selbstverständlich einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und die Perspektive einer nachhaltigen Zusammenarbeit.

  • Individuelle Personalentwicklung: Wir beginnen bereits während der Onboarding-Phase damit, gemeinsam Stärken, Entwicklungsfelder und fachliche sowie persönliche Ziele zu reflektieren.

  • Echter Teamspirit und regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents: Wir bieten Anlass zum Zusammensein und wollen Erfolge feiern.

  • Spannende Herausforderungen: Unsere Organisation wächst im Umfeld zukunftsweisender Technologien, Trends und Themen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Big Data und der Digitalisierung.

Interessiert?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins unter Verwendung unseres Webformulars.

Du hast vorab Fragen? Dann steht dir Stephanie von Ploetz gerne per Telefon zur Verfügung: 0631 91464476

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Our Content Marketing team at Wpromote is looking to add a Content Marketing Manager to develop, execute, and optimize content strategies that drive measurable business outcomes across organic search, AI-powered search experiences, and integrated marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Director of Content Marketing, you'll partner with clients to create high-quality content that builds brand authority, increases discoverability, and supports key business objectives. You'll collaborate across SEO, Paid Media, Social, Digital PR, Creative, and Analytics to develop data-driven content strategies and leverage modern content workflows to deliver impactful results.
At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

-Remote-first culture
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Flexible schedules
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $70,000 - $80,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quartzy is seeking a Vendor Relations Manager to build, manage, and grow strategic supplier relationships across our Life Sciences & Chemicals portfolios. You’ll drive growth and profitability by strengthening existing partnerships, identifying new opportunities, and bringing on strategic suppliers that expand and enhance our product portfolio.


Quartzy is a 100% distributed team so this role can be done anywhere in the US.


About You

You’re a relationship builder and problem solver who understands the Life Sciences industry and enjoys finding ways to create value for both suppliers and Quartzy. You’re commercially minded, data-driven, and comfortable navigating everything from supplier negotiations and business reviews to solving day-to-day challenges. You’re proactive, adaptable, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and proactively find solutions as the business evolves.


Why Quartzy

At Quartzy, we believe science moves faster when labs spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. Our platform streamlines how labs order, track, and manage supplies so researchers can focus on scientific breakthroughs that change the world.

Quartzy is the world’s #1 lab management platform, trusted by hundreds of thousands of scientists worldwide. By combining SaaS and eCommerce in a unique business model loved by customers, we help researchers spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. From cancer research and climate change to winemaking and vegan cheese, our impact is broad and meaningful. You’ll have the flexibility of remote work, the security of a profitable business, and the purpose of contributing to discoveries that matter. At Quartzy, your work has an impact - on your life, your career, and on science worldwide.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and manage strong, profitable, and lasting supplier partnerships by negotiating pricing, terms, growth targets, incentives, and service expectations.

  • Drive supplier profitability and commercial performance by analyzing cost of goods, margin, sales, and growth trends and identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and execute supplier growth strategies, including pricing initiatives, promotional programs, incentives, and other opportunities to increase sales and customer engagement.

  • Lead supplier business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities and gaps, establish priorities, and align on actionable plans for growth.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Quartzy to identify opportunities, address supplier and operational challenges, improve processes, streamline workflows, and support system and supplier integrations.

  • Own the resolution of escalated supplier issues, coordinating with internal teams and suppliers to drive timely resolution and maintain strong relationships.

  • Ensure data integrity across supplier catalogs and Quartzy systems, including Salesforce, Looker, and the Quartzy application.

jobs.title: Account Delivery Manager - USA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure - an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. As electric vehicles (EVs) drive a transformation of the transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of that grand revolution, and we’re just getting started. Our product - the AMPECO EV Charging Platform - is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their EV charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies all over the world, from North and South America to Europe, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission. We are looking to expand it with like-minded, capable people, eager to give, learn and grow with us.

About the role

At AMPECO the Account Delivery Manager (ADM) is the central role in servicing our clients: one person who owns the customer end-to-end and orchestrates a constellation of specialists around them.

You’ll be the primary point of contact for your customers’ operational and technical teams, driving value across the full lifecycle - from greenfield onboarding, through day-to-day operations, to long-term satisfaction. You don’t need to be the deepest expert in every area, you need to know when, how and why to pull in our specialists, and you're comfortable working hands-on in the platform and resolving service requests directly when that's what moves the customer forward.

If you thrive on ownership, problem-solving and building relationships, this is a chance to shape how AMPECO delivers for its enterprise clients.

What you’ll do

    Own the customer relationship

    • Own a portfolio of customers end-to-end, building a deep understanding of their business model, technical environment and commercial goals;
    • Act as the primary point of contact for operational and technical stakeholders, ensuring their priorities and our platform stay aligned;
    • Handle straightforward commercial topics directly, and partner with Business specialists on contract negotiations, expansion and C-level relationships.

    Run service delivery and operations

    • Own incident and escalation management end-to-end - from SLA tracking and governance of open items to direct, hands-on resolution of service requests where your involvement is the fastest path to a customer outcome;
    • Manage the onboarding of new customers in collaboration with AMPECO’s experts;
    • Run a clear cadence of operational reviews, status updates and account health checks so nothing drifts.

    Orchestrate the specialists supporting you

    • Know when, how and why to pull in Business or Technical specialists - and provide the needed context so they can address the request of the customer quickly;
    • Translate customer needs into structured requirements, then work with product, engineering and solution teams to assess feasibility, scope and timelines;
    • Keep internal stakeholders aligned and the customer informed throughout cross-functional delivery.

    Advise and shape the product

    • Act as a trusted advisor on day-to-day product use and adoption, and signal expansion opportunities as they emerge;
    • Surface customer feedback, recurring patterns and product gaps to internal stakeholders so we keep improving the platform;
    • Stay current on eMobility, EV charging trends and our evolving product capabilities.

What we’re looking for

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Specialist - REMOTE (US Midwest or US Eastern Region)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us:

At Botrista, we are revolutionizing beverage culture with intuitive, Nature-guided drink-making technology. By empowering restaurants and establishments to expand their menus without added complexity, we are driving growth and innovation at the touch of a button. Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our solutions create a new industry category, applicable to any cuisine, demographic, and business. With rapid deployment of our machines nationwide, we are delivering extraordinary beverage experiences to customers everywhere.

Position Summary

Botrista is hiring a hands-on Revenue Enablement Specialist to design and deliver practical onboarding and ongoing training for Sales and Account Management. You will help employees ramp faster, strengthen customer-facing skills, and consistently execute the behaviors that drive new sales and growth of existing accounts. This is an individual contributor role with ownership of training design and delivery.

Requirements

  • Audit and overhaul existing Sales and Account Management onboarding materials; build and personally deliver structured, role-specific onboarding with live practice, field observation, and readiness certification.
  • Design, launch, and personally facilitate an ongoing education program for existing employees, including prospecting, discovery, demos, negotiation, product knowledge, customer economics, account planning, retention, expansion, and beverage sales growth.
  • Travel into the field to observe customer interactions, coach practical skills, and identify development opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales and AM managers to identify skill gaps, create targeted training, and provide coaching resources. Functional managers retain accountability for individual performance.
  • Own and continuously improve the training curriculum, onboarding materials, continuing education calendar, and enablement knowledge base; collaborate with functional leaders on Sales and AM playbooks.
  • Translate new menus, products, pricing, tools, and commercial processes into clear, usable field training.
  • Work with RevOps to measure proficiency, ramp time, adoption, and relevant productivity improvements; target readiness for independent selling within 30 days and full productivity within 90 days, recognizing that territory and pipeline conditions also influence outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant commercial experience, including direct sales or account management experience and demonstrated success designing and delivering training or enablement programs.
  • Strong live facilitation and field coaching skills, with credibility among frontline sellers and account managers.
  • Ability to build practical programs from scratch: workshops, role plays, field coaching, and concise job aids—not just presentations.
  • Familiarity with consultative selling, customer growth motions, Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and sales performance data.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Restaurant technology, foodservice, multi-location, or physical-product experience is a plus, not required.

What We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in someone who can help us:

  • Improve productivity: we have roughly 60 employees across Revenue. modest improvements in sales conversion, rep production, and CSD can create meaningful incremental revenue.
  • Standardize onboarding: rebuild our existing program with a goal of getting new reps fully productive within 90 days.
  • Develop existing employees: establish recurring training on sales execution, account growth, product knowledge, and customer economics.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Sales Development Representative to join our growing team in New York, NY!


The Sales Development Representative will focus on acquiring new clients and will also play a pivotal role in cross-sell, upsell, and retention campaigns. Warm and cold call new business prospects and set sales appointments for the team. Consultative selling through education of customers via inbound and outbound calls. This may be accomplished by establishing strong broker, agency, and /or producer relationships through frequent contact, clear knowledge of company strategy and product and industry knowledge.


How You Will Contribute: 

  • Identify and qualify potential leads through research, networking, and outbound activities.
  • Work closely with the Sales Enablement team to align on targeted outreach campaigns and strategies.
  • Engage with prospects through various channels (email, phone, social media) to understand their needs, challenges, and how our solutions can address them.
  • Collaborate with partners to co-create marketing initiatives, events, and referral programs to expand the customer base.
  • Nurture relationships with potential clients, providing them with relevant content, product updates, and solutions that address their business needs.
  • Collaborate with the customer success team to ensure smooth transitions and consistent value delivery to clients.
  • Regularly update CRM systems with accurate customer and prospect information.
  • Analyze sales data and metrics to improve strategies and forecast future sales trends.
  • Support sales strategies and coordinate activities, such as visits to insurance broker offices, meetings, and networking events.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends, competitor offerings, and product developments.
  • Attend workshops, webinars, and training sessions to continuously hone sales and growth marketing skills.

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Willingness to obtain Insurance Producer license within 90 days of employment
  • Insurance Producer license in good standing (Preferred)

Skills & Experience to Be Successful:

  • Minimum education – Bachelor’s degree
  • 1+ years of experience in a sales or growth marketing role, preferably in a B2B setting
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Proficient knowledge in Microsoft Windows environment, including but not limited to Word, Excel, Power Point, and Publisher. Able to create, edit, and merge letters, spreadsheets, labels, etc.
  • Experience with CRM systems, marketing automation tools, and sales enablement technology
  • Exceptional telephone demeanor
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships
  • Passionate about growth, with an understanding of cross-selling, upselling, and retention strategies.

Pay Range

30 - 38 Hourly

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhance...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Planejamento, desenvolvimento, implantação e execução continuada de atividades de suporte técnico aos usuários de TIC e Serviços de Sustentação da Infraestrutura, remoto e presencial, abrangendo orientação e esclarecimento de dúvidas, recebimento, registro, análise, diagnóstico, atendimento de solicitações de clientes, resolução de problemas, implementação de serviços, migrações e transferência tecnológicas, execução de procedimentos periódicos, controle e atualização de documentações voltadas para sustentação da infraestrutura de TIC.

Consultoria e Engenharia de Middleware (JBoss, Tomcat e OpenShift)

  • Arquitetura e Parametrização: Configuração fina de servidores JBoss e Tomcat integrados à plataforma OpenShift, incluindo definição de parâmetros de memória (JVM), comunicação entre instâncias isoladas, datasources e módulos de autenticação/login.
  • Otimização Avançada (Tuning) e Escala: Aplicação de melhorias de desempenho no servidor e desenho de configurações de escalabilidade para suportar a alta demanda das aplicações do Poder Judiciário.
  • Ciclo de Vida Estratégico: Proposição proativa e execução de atualizações críticas de segurança (patches) e migrações de versão das plataformas de middleware, sempre alinhadas com a governança do tribunal.

Alta Disponibilidade, Observabilidade e Diagnóstico Especializado

  • Desenho de Soluções Resilientes: Realização de estudos de capacidade e proposição de arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade, englobando topologias de clusters, Load Balance e estratégias de redundância.
  • Monitoramento e Pareceres Técnicos: Monitoramento preventivo de intermitências, falhas e lentidões, com a responsabilidade sênior de emitir pareceres formais descritivos apontando causas-raiz e sugerindo soluções definitivas para aprovação do TJCE.

Sustentação Linux, Automação e Gerenciamento Centralizado de Logs

  • Administração de Sistemas Linux: Operação em nível de infraestrutura (permissões, SSH seguro, manipulação de arquivos) e gerência avançada de processos, serviços e ciclo de vida de pacotes operacionais (apt).
  • Automação de Rotinas: Desenvolvimento de scripts em Bash e agendamento de tarefas automáticas via crontab para otimização de processos diários.
  • Centralização de Eventos (Syslog): Arquitetura, centralização e gerenciamento de logs estruturados através de Syslog, cobrando experiência em filtros, roteamento, controle de retenção e auditoria forense de falhas.

Liderança Técnica, Versionamento e Apoio a Projetos

  • Governança de Código: Controle rigoroso de versões de configurações e infraestrutura utilizando GIT.
  • Dimensionamento e Planejamento: Participação consultiva em novos projetos de TI, fornecendo insumos sobre dimensionamento (sizing) e arquitetura necessária nos servidores de aplicação.
  • Disseminação de Conhecimento: Produção de artigos e documentações técnicas de alto nível focadas em melhores práticas de mercado para capacitação das equipes internas do tribunal.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (HRIS)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Product команди шукаємо Senior Product Owner.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • збирати й уточнювати потреби бізнес-оунера та внутрішніх замовників, проводити інтерв’ю з користувачами й перевіряти запропоновані рішення;

  • формувати вимоги, сценарії використання та критерії приймання, враховуючи ролі, права доступу, етапи процесів, сповіщення та звітність;

  • формувати й актуалізувати план розвитку продукту та вести повний цикл реалізації;

  • координувати роботу розробників, дизайнера, QA та замовників;

  • спільно з IT-департаментом проводити аудит наявних інструментів та інтеграцій;

  • разом із командою оцінювати строки, ресурси та залежності;

  • надавати бізнес-оунеру оцінки й дані, необхідні для підготовки бізнес-плану;

  • готувати та координувати план переходу з поточних інструментів;

  • аналізувати використання платформи та зворотний зв’язок, оцінювати зручність рішень і їхній вплив на ефективність процесів;

  • регулярно звітувати бізнес-овнеру про прогрес, результати, відхилення, ризики та рішення, які потребують погодження.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 5+ років досвіду як Product Owner або на схожих позиціях;

  • досвід повного циклу реалізації - від визначення потреби до впровадження та оцінки результату;

  • вміння перетворювати запити нетехнічних замовників на зрозумілі вимоги для розробки;

  • досвід роботи з продуктами зі складними робочими процесами, налаштуваннями, моделями даних або системами доступів;

  • наявність експертизи формування плану розвитку продукту, управління задачами та узгодження пріоритетів між кількома групами замовників;

  • практичний досвід Agile/Scrum;

  • вміння координувати кросфункціональну команду та досягати домовленостей без прямого адміністративного підпорядкування;

  • розуміння принципів роботи вебсистем, API та інтеграцій, а також основ користувацького досвіду й інтерфейсів;

  • вміння працювати з даними, визначати показники успіху та зрозуміло пояснювати результати;

  • самостійність у межах погоджених повноважень, відповідальність за результат і здатність завчасно повідомляти про ризики, пропонуючи варіанти рішень.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • HRTech / FinTech експертиза, автоматизації бізнес-процесів або внутрішніх корпоративних системах;

  • досвід роботи з модульними платформами, які об’єднують кілька функціональних напрямів;

  • наявність експертизи заміни корпоративних систем, міграції даних і впровадження нового продукту в роботу користувачів;

  • розуміння принципів захисту персональних даних і побудови систем ролей та доступів.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;...

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About A1M

A1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.

A1M’s mission is to preserve and improve government healthcare programs that are lifelines for underserved people in the United States, including people in poverty, elderly people, members of ethnic and racial minorities, immigrants, and refugees. We look for projects with nation-wide impact at the intersection of policy, data, and user experience design.

Besides building useful and usable digital services, A1M helps teams improve their agile, user-centered design practices – or helps them get started. Our goal is not just to build sustainable public services, but also to leave our teaming partners and customers more skilled and more confident in the future.

Business Services at A1M

Business Services is the operational backbone of our organization, enabling teams to work efficiently, securely, and effectively across every stage of the employee and business lifecycle. Our practice area brings together expertise in People Operations (HR support), Finance, Security & IT Support, Contracts, Legal, and Talent Management to deliver the systems, processes, and support that keep the business running smoothly. Business Services works closely with managers and leadership to drive operational excellence, manage risk, support growth, and create a strong employee experience.

About this role

People Operations is central to a healthy workplace. As a Senior People Operations Specialist, your goal is ensuring that employees have a positive experience with A1M as a mission-driven, remote-first company. You support employees in a human-centered way, ensuring that both their needs, and business needs are met consistently. As part of our ongoing commitment to excellence, you will bring a proactive approach to identifying areas for improvement and executing them. While you’re comfortable collaborating closely with company leadership, you’re also capable of working independently. Along with strong communication skills and an eye for details, you bring initiative, curiosity, and a commitment to supporting A1M’s mission by serving our team.

Skills and responsibilities

Technical Capabilities

  • Remain up to date on evolving Federal, State and local labor laws, advise Leadership on compliance, and build compliant workflows while reviewing and improving others’ documentation.
  • Oversee benefit administration, facilitate annual open enrollment, audit data, evaluate vendors, and optimize processes through automation or other improvements.
  • Advise People Managers on navigating complex employer issues, ensure consistent policy application, create templates and guides, and review documentation quality. Shape organization-wide strategies that nurture a culture of open communication and mutual support.
  • Lead and optimize the end-to-end employee experience lifecycle—ensuring that onboarding and offboarding processes are consistent, equitable, and aligned with organizational culture and goals.
  • Serve as the functional owner for HR technology platforms (e.g. ADP, Employee Navigator, and BambooHR), customize platforms to align with A1M’s HR workflows and processes, manage change implementation, recommend process enhancements, and advise staff on proper system usage.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Builds consistent communication between people, teams/projects, and A1M and clients in ways that prevent and break down silos, enabling new opportunities for improved delivery.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike seeks an experienced technical educator and cloud security specialist who wants to help our customers learn how to secure cloud environments and protect their organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. As an Instructor, Cloud Security within CrowdStrike's Services Training and Education team, this role goes beyond traditional teaching—it involves translating your real-world cloud security experience into actionable insights that help students elevate their defensive capabilities in the cloud.


Leveraging the CrowdStrike Falcon® Cloud Security platform, you will guide learners through immersive, hands-on training covering CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, container security, and cloud incident response. We seek a passionate cloud security educator who can inspire and equip our clients to stay ahead of today's most sophisticated threat actors.

    • Training is delivered primarily via virtual platforms, covering all U.S. time zones with occasional cross-regional hours; on-site delivery occurs on occasion, typically three to five days at a time

  • Lab Development: Collaborate with Lab Engineers to build, extend, and maintain hands-on lab environments that support the courses you contribute to
  • Product Knowledge: Stay current on CrowdStrike’s cloud security product portfolio and the broader cloud threat landscape; serve as an internal resource to help keep the team up to date on relevant product and industry developments

jobs.title: Oasis Reviewer - Home Health
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mosai

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​

Position Summary

  • Performs clinical review and validation of OASIS assessments on behalf of contracted home health agency clients, working within Mosai’s AI-assisted review platform and each client’s electronic medical record.
  • Applies licensed clinical judgment to independently verify platform-generated findings against the source record and produce clear, defensible recommendations.
  • May be assigned ICD-10 coding review as a secondary scope, based on credentials held and the services a given client has purchased.
  • This is a production review role and is not client-facing; all questions, disagreements, and escalations route through Mosai clinical operations and the client services team.

Job Duties:

  • Conduct review using Mosai’s AI-assisted review platform, accessing source documentation in the platform and the client’s EMR as the assignment requires; independently verify every platform-generated finding against the record before including it in a recommendation.
  • Review OASIS assessments across all required time points: Start of Care, Resumption of Care, Recertification, Transfer, and Discharge - validating responses against the current OASIS data set, CMS Guidance Manual, applicable skip logic, and CMS Quarterly OASIS Q&As.
  • Verify internal consistency between OASIS responses and the supporting record, applying particular scrutiny to Section GG self-care and mobility items, cognitive and behavioral items, and case-mix-impacting M-items.
  • Apply Patient-Driven Groupings Model (PDGM) requirements, including clinical grouping, functional impairment level, comorbidity adjustment, and LUPA exposure.
  • Where credentialed, review primary and secondary diagnosis assignment against ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines and home health sequencing conventions as a secondary scope, escalating coding or OASIS conflicts to Mosai clinical operations.
  • Produce written recommendations that state the item or code at issue, the supporting or conflicting documentation and its location in the record, applicable CMS or coding guidance, and clinical rationale — framed as compliant, non-leading requests that never direct a specific response.
  • Enter recommendations through each client’s defined channel, meet contracted turnaround commitments, and track recommendations to closure.
  • Work across multiple client agencies and EMR platforms, completing client-required onboarding and access provisioning before beginning review work for that client.
  • Access and use protected health information only as necessary to perform assigned review work, consistent with HIPAA minimum necessary requirements and the applicable Business Associate Agreement; never enter, alter, or fabricate clinical documentation.
  • Maintain review accuracy at or above the standard defined by Mosai clinical quality, participate in calibration exercises, and report platform false positives, missed findings, and out-of-date guidance references.

jobs.title: GHL Migration Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

COLAB is looking for an experienced GHL Migration Specialist to manage and execute client migrations to GoHighLevel (GHL) remotely. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience migrating websites, funnels, workflows, automations, contacts, calendars, and other assets into GHL while ensuring everything is properly configured, tested, and functional after migration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end migrations of client accounts and marketing assets into GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • Migrate and configure funnels, websites, landing pages, forms, workflows, automations, pipelines, calendars, contacts, and other GHL assets.
  • Recreate existing systems and processes accurately within GHL while maintaining their intended functionality.
  • Configure domains, DNS, tracking, forms, calendars, pipelines, email/SMS workflows, and other required integrations.
  • Audit migrated accounts to identify missing assets, broken links, incorrect configurations, or automation issues.
  • Test all migrated assets and workflows to ensure they function correctly before handover.
  • Troubleshoot migration-related issues and coordinate with other team members when technical support is required.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of migration progress, completed items, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.
  • Ensure migrations are completed within agreed timelines and meet internal quality standards.
  • Follow GHL best practices and maintain a clean, organized account structure.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • Proven experience handling GHL migrations and account setups.
  • Strong understanding of GHL workflows, automations, funnels, websites, forms, pipelines, calendars, and integrations.
  • Experience with DNS, domain configuration, tracking, email/SMS setup, and third-party integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies during migration and QA.
  • Ability to manage multiple migrations and meet deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Marketing agency experience is preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience migrating accounts from other CRM/marketing platforms into GHL.
  • Familiarity with Zapier, webhooks, APIs, Stripe, Twilio, Mailgun, or similar integrations.
  • Basic understanding of websites, HTML/CSS, domains, and DNS.
  • Experience with GHL snapshots and account cloning.

What We Offer

  • Remote opportunity
  • Other good benefits
  • Opportunity to work with multiple client accounts and marketing systems
  • Growth and learning opportunities
  • Collaborative agency environment

Work Location: Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Summary

Guidewire helps P&C insurers worldwide operate more effectively through the Guidewire Cloud Platform, the industry’s most trusted technology foundation.

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for ClaimCenter, you will own the marketing strategy for Guidewire’s flagship claims solution, empowering insurers to transform the most critical moment of truth in the insurance lifecycle into a seamless, automated, and customer-centric experience.

Your work will directly shape how insurers modernize their claims operations and drive superior financial performance. You will design and execute strategies that accelerate product adoption, drive pipeline, and equip sales teams to win in a highly competitive market. Working across product, engineering, sales, enablement, and marketing, you will translate complex claims automation, AI, and workflow capabilities into compelling business-outcome narratives that resonate with operational and technical leaders at insurance organizations.

Job Description

The impact you will have

  • Own the Narrative: Define the positioning for ClaimCenter, from the category-level story of claims transformation down to the technical proof points that survive a rigorous review by Heads of Claims Operations and IT leadership

  • Business Outcome Conversations: Translate the underpinnings of our SaaS architecture and claims logic into business-outcome conversations that resonate with executive leadership at insurers worldwide

  • High-Impact Content: Build technical content and sales enablement that holds up with an expert audience and that field teams actually use

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Create a GTM plan that earns the attention of claims system buyers and converts it into pipeline and platform adoption

  • Industry Leadership: Deliver keynotes at industry conferences and lead deep-dive workshops with customers alongside solution consulting and product management

  • Product Partnership: Partner deeply with product and engineering as a peer to bring new claims innovations, AI-driven features, and partner integrations to market

  • Market Intelligence: Keep Guidewire's roadmap and story ahead of the market by tracking Insurtech trends and technology advancements, market and business trends, and feeding that intelligence back to product and the field

  • Customer Advocacy: Earn customer trust and turn their performance results into stories that demonstrate measurable business value and ROI

What we look for

  • 7+ years of technical GTM experience: A proven track record in product marketing, solution engineering, or product management at an enterprise software company, specifically marketing complex core systems or FinTech/Insurtech solutions

  • Insurtech or Hyperscaler Background: Experience within the Insurtech ecosystem or at a horizontal hyperscaler or SaaS provider with a dedicated focus on Financial Services, especially P&C insurance

  • Deep Domain Expertise: A solid grasp of the claims lifecycle, including FNOL, adjudication, subrogation, and litigation, coupled with an understanding of how modern cloud architecture and AI improves loss ratios and operational efficiency

  • Messaging Excellence: The ability to synthesize technical information across automation, AI, and complex workflows, turning it into clear messaging for both technical and business audiences

  • Persuasive Communication: Strong writing and presentation skills are a must. You take dense technical input and shape it into messaging, content, and stories that are clear, sharp, and built to persuade at volume

  • Willingness to travel: up to 25% of the time

Pierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Resmed

We pioneer innovative solutions that treat and keep people out of the hospital, empowering them to live healthier, higher-quality lives. Our digital health technologies and cloud-connected medical devices transform care for people with sleep apnea, COPD, and other chronic diseases. Our comprehensive out-of-hospital software platforms support the professionals and caregivers who help people stay healthy in the home or care setting of their choice. By enabling better care, we improve quality of life, reduce the impact of chronic disease, and lower costs for consumers and healthcare systems in more than 140 countries. Our 2030 operating model intends to improve 500 million people’s lives and help them achieve their full health potential.

Let’s talk about the Role

Global Revenue CCaaS Sr. Product Manager with a growth mindset, focused on driving contact center transformation through innovation, stakeholder collaboration, and employee and customer-centric product delivery.

We are undergoing global service transformation and are seeking a collaborative, strategic, and execution-focused Global Revenue CCaaS Senior Product Manager to lead the evolution of Resmed’s global contact center technology ecosystem. This role is responsible for defining and driving the product strategy, roadmap, governance, and operational alignment across key platforms including RingCentral, NICE inContact, Salesforce Service Cloud, RightAnswers Knowledge Management, and Observe.ai Service Intelligence.

Supporting all global regions, this senior-level position requires a highly independent leader with deep hands-on expertise in CCaaS technologies and a strong understanding of modern contact center operations. The ideal candidate combines practitioner-level platform knowledge with a growth mindset and the ability to identify innovative, data-driven opportunities that accelerate customer service transformation and operational excellence.

The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience implementing and optimizing CCaaS solutions within complex, enterprise-scale global environments, with particular expertise in NICE inContact. They must be comfortable influencing at all levels of the organization, confidently presenting and defending product strategies, prioritization decisions, and roadmap recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.

This role requires exceptional collaboration and partnership skills, working closely with regional service leaders, business stakeholders, and Global Technology Solutions (GTS) teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise priorities, architectural standards, and evolving customer needs. Given the strong intersection between CRM and CCaaS capabilities, the role will also partner closely with the Global Revenue CRM Product Manager to deliver aligned roadmaps, coordinated delivery sequencing, and seamless customer and agent experiences across all touchpoints.

The Global Revenue CCaaS Senior Product Manager is ultimately accountable for the ongoing definition, refinement, communication, and execution of the Global Revenue CCaaS Product Roadmap, ensuring strategic alignment, scalable platform capabilities, and measurable business value across the enterprise.

Let’s talk about the Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Global Alignment

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Global Revenue CCaaS Product Roadmap, ensuring priorities align with business needs, technology capabilities, and enterprise strategy.
  • Ensure continuous roadmap alignment with the Global Revenue CRM Product Manager, recognizing shared dependencies and opportunities for integrated innovation.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of CCaaS platforms, with hands-on understanding of NICE inContact, including routing strategies, IVR/IVA design, agent workflows, and reporting.

jobs.title: Workday Extend Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Job Description

At Kainos, we provide a proven track record of launching innovative and creative SaaS products designed to help Workday customers maximize their Workday investment. Our existing solutions include Workday testing, compliance, data masking, employee document management and pay transparency analyzer.

We are looking for Workday Extend Developers to help shape our future product offerings on the Workday platform.

The role holder will join a Product team to focus entirely on innovating new products on the Workday platform. The team will identify, build, sell and operate these new products until they become mature products.  

This role has been opened as a result of new Workday partnerships which includes the Marketplace, the AI Gateway, AWS integration and the ‘Built on Workday’ programme. These initiatives provide the technical and commercial framework for creating a thriving product ecosystem on the Workday platform. With this new team we want Kainos to become the leading Partner in the Marketplace. 

You will use technologies and platforms including Workday Extend, AWS and AI. You will work within a small, collaborative team, contributing to the technical design and technical solutions for one or more new products.

You will also work with our product team to help build out our customer-focused roadmaps. You’ll be comfortable with a fast paced environment, creating proof-of-concepts and gathering user feedback to design solutions that challenge the problems faced by our customers and prospects. 

You’ll support your junior colleagues in all that you do by embodying the Kainos values. You’ll be passionate and committed to ensuring Kainos projects are successful. You’ll help build a community of practice in your specialist area.

​

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS

  • Hands-on experience developing Extend applications.
  • Experience developing & coding within agile delivery environments.
  • Experience with working with web service technologies (REST, SOAP).
  • Clear and effective communicator, able to communicate with customers and colleagues with credibility, including in a remote working situation. Proficient with use of English language.
  • Good commercial awareness and some understanding of project and business dynamics
  • Ability to plan own workload and meet deadlines
  • Able to apply all relevant standards and procedures to your own work, maintaining high quality and accuracy at all times
  • Aware of the importance of confidentiality and non-disclosure policies and/or agreements and ensures security of information at all times

DESIRABLE

  • Obtained Extend certifications from an accredited body in your area of specialization.
  • Obtained HCM certification.

Embracing our differences

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Director, AI & Security Development to lead one of the most strategic and forward-looking pillars within our cybersecurity organization.

This leadership role will build and scale a dedicated function responsible for cybersecurity Agentic AI development, security tooling and automation engineering, data analytics and reporting enablement, while contributing to our secure development practices. This role reports directly to the Chief Information Security Officer and operates alongside leadership for Security Operations, Security Architecture, and Governance, Risk & Compliance.

How You Will Contribute:

  • Lead a core cybersecurity capability by defining the strategy, operating model, and service offerings for AI & Security Development.
  • Drive development of AI-powered security agents to support detection, triage, investigation, and response.
  • Build and scale automation and orchestration capabilities across enterprise security technologies.
  • Enable security data integration, analytics, and reporting to support operational and executive decision-making.
  • Establish secure AI development practices and DevSecOps governance.
  • Partner closely with Security Operations, Architecture, and GRC. Build and lead a high-performing team.
  • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business value and risk reduction.

Skills & Experience to be Successful:

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, or related technical disciplines, including 5+ years in leadership roles.
  • Proven experience building or scaling automation, AI/ML, or advanced analytics capabilities.
  • Strong background in secure software development, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and API-driven systems.
  • Experience with security operations, detection engineering, or incident response workflows.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels. Strong communication skills and executive presence.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms or LLM-based systems. Familiarity with AI risk management and governance frameworks. (preferred)
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments. (preferred)
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or cloud/AI certifications. (preferred)

Pay Range

$210,000 - $214,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Bilingual French Generalist Expert — AI Safety
Type:Contract
Compensation:$48–$52/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Write expert-level prompts in French across a range of sensitive subject areas.
  • Apply structured guidelines to classify prompts and conversations.
  • Flag adversarial phrasings and escalation patterns. Document the reasoning behind your judgments.
  • Work independently and asynchronously to improve AI model safety.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure cultural sensitivity and accuracy in AI model outputs.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native or near-native fluency in French. Business-level written English.
  • A Bachelor's degree, completed or in progress.
  • Strong written reasoning and high attention to detail.
  • Sound judgment around sensitive and dual-use information.

Preferred

  • Based in France or the wider Western Europe region.

About You
You are an AI Engineer who turns Claude Code into reliable, unattended automation for real engineering teams. You will join the software team of a channel incentive platform company to adapt an existing Jira support triage routine, built in Claude Code for another product, to a platform of about 70 Node.js and .NET microservices. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Grant Reviewer, K-12 Education (High-Impact Tutoring)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its High-Impact Tutoring grant competition. OSSE is seeking experienced K-12 education professionals who have served as grant reviewers for OSSE in the past.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: September 10, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Apply K-12 education expertise to assess the design, quality, and feasibility of each applicant's proposed tutoring program.
  4. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  5. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  6. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  7. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  8. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  9. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  10. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Past service as a competitive grant reviewer for OSSE.
  • Professional experience in K-12 education.
  • Reliable access to a co...

About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Sr. Principal Sales Training Manager

Location: United States (Remote)

Experience: Senior

Job Function: Business Transformation

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer & Network Security

About the position

The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager drives hands-on training, execution, and adoption of Keyfactor's global sales enablement programs. This role works directly with sellers and sales leaders to ensure the skills, methodologies, messaging, and tools introduced through enablement are consistently applied in the field.

A significant portion of this role focuses on delivering consistent, high-impact onboarding experience, guiding new sellers from initial training and certification through field readiness and productivity. This role also supports ongoing everboarding through live customer call observation, Gong reviews, and targeted coaching to reinforce skills and drive consistent field execution.

The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager plays a critical role in reinforcing Keyfactor’s Value Selling and MEDDICC methodologies, helping sellers improve discovery, qualification, business value conversations, multi-threading, executive engagement, and overall opportunity execution.

jobs.title: Autonomy Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

About Nextpower

Nextpower is a global leader in intelligent solar tracker and software solutions, optimizing solar power plant performance worldwide.

Within Nextpower, the Robotics and Autonomy team is building and deploying robotic systems that operate at scale in real solar environments. These systems combine perception, planning, control, embedded compute, and cloud infrastructure to increase inspection capacity, improve safety, and enable scalable operations.

We are seeking a Autonomy Engineer to help accelerate the next phase of that growth. This role focuses on advancing real-world autonomy performance across the navigation stack and enabling robots to operate more independently, more efficiently, and at greater scale.

This is a systems-level role spanning perception, planning, and control. You will work directly on robots, in the field and in test environments, to ensure the system performs reliably under real-world conditions.

Role Overview

We are scaling both the capability and deployment of our robotic systems. As autonomy improves, the system must support more robots per operator, operate with higher levels of autonomy across diverse environments, and maintain consistent performance as complexity increases.

This role is focused on building and improving a tightly integrated autonomy stack that works end-to-end on the robot. You will operate within constrained embedded systems where compute, bandwidth, and power are limited, requiring thoughtful tradeoffs in model selection, algorithm design, and system architecture. You will design and implement perception, planning, and control systems, validate them on real hardware, and continuously improve performance through testing, simulation, and data-driven iteration.

You are expected to own system behavior, not just individual algorithms. This means understanding how the full stack behaves in real environments, identifying gaps, and driving improvements that make the system more capable, reliable, and scalable.

Core areas of responsibility include:

  • Developing and improving autonomy capabilities across perception, planning, and control

  • Getting systems working on real robots, not just in simulation

  • Debugging and resolving issues observed in real-world operation

  • Building and using simulation, log replay, and data pipelines to accelerate iteration

  • Collaborating across hardware, integration, and test teams to ensure system-level performance

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in robotics, autonomy, or related fields, with demonstrated experience developing software for robotic or autonomous systems in real-world environments (not just simulation)

  • Strong proficiency in at least one of the following: C, C++, Python, or Rust

  • Strong experience with Linux command-line environments, Git, and Docker

  • Strong experience with ROS2-based systems

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex system behavior

  • Strong hands-on experience working with physical robotic systems

  • Coachable and able to operate effectively within a fast-moving, collaborative team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Developing and deploying perception systems such as:

    • Semantic understanding of environments

This is a video-first role: the person in it owns paid-social video ads from the first idea to the final file, using AI visuals alongside classic editing craft.

The work spans polished, brand-appropriate performance creative for corporate and B2B clients as well as D2C consumer brands. Photorealistic AI-human ads, claymation, animation and mixed media are all part of the mix, and no one is expected to master every style.

Responsibilities

  • Take each video ad personally from concept and hook through AI-generated visuals, editing, pacing, sound, captions and final delivery.
  • Produce polished, on-brand performance video for both corporate/B2B and D2C consumer brands.
  • Create in a range of styles, such as photorealistic AI-human ads, claymation, animation and mixed media.
  • Support static ad design as a secondary part of the role.
  • Deliver platform-ready cuts and formats for paid social channels such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.
  • Use performance results and feedback to refine hooks and create new variations.
  • Work closely with the client's growth and creative team on briefs, reviews and revisions.

Requirements

  • 2–3+ years of directly relevant experience producing English-language paid-social video ads.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong creative taste and experience working with sophisticated brands.
  • Hands-on experience creating video with AI visual and video generation tools.
  • Ability to handle every stage of an ad alone: concept, hook, AI visuals, editing, pacing, sound, captions and delivery.
  • A portfolio of personally produced video ads, including at least one AI-led ad.

Qualifications

  • Proven, polished performance creative for corporate/B2B and D2C consumer brands.
  • Static design skills as a supporting strength.
  • Proficiency in a professional editing tool such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney or ElevenLabs.
  • Experience in claymation, animation or mixed-media styles is a plus.

Soft skills

  • Sharp creative taste, with an eye for sophisticated, on-brand work.
  • A quality-first standard for every piece delivered.
  • Independent ownership of each ad from first idea to final file.

Benefits

  • Full-time position.
  • 100% remote, working from anywhere in Latin America.
  • Creative range across corporate/B2B and D2C consumer brands, in many video styles.
  • Daily work with leading AI video tools inside an AI-first marketing company.
  • A role where quality comes first and creative craft is valued.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

We’re seeking a strategic, business-minded Marketing Manager to own marketing strategy, prioritization, and execution across a portfolio of business units. This role will act as the primary marketing partner for multiple businesses, developing a deep understanding of each unit’s goals, market, customers, and growth priorities and translating those needs into focused, actionable marketing plans.


The Marketing Manager will balance priorities across assigned businesses, determine where marketing resources can have the greatest impact, and lead a team of two internal marketing professionals. This includes setting clear expectations, delegating work, providing ongoing coaching and feedback, supporting employee development, and maintaining accountability for individual and team performance. The role will also engage and oversee contract marketing resources as needed and coordinate shared specialists across demand generation, content, digital, marketing operations, product marketing, and events.


Success in this role requires the ability to think strategically across multiple businesses while staying close enough to each to provide meaningful marketing leadership. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating competing priorities, partnering with business and Sales leaders, using performance data to guide decisions, and creating a proactive, results-oriented marketing partnership across a diverse portfolio.

You’ll identify, recruit, and nurture high-impact partners while helping them succeed through a strategic blend of partner acquisition and consultative enablement.

  • 5+ years of experience in solution channel sales and/or partner management, with a proven track record of owning territory and account management.
  • Demonstrated experience self-generating pipeline from discovery through close.

  • A track record of consistently exceeding quotas and revenue goals.
  • Strong business acumen, along with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Description

Our Business Technology team is looking for a Senior Security Operations Engineer to own the security of the tools, devices, identities, and data Fleetians rely on every day. You will help run corporate security operations end to end, covering detection and response, identity, endpoint, email, and SaaS security, data loss prevention, AI security, and vulnerability management, and make the day-to-day security calls that keep Fleetio safe.

You will be hands-on: engineering controls, writing and tuning detections, automating response, and closing gaps, not just administering tools. The goal is one connected defense, not a collection of consoles: a signal from Okta, CrowdStrike, Mimecast, or Google Workspace should drive action in the others automatically, so the environment protects itself and people step in only where judgment is needed. Around-the-clock monitoring is handled by our external SOC (CrowdStrike Falcon Complete); this role engineers the environment it watches, owns what happens when it escalates, and extends what it can see. You will work closely with our IT Operations and Compliance teams, our 3rd party SOC, and the Product Security team in Platform Engineering.

Our team treats AI as a core part of how we work. We build and use AI agents and automated workflows to handle toil, speed up investigation and response, and give our team more time for high-leverage work.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate is a security engineer who likes to build. You are as comfortable writing a detection or a response playbook as you are working an incident. You think in systems: you see the gaps between tools and close them by wiring the tools together. You make sound security decisions on your own, explain them clearly to technical and non-technical people, and balance risk with how people actually work.

You stay calm when something breaks. You can take a vague report, work out quickly what happened and who is affected, and give leaders a clear, evidence-backed answer. Then you fix the root cause so it doesn't happen the same way twice.

You're curious about how AI is changing security operations, and you're eager to put it to work on triage, enrichment, and response.

Your Impact

As a Senior Security Operations Engineer on Fleetio's Business Technology team, you will:

  • Own detection engineering and threat hunting in CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM: onboard log sources, write and tune detections across identity, email, SaaS, and endpoint telemetry, and keep false positives down
  • Own security automation: chain our tools together through CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR and our workflow automation platform so a signal in one (a risky Okta sign-in, a Falcon detection, a Mimecast hit, a Google Workspace sharing change) triggers enrichment, containment, paging, and ticketing in the others, plus AI agents that speed up triage and investigation, so routine response runs without waiting on a human

As the Director of AI Strategy and Transformation, you'll translate enterprise strategy into coordinated action by prioritizing opportunities, mobilizing cross-functional teams, aligning senior stakeholders, and ensuring critical initiatives maintain momentum.

The ideal candidate brings a strong portfolio mindset, sound business judgment, and the ability to move between strategy and execution. They will work across Customer Success, Product Leadership, Technology, and other enterprise teams, as well as with external technology and consulting partners, to ensure that the Customer Success AI transformation portfolio gets executed with excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Strategy and Prioritization

• Shape and maintain a portfolio of strategic AI transformation initiatives aligned with enterprise priorities.

• Evaluate opportunities, investments, dependencies, risks, and sequencing to support leadership decisions.

• Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, decisions, and areas of accountability.

Strategic Initiative Leadership

• Mobilize cross-functional teams around high-priority or emerging transformation opportunities.
• Provide direct leadership to select strategic initiatives that require senior-level coordination and influence.
• Identify barriers, resolve ambiguity, and create a practical path from concept to execution.

Executive and Enterprise Alignment

• Build alignment among senior business, Product, and Technology leaders.
• Develop strategic recommendations, leadership narratives, and decision materials.
• Maintain visibility into portfolio progress, emerging risks, and decisions requiring executive attention.

Operating Model and Strategic Partnerships

• Help evolve the governance, engagement models, and ways of working that support AI transformation.
• Establish repeatable approaches for prioritizing, mobilizing, and overseeing strategic initiatives.
• Lead relationships with selected technology, consulting, and strategic partners, ensuring their work supports enterprise priorities.

• Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of complex initiatives and aligning stakeholders around shared priorities.
• Experience leading across complex, matrixed organizations and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
• Experience translating strategy into roadmaps, investment decisions, and coordinated execution.

Core Capabilities

• Strong strategic judgment and the ability to evaluate opportunities, tradeoffs, dependencies, and organizational readiness.
• Portfolio mindset, including experience with prioritization, roadmap development, and cross-functional delivery.
• Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills.
• Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity, with the ability to create structure, change course when needed, and maintain momentum.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading AI, digital, data, or technology-enabled transformation.
• Familiarity with NIQ business, clients, products, and internal operating environment, or comparable experience within the data and insights industry.
• Formal Product Management or Product Leadership experience involving a portfolio of development efforts.
• Experience managing strategic relationships with technology companies, consulting firms, or other external partners.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transformation is prioritized and advanced across the enterprise. You will work with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to turn strategic ambition into a coordinated portfolio of initiatives that deliver meaningful business outcomes.
