jobs.company: ECOVIS KSO Steuerberater & Rechtsanwälte GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei ECOVIS KSO

Als Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) wirst Du Teil unseres Partnerunternehmens Flexcon IT (https://flexcon-it.de/). Du arbeitest mit ausgewiesenen Expert:innen auf ihrem Fachgebiet, um zukunftsweisende IT-Lösungen zu planen und umzusetzen. Präzise und transparent – nur so geht nachhaltige Digitalisierung für einen langfristig störungsfreien Betrieb. Du hinterfragst mit Bedacht die Herausforderungen von Morgen, entwickelst geeignete Cloud-Strategien im Team und gibst Antworten auf Fragen, die noch gar nicht gestellt wurden? Perfekt! Dies ist die Basis unseres Teams, in dem Eigenverantwortung und Sorgfalt ebenso wichtig sind wie unternehmerisches Denken und Zuverlässigkeit.

Hier bist Du gefragt

Du machst aus einem ersten Kontakt eine qualifizierte Verkaufschance und sorgst dafür,
dass kein guter Lead liegen bleibt. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen aus
Vertrieb und Technik zusammen.

  • Du recherchierst und identifizierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden.

  • Du sprichst neue Kunden telefonisch und digital an.

  • Du qualifizierst Leads und erkennst konkrete Bedarfe.

  • Du bereitest Erst- und Beratungsgespräche vor.

  • Du entwickelst Kontakte zu echten Verkaufschancen weiter.

  • Du übernimmst konsequent Follow-ups und nächste Schritte.

  • Du dokumentierst Kontakte und Opportunities sauber im CRM.

  • Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Vorbereitung und Vertriebsarbeit.

Dabei geht es nicht um möglichst viele Calls, sondern um gute Gespräche und echte
Verkaufschancen.

Das bieten wir Dir

Du wirst bei uns nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen, aber Du sollst schnell Verantwortung
übernehmen.

1. Verstehen
Produkte, Kunden, Zielgruppen und Vertriebsprozess kennenlernen.

2. Qualifizieren
Eigene Erstkontakte und Discovery-Gespräche übernehmen.

3. Entwickeln
Eigene Opportunities aufbauen und vorantreiben.

4. Verkaufen
Schritt für Schritt eigene Verkaufsprozesse bis zum Abschluss führen.

Unser Ziel:
Aus Dir wird ein richtig guter B2B-Vertriebler.

Dein Weg zu uns

  • Eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung (Bereich IT-System-Management, Büromanagement, Groß- und Außenhandel oder Dialogmarketing) ist von Vorteil, setzen wir nicht zwingend voraus

  • Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und daran, aktiv auf andere zuzugehen

  • Interesse an Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung und unternehmerischen Zusammenhängen

  • Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Verbindlichkeit – Du packst gerne selbst mit an

  • Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Lust, Dich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Interesse an IT, Digitalisierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz

  • Keine Scheu vor Telefonaten und der aktiven Ansprache potenzieller Neukunden

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

So erreichst Du uns

Gerne steht Dir unser Recruiting-Team unter ----- oder der 0211 908670 für jegliche Fragen zur Verfügung:

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

jobs.title: Director of Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind Start to Finish.

Kein Unternehmen kann wachsen ohne das richtige Team. Aus diesem Grund unterstützen wir E-Commerce, SaaS und Mittelstand wie Mellow Noir, Bears with Benefits, Memberspot, MBR-Skin, Cansativa Group und viele weitere dabei, ihre Schlüsselpositionen mit den richtigen Talenten zu besetzen.

Mit über 100 zufriedenen Kunden sind wir die #1 Recruiting Boutique für E-Commerce im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Unser Kunde sucht Dich!

Für eine der bekanntesten D2C-Brands Deutschlands suchen wir einen Director of Marketing (m/w/d).

Mit über 100 Mio. € Umsatz, mehreren Brands und einem profitablen Geschäftsmodell gehört die Gruppe zu den Top-Playern im deutschen E-Commerce. Jetzt geht es um die nächste Stufe: neue Märkte, neue Kanäle, neue Produkte.

Als Director of Marketing verantwortest Du das Wachstum aller Brands über sämtliche Kanäle, arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und prägst die nächste große Wachstumsphase der Gruppe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst ein 40-köpfiges Team aus Performance, CRM, Marktplätzen und Influencer und machst aus starken Einzelnen ein Team, das gemeinsam gewinnt

  • Du bringst die Brands in neue Länder und auf neue Kanäle wie TikTok Shop und Retail

  • Du launchst neue Produktlinien und machst sie zu profitablen Wachstumstreibern

  • Du wächst mit Köpfchen: EBITDA und Marge sind Dein Kompass, Wachstum um jeden Preis ist nicht Dein Spiel

  • Du denkst die Customer Journey end-to-end, findest jeden Bruch und bringst alle Teams auf eine Linie

Qualifikationen

  • Du hast auf Director- oder Head-of-Level große Teams geführt und weißt genau, wen Du wann wofür brauchst

  • Du kommst aus profitablem D2C und hast mindestens 20–30 Mio. € Umsatz bewegt, nicht verbrannt

  • Paid Social ist Dein Spielfeld: Direct Response liegt Dir im Blut, Millionen-Budgets steuerst Du mit ruhiger Hand

  • Du denkst in Customer Journeys und hast Influencer, Marktplätze oder TikTok Shop schon selbst bespielt

  • Du hast mit Investoren gearbeitet oder einen Exit begleitet? Dann bist Du hier goldrichtig

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und überzeugst damit auch im Boardroom

Benefits

  • Sehr attraktives Gehalt plus variabler Anteil

  • Schlüsselrolle mit großer Entscheidungsfreiheit in einer profitablen, PE-backed Gruppe

  • Große Budgets und echte Hebel: neue Märkte, Kanäle und Produkte

  • Remote-friendly mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office

Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt – auch wenn Du nicht jedes Kriterium zu 100 % erfüllst. Uns zählen Potenzial und Persönlichkeit mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

jobs.title: Online Marketing und E Commerce Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Vlitex

Die VLITEX GmbH mit Sitz in Bayreuth entwickelt und vertreibt innovative Brandschutzlösungen aus technischen Textilien mit Fokus auf Lithium-Ionen-Batterien. Zertifizierte "Feuerlöschdecken" und Sicherheitsprodukte des Unternehmens schützen weltweit Leben und minimieren Umweltschäden in Bereichen wie Feuerwehr, Industrie und E-Mobilität.

Deine Aufgaben im Online-Marketing und E-Commerce

· Onlineshop aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Anforderungen definieren, externe Umsetzung koordinieren, Produktdaten pflegen, Kaufprozesse testen und technische Fehler konsequent nachhalten.

· SEO und GEO entwickeln: Suchintentionen recherchieren, Produkt- und Anwendungsseiten optimieren und hilfreiche Experteninhalte erstellen. Inhalte, strukturierte Daten und Unternehmensinformationen so weiterentwickeln, dass VLITEX auch in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT und vergleichbaren KI-Antwortsystemen als relevante Quelle sichtbar wird.

· Google Ads und Paid Social steuern: Kampagnen, Zielgruppen, Anzeigenvarianten und passende Zielseiten entwickeln. Suchanfragen, Kosten und Ergebnisse auswerten und Budgets auf profitable Bestellungen und qualifizierte B2B-Anfragen ausrichten.

· Amazon und Amazon Ads steuern: Produktseiten, Bilder und Texte verbessern, Sortiment und Preise intern abstimmen, Angebotsprobleme lösen und die Verfügbarkeit koordinieren. Kampagnen aufsetzen und optimieren, Suchbegriffe auswerten und Budgets auf wirtschaftliche Verkäufe ausrichten.

· Content und Social Media organisieren: Themenplan führen, Texte und einfache Bild- oder Videoinhalte erstellen, Produktaufnahmen koordinieren und geeignete Inhalte für organische Kanäle veröffentlichen.

· Messung und Reporting sicherstellen: Käufe und Anfragen nachvollziehbar erfassen, Kennzahlen wie Umsatz, Conversion Rate, Werbekosten und Deckungsbeitrag auswerten und daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.

Das bringst du mit

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary: 120-160k • Total Comp: 200k

We're looking for a highly analytical, data-driven Director of Customer Lifecycle (CRM) who will architect a sophisticated, machine-learning-adjacent customer lifecycle engine designed to maximize long-term retention and engagement across our global user base.

Your mission is to bring structure, rigorous experimentation, and algorithmic scalability to a CRM system that is complex by nature — with many entry points, diverse user flows, and a high bar for automation. You will sit at the intersection of marketing, product, and data science, moving comfortably from high-level retention strategy to hands-on pipeline and campaign execution.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Lifecycle Architecture & First-Day Experience: Own the full CRM strategy, with a heavy emphasis on mapping day-0 (d0) user behavior to optimize early-stage retention and long-term user monetization.

  • Build Algorithmic Personalization: Move beyond static batch-and-blast and basic segmentation. You will collaborate with Data Science to deploy predictive logic, user-level personalization models, and behavioral triggers across Email, Push, SMS, and In-App.

  • Drive Rigorous Experimentation: Establish a world-class testing culture. You will design, execute, and analyze systematic experiments that look past surface-level metrics to measure true incrementality and downstream KPI impact (e.g., Day-30, Day-90 retention).

  • Partner on Data Schema: Work directly with Data and Engineering to design, audit, and optimize the CRM data schema, ensuring real-time event tracking is clean, correctly mapped, and actionable.

  • Execute & Scale: While you own the strategy, you are also the primary operator in the early stages. You will build, troubleshoot, and optimize complex logic loops and API-triggered campaigns yourself.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Data Fluency & Measurement Rigor: You speak the same language as data scientists. You have a deep understanding of statistical significance, multi-variant testing, and how to isolate incremental lift.

VP of Engineering

Berlin, Onsite

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Own engineering end to end (execution, quality, reliability, and people), reporting to our CTO at Almedia, Germany's fastest-growing company by YoY revenue.

  • Shape a lean, high-performing team with AI as core to the way the team ships.

  • Get engineers onto the highest-impact work, with a shared way of prioritising alongside Product and Design.

Your Mission

  • Partner with the executive team, Product, and Design to turn ideas into experiments and successful releases.

  • Make AI-native workflows the default, cutting the time from hypothesis to live experiment to decision, so more experiments reach customers without more defects.

  • Build a QA function that prevents defects and keeps the site reliably up, with the authority to surface release risk early.

  • Build the leadership bench and engineering culture that let the org keep compounding.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on leader, strong in TypeScript, who writes and reviews code. This is how everyone operates here, starting with our CTO.

  • Already rethought how a team works with AI and shipped faster because of it.

  • Bonus: React Native, Python, data pipelines.

Your Track Record

  • Scaled engineering organisations through significant business growth, developing engineering managers.

  • Led Frontend, Backend, and Reliability functions, and know how to design the operating model that lets them move together at speed.

  • Partnered closely with Product and Design, turning business priorities into a shared roadmap.

Why Almedia?

  • Grow With Almedia: Own meaningful equity in a company that's been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

  • We Listen: We regularly add to our benefits through rigorous employee feedback.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest o...

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Operations Research
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

What you'll do

CircuitHub builds circuit boards on demand, every order different. Each day thousands of decisions are made: which orders run on which machines, which parts to buy and when, what to promise a customer and what to charge. You'll build the models behind those decisions.

  • Plan the factory. Schedule orders, panels and machines across our factories for throughput and on-time delivery, and know days ahead when we will run out of work or capacity.

  • Model the Grid. The Grid is our factory-scale robot: dozens of movers, gantries, printers and ovens. Model how work flows through it, find the bottlenecks, and tell us what the next machine or change is worth.

  • Price and promise. Estimate what an order really costs in labour, machine time and parts, and help set prices and lead times that win work and make money.

  • Buy smarter. Decide what parts and consumables to stock, when to order them, and how much risk of a shortage to accept.

  • Put it into production. Your models don't live in a spreadsheet: they run every day, feed the planning and quoting systems, and get checked against what actually happened.

What we look for

  • A quantitative background in operations research, applied maths, statistics, quantitative finance, economics or a similar field, and a record of models that changed real decisions.

  • Optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint programming, or heuristics, and judgement about when a simple rule beats a solver.

  • Simulation and forecasting: building a model of a messy system, calibrating it to data and saying how far to trust it.

  • Strong Python and SQL. You write code other people can run and rely on.

  • You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

  • Curiosity about how things are physically made. You'll spend time in our factories in the US and UK.

Manufacturing experience is welcome but not required. If you have priced risk, optimised a portfolio or forecast demand, the problems here will feel familiar.

Stack

  • Modelling: Python, OR-Tools, simulation

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, Dagster

  • Agents: Claude Code and Codex throughout

Location

Remote anywhere, or from our offices in London or Cambridge (UK) if you prefer, with regular visits to our factorie...

As the market leader in German and Austrian dentistry, and with major funding under our belt, we’re now taking the next big step: new medical specialties, new countries, new products. Why praxipal? The shortage of skilled professionals is the biggest challenge in our healthcare systems. Medical practices rely on our AI receptionist Luna to reduce staff workload and keep care accessible for everyone. We’re growing at record speed and closed a $6.7M seed round with HV Capital.

  • A portfolio that shows what you can do, ideally with numbers to back it up

jobs.title: People Ops Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we're looking for an HR Intern to be Taktile's ambassador to our future employees.

You will collaborate closely with our People team to ensure the efficient management of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to ongoing feedback and support. You will play a crucial role in maintaining our HR systems, keeping employee data accurate, and supporting the administrative tasks that keep our people operations running smoothly. By handling these essential tasks, you will contribute significantly to shaping the company's growth and ensuring we maintain a high standard of employee satisfaction and performance. You will work closely with colleagues across all departments to manage various HR activities.

What You'll Do as an HR Intern

  • Employee Onboarding: Once candidates join our team, take the lead in preparing and coordinating first-day agendas for new hires, managing communication to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

  • Database and Profile Management: Maintain and update HR-related content on our internal databases and manage employee profiles in our HRIS (HiBob), ensuring all data is accurate and up-to-date. This is crucial for consistency and compliance with company policies.

  • Administrative Support: Prepare documents for various processes (internal transfers, mobility, etc.).

  • Employee Benefits Management: Assist in managing and communicating benefits for employees, ensuring they are well informed about their entitlements and processes.

  • General HR Support: Assist with any HR-related queries, providing timely and accurate information to employees and managers.

  • Process Improvement & AI Enablement: Help identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows, including building and refining AI tools (e.g. Claude skills) to make our people operations more efficient.

About You

  • Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

  • Collaborative attitude and willingness to assist team members in achieving common goals.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (German is a plus).

  • Excited to learn about new concepts, tools, and processes and eager to challenge the status quo.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Familiarity with HR software and tools.

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure & Security Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As an IT Infrastructure & Security Manager (m/f/d), you will play a vital role in maintaining, securing, and continuously improving our IT landscape across multiple locations. Working closely with internal stakeholders and technical teams, you will help ensure the reliability, performance, and security of our infrastructure while supporting the company's growth and innovation. We are looking for a hands-on professional who combines strong infrastructure expertise with a security-first mindset and enjoys working in a dynamic, international environment. 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Manage and maintain our IT infrastructure, including Windows and Linux servers, cloud services, and endpoint devices.

  • Ensure the availability, performance, and security of business-critical systems and services.

  • In regard to security administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online

  • Implement, monitor, and continuously improve security controls, policies, and best practices across the organization.

  • Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions and endpoint security platforms for Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

  • Support and maintain virtualization environments and infrastructure services.

  • Monitor network performance and security, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and collaborate on infrastructure improvements.

  • Review and maintain Firewall configurations (Fortigate Infrastructure, Sophos)

  • Provide second-level support for complex infrastructure and security-related incidents.

  • Contribute to IT projects, process improvements (BSI-Grundschutz, ISO /IEC 27001).



What you bring to the team:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a comparable qualification and professional experience (CCNA, CompTIA+).

  • Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure administration, system management, or IT operations.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Intune, Entra ID, and related cloud services.

  • Experience working with Windows environments; familiarity with Linux and macOS is highly desirable.

  • Solid understanding of IT security principles, endpoint protection, identity management, and system hardening.

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Certification Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Hardware Certification Engineer with focus on DO-254, you will be an important part of our Certification and Systems Engineering organization, supporting the development and certification of advanced unmanned aircraft systems.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

jobs.title: Intern - Machine Learning 12 months (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role:

Join the Machine Learning department at Quantum Systems and contribute to autonomy and perception functions for our unmanned vehicles across air, land and sea domains. During this 12-month internship, you will work with experienced engineers on practical machine learning projects—from preparing sensor data, training and evaluating cutting-edge supervised models and improving the workflows on the cloud that bring our functions into real systems. Your project focus will depend on your interests, skills, and the team’s priorities.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Our machine learning pipeline offers different internship areas of expertise including, but not limited to:

  • Prepare, inspect, and curate datasets from cameras, LiDAR, telemetry, and other sensor sources.

  • Support the development, training, and evaluation of machine learning and computer vision models.

  • Help test and improve models for deployment on resource-constrained embedded systems.

  • Contribute to reproducible training and evaluation workflows, including data and model tracking.

  • Analyze results, document experiments, and share findings with colleagues across machine learning tasks, hardware, testing, and operations.

  • Manage and extend our cloud services to automate and accelerate machine learning development.

  • Develop and integrate AI agents that automate and streamline employee workflows across the development lifecycle.

  • Improve the reliability, monitoring, security, and cost efficiency of our ML infrastructure.


What you bring to the team:

You are currently studying computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related engineering subject, and are looking for a 12-month internship.

  • You already have practical experience in machine learning and are interested in applying them to real-world systems.

  • You can write Python and have used it for coursework, personal projects, or research.

  • You are curious, analytical, and comfortable learning new tools and working through technical problems with a team.

  • You communicate confidently in English and are able to explain your work and discuss ideas with colleagues.

It is a plus if you have:

  • Worked with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or explored computer vision.

  • Used Git and Linux, or worked with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or GPU-based training.

  • Handled image, geospatial, LiDAR, or other sensor data, or have an interest in simulation and synthetic data.

Why Quantum-Systems:

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Embedded Software Engineer – Working Student / Intern Position (Full-Time, 12 Months)

Join our Drone Port team as Embedded Software Engineer and help develop the embedded software that enables safe and autonomous drone operations. As an experienced student, you will contribute practical engineering skills to a team of 20 colleagues and work closely with embedded software engineers, system architects, and hardware developers.

Over this 12-month, full-time position, you will take ownership of defined development tasks, from implementation and debugging to testing and documentation, with support and technical guidance from experienced colleagues.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize embedded firmware for our Drone Port systems.

  • Translate technical requirements into software features and contribute to design decisions.

  • Implement and test board support packages (BSPs), peripheral drivers, and interfaces to external sensors.

  • Debug firmware and investigate hardware–software interactions using appropriate measurement and - debugging tools.

  • Develop and maintain tests to verify functionality and improve software reliability and code coverage.

  • Contribute to bootloader development and firmware update mechanisms.

  • Support and improve our firmware build environment and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop and maintain tools for production, device configuration, and testing.

  • Document your work and participate in code reviews and technical discussions.


What you bring to the team:

  • You are studying electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related subject and are available to work full-time for 12 months.

  • You have substantial practical experience in embedded software development.

  • You write clean, structured, and efficient C code and understand the constraints of resource-limited microcontrollers.

  • You have hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and common peripherals.

  • You have practical experience with several embedded communication interfaces, such as UART, I²C, SPI, CAN, or Ethernet.

  • You understand core real-time operating system concepts and have ideally used an RTOS

  • You use Git confidently and are familiar with collaborative development workflows, including branches, merge requests, and code reviews.

  • You can read electronic schematics and use them to investigate hardware–software issues.

  • You approach debugging systematically and can explain your findings clearly.

  • You work independently on agreed tasks, communicate progress and obstacles proactively, and seek input when needed.

  • You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and sharing technical knowledge.

  • Your English is at least B2 level, both written and spoken.

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to join our People team and support our Engineering & Product teams. You will provide strategic business partnerships and coaching, develop people-related solutions to meet critical business needs and positively shape the Distribusion people experience.

What you will do:

  • You will be the first People Partner and work closely with the VP of People to onboard yourself into Distribusion's current People philosophies, practices, and processes.

  • You will partner with the Engineering and Product functions to sustainably achieve their growth and development goals.

  • You will partner with the other People functions on all aspects of employment experience.

  • You will build our management team’s capacity through coaching and influencing.

  • You will contribute to the strategy of the teams you support and to the direction of the People Business Partner team.

  • You will foster excellence in the support, motivation, retention, and growth of our talent.


Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid

We are looking for this role based at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • You bring extensive experience in People Business Partner roles in Germany or the European region.

  • Experience in successfully supporting and developing functions in high-growth phases.

  • You demonstrate outstanding judgment and make consistently good decisions for the company and our team members.

  • You know firsthand the challenges of a growth-stage company, anticipate scaling problems, and are adaptable and curious.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of designing and implementing people programs.

  • Strong leadership qualities with experience managing projects.

  • Proficiency in HRIS systems and KPIs and a keen interest in leveraging AI and other emerging technologies.

  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to liaise with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written.

  • Passionate about the people's development, enablement and success, resonating with the purpose behind the role.

  • Driven, ambitious, and willing to get hands-on in shaping the future of ground transportation travel.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – Contract (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office

jobs.title: Gap-Year-Student (m/w/d) im Office der Geschäftsführung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben

Eigene Projekte mit echter Verantwortung: Du übernimmst über die Monate hinweg mehrere klar abgegrenzte Initiativen, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

KI-Anwendungen bauen: Du nutzt KI nicht nur als Tool, sondern entwickelst eigene Anwendungen für unser Team und unsere Kunden, von Automatisierungen über Custom GPTs bis zu kleinen Webanwendungen.

Strategische Mitarbeit: Du arbeitest an OKR-Planungen, Investorenpräsentationen, Marktanalysen und Operational-Excellence-Themen mit.

Cross-funktionale Einblicke: Du bekommst Zugang zu allen Bereichen (Tech, Fulfillment, Marketing, Sales) und verstehst nach einem Jahr, wie ein wachsendes Unternehmen wirklich funktioniert.

Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du wirst behandelt wie ein vollwertiges Teammitglied, mit allen Rechten und Pflichten.

Ihr Profil

Du hast Dein Abitur mit sehr guten Leistungen abgeschlossen oder befindest Dich zwischen Bachelor und Master.

Du bringst hohe intrinsische Motivation mit und Lust, ein Jahr lang wirklich etwas zu lernen statt es einfach zu überbrücken.

Echte Begeisterung für KI und Technologie: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor & Co., probierst Neues aus und schreckst nicht zurück, wenn ein Projekt technisches Neuland ist.

Keine Angst vor technischen Herausforderungen: Wenn ein Workflow automatisiert werden muss oder ein neues Tool evaluiert werden soll, legst Du los und lernst beim Tun.

Analytisches Denkvermögen, Hands-on-Mentalität und unternehmerisches Gespür.

Reife, Eigenverantwortung und Lust, schnell zu lernen, auch wenn vieles neu ist.

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Warum wir?

Unser Ziel: ein faires, datengetriebenes Wertgutachten für jede Immobilie in Deutschland. Bei Certa ersetzen wir das klassische Sachverständigenwesen durch eine KI-gestützte Bewertungsplattform, die schneller, präziser und transparenter ist als alles, was der Markt heute kennt.

Du planst ein Gap Year zwischen Schule und Studium oder zwischen Bachelor und Master und willst diese Zeit nicht mit Backpacking-Klischees, sondern mit echter Verantwortung füllen? Bei Certa bekommst Du eine Rolle, die Du in einem Jahr nirgendwo sonst bekommst.

Das Office der Geschäftsführung arbeitet direkt mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern (Alexander Rausch & Matthias Mertens) an den Top-Themen, die Certa als Unternehmen entscheidend voranbringen. Vom OKR-Framework über Marktexpansion und Operational Excellence bis zum Aufbau skalierbarer Backoffice-Strukturen. Trotz der Nähe zur Geschäftsführung leben wir eine entrepreneuriale, pragmatische Arbeitskultur: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, hohe Umsetzungstiefe.

Ein Gap Year bei Certa ist kein Praktikum mit Abstrichen, sondern eine vollwertige Rolle mit eigenen Verantwortungsbereichen. Du bekommst Zeit, in mehrere Themen tief reinzukommen, eigene Projekte aufzubauen und mit der Zeit echte Ownership zu übernehmen.

Ein Jahr, das Dich prägt: Du lernst in 12 Monaten mehr über Wirtschaft, Technologie und Unternehmensführung als in den ersten zwei Studienjahren.

Direkte Linie zu den Gründern: Du arbeitest täglich mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern. Keine Layer, keine Politik, keine Slide-Schlachten.

Spielwiese für KI-Enthusiasten: Bei uns ist KI kein Buzzword, sondern Arbeitsalltag. Du bekommst Zugang zu allen relevanten Tools und Modellen.

Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an Themen, die wirklich zählen, nicht an Beschäftigungstherapie.

Faire Vergütung: Anders als bei vielen Gap-Year-Programmen wirst Du bei uns als vollwertiges Teammitglied bezahlt.

jobs.title: AI & Automation Lead (f/m/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.

lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.

Your Mission:

As AI & Automation Lead, you will establish and lead lemon.markets’ first dedicated AI function, making AI a safe, practical and measurable part of how the whole company works. Reporting directly to the VP Engineering and operating across the first line, you will identify high-value opportunities across Engineering, Finance, Operations, Compliance, Product, Sales, Partner Management and People and turn them into solutions that improve efficiency without compromising quality or control.

You will build on the foundations already being established, including a governed AI platform, an inventory of current use cases and an initial risk assessment aligned with the EU AI Act. A key part of your role will be creating the standards, measurement framework and decision processes that determine which use cases are scaled, improved or stopped.

Working closely with Engineering, Finance, Risk Management and Compliance, you will balance innovation with data protection, operational resilience, cost discipline and regulatory expectations. This is your opportunity to shape how a regulated financial company adopts AI responsibly, while building a function that leaves lasting capability across the organisation.

  • Enable teams across the company to use AI effectively themselves by developing practical workflows, guidance and capabilities that reduce manual effort without creating dependency on the AI function.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Investing (f/m/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As a Product Manager in the Investing domain, you will contribute to the product scope our largest partners depend on, as well as our side of the joint dwpbank x lemon.markets suite. Your remit will include working with some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe to deliver core capabilities. These include trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the investing capabilities we're building jointly with dwpbank. You will scope them, prioritise them, and deliver them.

Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Investing, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work across internal teams at lemon.markets, our largest partners, and dwpbank counterparts in the group. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for a set of partner-critical Investing capabilities, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional crew including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, external partners, and colleagues in risk, finance, and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs internally and externally.

  • Ensure that any partner-specific integrations have longevity within our platform.

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects - scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise.

  • Work with dwpbank counterparts on joint product opportunities, translating between two organisations with different ways of working.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off fixes for the loudest partner.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in our space, and bring the insights back to the team.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 2-3 years of product experience, independently shipping highly complex products.

jobs.title: First Line Manager (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As a First Line Manager at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.


What you'll do

  • Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

  • Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

  • Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

  • Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

  • Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

  • Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.


Who you are

  • You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

  • You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

  • You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

  • You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

  • You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

  • Building a team excites you more than your own quota.


This might not be the right fit if…

  • you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

  • you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

  • you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

  • you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.


Why now

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

The role

Almost everything Peec shows a customer passes through a model at some point. We track brands, products, sentiment, citations and sources across millions of AI answers. Those answers change whenever a provider ships a new model and differ by country, language and prompt. Turning that into numbers customers can trust and act on is the core data science problem at Peec.

Our data science team has grown fast, with AI-powered features shipping across the product. We're now growing the team further and need someone to lead it. You'll turn a group of strong individual contributors into a high-powered, fast-shipping team. You'll report directly to the CTO and lead a team of 7 data scientists.

What you'll do

Leading people

  • Hire, onboard and grow the data science team. We're hiring several data scientists right now, and you'll shape who joins and how they ramp up.

  • Build a team culture that matches our values: a high bar for quality, full ownership of outcomes, and kindness towards each other

  • Lead and inspire the team through regular 1:1s, actionable feedback and clear career paths

Leading the technical work

  • Set the technical direction and roadmap for data science, together with product and engineering leadership, and decide what the team works on and what it doesn't

  • Own quality in production with strong operational excellence and reproducibility across the ML lifecycle

  • Drive innovation by investing in scalable machine learning data infrastructure

  • Stay close to the work: review designs and code, and step in hands-on when it matters

  • Represent data science to leadership and customers

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in data science or machine learning, including 3+ years managing data scientists or ML engineers as direct reports, ideally at a high-growth startup or an established tech company

  • A track record of building great teams: hiring well, developing people, and creating the standards and rituals that make a team more than the sum of its individuals

  • Experience taking ML products from research to production, and building the practices that keep them reliable: evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We are hiring a Fullstack Engineer for our Growth team. You will run experiments across the whole self-serve journey: from the moment someone first hears of Peec AI to the day they renew, refer a friend or leave. That covers the website, signup, pricing and checkout, the trial and onboarding. It also covers the moments in the product where we ask people to do something, like connect a tool, invite a teammate or upgrade. You can work on any of these, and we decide together where the focus goes each month or quarter.

You come up with the hypothesis, design the experiment and discuss it with the team. Then you run the rest of the loop yourself: build it, instrument it, ship it behind a flag, read the result and write down what happened.

You report to the VP of Growth and work with our Growth PM, our growth engineer, and the marketing and design teams.

What you'll do

  • Go after big swings. We size every idea first and look for changes that could move a funnel step by 30 to 40 percentage points. It is fine if most of them fail.

  • Build and improve the experimentation infrastructure. Feature flags, assignment at the account level, exposure logged when someone becomes eligible, outcomes recorded on the server, and holdouts we read.

  • Keep conversion data accurate. Event design, funnel definitions and readouts the team can rely on.

  • Own what you ship after launch. You watch it, read the result on the date you set, and decide whether we keep it, change it or remove it.

  • Build internal tools that let the team run more experiments with less manual work.

What we're looking for

  • You have run growth experiments end to end. You formed the hypothesis, designed the test, built it and read the result. Not advised on them, not analysed someone else's.

  • You write production code today. Strong React and TypeScript on the frontend, comfortable in Node.js and databases on the backend. Our stack is React, Node.js and Next.js.

  • You know what your volume can detect. You can size a test, say how long it needs to run, and tell us when a result is not readable.

  • SQL and analytics fluency. Funnels, cohorts, event design.

  • B2B SaaS experience.

  • You ship with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent.

  • Product judgement. You can tell which changes need a test, which can ship without one, and which are not worth building.

  • Product taste. You care about how the things you ship look and fee...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Über die Rolle

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App.

  • Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben.

  • Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

Du passt gut, wenn du

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

  • Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst.

  • Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

  • Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt.

  • Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

  • Fließend Deutsch sprichst.

Deine Benefits

  • Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

  • 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

  • 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du bist die Person vor Ort: Jede Verwaltung, die wir übernehmen, wird erst durch dich zu einem Buena-Betrieb. Ohne dich bleibt sie, was sie war.

  • Wir wachsen schnell: Jeden Monat kommen neue Hausverwaltungen dazu. Deine Einsätze werden nicht weniger, sondern größer.

  • Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Sta...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS.

Keine Lust mehr auf einen stressigen Praxisalltag und mangelnde Wertschätzung? Es ist Zeit für die Praxis der Zukunft, werden Sie Teil von PraxisEins!

Sie wollen endlich in einem Umfeld arbeiten, das Sie wertschätzt, Stress so gering wie möglich hält, technisch stets modernisiert wird und Ihnen angenehme Arbeitszeiten ermöglicht? Ein Traum? Falsch! Bei uns ist das möglich!

Werden Sie Teil einer solchen Praxis!

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Medizinische Fachangestellte (m/w/d) für unser Hausarztzentrum

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN

  • Wertschätzung

  • Offene Feedback-Kultur (Wichtigste Regel: Wir reden miteinander und nicht übereinander)

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

  • 28-30 Urlaubstage

  • Umfangreiche fachliche sowie überfachliche Weiterbildungen

  • Raum für Kreativität und Eigeninitiative

  • Zusammenarbeit mit jungem Management

  • Moderne, attraktive Praxis, die zum Austausch einlädt und das Wohlbefinden fördert

  • Junges, dynamisches Team, das etwas bewegen will

IHRE AUFGABEN

  • Sie unterstützen im Praxisalltag am Empfang, im Labor und bei der Behandlung

  • Sie unterstützen bei Dokumentation und Abrechnung (EBM, GoÄ)

  • Sie unterstützen das Recall-Management und Patiententelefon

  • Sie unterstützen beim Beschaffungsmanagement

  • (falls NäPa/Verah/Eva) Sie betreuen Ihre Patienten durch regelmäßige Hausbesuche und Heimbesuche

IHR PROFIL

Bei uns zählen Charakter und Menschlichkeit mehr als Skills & Erfahrung. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Punkte des Anforderungsprofils erfüllen, bitten wir Sie, uns Ihre Bewerbung zu senden. Schließlich können wir alles beibringen, wenn der Charakter und die Einstellung stimmt!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringen Sie idealerweise mit:

  • Lebensfrohe und offene Natur

  • Verantwortungsbewusstes und respektvolles Auftreten

  • Hohes Maß an Selbstorganisation und Zuverlässigkeit

  • Berufserfahrung in einer Praxis im hausärztlichen Bereich oder als MFA bzw. in der Pflege

  • Leichtigkeit im Umgang mit digitalen Programmen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf sehr gutem Niveau

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Customer Success - Access Operations Specialist to support our institutional customers and Sales team at AMBOSS.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Institutions can only get value from AMBOSS if their users can reach it easily and know it’s available to them, and as our Customer Success - Access Operations Specialist, you are the person who makes that happen.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring our institutional partners unlock the full value of AMBOSS, helping embed it into daily clinical and teaching routines and strengthening user experience, retention, and growth. Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, Ronald, you will help support our International and US customers and the respective Sales Managers, contributing to our revenue and internationalization company goals.

You will:

  • Manage, prioritize and effectively address requests from our B2B Sales Team and institutional administrators to support their license and trial launches, always keeping the experience and value our users get from AMBOSS at the center.

  • Set up the agreed access methods for AMBOSS by following through on the technical details of the implementation with the institution’s IT team and our internal stakeholders, ensuring each access method is configured correctly and ready on time.

  • Own the project management of complex access set-ups, such as single sign-on or licenses with multiple access methods, by aligning institutional IT teams, administrators, Engineering, and Sales on scope, timelines, and responsibilities, tracking progress against milestones, resolving blockers early, and guiding the set-up end to end through go-live.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Systems Architect - Workday
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

Greif mit uns nach den Sternen!

Zur Unterstützung unseres Finance-Teams bei Limehome suchen wir eine:n motivierte:n Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting (m/w/d). Du unterstützt primär unser Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft und bei den Monatsabschlüssen und bekommst je nach Bedarf darüber hinaus Einblicke in weitere Finance-Themen wie Reporting, FP&A und Prozessautomatisierung. So lernst du eine moderne, tech-getriebene Finanzfunktion in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen von Grund auf kennen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung.

Als ‘Host with heart’ bist du für diese Themen verantwortlich:

  • Du unterstützt das Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft, zum Beispiel in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung (z. B. Rechnungserfassung, Kontenabstimmung, Belegmanagement).

  • Du hilfst bei vorbereitenden Tätigkeiten für die Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse mit.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung von Daten und Auswertungen, z. B. für Reportings oder Ad-hoc Anfragen.

  • Du wirkst an der Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Finance-Prozessen mit – inkl. dem Einsatz von Tools und KI.

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig je nach Bedarf kleinere Projekte und Ad-hoc-Aufgaben über den gesamten Finance-Bereich hinweg.


Was Du brauchst, um mit uns nach den Sternen zu greifen:

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in, idealerweise mit wirtschaftswissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt (z. B. BWL, Finance, Accounting, Wirtschaftsinformatik).

  • Du bringst eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit und arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen.

  • Du hast eine Affinität für Prozesse, Tools und Systeme und Interesse an Automatisierung und KI

  • Du bist proaktiv, lernbereit und übernimmst gerne früh Verantwortung.

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du kannst uns idealerweise für etwa 16-20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen (flexibel in der Prüfungszeit).

Darum wirst du deinen “Aufenthalt” bei uns lieben:

  • Onboarding und Feedback: Wir sorgen mit unserem gut durchdachten Onboarding-Prozess für einen reibungslosen Start. Regelmäßiges Feedback und Peer Reviews unterstützen dich zusätzlich in deiner Weiterentwicklung. 

  • OneTeam: Eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit Team-Stand-ups, regelmäßigen All-Hands-Meetings und Firmenevents (Sommerparty, Wiesn,...).

  • Alles für unsere Limehomies: Bis zu 24 bezahlte Urlaubstage im Jahr, Rabatte bei Urban Sports Club, Unterstützung beim Thema psychische Gesundheit (Nilo.health), Staycations in einem unserer Limehomes und viele weitere Vorteile.
