jobs.title: Lead Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Venture

We are building AI infrastructure. Our pre-seed funding is secured, there is early customer demand and the product is already in production.

We are now looking for a Lead Engineer to build the core of the product with us, set the technical direction and grow the engineering team.

About the Role

As Lead Engineer, you will spend most of your time building. At least 80% of your week is hands-on coding on our core systems. The rest goes into setting the technical direction, leading a team of 2 engineers and helping us hire as the team grows.

We are an AI-native engineering team, with agentic engineering at the centre of how we write, review and ship code. Coding agents such as Claude Code are the default way we build software, not an add-on.

We are at a very early stage. Many of the important technical decisions are still ahead, and you will be one of the people making them.

What You’ll Do

  • Write code every day and contribute directly to our core systems, from APIs to cloud infrastructure

  • Set the technical direction with the founding team, from architecture to build-vs-buy decisions

  • Lead and support our team of 2 engineers, review their work and set high engineering standards

  • Support technical hiring and help shape how the engineering team grows

  • Build and improve our agentic engineering setup, from harnesses and workflows to running multiple agents in parallel, evaluating their output and benchmarking what works

  • Build and operate reliable AI infrastructure, with security, GDPR and European data residency built in

About You

You are a strong engineer who loves to build and is interested in more than the code itself. You care about how a team works, how technical decisions get made and how an engineering organisation takes shape at an early stage. You may already have led a team, or you may be a senior engineer ready to step into a lead role and take on the responsibility that comes with it.

  • Strong backend and platform foundations, including distributed systems, API design, cloud infrastructure and production systems

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems or AI infrastructure in production

  • Extensive daily use of coding agents such as Claude Code, with strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review and own the quality of their output

  • Experience designing and improving agentic engineering workflows, including harnesses, multi-agent orchestration and benchmarking, with a clear understanding of where agents help and where they fall short

  • Experience as a Lead Engineer or Tech Lead, ideally in an early-stage startup, or as a senior engineer who has mentored others and is ready to step into a lead role

  • A real interest in more than coding, including setting the technical direction, leading a team and hiring

  • Fluent English; German is a plus

Why Join

Funding is secured and the product is already in production, but most of the important technical decisions are still ahead. You will write a lot of code, shape the architecture and help build the team from the start, with equity in the business you help build.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office 5 days a week, starting as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Field Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. jobs.title: Sales and Client Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

As the Client Success Manager (CSM), Intelligence & Security you will drive new business and client retention for Sibylline’s intelligence platform. Working with security, intelligence, and risk teams at organisations across the UK and Europe, you will build a pipeline of new clients, looks after a portfolio of existing accounts, and represents Sibylline at industry events.

This is a client-facing role suited to someone early in their sales career who wants to build expertise in the intelligence and security sector. You will speak regularly with heads of security, global security operations centres (GSOCs), intelligence analysts, and risk managers, so confident communication and a genuine interest in global affairs are essential.

Full support and guidance will be provided by our global team, including structured training on our platform and services, and ongoing professional development.

Responsibilities

  • Business Development: Generate new leads through outreach, networking, and event follow-up, targeting security, intelligence, and risk functions within the UK and European market.
  • Platform Sales: Run discovery conversations and product demonstrations, understand each prospect’s intelligence requirements, and show how Sibylline’s platform meets them. Prepare and price proposals with support from senior colleagues.
  • Events: Attend and help staff industry events, conferences, and exhibitions across the UK and, at times, internationally to meet clients, generate leads, and raise Sibylline’s profile.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm Eastern Time.

  • Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

*Open to Director level candidates


General Description:

BeOne Medicines is seeking a highly analytical, intellectually curious, and entrepreneurial strategy professional to support the development and execution of strategic priorities across its global Research & Development organization.

Reporting to the VP of R&D Strategy & Operations, this individual will work closely with senior R&D leadership to address complex strategic questions, evaluate new opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and advance high-priority initiatives across Research, Development, and emerging innovation platforms.

This role is ideal for a versatile problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity, moves comfortably between strategy and implementation, and translates complex scientific, operational, and business information into compelling executive-level insights.


Essential Functions of the Job:


R&D Strategy & Strategic Problem-Solving

  • Lead strategic analyses addressing R&D priorities, organizational capabilities, productivity, portfolio considerations, and emerging opportunities.
  • Structure ambiguous business questions, develop hypotheses, conduct targeted research and analysis, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Conduct industry benchmarking, competitive intelligence, market assessments, and evaluations of innovative R&D approaches and business models.
  • Support R&D strategic planning, long-term priorities, and initiatives to strengthen research and development capabilities.

Strategic Initiatives & Implementation

  • Independently manage strategic workstreams and special projects from problem definition through recommendation and early implementation.
  • Partner with Research, Development, Finance, BD, and other functions to gather insights, evaluate alternatives, and advance cross-functional priorities.
  • Support initiatives related to R&D innovation, new operating models, external partnerships, and the evolution of BeOne's development capabilities.
  • Translate strategic recommendations into practical implementation plans and support execution as needed.

Executive Decision Support & R&D Operations

  • Develop high-quality executive presentations, strategic narratives, briefing materials, and recommendations for senior R&D leadership.
  • Support R&D-wide strategic planning, goal setting, governance, and leadership decision-making processes.
  • Synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into clear implications, trade-offs, and recommended actions.
  • Support high-priority activities of the R&D head office, including leadership meetings and cross-functional coordination.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in biopharma, life sciences consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, or related fields; consulting and industry experience are equally valued.
  • Strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, including familiarity with drug discovery, clinical development, and the broader R&D value chain.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently structure and solve ambiguous strategic questions, develop recommendations, and drive workstreams with limited supervision.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and synthesis capabilities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Shift Collab

At Shift Collab, we're a clinician- and women-led, award-winning national virtual mental health therapy practice of over 125 Registered Social Workers and Registered Psychotherapists reshaping virtual mental health care across Canada.

We’re always meeting therapists who would be a great fit for our team. This is an open posting, so we’ll be collecting applications and reaching out as needed based on our current client needs. This is an independent contractor role.

What This Role Actually Looks Like

We invest heavily in growing your caseload through marketing, client matching, and a strong referral engine. What we need from you is a partner in that effort: someone who shows up consistently, runs excellent Meet & Greet sessions, builds strong therapeutic relationships, and keeps clients engaged in thoughtful treatment planning.

We do the heavy lifting on visibility and operations. You focus on delivering excellent clinical care and building a caseload that lasts.

Hours

  • Typically 8 to 10 hours a week to start
  • Evening and weekend availability is a strong asset
  • Potential for schedule growth, based on your availability and our demand.

What We Handle, So You Don't Have To

Billing, scheduling, client intake admin, and back-office support are all covered. Our secure telehealth platform gives you one place to manage sessions and notes. Your time goes to clinical work and client relationships, not chasing paperwork.

Compensation

Our compensation model reflects clinical experience, tenure, client demand, market rates, and the full support that comes with practicing at Shift Collab. Your rate is part of a broader model that includes client referrals and matching, marketing, billing, scheduling, intake administration, technology, and ongoing practice support.

Why Therapists Stay

  • Admin and marketing support. We take care of the infrastructure behind your practice and invest in bringing new clients to Shift.
  • A real community. Being 100% virtual doesn't mean practicing alone. Peer supervision, team meetings, and knowledge-sharing keep you connected.
  • Your own professional presence. We help build your bio and visibility, with opportunities for some therapists to write, speak, or contribute their expertise publicly.
  • Support for you, too. Wellness resources, peer support, regular touchpoints, and social events help you stay connected to the community.

Who Thrives Here

  • Approach the therapeutic relationship with engagement over acronyms
  • Deliver high-quality, accessible virtual care and understand virtual-first practice
  • Excel at Meet & Greet sessions and know how to turn a first conversation into a strong therapeutic match
  • Take retention and treatment planning seriously so clients feel cared for and know where their therapy is going
  • See caseload growth as a shared effort and are ready to actively partner on it
  • Can offer some evening availability, where client demand is highest

Engineered Intelligence is a Canadian software company with a global presence redefining how utilities plan and invest in grid infrastructure. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

Wealthfront is looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to help drive design for our Investing products, reporting to the Design Director for Self-Directed Investing. Building great financial products requires digging diligently into the details to address complex problems with elegant solutions. We’re seeking a designer who cares deeply about all aspects of a great product experience, from strategy to pattern to pixel.

Wealthfront pioneered automated investing by offering broad access to sophisticated investing strategies at a fraction of the cost of traditional financial advisers. Our mission is to build a financial system that favors people over institutions. On this team, you would be a key part of expanding the ways we help our clients build long-term wealth through saving and investing.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration skills, the ability to think in scalable systems/platforms, and a high bar for craft & execution. A passion for investing or experience building consumer financial technology products is highly desirable.

Growing and managing your wealth is fundamental to being able to build the life you want with the people who matter most. This is a unique opportunity to be at the center of charting the next generation of technology innovation in investing products. If this gets you excited, we want to hear from you!

Design at Wealthfront

Designers at Wealthfront transform complex financial technology into simple and delightful experiences. Our commitment to our clients and high bar for craft set us apart from traditional financial institutions, fostering trust with our clients and empowering them to build lasting wealth on their own terms.

We pride ourselves on our meticulous attention to detail, consistently striving for excellence in all areas of our craft. We place just as much emphasis on the words we use to communicate with our clients as we do the interactive elements of our experiences. This shows up in our team structure–we have nearly a 1:1 ratio of content designers to product designers. We understand how design plays an important role in the success of our business and we are active participants in various leadership forums.

Collaboration is at the core of our approach. We work closely with our counterparts in engineering, product management, research, data science, legal, and compliance to define opportunities and explore solutions. We are equal partners in making strategic decisions and defining impactful roadmaps. We embrace a culture of continuous learning, prioritizing the magnitude of our successes over the percentage of times we are successful.

Most importantly, we love what we do! We are passionate about our mission, the financial technology space, and our clients. We take pride in our culture with a high bar, and a low ego.

Learn more about our design team at

We’re a remote friendly team and open to candidates in the US.

  • Use design to accelerate strategic decision-making by harnessing skills such as rapid prototyping and broad design exploration

jobs.descriptionHtml:
To protect candidates from recruitment scams, MarCom Group will only communicate with applicants through domains such as @marcomgroup.com or . MarCom Group will never contact an applicant from another domain or ask to provide payment as part of the recruiting process.

MarCom Group is a top-ranked creative agency that provides strategic advertising, branding, marketing, design, digital, and events solutions. We are a woman-owned small business founded in 1996 in the Washington, DC area.

The Audience Insights Analyst is a member of MarCom Group’s Brand Strategy department, specializing in audience research, workforce intelligence, and candidate persona development to support awareness and recruitment marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting labor market data, demographic and psychographic research, workforce trends, and candidate behaviors to develop comprehensive, data-driven audience personas that inform recruitment marketing strategies. Working collaboratively with Creative, Media, and Account Services teams, the Audience InsightsAnalyst transforms complex research and workforce data into actionable insights that help clients better understand, attract, and engage priority talent audiences. The position plays a key role in identifying high-value talent segments, understanding candidate motivations and barriers, mapping candidate journeys, and translating audience intelligence into strategic recommendations for messaging, creative development, media targeting, and campaign optimization. The Audience InsightsAnalyst ensures marketing strategies are grounded in meaningful audience understanding, supported by reliable research methodologies, and aligned with hiring objectives and applicable compliance requirements.

MarCom Group Core Values 
 
At MarCom Group, our “Core Four” values guide every interaction — with each other and with our clients: 

 

  • Foster Collaboration: We value every voice. We win as one. We proactively seek opportunities to collaborate, reaching across teams and with clients to create solutions together.  
  • Inspire Possibilities: We imagine more, create boldly, and turn ideas into reality. We stay open-minded, flexible, and creative, always seeking innovative approaches.  
  • Champion People: We invest in people, and they invest in themselves, so we grow together. We celebrate our team, share wins, and have immense compassion for each other, our clients, and the audiences we serve.  
  • Lead with Why: We seek to understand, are always curious, and act with intention. We ask “why” to get to the root of challenges and deliver solutions that truly matter

Supervisory Responsibilities

The Audience InsightsAnalyst position does not formally supervise other employees but may facilitate research workstreams, guide deliverable development, and provide direction to internal team members supporting research development tasks.

Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

About the Role

As a Workforce Associate Architect, you will partner with business leaders and the Talent & Workforce Strategy team to help shape the workforce required to execute business strategy.

This is a highly consultative role for someone who is curious, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to turn complex business and workforce questions into structured options, recommendations, and action plans.

The role supports the Workforce Architect in understanding how work gets done today, identifying opportunities to redesign the workforce and operating model, and helping leaders make informed decisions about roles, capabilities, organizational structures, workforce capacity, and future ways of working.

Requirements

Core experience

  • Workforce strategy or strategic workforce planning
  • Management or business consulting
  • Business transformation
  • Organizational design or target operating model redesign
  • Organizational effectiveness
  • Workforce transformation
  • Project/program management
  • Change management
  • Business strategy or transformation
  • Fluent English proficiency.

Consulting & stakeholder capabilities

  • Consultant behavior: intellectually curious, asks thoughtful questions, challenges constructively, and does not simply accept the initial problem statement.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across different levels and functions.
  • Confidence facilitating meetings, workshops, and difficult discussions.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to convert ambiguous problems into structured analysis and recommendations.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-through.
  • Experience managing multiple workstreams, actions, decisions, risks, and dependencies.
  • Comfort working in environments where the answer is not known at the outset.
  • Ability to balance analytical evidence with business judgment.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Knowledge and experience in financial markets, insurance markets, and/or the US insurance market.
  • Prior traditional HR experience is nice to have. Relevant workforce, transformation, consulting, organizational-design, or business experience can provide the foundation for success in this role.

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

jobs.descriptionHtml:
PandaDoc is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, CPQ to own the go-to-market strategy for a critical product line in our document workflow and revenue operations suite. CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) is how we help sales teams close deals faster and expand ACV. It is a strategic revenue engine, and we need a PMM who understands how to market a product that moves the needle on sales velocity and deal size.

You'll work directly with our CPQ product team and Sales leadership to define positioning, messaging, and campaigns that resonate with Sales leaders and RevOps professionals who are evaluating whether to build vs. buy. Our buyers need to see clear ROI, implementation speed, and competitive differentiation before they commit. You'll run a dual-track GTM motion that speaks to both the business buyer who owns the budget and the technical operator who will configure and manage the system.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the CPQ GTM strategy. From influencing the roadmap to post-launch adoption and expansion, you're the connective tissue between Product and the market. You define who we're building for, why it matters, and how we win against entrenched competitors.
  • Lead AI positioning for CPQ. AI is changing how sales teams configure, price, and approve quotes. You will translate what our AI features do into outcomes a RevOps leader can defend to a CFO. You will set the standard for accuracy and trust in every claim we make about them.
  • Partner deeply with Product. You'll be in the room early, bringing customer data, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to roadmap conversations. You will advocate for capabilities that unlock commercial opportunity and help co-author product strategy.
  • Own our narrative. Our buyers are Sales leaders and RevOps at SMB companies who evaluate CPQ based on ROI, implementation timeline, and competitive positioning. You will build positioning that converts budget holders and technical operators who influence the decision.
  • Partner with demand gen to develop and execute campaigns. You will help define the campaign vision: audience segmentation, demand hypothesis, and content topics, and working with our demand gen team help deliver sales pipeline.
  • Enable Sales to sell and expand. You build the tools that help revenue teams have confident conversations and partner with Sales on win/loss analysis to continuously sharpen positioning and identify gaps.
  • Drive post-launch adoption and expansion. CPQ is only valuable if it's adopted and used. You will work with Customer Success and Sales to identify expansion use cases, build case studies, and drive adoption campaigns that help customers realize ROI.

You'll Have

  • 5+ years in marketing, with at least 3 in B2B SaaS product marketing with demonstrated experience marketing to business buyers (Sales Ops, RevOps, Finance, IT) and technical operators.
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools. You use AI daily to draft, analyze, and test ideas, and you know where it fails. You can explain to a skeptical buyer where AI speeds up a quote process and where a person still needs to check the output.

You've identified what assets need to exist, written the brief, set the quality bar, and coordinated subject matter experts to produce output that's both credible and compelling. You write clearly, you know what lands with business and technical audiences, and you can show the work.

jobs.title: Senior HRIS Analyst (Workday)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT EARNIN

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly.

We are seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst to own and evolve our Workday platform, primarily focused on Core HCM and Security. This role designs, configures, and optimizes scalable people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, and IT teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring data integrity, security, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle. We are in the midst of an exciting Intelligent Work Systems transformation, evolving from manual operations to designing AI-enabled, cross-system workflows that scale across the enterprise. We’re looking for someone with a strong Workday foundation and an inventor mindset to help build what’s next.

The San Diego base salary range for this full-time position is $153,130-$187,158, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. If based in or near Mountain View, CA, the role requires in-office work 2 days a week, though we are open to remote candidates in PT or CT time zones.

We are seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst to own and evolve our Workday platform. This role primarily focuses on payroll administration, and payroll administration experience is required. You'll also bring strong Core HCM expertise and support other Workday functional areas, including Time and Absence and Advanced Compensation. This role is responsible for designing, configuring, and optimizing scalable payroll and people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, Total Rewards, and Payroll teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring payroll accuracy, data integrity, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ampa is a pioneering neurotechnology startup developing brain stimulation technology to help eradicate depression. We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

What to Expect:
Working at Ampa is a rare chance to help transform global mental health and save millions of lives — a level of impact that demands deep commitment. Success here requires resilience, adaptability, and the discipline to put in long hours. If you thrive in a high-intensity, fast-changing environment and want your work to truly matter, you may do the best work of your life here.

We’re seeking an extremely talented Frontend-focused Fullstack Software Engineer to lead the development of our neuromodulation technology. In this role, you’ll be leading the team responsible for building the most user-friendly, scalable, and advanced brain stimulator platform in the world. You’ll work across both frontend and backend systems to control the stimulator, visualize data for healthcare providers, sync data with the cloud, collaborate with other engineers, ensure strong encryption, and create a seamless user experience. You’re a 10x engineer, passionate about mental health, with the potential to lead and mentor a growing team.

  • Drive: Highly motivated, open to feedback, and able to learn new skills as needed.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup.

Specific to this role:

  • Expertise: Strong in front-end architecture, API design, and data-driven development.
  • Experience: 6+ years in full stack development, including React/React Native and backend technologies like Python or Node.js.
  • Miscellaneous: Hardware interaction, computer vision, camera APIs (desirable).

Why Join Ampa?

  • Impact:
  • Growth: Thrive in a startup environment with rapid innovation.
  • Stability: Enjoy startup benefits with a secure product line.
  • Ownership: Receive substantial equity as an early team member.

Logistics:

  • Work Mode: Remote, Hybrid, or In-Person
  • Locations: United States - Pacific or Mountain time zones

jobs.title: Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

About the Company

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to millions of hosts who have welcomed guests in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Payments Risk Operations team protects Airbnb's guests, hosts, and the platform from fraud, financial loss, and abuse. Our investigators and agents review high-risk activity every day, and the quality of their tools directly shapes the speed, accuracy, and consistency of every decision they make. You will join a team of operators, analysts, and program leaders who partner closely with Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to keep our community safe.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead, you will own the end-to-end agent experience for risk and fraud operations. You will define what our investigators need, design and conceptualize the next generation of the risk workbench, and drive automation through process efficiencies and AI. You will be the voice of the agent in tooling decisions and the bridge between operational reality and technical execution. Your work will reduce manual effort, shorten handle times, improve decision quality, and free our experts to focus on the most complex cases.

A Typical Day

Agent experience

  • Own the end-to-end agent experience across risk and fraud investigation workflows, from case intake through decision, documentation, and quality review.
  • Spend time with agents to observe workflows, map pain points, and quantify friction in handle time, clicks, context switching, and error rates.
  • Establish feedback loops (surveys, office hours, champion networks, ticket intake) so agent needs are captured, prioritized, and closed out transparently.
  • Partner with Training, Quality, and Workforce Management to ensure tooling changes land with clear enablement, documentation, and adoption tracking.

Tooling requirements and improvements

  • Translate operational needs into clear, prioritized business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that Platform and Engineering can build against.
  • Own and manage the operational risk tooling roadmap and backlog, balancing quick wins, foundational investments, and policy or regulatory needs.
  • Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of tooling requests using impact sizing (time saved, loss prevented, accuracy gained, risk reduced).
  • Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), launch readiness, and post-launch measurement for every tooling release.

Workbench design and conceptualization

  • Define the long-term vision for a unified risk workbench that brings signals, account history, payment data, linked entities, and decisioning into a single, intuitive workspace.
  • Partner with Platform, Design, and UX Research to run discovery, build journey maps, create wireframes and prototypes, and conduct usability testing with agents.
  • Champion design principles of simplicity, consistency, and accessibility so agents can make accurate decisions quickly and co...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Methods is a £100M+ IT Services Consultancy who has partnered with a range of central government departments and agencies to transform the way the public sector operates in the UK. Established over 30 years ago and UK-based, we apply our skills in transformation, delivery, and collaboration from across the Methods Group, to create end-to-end business and technical solutions that are people-centred, safe, and designed for the future.

Our human touch sets us apart from other consultancies, system integrators and software houses - with people, technology, and data at the heart of who we are, we believe in creating value and sustainability through everything we do for our clients, staff, communities, and the planet.

We support our clients in the success of their projects while working collaboratively to share skill sets and solve problems. At Methods we have fun while working hard; we are not afraid of making mistakes and learning from them.

Predominantly focused on the public-sector, Methods is now building a significant private sector client portfolio.

Methods was acquired by the Alten Group in early 2022. Alten is a global engineering firm with approximately 57,000 employees specializing in engineering and IT services.

Requirements

  • Support and drive delivery across Titan, ViCTOR and ARES, maintaining clear priorities, milestones and ownership.
  • Titan / ViCTOR: Support Titan delivery and the transition from ViCTOR, coordinating development, testing, assurance, release and dependencies.
  • ARES: Manage the automation delivery pipeline, ensuring priorities, dependencies, blockers and readiness are actively managed.
  • Delivery control: Maintain accurate Jira plans, RAID, dependencies and delivery status.
  • Team leadership: Run effective delivery ceremonies including stand-ups, planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Risk & escalation: Proactively resolve blockers and escalate risks to Senior Delivery Manager, dependencies or decisions requiring senior intervention.

Expected outcomes

  • Delivery across Titan, ViCTOR and ARES is controlled and transparent.
  • Priorities, ownership and next steps are clear.
  • Risks and dependencies are identified and addressed early.
  • Delivery ceremonies drive decisions and action rather than administration.
  • Senior intervention is focused on exceptions, escalations and decisions, rather than routine delivery management.
  • Senior Delivery Manager capacity is released to focus on Application Platforms portfolio leadership, strategic priorities and senior stakeholder engagement.

This role will require you to have or be willing to go through Security Clearance.   • A supportive and collaborative environment.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. You'll join a small, fast-moving team building Chainguard Harness.

Chainguard Harness uses frontier AI models to hunt down exploitable vulnerabilities in a customer's application, then delivers validated findings with recommended fixes, with no model access required. Customers trust us with their source code, so security isn't just a feature of this product. It is the product.

As a Staff engineer you'll own large parts of the Harness architecture, guide technical decisions across the team, and help take the product from beta to a service that scales to many more customers and environments.

What you'll do

  • Own major parts of the system end to end, from design through implementation, rollout, and operation

  • Build security into the foundation: protecting customer code end to end, least-privilege access, and auditing everything the system and its operators do. Partner with Product and Security on threat models and reviews.

  • Make Harness a reliable, observable, production-grade service, making sound long-term tradeoffs around scale, cost, technical debt, and build versus buy.

  • Work directly with customers, Product, and our field team. You'll join customer calls and turn feedback into the roadmap.

  • Raise the bar for the team through design docs, code review, and mentoring, and by showing how AI tooling can make a small team move fast without cutting corners on security.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of experience in software development

  • A track record of building and operating production services where security and data confidentiality were hard requirements, not afterthoughts

  • Experience designing systems that hold confidential customer data end to end

  • Experience shipping software into air-gapped, disconnected, or highly restricted environments

  • Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on GCP and/or AWS, including IAM, KMS, networking, and infrastructure as code (Terraform)

  • Hands-on experience with virtualization and workload isolation, such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker or Cloud Hypervisor, gVisor, nested virtualization, or bare-metal hosts

  • A working knowledge of applied cryptography: envelope encryption, key management and rotation, HSM/KMS-backed keys, and signing

  • Proficiency with Go

Overview

Being on medication is tough enough. We want to make getting it the easy part. Getting prescriptions to patients has become increasingly complex. When things get messy along the prescription journey, pharmaceutical manufacturers rely on us to untangle the process and create a clear path—allowing patients to build trusting relationships with their medication brands.

We’re not only committed to taking the pain out of the prescription process, but we’re also devoted to bringing the brightest minds together under one roof. We bring together diverse voices—engineers, pharmacists, customer service veterans, developers, program strategists and more—all with one vision. Each perspective and experience makes ConnectiveRx better than the sum of its parts.

The Adjudication Analyst is responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance, analysis, and quality assurance of ConnectiveRx pharmaceutical affordability (copay) programs. The candidate will be accountable for program set-ups and maintenance. This role performs quality control on program setups and updates, investigates adjudication outcomes and data discrepancies, and applies business rules consistently to ensure operational accuracy and program integrity.   • Support documentation updates and process improvements. Primarily responsible for maintaining SOPs, work instructions, job aids, tracking logs and spreadsheets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from 4-year college or university or equivalent experience required
  • Minimum 2-4 yrs of pharmacy technician/adjudication experience. Prior experience performing quality checks, operational analysis, or investigative work preferred

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Senior Executive Talent Sourcer, Go-to-Market is a strategic member of our Executive Search team, dedicated to identifying and engaging Senior Director+ leaders across our revenue organization. You will be a trusted market advisor to recruiters and hiring leaders: mapping talent markets, shaping search strategy with data, and building calibrated slates of executives who can sell and scale AI in the enterprise.

This role primarily supports searches based in the United States, with partnership on global GTM searches as needed.

What you'll do

  • Partner with executive recruiters and GTM hiring leaders at intake to define and challenge the search: the problem the role solves, the profile that fits, and where that talent sits in the market.

  • Build market maps and competitive org charts across enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity, and hyperscaler sales organizations, and keep them current as leaders move.

  • Identify, engage, and qualify Senior Director+ GTM leaders, assessing quota and attainment history, deal size, segment, team scale, and experience selling AI and consumption-based offerings.

  • Deliver calibrated talent slates with a clear point of view on each candidate and on the market overall.

  • Use market data, including compensation benchmarks, talent supply, and competitor moves, to advise hiring leaders and adjust search strategy when the market doesn't match the spec.

  • Source for emerging roles without established titles, such as forward-deployed engineering, AI specialist overlays, and AI value realization, by mapping capabilities rather than matching titles.

  • Use AI tools every day for research, mapping, and outreach, and help the team improve how we source.

  • Create a high-touch, discreet experience for every executive you engage, whether or not they join ServiceNow.

  • Manage multiple concurrent executive searches while maintaining pipeline quality and responsiveness.

Search areas

You will support Senior Director+ searches across the GTM organization focusing on talent that often comes from enterprise software, AI platforms, cybersecurity, hyperscalers, and GSIs.

What you bring

  • Current executive sourcing experience at the Senior Director+ level, in retained executive search or an in-house executive search team.

  • 3+ years focused on sourcing executive level GTM/Sales leadership in enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Fluency in GTM metrics and the ability to qualify a sales leader's track record: quota, attainment, ACV, net revenue retention, deal size, segment, and team scale.

  • Strong understanding of GTM compensation, including OTE, base and variable mix, accelerators, and equity, and how it shapes candidate motivation and offer strategy.

  • Deep knowledge of the enterprise GTM talent landscape: key competitors, how their sales organizations are structured, and recent leadership moves.

At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced

Senior Principal Power Electronics Engineer (m/f/x)

to lead the development of advanced power electronics solutions for Solid State Transformer applications in datacenters, driving product architecture, technology roadmap, and research initiatives while providing technical leadership in customer projects, mentoring engineering teams, and continuously improving development processes and tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop Solid State Transformers for Datacenters.
  • Lead electronics and product architecture development.
  • Work as a subject matter expert in customer projects.
  • Drive company’s technology and product roadmap development.
  • Lead and plan research projects.
  • Support and mentor junior team members.
  • Drive electronics development process and tool development.

Requirements

  • Strong analog and digital electronics design expertise (simulation, schematics, layout, EMC, thermal design, functional safety).
  • Experience with product testing, qualification, and relevant standards.
  • Proven electronics architecture design experience.
  • Technical leadership and project ownership experience.
  • Full product development lifecycle experience in automotive or similar industries.
  • Good knowledge of electronics development tools and processes.
  • Experience with electronics industrialization, EMS suppliers, and production test systems.
  • Background in power electronics and energy storage applications.
  • MSc or PhD in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Benefits

  • A versatile and responsible role in a skilled and supportive team.
  • Opportunity to influence product quality and development.
  • An international working environment with growth opportunities.
  • Support for professional development.

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a global leader in critical power infrastructure for AI data centers and electrical grid stability, founded in 2009. Power today is more than electricity.

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to 40% more energy efficient. We keep the lights on when grids fluctuate, stabilizing electrical infrastructure under the combined pressure of accelerating renewable energy deployment and surging AI demand.

When power fails, critical operations stop. We exist to prevent that in microseconds. Powering the infrastructure that powers everything else.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Closing Auditor to join our accounting team. You’ll review client-level accounting and closing packages, making sure every closing statement is accurate, compliant, and processed on time. We're looking for an experienced editor to review and polish SEO content for a B2B client in the testing, inspection, and certification space — technical, compliance-driven content across industries including automotive, medical devices, energy, and industrial safety.

  • Turn work around within agreed deadlines

Send your CV and, if available, examples of editing work.

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Harbor seeks a Research Specialist, Legal Knowledge and Research Services to join the Library and Research department. The Research Specialist provides advanced legal research, strategic guidance, and high-impact client support as part of Harbor’s Knowledge and Research Services team. This role is suited for an experienced research professional who brings deep subject matter expertise, strong project ownership, and the ability to deliver sophisticated written and verbal work product. The Specialist serves as a trusted resource across complex legal and business research matters, contributes to departmental innovation and knowledge management, and supports exceptional service delivery to clients and internal stakeholders.

The Specialist is expected to operate with a high degree of independence, demonstrate deep knowledge of legal research methodologies and related service areas, and contribute to the development of scalable research processes, documentation, and best practices that improve research quality, consistency, efficiency, and long-term client value. This is a full-time, fully remote position that can be worked from anywhere in US or Canada. This position will cover the hours of 2 PM - 11 PM ET (with some flexibility).

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a go-to subject matter expert in one or more specialized legal research areas, regularly leading complex research initiatives from intake through completion and delivering clear, actionable, client-ready results.
  • Lead complex client-facing and internal research projects, including scoping requests, developing research plans, managing deadlines, and ensuring work product aligns with client expectations and Harbor’s quality standards.
  • Act as a trusted subject matter lead for client work by building and maintaining strong internal and external relationships, engaging effectively across library, research, and intelligence services, and adapting deliverables to client needs.
  • Demonstrate strategic client ownership by proactively understanding client goals, anticipating research and service needs, and aligning deliverables, recommendations, and follow-through with long-term client success and Harbor’s broader service strategy.
  • Model Harbor values with peers, team members, clients, and across work product by promoting collaboration, inclusion, respectful communication, knowledge sharing, and strong ownership of client outcomes.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor to colleagues, particularly junior analysts and researchers, by sharing expertise, contributing to shared knowledge spaces, and supporting team learning and best practices.
  • Pilot new research tools, advanced platforms, and emerging methodologies; provide strategic input on research workflows, service delivery models, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Define and maintain a clear specialty research portfolio of templates and deliverables that demonstrates enterprise-level influence, advances reusable service capabilities, and supports scalable, consistent delivery across clients, teams, and research service areas.
  • Advise on improvements to departmental research approaches and knowledge management documentation, including the evaluation, adoption, and effective use of emerging research technologies.
  • Own end-to-end workflow processes for complex projects and client requests, balancing competing priorities and deadlines while ensuring timely, accurate, efficient, and high-quality delivery.

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Our Enterprise Federal sales team works with a best-of-breed product that solves real problems for our customers. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology that helps them identify the customer’s unique needs and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. Whether you’re looking to learn from the best or be the best, the Datadog sales team is dedicated to furthering personal development and team success.</p> <p>We are searching for an experienced Federal, Civilian Sales Executive that has a real passion for technology and can deliver on bold revenue targets. As we continue to enter into bigger markets, and formalize our support for the Public Sector enterprise segment, this division within Datadog will blaze the path for organizational growth. This is a lucrative opportunity to break into new Civilian Agencies within a rich territory, as well work with accounts who are in a hybrid state and transitioning to the cloud.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PostHog

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

  • A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics, replay vision, AI observability, and error tracking

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

  • Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

  • Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-eff...

jobs.title: AI & Data Analytics Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview:

Jimdo is becoming an AI-first company, and our People team is one of the first places where that shows up in daily work. We're looking for an AI & Data Analytics Partner to build the agents, analytics and workflow automations that make the People team faster, smarter and easier to scale.

You'll take a process from "this is slow and manual" to a working, compliant solution in production, and then make sure the team can run and extend it without you. You'll also give leadership one reliable view of People data, so decisions rest on numbers everyone trusts.

You’ll start with the People team, and the scope can grow to any other function across Jimdo.

The team and who you'll work with:

You'll report to the Manager Performance Intelligence and work day to day with the People team and our HR Business Partners.

You'll also work closely with our AI team on standards and capabilities, with Finance and Legal on data consistency and compliance, and with our HR system and payroll providers.

This is a remote role, open to candidates based in Germany, Italy, Spain or Portugal.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build a central reporting suite in Tableau that brings data from HiBob, payroll and compensation tools into one source of truth, with dashboards leadership actually uses.

  • Own the quality and structure of People data, and use analytics to spot workforce trends, risks and process bottlenecks.

  • Find the HR processes with the most friction and fix them with AI agents and workflow automation, from first prototype to production.

  • Improve self-service for employees and managers with AI tools that answer the repetitive questions, so the People team can focus on the work that needs a person.

  • Connect our systems of record and improve the data flow between HR and Finance, so there's far less manual reconciliation.

  • Make every solution auditable, explainable and compliant, and set clear guardrails for responsible AI use.

  • Run hands-on workshops and co-building sessions and write playbooks, so the team can build and maintain automati...

jobs.title: Staff Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Staff Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d), you are RobCo's most senior technical voice in sales, owning your own deals alongside Account Executives while setting the technical standards that make the whole Robotics Sales Engineering team stronger. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

This is a technical leadership role without people management. You keep a quota with your own Account Executives, and a fixed part of your time goes into raising the technical bar across the team. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. Sales leadership turns to you first when they want to know how strong the pipeline really is.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define how the team judges feasibility, including real-world limits beyond data sheets, edge cases and clear no-go criteria

  • Develop our requirement workshop format and handover standards further

  • Step into complex or escalating deals across the team, set the technical direction and stay involved until the responsible RSE can carry the case forward

  • Make the go/no-go call on difficult feasibility cases, review concepts before handover and approve larger price indications

  • Build reusable assets such as calculation models, reference layouts per use case and enablement material for Sales and our partners

  • Track which use cases keep coming up and which we win or lose, and feed these insights into focus areas and the product roadmap

  • Shape onboarding and ramp-up for new RSEs and give technical feedback across the team

  • Pitch to strategic customers, give talks at trade fairs and events, and decide with Marketing and Product what we demo and why

  • Stay the technical lead for your own Account Executives and share their quota

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Extensive experience in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including time at a senior level

  • Experience working against a quota and winning complex deals

  • A track record as the person colleagues turn to when a feasibility question gets hard

  • The ability to recognize patterns across projects and turn them into rules, templates and tools that others use

  • Experience leading through expertise, with the trust of engineers and sales leaders in your technical judgement

  • The confidence to make a go/no-go call and stand behind it, even when a deal is on the line

  • Strong presence on stage and in the boardroom, from trade fair talks to pitches to strategic customers

  • Fluent German (C1+) and fluent English (C1+), and willingness to travel, around 30% of the time

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Our Client

Our client is a global IT consulting and digital engineering company specializing in software development, cloud transformation, data and AI, and digital experience solutions.

With an international presence and extensive engineering capabilities, the company supports enterprise clients across multiple industries in designing, developing, and implementing technology-driven business solutions.

Our client is expanding its Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) practice in the DACH region and is looking for a consultant with deep e-commerce knowledge, technical understanding, and client-facing advisory experience.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce, you will help grow our client's Retail & CPG business by translating business challenges into technology solutions and consulting engagements.

This is a hands-on functional consulting role with a strong technical and pre-sales component. You will work closely with senior client stakeholders, sales teams, and technical specialists to shape digital commerce solutions, lead discovery workshops, and support new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate understands how different e-commerce platforms and customer-facing technologies work together, can advise clients on the right solutions, and is comfortable collaborating with commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise Retail & CPG clients on e-commerce, digital customer experience, personalization, customer data and technology transformation.
  • Translate business requirements into solution concepts, capability roadmaps and target architectures.
  • Lead discovery sessions and solution design workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
  • Advise on the integration of commerce platforms, CDPs, marketing technologies, PIM, OMS and other digital commerce systems.
  • Collaborate with sales and pre-sales teams to identify client opportunities, develop proposals and shape consulting engagements.
  • Stay informed about DACH retail trends, marketplace dynamics, emerging technologies and changing customer expectations.
  • Develop reusable consulting assets, including reference architectures, solution frameworks, demonstrations and go-to-market offerings.
  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CDOs, CMOs, CIOs, and Heads of E-commerce.
  • Collaborate with regional and global technology teams to support the growth of the Retail & CPG practice.
  • Represent the company at client meetings, industry conferences, and relevant networking events.

Key Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the broader digital commerce ecosystem and how its different technologies connect.

Relevant areas include:

  • E-commerce platforms: commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, headless and composable commerce.
  • Customer data and CDPs: Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Segment, mParticle, Tealium, Bloomreach, first-party data and consent management.
  • Marketing technology and personalization: Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, Emarsys, Dynamic Yield, Algolia, Optimizely and customer journey optimization.
  • Commerce architecture and integrations: OMS, PIM, DAM, APIs, system integrations, distributed order management and omnichannel fulfillment.
  • Marketplaces and retail media: Amazon, Zalando, Otto, Kaufland, retail media networks, marketplace integrations and D2C business models.
  • Emerging commerce technologies: AI-assisted shopping, conversational commerce, GenAI applications, loyalty solutions and digital customer engagement.

Expertise across every platform is not required. Wh...

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) v...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. 

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen.
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.



ÜBER DEINEN JOB

  • Zusammen mit unserem CEO übernimmst du Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Geschäftsentwicklung bei freiheit.com 
  • Dafür hast du immer ein klares Ziel im Blick: Den Erfolg Deiner Kunden.
  • Enge Kundenbeziehungen sind für uns selbstverständlich, als verlässlicher Partner bist du öfters beim Kunden vor Ort und identifizierst mit ihm zusammen seine wichtigen strategischen Ziele.
  • Du bist strategischer Berater der Geschäftsführung und pflegst interne und externe Beziehungen.
    • Client Success

  • Mit Start und Ausbau eines Projektes stellst Du gemeinsam mit den Engineering Directors das für das Projekt optimale Engineering Team auf. 
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering Teams zusammen und identifizierst evtl. Frictions in dem jeweiligen Projekt. Deine Verantwortung ist es, diese zu beseitigen und damit sicherzustellen, dass das Engineering Team effektiv und effizient arbeiten kann und unsere “Optimal Work Environment” sichergestellt ist.
  • Du bist der Projektmanager und initiierst und moderierst regelmäßige Meetings, Review Sessions, Steering Committees.
    • Client Development
  • Zusätzlich entwickelst du Business und konvertierst unsere Leads zu Bestandskunden.
  • Du pflegst und erweiterst kontinuierlich Dein Netzwerk, verstehst die Potenziale bei unseren Kunden und fokussierst Dich zusammen mit dem Engineering aktiv auf den Kundenausbau.

jobs.title: Buyer Development Sr Director DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company at a Glance
OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens.

At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

OpenX is looking for a senior, commercially driven Buyer Development leader to establish and grow our demand-side business across DACH.
This is the first dedicated Buyer Development role in-market. The role will be directly responsible for generating revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands, building senior relationships and commercial foundations required for long-term growth.

The successful candidate will open senior buyer relationships, build and manage pipeline, progress strategic opportunities, and convert demand-side engagement into measurable revenue outcomes.

This is a senior individual contributor role to begin with. As the DACH opportunity matures, the ambition is for this person to help build and potentially lead a broader regional Buyer Development function once clear market proof points have been established.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Revenue Growth

  • Take direct responsibility for generating and growing buyer-led revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands in DACH.

     

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline across PMP, curation, SPO, CTV, data-led activation, OpenX Select, premium supply, AI-led solutions, and direct buyer partnerships.

     

  • Convert senior relationships into commercial outcomes through consultative selling, strategic account planning, business cases, QBRs, joint business plans, and deal progression.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline, forecasting, revenue progression, and opportunity prioritisation.

     

  • Build the Market
  • Establish OpenX’s Buyer Development presence in DACH as the first dedicated in-market hire.
  • Create a clear map of priority buyers, agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, data partners, senior decision-makers, trading models, and commercial pathways.
  • Identify where OpenX can create the most meaningful and scalable impact in the region.
  • Build the foundations for a future regional team, including account prioritisation, pipeline discipline, market feedback loops, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Work Cross-Functionally
  • Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, Marketing, global Buyer Development, DSP Strategic Partnerships, and the Data Partner function to shape, activate, measure, and scale DACH opportunities.
  • Partner with DSP Strategic Partnerships to improve buyer access, support SPO conversations, and ensure agency and client demand can be activated efficiently through priority DSP routes.
  • Partner with the Data Partner function to identify relevant data-led opportunities for DACH buyers, including curated marketplaces, audience-led activation, and strategic client solutions.
  • Build OpenX’s Market Presence
  • Represent OpenX as a credible senior voice in the DACH programmatic market.
  • Support OpenX’s visibility through senior meetings, client education, industry events, roundtables, and thought leadership.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.

We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.

Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.

If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

 

What you will do:
  • Reporting to our SVP Sales, EMEA & APJ you will implement sales plans for your assigned territory by forecasting and exceeding quota
  • Through a combination of inbound and outbound leads, you will manage a high-velocity, SaaS funnel
  • You will manage and track business opportunities through CRM and other supporting tools
  • You will collaborate on and improve the sales cycle, including product, support, and sales engineering
  • You will work with and promote Partner ecosystem
  • Convey Sysdig key value drivers and differentiators to prospects and customers
  • Understand the competitive market, being familiar with competing companies and their offerings
