jobs.descriptionHtml:
COMPENSATION ANALYST II

* Open to candidates residing in any of the 12 Latin America & Caribbean (LAC) countries where Compassion operates (Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Brazil, Bolivia, Mexico, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Honduras, El Salvador, Dominican Republic and Haiti)

* All applicants must submit an updated CV/Resume in English.


About the Role

The Compensation Analyst II supports the administration and analysis of global compensation programs by providing market insights, compensation data analysis, and guidance to leaders and People & Culture partners. This role plays an important part in ensuring compensation programs are administered accurately, consistently, and in alignment with organizational guidelines and market practices.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Administer and support global compensation programs, policies, and processes, ensuring accurate and consistent application across regions.

  • Coordinate compensation survey participation from end to end, including data collection, validation, submission, provider communication, and analysis of survey results.

  • Conduct compensation analyses such as market pricing, salary benchmarking, internal equity reviews, pay recommendations, and offer-related compensation comparisons.

  • Support the administration of compensation programs including USD Pegging and Economic Relief Payments, ensuring accurate calculations, data validation, and timely communication to stakeholders.

  • Prepare compensation reports, analyses, and recommendations to support leaders, People & Culture partners, and organizational decision-making.

  • Partner closely with People & Culture, Talent Acquisition, Treasury, ministry leaders, regional leadership, and external survey providers on compensation-related initiatives and inquiries.

  • Review compensation actions for compliance with established policies, guidelines, and compensation frameworks while maintaining data integrity and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by helping enhance compensation processes, documentation, and program administration practices.

  • Champion Compassion’s commitment to child protection by ensuring child protection considerations are prioritized in decision-making and daily work. Adhere to Compassion’s Child Protection Policy and Code of Conduct, promptly report concerns related to child abuse, neglect, or exploitation through established reporting channels, and support appropriate response procedures when needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.

  • Experience in Human Resources with direct responsibility for compensation-related work.

  • Experience supporting compensation programs within a global or multinational organization.

  • Knowledge of compensation surveys, market benchmarking, and statistical analysis.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with compensation or workforce data.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a global, collaborative environment.

  • Demonstrated collaboration, adaptability, and continuous learning mindset.


Working Conditions

  • Remote work environment.

This position serves as primary support and one-to-one relationship builder to Capella’s prospective students, educating prospects about online degree programs, financing, and licensure matters, while helping to clarify key decision-points and solution alternatives which align with the needs of the individual. Associate Enrollment Specialists utilize consultative relationship building skills focused on a supportive and empathetic approach, a mastery of highly complex educational program offerings, and a strong achievement orientation to promote Capella in a passionate yet transparent manner, ensuring we are meeting the needs of our students.

This role is responsible for supporting the prospective student through the full lifecycle of the enrollment process. This entails initial relationship development, exploration of needs and personalized solution offerings, navigating the decision-making and application process, and asking for the business when appropriate in addition to effectively preparing the student for long-term success.

As the dedicated resource, this process involves multiple interactions, often over an extended period of time. It requires developing an advanced understanding of the lead and application process, of the systems and tools necessary for navigating and managing workflow and pipeline, and of how to help prospects make fully informed decisions on how to achieve their educational objectives.

Essential Duties

  • Utilizing organization and forecasting methodology to build and manage a strong pipeline. This entails multiple points of contact per individual student to help identify correct educational solutions.
  • Guiding prospects through Capella’s enrollment process: qualifying readiness and fit, investigating and discovering needs, understanding motivations, presenting features and financing options, recommending programs and customized solutions, asking for the business when appropriate and always listening to the needs of the student.
  • Typical day will involve continuous customer interaction throughout the majority of the day on the phone or via chat, social media all customer contact is with “warm” leads—no cold calling. Individual inquiries will be focused on our degree (Bachelor, Master, or PhD) programs. A variety of service standards are measured such as availability, talk time, adherence to contact strategy & protocols, pipeline management, backlog, record keeping, forecasting, etc.
  • Leveraging automation tools and complex software applications to manage student data.
  • Committing to continuous training and development to become experts on a dynamic, evolving product offering. Establishing credibility is essential and Associate Enrollment Specialists are responsible for utilizing extensive product knowledge.
  • Team participation: Specialists are expected to operate as a team, dedicated to meeting customer expectations and reinforcing a high quality, end-to-end student experience. This entails supporting colleagues, taking active part in team discussions and 1:1 call coaching sessions, and providing constructive feedback to management. Improving student engagement by creating personalized pathways for students, by assessing needs and being transparent and clear with all students so they are making fully informed decisions.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER

Remote (UK-based) with occasional travel to pitches and team events

Salary: £50,000+ DOE

Full-time (37.5 hours per week)

About LAB

We’re a company that cares about the humans behind the tech.

At LAB, we believe in the power of digital to reshape the world for good. That belief drives the work we do every day, and we're proud to support our team as they create innovative solutions that make a real impact for our clients.

As part of the Human First Collective, alongside Reflect Digital (digital marketing) and Aspiration Digital (our non-profit digital skills conference for students), we’ve built a culture that encourages people to love what they do and do what they love. We’re deeply committed to the growth and development of our people, and we take pride in creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

Our shared mission is grounded in a deep understanding of human behaviour, which we apply to the design and delivery of digital solutions that challenge the norm and help reshape the digital world. With a broad portfolio of work, from major household brands to disruptive startups, and internal initiatives aimed at making the world a better place, every day brings new challenges, opportunities, and inspiration.

Our Core Values

Our values are the driving force behind our business success, empowering our team to make informed decisions with integrity:

  • People First. Always:We truly believe our agency is only as strong as our team. We lead with empathy, transparency, and high trust, respecting boundaries and treating everyone with dignity. To us, data isn't just numbers on a screen; it represents real people and families.

  • Growth Fuelled by Curiosity:We don’t just accept a brief; we interrogate it. Curiosity drives our growth mindset, pushing us to challenge assumptions, prioritise critical thinking over rigid processes, and learn fast.

  • We Win Together:Success is a shared victory. We operate as a true extension of our clients’ teams, balancing individual freedom with open collaboration to produce award-winning work with real-world impact.

    We’re looking for a high-performing Business Development Manager—someone with the commercial instinct, gravitas, and creative spark to own our growth story and run with it.

What you'll be doing

This isn’t a hand-holding exercise; it’s a high-autonomy launchpad. You will own our entire new business engine: hunting down incredible opportunities, crafting narratives that captivate, and turning strategic conversations into lasting commercial partnerships.

Owning the Deal & Driving Growth

  • Take full ownership of the sales journey from initial spark to closed deal, backed by total independence and trust.

  • Build and execute your own proactive outbound strategy, targeting high-value brands that match our values and ambition.

  • Take centre stage in pitch rooms: build powerful commercial narratives, rally internal specialists, and deliver proposals with authority and flair.

  • Use sharp commercial instinct to qualify inbound leads, focusing your energy where we can add real, transformational value.

  • Shape pricing strategies that demonstrate high value to clients while protecting our team's hard work and agency margins.

  • Keep our CRM clean, reliable, and acting as the strategic source of truth for the entire business.

Building Brand Voice & Market Authority

  • Team up with our Marketing Director to design smart outreach, from high-converting campaigns to hosting engaging webinars.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

We are looking for anAssociate QA Consultant with 1–2 years of QA experience or a minimum of 6 months of paid QA internship experience to join our Quality Assurance team.

This role is suited for someone who has a strong foundation in software testing and is interested in building expertise in Amazon Connect, IVR, Contact Center, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, APIs, and AI-powered customer experiences.

You will work closely with experienced QA consultants, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to support testing across complex customer and agent journeys.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony

  • Support testing of Amazon Connect Contact Flows, queues, routing, and agent workflows.
  • Execute functional testing of IVR and self-service journeys, including DTMF, speech/ASR, authentication, transfers, callbacks, and error/timeout scenarios.
  • Understand basic contact center and telephony concepts such as IVR, ACD, PSTN, DID/toll-free, CTI, and call recording.
  • Validate agent and supervisor experiences across voice and digital channels.

AWS & API Testing

  • Perform basic testing of AWS services used within Amazon Connect solutions, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex, and CloudWatch.
  • Execute API testing using tools such as Postman.
  • Validate API requests/responses, data mapping, error handling, and integrations between systems.
  • Support investigation of issues across Amazon Connect, AWS, Salesforce, and third-party systems.

Salesforce & Omnichannel Testing

  • Support testing of integrations between Amazon Connect and Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV).
  • Test agent workflows, CTI, screen pops, Voice Call records, and Omni-Channel functionality.
  • Execute testing of Amazon Connect Chat and other omnichannel customer journeys.

Test Execution & Defect Management

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

We are seeking an IT Security Engineer to own the security standards and controls that protect Alpaca’s workforce identities, endpoints, and critical business systems. The scope includes identity and access management, single sign-on, privileged access, multi-factor authentication, endpoint security, secure network access, and email security.

You will maintain those standards, measure how the controls are working, and partner with IT, who run devices and day-to-day administration.

This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with IT, DevOps, Engineering, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Endpoint, Email, and Domain Security:

jobs.title: Client Sales Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

If you like meeting people, asking good questions and seeing a deal come together, this role will feel natural. As a Client Sales Specialist, you'll talk with business owners about how they take payments and run their orders, show them a setup that costs less and runs smoother, and bring them on board.

You'll start with full training and a clear process, and you'll always have a team behind you when a question comes up. Owners are usually glad to hear about real savings, which makes the conversation an easy one to open. This is a full-time position, and pay is performance based, so what you earn grows with the accounts you bring on, with bonuses for strong months.

What You'll Do

  • Start conversations with business owners and earn their trust
  • Ask about how their business runs and what their current setup is costing them
  • Present a payment and point-of-sale option that fits the way they work
  • Answer questions, work through concerns and close the sale
  • Stay with each new account until it is up and running
  • Log calls, follow-ups and next steps in the CRM

What We're Looking For

  • Friendly, confident communicator who enjoys selling
  • Self-starter who keeps a steady pace through the week
  • Coachable and quick to pick up a new process
  • Customer service, retail, hospitality or sales experience is a plus

What's Offered

  • Full-time position
  • Hands-on training and weekly coaching
  • A clear step-by-step process and a team in your corner
  • Performance-based pay with monthly bonuses
  • Advancement based on results

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Organization

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.
Redhorse transforms the way government utilizes data and technology. We are seeking a Junior Solutions Architect to support the technical design, development, and delivery of IT and cloud solutions. In this role, you will collaborate with lead architects, system engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate mission and user requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical architectures. This position supports federal and Department of Defense (DoD) engagements, offering an opportunity to contribute directly to modernizing critical public-sector systems using cloud-native and DevSecOps principles.

Key Responsibilities

    • Technical Design & Architecture: Assist in the design and modeling of end-to-end architectures, system integration diagrams, and technical specifications for federal IT programs.
    • Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with technical leads and stakeholders to decompose functional, operational, and mission requirements into structured solution designs and technical user stories.
    • Artifact Development: Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system-of-systems diagrams, interface control documents, and architectural blueprints for government review.
    • System Integration: Support the integration of multi-tier software applications, cloud hosting infrastructure, data engineering pipelines, and emerging artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) workflows.
    • Engineering Collaboration: Partner with software development, infrastructure, and test teams to provide architectural guidance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and ensure compliance with design standards.
    • Security & Compliance Alignment: Incorporate federal security baselines into architectural designs, supporting compliance with NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), FedRAMP, and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (IL2–IL6).
    • Process Enablement: Apply cloud-native design patterns, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and Agile development methodologies to support continuous delivery.

Required Skills

    • Security Clearance & Eligibility: Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. Citizenship (mandated by federal contract requirements).
    • Professional Experience: 4+ years of professional technical experience in software engineering, systems engineering, cloud engineering, or solutions architecture.
    • Cloud Platforms: Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, or deploying solutions within cloud computing environments (AWS preferred).
    • Application Architecture: Working knowledge of microservices architectures, full-stack design patterns, and API integration standards (REST, GraphQL).
    • Infrastructure Automation & Containers: Practical experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

jobs.title: Video Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Foundation

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

Mission of the Role

You own video at Foundation: how we make it, how good it is, and how it grows. Our video work exists to get clients found and cited in AI search and on YouTube. You build the engine that delivers it well, at scale.

Video covers YouTube first, plus on-page video and short-form where it supports visibility, and the craft behind it: scripts, hooks, pacing, packaging and thumbnails.

Reports to: Head of Organic & AI Visibility. Direct reports: video specialists

What you'll own:

  • Execution. You own how video gets made at Foundation: whether we build an in-house team, use a bench of freelancers, partner with a production company, or mix them. You choose and manage the partners, set the workflow, and make it run at scale without losing quality.
  • Your team. You manage and develop the video specialists who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. As video demand grows, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
  • The video craft. You own what good video looks like: scripts, hooks, pacing, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, and how a video gets found on YouTube and cited by AI assistants. The Creative Director's quality gate holds video to your standard.
  • The standard. You set methods and SOPs, support QA, spot and close skills gaps, give input on reviews, and run the technical interview for every video hire.
  • Growth across every book. You work with the GEO/AEO Marketing Directors to find clients who should be buying video and aren't yet, and help them pitch it.
  • New offerings. You spot what's next in video for AI visibility and make it sellable and deliverable.
  • Client education and sales support. You run working sessions for clients and join pitches where your expertise wins the deal.

What you bring:

  • 8+ years in video, including growing YouTube channels for B2B brands, with channel results you can show and explain.
  • You've built and run a video production engine: in-house, freelance or agency partners, with budgets, timelines and quality you can talk through.
  • Strong opinions on the whole engine: scripts, thumbnails, pacing, packaging and descriptions. You can look at a video and say exactly why it will or won't perform.
  • You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in your real work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like VidIQ, HeyGen, ElevenLabs or Higgsfield counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.
  • Experience teaching others and raising the bar for people who don't report to you. A channel of your own is a strong plus.

Position Details:

Full-time (Monday to Friday, ~40 hours/week), Full Remote

Target Location: Canada, USA

Compensation: Base salary 88k–110k depending on experience and location

Variable compensation: Target 15% of base, tied to KPIs

Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Client Relationship Specialist

The position operates in a fast-paced, technology-based environment. The Client Relationship Specialist will have total responsibility for the client experience and retention of client accounts, as well as the control and autonomy to help clients succeed in expected and unexpected ways.

Here is more of what you’ll get to do:

  • Total responsibility as primary liaison between Net Driven and dealers in the United States and Canada.
  • Communicate effectively and timely with clients about Net Driven’s products and features and the process that will be followed to deliver them.
  • Plan, schedule and execute client performance discussions within established time frames.
  • Drive growth of your book of business by identifying opportunities for dealers to increase their product footprint with Net Driven.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent client management experience.
  • 2 - 5 years’ equivalent experience.
  • Fast learner who thrives on multi-tasking.
  • Skilled at managing time/priorities based on company goals and objectives.
  • Knowledge of SEO, social media, and website analytics.
  • Must be a great communicator to contribute to and ensure high integrity and a high productivity culture.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com or CRM software preferred.
  • Technology/Automotive experience preferred.
  • Call center success in a client-facing position is a plus.

Does this position sound like something you would enjoy and be successful at, but you’re not sure you have the exact qualifications to be considered? While our job descriptions outline the type of candidate we’re looking for, it is not a checklist. We encourage you to apply!

This role is not open to candidates located in Colorado, Connecticut, California, Maryland, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, or Washington.

Who are we?

LeadVenture is the market-leading SaaS provider of digital retailing, eCommerce, digital marketing and eCatalog solutions for dealerships across 12 industry verticals including powersports, marine, RV, pre-owned auto, agriculture and more. Our family of brands includes Dealer Spike, Dealer Car Search, Frazer, TCS Technologies, Net Driven, Direct Communications, Inc. (DCi), Powersports Support, Level 5, PSM Marketing, Monroney Labels, and Interact RV. We are an international company with offices located in the United States, Mexico (Juniper Data Center), Belize (Dealer Spike Belize), India and The Netherlands. Together, we are LeadVenture.

In this role, you’ll be working with our Net Driven brand who provides results-driven digital marketing solutions to thousands of independent automotive businesses throughout North America. Net Driven helps small businesses thrive in the digital age and employs some of the region’s most influential minds in technology, SEO, digital marketing, and web design.

LeadVenture provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. jobs.title: Data Science Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Data Science Strategist

About the Role

We're looking for a Data Science Strategist who is equally comfortable in a client discovery call and deep in a data pipeline. You'll sit on the Data Science team within Integrated Marketing, where your days will be primarily hands-on and technical: building dashboards, connecting data sources and running measurement models. Just as important, you'll bring a strategist's ear. You'll listen to the business problem behind a data request, figure out what's really being asked, and design creative, practical solutions using the right combination of tools. This role blends data strategy and data building. If you enjoy turning a messy marketing question into a clean measurement framework, and then building the thing yourself, this is for you.

What You'll Do

Data strategy & problem solving
  • Partner with account, media, social, SEO and client teams to understand their goals and translate business questions into clear measurement plans and KPIs.
  • Diagnose data problems (gaps in tracking, disconnected sources, conflicting numbers) and recommend creative solutions across our toolset.
  • Design measurement frameworks for integrated campaigns spanning paid, owned and earned channels.
  • Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients in plain, actionable language.

Dashboards, data tools & AI-assisted building
  • Build, automate and maintain client and internal dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Use NinjaCat (and other BI and data-connector tools) to unify cross-channel marketing data into scalable reporting.
  • Build custom data tools beyond dashboards, such as automated data pipelines, calculators, audit and QA scripts, reporting templates and lightweight internal apps that make the team faster.
  • Explore and pilot new AI-powered features in our BI and martech stack, and help shape how the team uses AI responsibly in its data work.
  • Develop data models and QA processes that keep reporting accurate, consistent and trustworthy.
Attribution & marketing measurement
  • Develop and run multi-touch attribution (MTA) analyses to understand channel contribution across the customer journey.
  • Build and interpret media mix models (MMM), working across a range of toolsets (e.g., open-source frameworks such as Meridian or Robyn, platform-native tools, or custom models in Python/R).
  • Recommend budget allocation and optimization strategies based on attribution and MMM outputs, including incrementality and testing approaches where appropriate.
Innovation
  • Stay current on martech, privacy changes, AI and measurement methods, and bring new ideas and tools to the team.

What You Bring

Required
  • 4–7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, or business intelligence, ideally in an agency or consultancy environment.
  • Strong digital marketing background: a working understanding of paid search, paid social, programmatic, SEO, email and web analytics.
  • Proven dashboard building and BI experience (e.g., NinjaCat, Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience building other data tools and automations, not just dashboards (e.g., scripts, pipelines, templates or small apps).
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your building workflow (coding, analysis, automation and documentation), with the judgment to check and validate what they produce.
  • Hands-on expertise with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Experience building or applying multi-touch attribution and media mix modeling, using more than one toolset or methodology.
  • Strategic mindset: you listen first, ask good questions and connect data work to business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability...

Our client, a mission-driven, fast-growing cloud company has exclusively engaged Solutus Legal Search to assist its executives in hiring an attorney to serve as Counsel in their growing legal department.

Reporting to a Deputy General Counsel, this attorney will be an early member of the company’s legal team. This attorney will support the company’s global operations and procurement functions, which include negotiating vendor and technology agreements, master purchase agreements, SaaS, software licenses, and other commercial, technology, and operational contracts. This attorney will have at least five years of experience negotiating and drafting commercial contracts.

Responsibilities Include:

    • Drafting and negotiating various vendor and procurement agreements including technology agreements, software licenses, SaaS and other business tooling agreements, enterprise system and platforms, marketing and event agreements, facilities-related agreements, professional services agreements, and AI tools.
    • Working closely with internal teams on vendor governance and policies, risk mitigation, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
    • Negotiating privacy, information security, regulatory, insurance, and data protection aspects of procurement agreements, and working closely with other legal and non-legal functional teams on such issues.
    • Advising on contract disputes and other issues arising from vendor agreements.
    • Developing and refining procurement processes, standard terms, templates, and playbooks to support a high-volume contracting environment.
      • Providing legal and strategic business advice and ensuring agreements are consistent with internal corporate policies and processes.

The Ideal Candidate

    • JD with at least one state bar membership and eligible to practice in your state of residence.
    • Have at least five (5) years of experience with drafting and negotiating commercial transactions. Experience supporting procurement agreements is preferred.
    • Strong work ethic and self-starter, with a growth mindset.
    • Flexibility in working hours in a global enterprise.
    • Detail-oriented, ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects, strong project management and organizational skills, work well under pressure and deadlines.
    • Strong personal communication skills, both written and oral.
    • Excellent judgment, strong business orientation and ability to translate legal risk into practical commercial advice within the context of business objectives.
    • Strong interpersonal, communication and management skills; ability to build trust and strong relationships with the company’s procurement team and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Experience supporting high growth infrastructure SaaS company.
    • Track record of performing with a sense of urgency and excelling in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation is targeted at an annual base salary range of $190,000 to $225,000, an equity grant, and generous benefits. The total compensation package will vary and depend on the candidate’s level of seniority, number of years of directly relevant experience, and geographic location.

Solutus has been selected as the retained representative on this desirable search. Resumes submitted directly to our client will be forwarded to Solutus for review and evaluation.

The role is expected to combine strong customer relationships with clear commercial judgement, pace and accountability.
Success will be measured by retention, renewal performance, revenue growth, quality of pipeline and forecast accuracy, not simply customer activity.

  • Identify customers who can act as references, case studies and advocates for ParentPay Group.
  • Provide structured customer and market feedback, including recurring needs, competitive issues and product gaps.
  • Develop strong knowledge of ParentPay Group products, the Further and Higher Education market and relevant competitors.
  • Own the accuracy of allocated accounts, renewals, opportunities and forecasts presented through commercial reviews.
  • Progressively take greater ownership of the customer portfolio as capability and experience develop.

Rate: $1.50 USD per qualified message

Location: Remote: Participants must be based in Saudi Arabia

Schedule: Flexible

Project type: Short-term/project-based

Device requirement(s): You must use your own mobile phone and Saudi Arabia phone number

The Project

Productive Playhouse is seeking Arabic-speaking participants for a mobile messaging data collection project. Participants will submit authentic scam and spam SMS messages received on their personal mobile phones to help improve technology designed to identify fraudulent and unwanted communications.

This is a flexible, remote opportunity. Participants may submit eligible messages whenever they receive them, provided all submissions meet project requirements..

Your contributions will support the development of tools designed to make mobile messaging safer for users around the world.

Please note: Messages collected from email or other platforms are not eligible. Submissions must be SMS messages received directly on your mobile phone.

Only submissions that meet requirements will be eligible for payment

Why PPH?

  • Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing
  • Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do
  • Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement
    Real project experience with a global data and language services company
  • Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.

Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation — it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.

All engagements are contingent upon successful completion of identity verification. Productive Playhouse is an equal opportunity organization headquartered in California and committed to diversity and inclusion across our global workforce. jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (Top Secret Clearance Required)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to drive the security and trust architecture across Catalyst, our secure multi-cluster service mesh platform. You will set the patterns other engineers follow for authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. We are looking for someone who has built platform-wide security architecture and wants to set technical direction for a team building critical infrastructure.

TRAVEL: International travel to Middle East and geopolitical hot zones, up to 25% per calendar year is required. Please apply only if you can meet this requirement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture for Catalyst's authentication and authorization layer (e.g., OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML, RBAC, ABAC models) and help set the patterns other engineers build against
  • Drive reliability and security strategy for the trust layer: define SLOs and SLAs for authn/authz latency and availability, lead incident response for credential and access-control incidents, and design for safe revocation under partial failure
  • Participate in on-call and incident response for our data platform including leading post-incident reviews, triage, prevention, and mitigation
  • Define and implement secure-by-default developer patterns and infrastructure primitives to reduce security friction and eliminate common vulnerability classes (e.g., standardized authentication middleware, automated credential lifecycle management, and hardened service-to-service communication patterns using mTLS and SPIFFE/SPIRE)
  • Define the QA philosophy and test strategy for the security layer, including threat modeling, adversarial test coverage, and session and revocation edge cases, and own the security quality gates in the deployment pipeline (e.g., integrating SCA, SAST, and container image scanning)
  • Implement and review pull requests across session, token, and authentication systems ensuring that security, testing, and operational readiness
  • Architect and implement encryptions at rest and in transit, key hierarchies, and HSM/KMS integration (e.g., using HashiCorp Vault or cloud-native KMS providers)
  • Lead team rituals such as design discussions to improve culture, surface new ideas, risks, and strategies across the team
  • Partner with security and IT teams to align on networking, observability, and identity patterns (e.g., including VPCs, network policies, IAM, and service mesh configurations) and ensure compliance with relevant industry standards (e.g., OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2)
  • Lead offensive security and vulnerability discovery efforts (e.g., directing third-party penetration tests, conducting internal red-team exercises, regular security assessments and penetration testing) against core platform components to identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Being a force multiplier by championing security programs, patterns, standards, and documentation
  • Grow team capability through deliberate coaching; mentor senior engineers on secure API and protocol design
  • Travel up to 25% for customer engagement, architecture reviews, or team collabo...

jobs.title: Project Manager, eCOA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help shape the delivery of innovative electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions that support clinical trials around the world. As a Project Manager within our eCOA business unit, you will lead cross-functional project teams through the successful execution of global clinical studies, ensuring high-quality delivery, exceptional customer service, and adherence to project timelines and budgets. You will serve as a trusted partner to sponsors and internal stakeholders, driving study success from startup through closeout while helping bring life-changing therapies to patients faster. This India-based role supports global customers and project teams and may require flexibility to collaborate across multiple time zones, including regular coverage of U.S. stakeholder meetings when needed.


What We Offer

  • Competitive pay and incentives.
  • Provident fund and medical insurance.
  • Engaging employee programs and local events.
  • Modern office spaces and remote work flexibility.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development within a global organization.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the planning, setup, monitoring, and closeout phases of eCOA studies and programs.
  • Gather customer requirements and translate study needs into actionable plans for cross-functional operational teams.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage study documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate the distribution, tracking, reconciliation, and management of study devices and associated equipment.
  • Create, review, and distribute study status reports, metrics, and project communications.
  • Ensure appropriate archival of study data, documentation, and project records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations through proactive communication and effective stakeholder engagement.
  • Monitor study timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies to ensure successful project execution.
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned studies, including budget reviews, revenue forecasting, scope change assessments, and invoice reconciliation activities.
  • Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues appropriately to support study success.
  • Facilitate collaboration between sponsors, vendors, and internal teams to drive efficient use of resources and achievement of contractual obligations.
  • Lead internal and external discussions, negotiations, and stakeholder communications to support successful study execution.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to address customer concerns and project challenges.
  • Maintain issue tracking documentation and ensure timely follow-up and resolution of customer escalations.
  • Serve as the Project Management point of contact for operational readiness activities related to new product and service initiatives.
  • Present eCOA services and operational workflows during investigator meetings, site initiation meetings, and client presentations as required.
  • Support onboarding, mentoring, and training of new Project Management team members.
  • Contribute to departmental initiatives, process improvements, and special projects as assigned.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant project management experience.
  • 4 years of project management experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, clinical research, life sciences, or related industries.
  • Understanding of the drug development process and clinical trial environment.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. The Americas Compliance team is hiring a Senior Compliance Manager to own compliance for OKXICE TSV. OKXICE TSV is the tokenized securities venue run by the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, and it lets eligible US users trade tokenized US-listed stocks on-chain. You'll be the main person accountable for meeting the exemption's ongoing conditions. You'll work closely with Legal, Product, Web3 Risk Control and our AML, Sanctions and Surveillance teams.   • Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.
  • Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.

  • Report to the OKXICE LLC Board of Managers and to Americas Compliance leadership, and manage and develop a TSV Compliance Analyst.

Our mission is to deliver strategically located, scalable digital infrastructure engineered for rapid deployment and reliability.

Our team brings decades of experience in infrastructure development and operations, focusing on accelerating growth and reliability in North America.

Values:

  • Client First Alignment: We align our solutions with our clients’ goals, applying our expertise to ensure our facilities are delivered with predictability.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency, backed by rigorous planning and technical precision to ensure certainty at every stage.
  • Operational Excellence: Our team brings decades of experience in hyperscale development, design, construction, commissioning and operations. We don’t just build, we execute with purpose.

The position also originates, structures, and negotiates the utility service, energy supply, and infrastructure agreements necessary to secure those solutions across Montera’s development portfolio.

The ideal candidate brings deep utility and power-market expertise, strong commercial acumen, and a proven ability to drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution. Success in this role is defined by the ability to develop credible power strategies, evaluate and communicate risks and opportunities, advance critical external negotiations, and deliver clear, decision-ready recommendations that support both investment decisions and customer commitments.

jobs.title: Medical Doctor (MD) - Client Medical Educator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
NeoWork is hiring a Medical Doctor (MD) to join a U.S. personal injury law firm as a Client Medical Educator. You will speak directly with the firm's clients about their injuries and treatment, helping them understand why MRIs and follow-up care matter for their recovery and their case.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Speak with personal injury clients by phone or video about their injuries and medical treatment options
  • Explain clearly why MRIs, diagnostic imaging, and follow-up care matter
  • Help clients understand how injuries, treatment, and recovery relate to their case
  • Reinforce attorney and paralegal guidance in a medically credible, easy-to-understand way
  • Suggest alternative treatment paths when clients are hesitant about a doctor's recommendation
  • Work closely with attorneys, paralegals, and the firm's in-house nurse on complex cases
  • Document client conversations and outcomes accurately in the firm's case management system

Requirements

  • Medical degree (MD or equivalent) from an accredited medical school
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence in client-facing conversations
  • Ability to explain medical concepts in simple, clear, and reassuring language
  • Comfortable educating and guiding clients in a persuasive but professional way
  • Strong rapport-building, empathy, and listening skills
  • Interest in working in a legal or personal injury environment, not only clinical care
  • Availability to work full-time during U.S. business hours
  • Based in the Dominican Republic, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have

  • Experience in emergency medicine, orthopedics, physical medicine, or radiology
  • Familiarity with personal injury, workers' compensation, or medico-legal cases
  • Degree from a medical school recognized for U.S. licensing (ECFMG / USMLE)
  • Experience in telemedicine or patient education roles

• Fluency in Spanish

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance for contractors

• Holiday Extra Pay

  • The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.

• This is a 100% home-based position

  • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
  • In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
  • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
  • There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

jobs.title: Praktikum eCommerce-/ Projektmanagement (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SaleLab ist ein stark wachsendes E-Commerce Unternehmen aus Ravensburg. Weltweit agierend, verkaufen wir auf verschiedenen Marktplätzen und in eigenen Onlineshops Produkte unserer eigenen Marken.

Du brennst für Sales und hast Lust, mit uns die eCommerce-Welt zu erobern? Du hast keine Lust auf ein 0815 Praktikum, sondern willst maximalen Impact und Lernerfolg? Dann lass uns gegenseitig unbedingt kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst unsere individuellen Vermarktungs- und Marketingaktivitäten auf einzelnen Markplätzen und setzt diese mit dem Ziel der Umsatzsteigerung um
  • Du wirkst aktiv bei der Produktentwicklung, der Marktanalyse, der Ausarbeitung von UPSs und deren technischen Umsetzung mit
  • Du implementierst, gemeinsam mit dem Sales Team, weitere Marktplätze und baust diese aus
  • Du analysierst und reportest die bestehenden Aktivitäten und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du optimierst und baust unsere Produktplatzierungen aus
  • Du identifizierst performancesteigernde Maßnahmen und betreust/ optimierst unsere Präsenzen im Hinblick auf Produktbewertungen und Sichtbarkeit
  • Du bekommst einen detaillierten Einblick in alle Prozesse des Unternehmens

Qualifikation

  • Du kannst dich für das dynamische Umfeld in einem Startup begeistern und hast Interesse daran, die Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten und voranzutreiben
  • Du bist aktuell in einem Studiengang wie BWL, Finance & Controlling, Management, Online Marketing, Wirtschatfsingenieurswesen oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung immatrikuliert
  • Du hast eine Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Statikstiken
  • Du hast mindestens 3, besser 6 Monate Zeit uns innerhalb deines (Pflicht-) Praktikums zu unterstützen

Benefits

Dich erwartet ein modernes, digitales und dynmaisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer "Du-Kultur" samt einer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit. Wir sind ein durch und durch motiviertes Team, das etwas bewegen will. Wir bieten dir gerne die Möglichkeit flexibel zu arbeiten, bei uns im Office und zu Teilen im Home Office.

Damit du deine Arbeit gut erledigen kannst und deinen Alltag effizienter gestaltest, stellen wir dir ein leistungsstarkes MacBook oder ThinkPad und die für deine Arbeit nötige Software zur Verfügung. Teamevents und online Meetings kommen natürlich nicht zu kurs, denn die Teamdynamik ist uns sehr wichtig.

Außerdem hats du die Möglichkeit während deines Praktikums eine Wellpass Mitgliedschaft zu erhalten.

Na? Neugierig geworden? Dann bewirb dich direkt und lerne uns und die Inhalte deines Praktikums besser kennen.

Findest du dich nicht in allen Anforderungen wieder? Kein Problem. WIr freuen uns dich kennenzulernen und schauen zusammen, ob wir zueinander passen.

jobs.title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Deggendorf
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Deine Rolle

Vertrieb, Beauty und Verantwortung für deinen eigenen Standort

Du hast Freude am Verkauf, kannst Menschen begeistern und möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team etwas bewegen? Dann werde Sales Manager / Standortleiter (m/w/d) bei hairfree in Deggendorf.

Bei uns verbindest du persönliche Kundenberatung mit aktivem Vertrieb und der Leitung unserer Lounge. Du berätst Menschen, die sich bereits für dauerhafte Haarentfernung interessieren, begleitest sie bis zum Vertragsabschluss und entwickelst deinen Standort gemeinsam mit deinem Team weiter.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Festgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision: Dein Vertriebserfolg zahlt sich aus.

  • Interessierte Kundenkontakte: Du arbeitest mit Anfragen von Menschen, die sich bereits für unsere Leistungen interessieren.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du lernst unsere Beratung, Behandlungskonzepte und Abläufe Schritt für Schritt kennen.

  • Regelmäßige Verkaufstrainings: Unsere Academy und interne Coachings unterstützen deine Entwicklung.

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst deinen Standort aktiv weiter.

  • Ein unterstützendes Team: Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte und gemeinsame Events.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kundenberatung und Verkauf: Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, erkennst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und gewinnst sie für die passende Behandlung.

  • Angebote und Vertragsabschlüsse: Du erklärst unsere Leistungen verständlich, beantwortest Fragen und führst Beratungsgespräche verbindlich zum Abschluss.

  • Nachfassen und Kundenbindung: Du bleibst an offenen Anfragen dran und begleitest deine Kunden zuverlässig.

  • Standortverantwortung: Du behältst Umsatz, Vertriebskennzahlen und Terminauslastung im Blick und setzt passende Maßnahmen um.

  • Teamführung: Du unterstützt dein Team im Alltag, gibst Feedback und sorgst für klare Abläufe.

  • Organisation und Dokumentation: Du pflegst Kundeninformationen und Vereinbarungen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Beratung, Verkauf und Standortleitung. Gleichzeitig bist du Teil des operativen Teams und packst im Lounge-Alltag mit an.

Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Consultant - Vollzeit (German Speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.

  • Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.

  • Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.

  • Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.

  • Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.

  • Modernes Büro in Freiburg: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.

  • Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.



  • Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.

  • Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.

  • Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.

  • Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

Du bist eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die Verlässlichkeit, klare Strukturen und Teamgeist lebt?
Übernimm Verantwortung, optimiere Prozesse und führe dein Team zu Höchstleistungen. Begeistere unsere Kunden mit ehrlicher Beratung und nachhaltigen Konzepten und wachse mit uns in einem Umfeld mit klaren Zielen und einem starken Team!

Das bieten wir dir

  1. Ein starkes Team und ein bewährtes Erfolgssystem.

Unsere Werte

  • Verlässlichkeit: Wir halten, was wir versprechen, für unsere Kunden und das Team.

jobs.title: Projektingenieur Entwicklung (m/w/x) – Teilprojektleitung Prototypen und Prüftechnik
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Die Alveon MedTech GmbH ist ein innovatives Medizintechnik-Startup mit Sitz in Ostfildern bei Stuttgart. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung medizinischer Inhalationssysteme. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 haben wir erfolgreich eine patentgeschützte Basistechnologie entwickelt. Aktuell arbeiten wir – im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft mit einem der größten deutschen Unternehmen im Medizinalcannabis-Markt – an der Entwicklung und Zulassung des ersten dosierfähigen Cannabis-Inhalators für den europäischen Markt.

Jetzt steht die entscheidende Phase an: Prototypen, Versuche, Verifikation und Zulassung. Dafür erweitern wir unsere Prüfkapazitäten in Ostfildern und bei externen Partnern und suchen jemanden, der diesen Bereich verantwortet.

Als Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik übernimmst du abgegrenzte Entwicklungsbereiche mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung — von der Konzeption über Versuch und Prototyp bis zum belastbaren Nachweis. Du bekommst Ziele, keine Arbeitsanweisungen.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO und Projektleiter zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass zum jeweiligen Meilenstein die richtigen Prototypen bereitstehen — und koordinierst dafür Kolleginnen, Kollegen und externe Partner.

Aufgaben

Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitspakete:

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung abgegrenzter Entwicklungsthemen

  • Festlegung von Vorgehen, Umfang und Abbruchkriterien

  • Abstimmung mit QM/Regulatory und externen Partnern

  • Terminverantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Versuchsaufbauten, Prototypen und Mustern

Schwerpunkt: Versuch, Prüfaufbau und Labor

  • Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen, Messplätzen und Versuchsständen

  • Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Entwicklungs- und Verifikationsversuchen, unter anderem zu Verdampfungsleistung, Dosiergenauigkeit, Temperaturverhalten, Dichtheit und Lebensdauer

  • Aufbau und Betreuung der Messtechnik inklusive Kalibrierung und Prüfmittelverwaltung

  • Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von Prüfkampagnen bei externen Laboren und Hochschulen

  • Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, Versuchsprotokollen, Prüf- und Entwicklungsberichten

Ergänzend: Konstruktion und Prototyping

  • Konstruktion von Vorrichtungen, Adaptern und Bauteilen im CAD

  • Prototyping mittels 3D-Druck sowie Aufbau, Kennzeichnung und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Mustern

  • Technische Bewertung von Bauteilen und Werkstoffen aus Keramik, Spritzguss und Silikon

  • Zuarbeit zur technischen Dokumentation gemäß MDR und ISO 13485

Qualifikation

Damit du in dieser Position erfolgreich bist, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Physik) oder Technikerabschluss mit einschlägiger Erfahrung

  • Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Entwicklungsumfeld, davon mehrere Jahre in eigenverantwortlicher Rolle

  • Die Fähigkeit, pragmatisch zu entscheiden, wie weit eine Lösung gehen muss — und das zu begründen

  • Sicheres, repräsentatives Auftreten gegenüber Lieferanten, Prüflaboren und Hochschulen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Messtechnik sowie mit der Auswertung und Darstellung von Versuchsdaten

  • Sorgfältige, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner Arbeit

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Selbststrukturierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in technische und regulatorische Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Ostfildern sowie zu gelegentlichen Einsätzen bei Partnern und Prüf...

jobs.title: Werkstudent Content Creator Social Media mit Fokus vor der Kamera (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl, hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media und weißt, wie man Menschen innerhalb der ersten Sekunden eines Videos abholt?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Für unsere Social Media Kanäle suchen wir eine kreative Content Creatorin, die regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera steht und eigenständig Videos für TikTok, Instagram Reels und weitere Plattformen produziert.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, vor der Kamera zu stehen. Du entwickelst Ideen, filmst deine Inhalte selbst und übernimmst anschließend auch den Schnitt und die fertige Aufbereitung der Videos.

Aufgaben

  • Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und bist eines der Gesichter unserer Social Media Kanäle
  • Du entwickelst kreative Ideen und neue Videoformate für TikTok, Instagram Reels und weitere Plattformen
  • Du produzierst deine Videos eigenständig von der Idee bis zum fertigen Content
  • Du kümmerst dich selbst um Aufnahme, Schnitt, Untertitel, Musik und die finale Aufbereitung deiner Videos
  • Du präsentierst Produkte auf eine natürliche, unterhaltsame und authentische Art
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Social Media Trends und setzt passende Trends schnell in eigenen Content um
  • Du entwickelst Hooks und Konzepte, die Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen und Zuschauer zum Weiterschauen bringen
  • Du testest unterschiedliche Videoideen und entwickelst erfolgreiche Formate kontinuierlich weiter

Qualifikation

Uns ist nicht entscheidend, ob du bereits jahrelange Berufserfahrung hast. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du vor der Kamera authentisch wirkst, kreativ bist und Social Media wirklich verstehst.

Du solltest:

  • dich sehr wohl vor der Kamera fühlen
  • offen, kommunikativ und selbstbewusst auftreten
  • TikTok und Instagram intensiv nutzen und aktuelle Trends kennen
  • ein gutes Gespür für unterhaltsamen und aufmerksamkeitsstarken Content haben
  • Videos selbstständig aufnehmen und schneiden können

jobs.title: Prozessingenieur (m/w/d) diagnostische Testsysteme / Point-of-Care (1728)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ihre Karriere in der Entwicklung innovativer Fertigungsprozesse für die medizinische Diagnostik.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Diagnostik im Bereich Point-of-Care. Sie verbinden Mikrosystemtechnik, Materialwissenschaften und experimentelle Forschung, um innovative Diagnostiklösungen von der ersten Machbarkeitsstudie bis zur Überführung in die Produktion voranzubringen.

Aufgaben

  • Testträgerentwicklung: Sie bearbeiten eigenständig technische Arbeitspakete und Teilprojekte zur Entwicklung und Evaluierung neuer Testträgerformate für Point-of-Care-Anwendungen und bewerten deren technische Umsetzbarkeit

  • Prozessentwicklung: Sie definieren, etablieren und optimieren Herstellungsverfahren für diagnostische Testsysteme

  • Test/Versuch: Sie planen und führen experimentelle Untersuchungen zu neuen Materialien, Fertigungsansätzen und technologischen Konzepten durch

  • Auswertung/Dokumentation: Sie werten Versuchsergebnisse aus und dokumentieren Ihre Erkenntnisse

  • Optimierung: Sie optimieren Testträgermaterialien, Oberflächenstrukturen und Funktionalisierungen unter Berücksichtigung der Schnittstellen zur Sensorik und Messtechnik

  • Technologierecherche: Sie führen Literatur- und Patentrecherchen durch und entwickeln daraus neue Ansätze für Fertigungsprozesse und diagnostische Anwendungen

Qualifikation

  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mikrosystemtechnik, Biotechnologie, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Materialwissenschaften, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • PoC-Erfahrung: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung im Bereich Point-of-Care, diagnostischen Testträgern, Biosensoren oder vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Produktkenntnisse: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testträger-/Sensorarchitektur, Materialauswahl, Herstellung und Charakterisierung sowie der Überführung von Laborprozessen in die Produktion

  • Technische Erfahrungen: Praktische Erfahrung mit Dosiersystemen, Microdispensing, additiven Fertigungsverfahren oder Laserbearbeitung

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständige, strukturierte und experimentell orientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität

  • Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Attraktive Konditionen: Freuen Sie sich auf eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING mit einer Vergütung, die Ihre Expertise würdigt

  • Innovative Projekte: Gestalten Sie zukunftsweisende Technologien an der Schnittstelle von Pharma, Diagnostik und Mikrosystemtechnik und begleiten Sie neue Testsysteme von der Entwicklung bis zur Produktionsüberführung

  • Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf persönliches Wachstum und eine Kultur der Unterstützung und Förderung legt

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:

Herr Dipl.-Wirt.-Ing. Thorsten Schermann

jobs.title: Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) oder Wirtschaftsprüferanwärter (m/w/d) mit Aussicht auf Partnerschaft
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind
Mittelständisch denken, weltweit agieren – unser Ansatz seit 1935. Als Kanzlei im Herzen von Hamburg mit ca. 15 Mitarbeitenden betreuen wir Unternehmen verschiedenster Größen und Branchen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Durch diese interdisziplinäre Ausrichtung ergeben sich abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Mandate, wie sie in Kanzleien unserer Größenordnung selten zu finden sind. Die Vielfalt unserer Projekte bietet nicht nur spannende Herausforderungen, sondern auch die Chance, sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei steht bei uns nicht nur die Arbeit im Fokus, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie sich wirklich wohlfühlen können. Bei Scheller & Partner legen wir großen Wert auf eine persönliche Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, in der Teamgeist und Wertschätzung großgeschrieben werden.

Haben Sie Lust, den nächsten Schritt zu gehen, sich vielseitigen und spannenden Aufgaben zu stellen und gleichzeitig fachlich, persönlich und finanziell zu profitieren? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Aufgaben

Ihr Aufgabengebiet
Durch unsere interdisziplinäre Ausrichtung profitieren nicht nur unsere Mandanten, sondern auch Sie als Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d). Bei Scheller & Partner können Sie den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle sowie abwechslungsreiche Mandate übernehmen. Abhängig von Ihren Schwerpunkten, umfasst Ihr Aufgabenbereich:

  • Prüfung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen
  • Durchführung von Due-Diligence-Prüfungen, IKS-Prüfungen sowie Unternehmensbewertungen
  • Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Steuerliche Beratung

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit
In unserem Team legen wir großen Wert auf Zuverlässigkeit und Kollegialität – denn nur dann sind wir gemeinsam erfolgreich! Wenn Sie zudem die folgenden Qualifikationen mitbringen, passen Sie perfekt zu uns:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsprüferexamen (oder Voraussetzungen für Wirtschaftsprüferexamen erfüllt) und erste Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, mit der Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Sachverhalte zu analysieren und praxisorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Engagement, Zielstrebigkeit und die Lust, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Benefits

Ihre Vorteile bei uns
Ein erfolgreiches Team braucht die richtige Basis – ein positives Arbeitsklima, klare Kommunikation und Freude an den täglichen Aufgaben. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das diese Werte fördert und unterstützt. Außerdem können sich Teammitglieder über folgende Benefits freuen:

  • Aussicht auf Partnerschaft: ergreifen Sie die Chance, langfristig Verantwortung zu übernehmen und eine Partnerschaft anzustreben
  • Vielschichtige Tätigkeiten: abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben im Bereich der Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung für spannende Mandanten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Umsatzbonus und variable Vergütungsmodelle
  • Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Betriebliche Krankenversicherung und Altersvorsorge mit 15 % Zuschuss
  • Flexibilität: Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Familienfreundlichkeit: Kindergartenzuschüsse für Eltern
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Helle Büros mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen, höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und zwei Bildschirmen
  • Support: Unterstützung beim Berufsexamen
  • On top: Gutscheine, Fahrkostenerstattung und eine zentrale Lage mit perfekter Anbindung

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil unseres Teams!

jobs.title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen.

Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir.

Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise.

Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.

Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Das bringst du mit

Background
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst.

Skills und Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl.

  • Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern.

  • Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus.

Mindset

Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen.

Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten.

Organisation & Ruhe: Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt.

Gut zu wissen:
Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) und wird vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office ausgeübt, so bist du mittendrin im Team und im tä...

jobs.title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft.

As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

  • Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented.

  • Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams.

  • Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme.

  • Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations.

  • Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses.

  • Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels.

  • Shape the certification approach for the propulsion battery system in cooperation with Certification and Airworthiness and represent the ESS team in technical discussions with EASA, including Stage of Involvement (SOI) and compliance reviews.
