jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

  • Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Electrical Systems Designer (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

  • Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

jobs.title: Talent Partner (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

At VÆRIDION, we're building the Microliner, a fully electric aircraft, and the battery technology that powers it. To make that happen, we need great people, and as our Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders), you'll play a key role in bringing them on board.

As part of our People & Culture team, you'll own recruiting end to end for your positions and advise our hiring managers as a true partner. You'll make sure every candidate gets a process that is fast, honest, and personal. You'll also keep improving how we find and hire talent. Our goal is to ensure that every candidate leaves the process with a positive impression of VÆRIDION, regardless of the outcome.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, from screening to offer and closing.

  • Understand your hiring managers' requirements and advise them on recruiting, including relevant market insights, realistic timelines, and candidate availability.

  • Design and run sourcing strategies, including direct outreach, talent mapping, and networks, to reach passive candidates in competitive markets.

  • Lead complex and cross-functional hiring processes, and influence hiring decisions with structured interviews and data-driven recommendations.

  • Negotiate offers and close candidates.

  • Maintain our ATS Ashby and keep data and reporting clean and reliable.

  • Improve our recruiting processes, candidate experience, and employer branding.

 

Your Profile:

  • You have a background in HR, business, psychology, or a related field.

  • You have 3+ years of recruiting experience from first conversation to signed contract, ideally in a scaling company or a technical industry.

  • You can run a hiring process on your own, from screening to hire, and you are confident challenging hiring managers to drive better hiring decisions.

  • You find people who aren't looking. You know how to approach engineers and specialists directly and get a reply.

  • You communicate clearly in English, in writing and in conversation, and you keep candidates and stakeholders informed without being asked.

  • You stay organised across many open roles at once and never lose track of a candidate.

  • You work well with data and modern recruiting tools. Experience with Ashby is a plus.

  • Fluent in English is required, German is a Plus.

  • You enjoy working in an office-first culture at our Munich site.

  • Design and run sourcing strategies, including direct outreach, talent mapping, and networks, to reach passive candidates in competitive markets.

  • Lead complex and cross-functional hiring processes, and influence hiring decisions with structured interviews and data-driven recommendations.

  • Negotiate offers and close candidates.

  • Maintain our ATS Ashby and keep data and reporting clean and reliable.

  • Improve our recruiting processes, candidate experience, and employer branding.

 

Your Profile:

  • You have a background in HR, business, psychology, or a related field.

  • You have 3+ years of recruiting experience from first conversation to signed contract, ideally in a scaling company or a technical industry.

  • You can run a hiring process on your own, from screening to hire, and you are confident challenging hiring managers to drive better hiring decisions.

  • You find people who aren't looking. You know how to approach engineers and specialists directly and get a reply.

  • You communicate clearly in English, in writing and in conversation, and you keep candidates and stakeholders informed without being asked.

  • You stay organised across many open roles at once and never lose track of a candidate.

  • You work well with data and modern recruiting tools. Experience with Ashby is a plus.

  • You enjoy working in an office-first culture at our Munich site.

jobs.title: Head of Event Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Location: Remote USA

Role Overview

At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional and passionate Head of Event Marketing to build and lead our global events program. With more than 20,000 customers and a place on the AI 50, CodeRabbit is one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, and events are one of our most important engines for brand, pipeline and direct revenue. You will own a truly global remit spanning North America, Western Europe, Japan and the broader APAC region, with a multi-million dollar budget that is growing year over year.

This is a builder role. You will inherit a strong core team, grow it, and set the strategy for every event we sponsor or host, from Tier 1 conferences like AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next and NVIDIA GTC, to local-market engineering leadership events, to our own customer conferences across multiple continents. We don't just show up and staff a booth. We want a strategic, creative and analytical leader who designs the full experience around each event and can generate return on every dollar invested.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, hire and develop a global events team

  • Own the global events strategy and budget, making investment decisions grounded in ROI across brand, pipeline and direct revenue

  • Lead our presence at sponsored events and engineering events

  • Build and scale CodeRabbit's own hosted events

  • Determine the right event mix for each territory

  • Design the full experience around each event, including advertising around the venue, social events, and other activations

  • Own end-to-end program management and execution

  • Define success metrics for every event

  • Bring an entrepreneurial point of view

Qualifications

  • Proven ability to plan and execute a diverse portfolio of events at, global scale

  • Deeply analytical

  • Strong program management and execution skills

  • Experience using events to build brand, generate pipeline and drive direct revenue

  • Experience marketing developer tools

jobs.title: Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

The role We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level. This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

What you'll own • Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands. • The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering. • The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar. • Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes. • Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship. • The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct. • Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

What you need
• 6+ years of professional experience, with deep hands-on SAP experience: S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area such as FI/CO, SD, MM or PP. Whether you come from SAP consulting, solution architecture or product at an SAP ecosystem software company, all of it counts.
• 4+ years in product: you've owned a B2B product and its roadmap end to end, prioritised with engineering and shipped to enterprise users. Title doesn't matter, ownership does.
• Experience leading people: you have led product managers, solution architects or consultants, and you want to keep building a team.
• A command of the SAP transformation lifecycle and SAP ...

jobs.title: Founders Associate, Growth (Munich Office)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dataleap

Dataleap is the agentic operating system for the enterprise: a coding agent for business users. With Dataleap, teams build, scale and manage agentic systems, where agents, apps and chat work as one connected system. Agents do the grunt work, and humans add judgment from their own cockpit.

We're backed by YC and angels like Aravind (Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). Tens of thousands of our agents run at scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. Revenue is doubling every month, and demand is bigger than we can handle.

The role

I'm Jan, Co-founder and CEO. I need a sharp generalist next to me to turn our biggest growth priorities into results. One week you're building the business case for an enterprise deal. The next, you're running an agent hackathon at a customer or testing a new segment.

What you'll do

  • Drive strategic projects. Work with the founders on top priorities, bringing research, analysis and clear recommendations to key decisions.

  • Make our customers win with Dataleap. Build alongside customers, prove the value with the first agents, and scale adoption, from hackathons to C-suite rollout strategy.

  • Shape our go-to-market. Explore segments, test growth plays, support enterprise deals, and sharpen how we tell the Dataleap story.

  • Connect customers and product. Turn customer insights into concrete feedback and help shape our product.

  • Run growth as an agentic system. Agentify your way out of the job.

  • Own projects end-to-end. Define the problem, bring the right people together, and drive it to a clear outcome.

You're a fit if

  • You're an ex-founder or have 1–3 years in a high-growth startup, VC or consulting.

  • You're an AI power user. Not "exploring AI": you live in it. You ship agents on weekends and have opinions on model routing, eval design, and where current systems break.

  • You're high agency with a high clock speed. You drive the agenda, prioritize ruthlessly, and communicate sharply and to the point.

  • You're low ego and high ownership. You'll do the unsexy work without flinching. You want to work hard and be deeply obsessed.

  • You're commercially sharp. Renewals, expansion and navigating many stakeholders are second nature.

  • You're great with people. You can walk into a room of executives and lead it, and customers and senior stakeholders trust you quickly.

  • You speak native German and fluent English, and you're based in Munich or ready to move here.

I'll index heavily on energy, values and slope.

Why join us

We're in a unique moment in time. For the next few years, enterprise agents will reshape how people work, and we're at the epicenter of that shift.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns & Die Opportunity

Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken?
Lightspeed ist die führende All-in-One-Plattform für Handel und Gastronomie. Als KI-getriebenes Tech-Unternehmen bieten wir dir eines der besten SaaS-Produkte auf dem Markt.

In dieser Rolle bist du nicht einfach nur Angestellter – du bist der "Owner" deines eigenen Gebiets in Bonn oder Ruhrgebiet. Gemeinsam mit einem neuen, dynamischen Team von ca. 8 Personen und einem erfahrenen Manager vor Ort eroberst du den Gastronomiemarkt in deinem Gebiet. Wir verzichten auf Micromanagement und setzen auf Vertrauen, Freiheit und Ergebnisse.

Deine Mission in Bonn oder Ruhrgebiet

Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet und gewinnst die Top-Locations der Stadt für Lightspeed. Dein Erfolg basiert auf einem modernen, holistischen Vertriebsansatz:

  • Digitaler Rückenwind: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv durch Performance Marketing & qualifizierte Leads.

  • Strategische Partnerschaften: Du baust dir ein lokales Netzwerk und ein starkes Empfehlungsmanagement (Referrals) auf.

  • Gezielte Kaltakquise & Walk-ins: Du bist täglich im Markt präsent, besuchst Restaurants, Cafés sowie Bars und überzeugst die Inhaber direkt vor Ort.

  • Full-Cycle-Verantwortung: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess selbstständig – vom ersten Händedruck über die Produkt-Demo bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Beratender Verkauf: Du verkaufst nicht nur Software, sondern hilfst Gastronomen partnerschaftlich dabei, ihr Business erfolgreicher zu machen.



Wer du bist (Dein Profil)

  • Ein echter Hunter: Du liebst die Herausforderung der Neukundengewinnung, bist extrem selbstmotiviert und brauchst niemanden, der dir ständig über die Schulter schaut.

  • Kommunikationsstark: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (essenziell für den Vertrauensaufbau mit lokalen Inhabern) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

  • Charismatisch & Resistent: Du besitzt ein sicheres Auftreten, starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten und hast kein Problem damit, in ein volles Restaurant zu gehen und ein Gespräch zu starten.

  • Ehrgeizig: Du willst deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt belohnt wird.

  • Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Business Development oder in der Gastronomie ist ein Plus – dein Drive und deine Einstellung zählen für uns jedoch am meisten.

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Ein faires Fixgehalt gepaart mit einer ungedeckelten Provision (uncapped Commission) – mit überdurchschnittlich hohem Verdienstpotenzial für Top-Performer.

jobs.title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

  • Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms.

  • Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling.

  • Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links.

  • Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery.

  • Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability, security hygiene and operational documentation, working closely with our cybersecurity engineer.

  • Engineering Standards: Set the infrastructure standards our teams follow, and support firmware, robotics, CV and test teams in the lab and the field.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership across many areas at once and enjoy covering several roles in a small team, from planning a system to fixing it by hand.

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

  • You bring around five years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps or Linux systems engineering, ideally in a small IT or platform team, and you can point to real systems you built and ran.

  • You have distributed and updated software across large f...

jobs.title: Prüfungsassistent (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Mittelständisch denken, weltweit agieren – unser Ansatz seit 1935. Als Kanzlei im Herzen von Hamburg mit ca. 20 Mitarbeitenden betreuen wir Unternehmen verschiedenster Größen und Branchen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Durch diese interdisziplinäre Ausrichtung ergeben sich abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Mandate, wie sie in Kanzleien unserer Größenordnung selten zu finden sind. Die Vielfalt unserer Projekte bietet nicht nur spannende Herausforderungen, sondern auch die Chance, sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei steht bei uns nicht nur die Arbeit im Fokus, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie sich wirklich wohlfühlen können. Bei Scheller & Partner legen wir großen Wert auf eine persönliche Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, in der Teamgeist und Wertschätzung großgeschrieben werden.

Haben Sie Lust, den nächsten Schritt zu gehen, sich vielseitigen und spannenden Aufgaben zu stellen und gleichzeitig fachlich, persönlich und finanziell zu profitieren? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Aufgaben

Ihr Aufgabengebiet
Bei uns leistet jeder Einzelne im Team einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kanzlei – und erhält dafür den nötigen Raum, um sich zu entfalten. Auf Sie warten vielfältige und spannende Aufgaben, die nicht nur zu Ihrer Qualifikation passen, sondern auch Ihren persönlichen Interessen und Stärken gerecht werden. Diese setzen sich aus folgenden Tätigkeiten zusammen:

  • Mitwirkung bei Jahres- und Konzernabschlussprüfungen sowie bei Due-Diligence-Prüfungen und IKS-Prüfungen
  • Erstellung von Prüfungsberichten und Dokumentationen

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit
In unserem Team legen wir großen Wert auf Zuverlässigkeit und Kollegialität – denn nur dann sind wir gemeinsam erfolgreich! Wenn Sie zudem die folgenden Qualifikationen mitbringen, passen Sie perfekt zu uns:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Schwerpunkt Steuern bzw. Wirtschaftsprüfung
  • Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Wirtschaftsprüfung
  • Eine stark ausgeprägte analytische Denkweise und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
  • Engagement, Zielstrebigkeit und die Lust, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Benefits

Ihre Vorteile bei uns
Ein erfolgreiches Team braucht die richtige Basis – ein positives Arbeitsklima, klare Kommunikation und Freude an den täglichen Aufgaben. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das diese Werte fördert und unterstützt. Außerdem können sich Teammitglieder über folgende Benefits freuen:

  • Entwicklung und Unterstützung: zahlreiche Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Unterstützung bei Berufsexamina und Spezialisierungen, ein persönlicher Mentor für die Einarbeitungszeit
  • Vielschichtige Tätigkeiten: abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben im Bereich der Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung für spannende Mandanten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Umsatzbonus und variable Vergütungsmodelle
  • Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Betriebliche Krankenversicherung und Altersvorsorge mit 15 % Zuschuss
  • Flexibilität: Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

jobs.title: Head of Growth / Sales Lead (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Zenon

Bei Zenon besetzen wir die Rollen, die über den Erfolg der größten Tech-Transformationen der kommenden Jahre entscheiden. Als Boutique für Executive Search im IT-Umfeld arbeiten wir für führende Tier-1-Unternehmen und ambitionierte Tech-Player, um die Menschen zu finden, die den Unterschied machen. In unserem kompakten Team in Hamburg gestaltest du als Head of Growth / Sales Lead den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts maßgeblich mit.

Mission

Du baust ein skalierbares Sales-Modell auf, das Zenon von einem stark personengetriebenen 360-Grad-Ansatz zu einer systematischen, datengetriebenen und spezialisierten Organisation entwickelt.

Operatives Business Development & Staffing Sales

  • Du übernimmst aktiv die Neukundenakquise und gewinnst eigenständig neue Recruiting- und Staffing-Mandate.

  • Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, analysierst deren Hiring-Bedarfe und entwickelst gezielte Akquisestrategien.

  • Du führst Kundenmeetings, präsentierst unsere Dienstleistungen und verantwortest Vertragsverhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Hiring Managern, HR-Entscheidern und Führungskräften auf.

  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter und identifizierst neue Umsatzpotenziale.

  • Du übernimmst persönlich Verantwortung für strategische Accounts und relevante Umsatz- und Wachstumsziele.

Sales Strategy & Growth

  • Du entwickelst und setzt unsere Sales- und Wachstumsstrategie um.

  • Du etablierst strukturierte Outbound-Prozesse und entwickelst neue Wege zur systematischen Kundengewinnung.

  • Du identifizierst neue Märkte, Branchen und Geschäftspotenziale für Zenon.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse, Playbooks und KPIs.

  • Du analysierst unsere Pipeline, Conversion Rates und Umsatzentwicklung und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im anspruchsvollen B2B-Vertrieb mit Enterprise-Kunden, idealerweise in der Personalberatung

  • Nachweisbarer Track-Record im eigenständigen Aufbau und Abschluss komplexer Deals

  • Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Methoden und modernen Outbound-Ansätzen

  • Fähigkeit, kommerzielle Strukturen selbst aufzubauen statt nur bestehende Teams zu verwalten

  • Stark in Executive-Stakeholder-Management, Discovery, Verhandlung und Closing

  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit Perspektive auf die Führung einer größeren Sales-Organisation

Das bieten wir

  • Für deinen Arbeitsweg und deine Mobilität stehen dir ein Firmenwagen, ein Fitnessabo sowie Optionen zur beruflichen Bildung und internen Mobilität zur Verfügung.

  • Profitiere von Mentoring, regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern sowie kostenlosen Getränken am Standort Hamburg.

  • Ausstattung wie ein Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy gehören zu deiner täglichen Ausrüstung.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

Why Zenon?

Wir bauen nicht einfach ein weiteres Recruiting-Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln eine Organisation, die durch Spezialisierung, Qualität und systematische Kundenentwicklung nachhaltig wächst.

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Neues zu lernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen.

Ready to grow with us? Let's talk.

jobs.title: Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d)
jobs.company: MRDW - Mescheder Reese Dalkmann Wiebel PartGmbB
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das, worauf es ankommt.

Wir stellen uns vor.

Gute Beratung basiert auf weit mehr als Zahlen, Daten und fachlichen Lösungen. Sie lebt von Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und der Art, wie Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Genau dieses Verständnis prägt aus unserer Sicht auch ein gutes Arbeitsverhältnis. Uns ist es wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem man ankommen, sich wohlfühlen und stetig weiterentwickeln kann. Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam, Herausforderungen meistern wir im Team. Wir sind MRDW, Mescheder Reese Dalkmann Wiebel, eine Kanzlei mit Sitz in Paderborn, 35 engagierten Persönlichkeiten und einem interdisziplinären Beratungsprofil aus Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung.

Aufgaben

Ihre Stärken, Ihre Tätigkeiten.

Wirkungsfeld.

Als Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) haben Sie bei uns die Verantwortung, die Ihrer Position gerecht wird. Sie arbeiten eigenständig und können sich entsprechend Ihres Tätigkeitsfelds und Ihrer fachlichen Schwerpunkte kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Darüber hinaus haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich Schritt für Schritt auch unternehmerisch in die Kanzlei einzubringen.

  • Vollumfängliche Verantwortung für Prüfungsmandate
  • Prüfung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen
  • Durchführung von Due-Diligence-Prüfungen, IKS-Prüfungen und Unternehmensbewertungen
  • Mitwirkung bei innovativen Themen (z. B. bei der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Prozesse)

Qualifikation

Die Einstellung zählt.

Erwartungen.

Sie bringen fachliche Stärke, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch sowie ein klares Verständnis für langfristige Mandantenbeziehungen mit. Wenn Sie sich außerdem in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfinden, dann passen wir gut zusammen.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsprüferexamen und idealerweise bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung von Prüfungsmandaten
  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine verlässliche Arbeitsweise
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
  • Interesse an neuen Themen und digitalen Prozessen

Benefits

Wir bieten gerne mehr.

Arbeitgeberprofil.

Damit Sie Ihre Aufgaben zuverlässig und mit Freude erfüllen können, schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, das Ihnen sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich Raum gibt. Diese Punkte sind für uns daher selbstverständlich:

  • Menschliche und finanzielle Wertschätzung Ihrer Leistungen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Austausch auf Augenhöhe und ein respektvolles Miteinander
  • Spannende, vielfältige Mandate, an denen Sie wachsen können, sowie Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich an Ihren individuellen Zielen orientieren
  • Ein Arbeitgeber, der sich kontinuierlich hinterfragt und auf die Bedürfnisse des Teams eingeht
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile, die das Leben angenehmer machen (wie bspw. ein verkürzter Freitag)
  • Zahlreiche Maßnahmen im Bereich der Nettolohnoptimierung

Zeit für etwas Neues.

Bewerbungsprozess.

Warum kompliziert, wenn es auch einfach geht? Bewerben Sie sich in wenigen Schritten über unser digitales Bewerbungsformular auf diese Stelle. So können wir mehr voneinander erfahren.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remmert entwickelt und baut automatisierte Lager- und Intralogistiksysteme für Langgüter, Blech und Werkstücke. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen aus der metallverarbeitenden Industrie in ganz Europa. Als familiengeführter Mittelständler mit internationalem Anspruch verbinden wir technische Präzision mit langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.

Das Projekt:

Unsere Marke ist gewachsen, unsere Produkte und Zielgruppen auch. Jetzt wollen wir das Erscheinungsbild von Remmert gezielt weiterentwickeln. Es geht nicht um einen Neuanfang, sondern darum, das bestehende Corporate Design zu schärfen und zukunftsfähig zu machen. Als Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn) beschäftigst du dich an unserem Standort in Hüllhorst insbesondere mit diesen drei Ausprägungen:

  • Produkt-Branding: Erarbeitung klarer Gestaltungsregeln unserer Maschinen und Anlagen

  • Corporate Communication: die nach innen und außen gerichtete Unternehmenskommunikation in allen Facetten

  • Marktkommunikation: Weiterentwicklung und Streamlining visueller Kommunikationsmittel wie Anzeigen, Messen und Website

Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse des bestehenden Markenauftritts über alle Kanäle und Medien hinweg

  • Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines Gestaltungssystems mit gemeinsamem Markenkern und differenzierten Ebenen für Produkt, Unternehmen und Markt

  • Weiterentwicklung des Corporate Design Manuals, inklusive Anwendungsbeispielen und Vorlagen

  • Begleitung der Umsetzung, zum Beispiel bei Print- und Vertriebsunterlagen, Website, Social Media, Messeauftritten und Präsentationen

  • Aktive Mitarbeit an laufenden Marketingprojekten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Agenturen; Präsentation von Zwischenständen

Deine Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Mediendesign oder vergleichbar, idealerweise im Master

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Typografie, Corporate Design und Markenentwicklung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop); Figma von Vorteil

  • Konzeptionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, gestalterische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu begründen

  • Interesse an Industrie und Technik: Du hast Lust, eine B2B-Marke im Maschinenbau zu gestalten

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Verfügbarkeit für mindestens 12 Monate, in der Vorlesungszeit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche

Option Masterarbeit

Das Projekt eignet sich als Grundlage für eine Masterarbeit, zum Beispiel zur Markenarchitektur oder zur Differenzierung von Markenebenen im B2B-Umfeld. Die Betreuung stimmen wir gemeinsam mit dir und deiner Hochschule ab.

Benefits

  • Ein echtes Gestaltungsprojekt mit Verantwortung und sichtbarem Ergebnis, das du von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung begleitest

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf dein Studium, und teilweise mobiles Arbeiten

  • Faire Vergütung

  • Einblicke in eine technisch anspruchsvolle, international tätige Industrie

  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement

  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr

  • Sonderboni wie Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Senior Software Engineer)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari engineer senior yang ingin menjaga sistem yang digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen, serta menjadi gerbang terakhir untuk setiap perubahan pada inti sistem.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang komponen yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim produk: inti sistem, database bersama, infrastruktur, keamanan, dan pipeline rilis. Banyak tim kecil membangun dengan bantuan agent AI di atas sistem ini. Tugas Anda memastikan mereka tidak saling berbenturan dan setiap perubahan pada inti sistem melewati Anda dengan aman. Anda tidak terikat pada satu tim produk; Anda melayani semuanya. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Menjaga stabilitas, keamanan, dan performa inti sistem serta database bersama. * Menelaah dan menyetujui setiap perubahan pada inti sistem, termasuk perubahan hasil agent AI. * Menyusun standar teknis dan rulebook tertulis yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim. * Menangani gangguan produksi dan menyusun postmortem secara terbuka. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengalaman memegang sistem berskala besar yang tidak boleh berhenti beroperasi, termasuk menangani gangguan pada sistem tersebut. * Mampu menilai hasil agent pada sistem yang saling terhubung dan mengenali perubahan kecil yang dapat merusak modul lain. * Mampu menulis standar dan rulebook yang dibaca serta dipakai orang lain. * Tenang saat menghadapi gangguan dan jujur dalam menyusun postmortem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Mentoring satu per satu sebagai cara utama. Di sini, pengetahuan disebarkan melalui standar tertulis. * Menjadi yang paling cepat menulis kode. Agent yang menulis kode, Anda yang menjaga. * Penguasaan satu *stack* saja. Sistem kami terdiri dari lebih dari satu generasi teknologi. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Cerita sistem:** Ceritakan satu sistem yang pernah Anda jaga dan satu gangguan yang pernah Anda tangani. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus arsitektur:** Selesaikan permasalahan arsitektur nyata dengan bebas menggunakan tools AI. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi perubahan:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah perubahan hasil agent pada modul yang saling bergantung dan menemukan perubahan yang merusak modul lain. * **Wawancara dengan CTO:** Pembahasan mengenai cara Anda menyusun standar dan menjaga sistem. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Platform Engineer yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda memahami inti sistem secara menyeluruh dan siap menjadi gerbang terakhir bagi setiap perubahan pada inti sistem. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada cara Anda memeriksa, cara Anda menyusun standar, dan cara Anda bersikap saat terjadi gangguan. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: **POSITION SUMMARY** We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to drive product strategy, development, and growth for AccelByte's gaming technology platform. You'll own product decisions, not just the backlog. We are looking for a hands-on product leader who can actively identify customer problems, shape product direction, drive product discovery, and translate insights into impactful product initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with commercial acumen, particularly in SaaS pricing, monetization, and business model development, to maximize product value and business growth. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own and drive product strategy, vision, roadmap, and execution, ensuring alignment between customer needs, technical capabilities, and business objectives. * Lead product discovery by identifying customer pain points, validating opportunities, and translating customer insights into product requirements and actionable solutions. * Own product definition, prioritization, and decision-making. * Develop and refine SaaS pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies, including usage-based pricing and other revenue models, to support product adoption and sustainable business growth. * Identify opportunities to improve product value, customer adoption, retention, and revenue performance through data-driven product decisions. * Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver scalable product capabilities and successful product adoption. * Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, validate product direction, and communicate product value effectively. * Define product success metrics, monitor product performance, and use customer feedback and data to continuously improve product outcomes. * Provide product leadership and mentorship to other product team members, fostering strong product thinking, ownership, and execution. **QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE REQUIRED** * 7+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of product strategy and successful product development. * Proven experience in B2B SaaS, platform products, or enterprise software, preferably involving developer-facing products, APIs, cloud services, or technical platforms. * Strong experience in SaaS pricing, monetization, packaging, or revenue model development, with demonstrated contribution to pricing strategy and commercial outcomes. * Proven ability to drive product discovery, define product requirements, prioritize initiatives, and translate customer problems into successful product solutions. * Strong business acumen and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, market potential, and business impact. * Experience working closely with Engineering teams on technical products, with the ability to understand technical trade-offs and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** **Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.** Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Full-Stack SMPP Developer** We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Stack SMPP Developer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing robust SMS gateway solutions and full-stack web applications. You will bridge the gap between complex telecom protocols and modern web interfaces, ensuring seamless, high-volume, and reliable message routing. **Key Responsibilities** * SMPP Integration & Management: Implement, configure, and maintain SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) client/server connections (v3.4/v5.0) with various SMS Centers (SMSC) and telecom aggregators. * Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and deploy scalable front-end and back-end applications that interface with our SMS gateway and core business systems. * System Optimization: Monitor and optimize database queries, API performance, and message queuing systems to handle high-throughput SMS traffic. * Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to SMPP session drops, message delivery failures, and application bugs. * Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, QA engineers, and external telecom partners to deliver reliable communication solutions. * Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices in software development and version control (Git). **Mandatory Qualifications** * Education: Must be a College Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * SMPP Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically working with the SMPP Protocol (e.g., handling SMSC connections, parsing PDUs, managing SMPP sessions, and troubleshooting delivery receipts). * Full-Stack Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of professional experience in Full-Stack Development, demonstrating proficiency in both front-end and back-end technologies. **Technical Skills & Competencies** * Backend Technologies: Proficiency in languages commonly used for SMPP and backend services (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or PHP). * Frontend Technologies: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) and standard HTML/CSS. * SMPP Libraries: Familiarity with SMPP libraries such as Cloudhopper (Java), jSMPP, node-smpp, or Python's smpplib is highly advantageous. * Databases: Solid understanding of relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases. * APIs & Messaging: Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message brokers/queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). * Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills. **Work Setup & Location Details** Hybrid Work Model (A mix of on-site and remote work, specific schedule to be discussed during the interview). On-Site Office: Ruko Citra 7, Jl. Peta Barat No.16 Blok A03, Desa/Kelurahan Kalideres, Kec. Kalideres, Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, Provinsi DKI Jakarta 11840 **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (HMO). * Government-mandated benefits * A collaborative and innovative work environment. * Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth in the telecom-tech space. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * SMPP Protocol: 1 year (Required) * Full-Stack Development: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Manager| 100% Remote EU
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. jobs.title: Product Builder (Product Manager)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari Product Builder yang mampu membangun solusi secara langsung, bukan menulis spesifikasi lalu menunggu. Produk yang Anda bangun akan digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen di lebih dari 1.200 institusi pendidikan tinggi di Indonesia.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang satu modul dari awal hingga akhir: memahami permasalahan pengguna di kampus, menentukan bentuk fitur, membuat prototype yang dapat diklik dengan bantuan AI, mengujinya ke pengguna, lalu bekerja bersama seorang Product Engineer hingga fitur tersebut benar-benar digunakan. Anda tidak mengelola orang. Anda mengelola hasil. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Mengumpulkan kebutuhan langsung dari pengguna dan menyusunnya menjadi dokumen kerja yang jelas, termasuk alur, UI/UX, dan *acceptance criteria*. * Membuat prototype yang berfungsi dengan bantuan AI dan melibatkan pengguna sejak tahap awal. * Memeriksa hasil kerja AI dan menentukan bagian yang perlu diperbaiki. * Memantau tingkat pemakaian fitur pascarilis sebagai ukuran keberhasilan. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membuat sesuatu yang digunakan oleh orang lain dan dapat menunjukkannya. * Mampu mengarahkan AI untuk membuat prototype serta mengenali bagian hasilnya yang keliru. * Mampu memprioritaskan, termasuk menolak fitur yang tidak perlu dibuat. * Bersedia berinteraksi langsung dengan pengguna, tidak hanya melalui laporan. * Memiliki pemahaman teknis yang cukup untuk berdiskusi dengan Product Engineer mengenai dampak sebuah fitur terhadap data dan sistem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Sertifikasi Scrum atau pengalaman mengelola tim besar. * Kemampuan coding dari nol. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman. Kami menilai apa yang telah Anda bangun. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu karya yang Anda buat dengan bantuan AI dan telah digunakan oleh pengguna, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Ubah permasalahan nyata dari institusi pendidikan menjadi prototype yang dapat diklik. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi hasil AI:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah hasil AI yang memuat sejumlah kesalahan dan menjelaskan temuan Anda. * **Wawancara pengguna dan keputusan produk:** Pembahasan mengenai pengalaman Anda dengan pengguna nyata dan cara Anda mengambil keputusan. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Builder yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu mengarahkan agent, memeriksa hasilnya secara menyeluruh, dan bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada instruksi yang Anda berikan, hasil yang Anda periksa, dan keputusan yang Anda tolak. Fulltime Surabaya, Jawa Timur

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About AkzoNobel** Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together. For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved. **Job Purpose** --------------- Drive process optimization and continuous improvement in coatings manufacturing to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, process reliability, and cost effectiveness through process engineering, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), Kaizen, troubleshooting, scale-up, and compliance with established standards, while ensuring Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ Develop and optimize coatings manufacturing processes, including pre-kitting of raw material, mixing, dispersion, grinding, let-down, and filling. Support process trials, commissioning, scale-up, and qualification of new products and equipment Monitor production performance, analyze process parameters, yields, cycle times, losses, and deviations, and identify improvement opportunities using production data and root cause analysis (RCA). Conduct production trials, evaluate process and equipment performance, validate process changes, and collaborate with Production, QC, Engineering, and RDI team on equipment upgrades and process modifications Establish standard operating procedures (SOP) practices including Work Instruction (WI), Standard Working Sheet (SWS), and One Point Lesson (OPL), optimize operating parameters, production sequences, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to improve throughput, quality, and resource utilization **Key Activities** ------------------ Evaluate alternative process parameters, production sequences, equipment capacities, and process scenarios to identify potential bottlenecks and optimize manufacturing performance. Improved process planning, reduced trial-and-error activities, and better-informed technical and operational decisions. Manage cost and time constraints. Evaluate process costs, cycle times, material losses, energy consumption, and resource requirements. Prioritize improvement projects based on business impact and implementation feasibility. Reduced manufacturing costs, improved cycle times, optimized resource utilization, and delivery of improvement projects within agreed timelines. Perform risk assessments. Identify and assess process, equipment, quality, and HSE risks associated with routine operations, process changes, new products, and equipment modifications. Define and follow up on appropriate mitigation actions. Reduced operational and process risks, improved process safety, and compliance with applicable HSE and quality standards. Provide process documentation and operating instructions. Develop and maintain process specifications, working instructions or operating procedures, process flow diagrams, parameter standards, troubleshooting guides, and change-control documentation. Train relevant personnel on revised processes and standards. Accurate and controlled process documentation, consistent operating practices, effective knowledge transfer, and sustained compliance with manufacturing standards. Apply HSE principles and implement workplace improvement projects. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com **Job Description** Business Operations Lead is responsible for driving operational excellence, governance, business compliance, and process optimization across Indonesia and the Philippines. Acting as a strategic business partner to the Regional Director and country leadership teams, the role oversees the effectiveness of operational processes, controls, and business systems across Finance, Risk & Assurance, Business Generation, and Office Operations. The role works closely with local operational leads, including the Finance, HR, and Office Manager, to drive process standardization, continuous improvement, system enhancements, and operational scalability that support business growth and compliance. The position is accountable for ensuring the business operates efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with regional and corporate standards while providing leadership with meaningful business insights, performance reporting, and risk visibility. **Finance & Commercial Governance** Provide oversight and governance of commercial operations to support business performance and effective pengalaman kerja minimal **3–5 tahun** di bidang Technical Support, Application Support, IT Support, atau bidang teknologi terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman minimal **1–2 tahun dalam posisi jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** We are looking for a commercially minded and data-driven professional to turn complex business data into actionable insights. jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** ------------------- 1. Job Purpose To lead loss elimination and process capability improvement in a designated area by driving the KHMS Zero Loss journey, owning the Centreline DMS system, developing control strategies, and building frontline problemsolving capability through coaching and technical leadership. 2. Key Responsibilities Loss Elimination & Problem Solving * Identify, prioritize, and eliminate chronic and sporadic losses using KHMS and reliability tools. * Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Universal Problem Solving (UPS) for critical issues. * Maintain structured loss analysis routines with regular updates to the CI action pipeline. Process Control & Standardization * Own and lead deployment of the Centerline Daily Management System (DMS) in the assigned area. * Define and maintain equipment standards and basic conditions (CIL and CL targets). * Implement and conduct health checks for Centerline and Defect Handling systems. * Lead change management processes related to Safety, Quality, Engineering, and KHMS. Coaching & Capability Building * Coach operators and team leaders in 5S, Clean-Inspect-Lube (CIL), Centerlining (CL), and structured problem-solving. * Conduct regular check-ins on CIL and CL checklist completion and compliance. * Develop and deliver training, including One Point Lessons (OPLs), to drive standard work and knowledge sharing. * Build a zero-loss mindset and develop ownership on the floor. Daily Leadership & Rhythm Execution * Spend at least 80% of time on the floor, observing losses, supporting operators, and gathering data. * Lead CI daily routines, including data review, planned stops, RCFA, and floor coaching. * Actively participate in DDS (Daily Direction Setting) meetings (Level 1 and 2), reporting progress and flagging issues. * Partner with Process Owner and Maintenance Lead to prioritize and align on improvement actions. 3. Key Metrics/KPI * Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE) * Yield Losses * Right First Time (Quality) * Safety Metrics * KHMS Scorecard Compliance * Centerline DMS health status 4. Key Stakeholders * Line Operators * Team Leaders (Operations and Engineering) * Process Owner * Operations Manager * Maintenance Supervisors * Project Engineers 5. Other Expectations * Qualify on all basic operator roles within the designated process. * Effectively lead RCFA events and ensure completion of corrective actions. * Write and maintain SOPs, OPLs, and work standards. * Act as a visible KHMS role model and change agent for Zero Loss. * Drive standardization and reapplication of successful practices across shifts or lines. **Location(s)** --------------- Karawang **Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority** **Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals** **with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes** **.**

jobs.descriptionHtml: ***User Research Lead - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. Within our Food-Land-Water (FLW) Program, we envision critical ecosystems such as forests and peatland across Indonesia to be governed fairly and sustainably. We believe sustainable land use management is key for Indonesia to meet its climate goal, in line with keeping the global climate target below the 1.5 degree Celcius warming threshold, while providing sustainable livelihoods to forest-dependent communities and conserve biodiversity in the landscape. We intend to achieve this through safeguarding the remaining forest and peatland from deforestation, degradation, and fragmentation; maintaining forests and peatland quality through sound stewardship; and restoring degraded ecosystem to improve its productivity, conservation value, and ecosystem services. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. ***Data Lab Indonesia*** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The User Research Lead will support the Data Lab team in integrating design thinking with strategic objectives to advance Data Lab mission. Reporting to the Product and Engineering Manager, The User Research Lead will work closely with a dedicated team, including a Product Specialist, UI/UX Designer, and Visualization Designer. These collaborators will provide essential support, fostering a culture of teamwork and innovation. Based in Jakarta and tailored for teleworking, offering flexibility while requiring occasional travel to project sites or partner locations. jobs.title: Senior Web Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Senior Web Designer - DotYeti** **Important Note:** This position operates within the Jakarta, Indonesia time zone (3 PM - 11 PM WIB). Flexibility with working hours is essential. **At DotYeti, we believe great design should feel as good to make as it does to look at.** We're a fully remote creative team helping businesses bring their ideas to life. Everything we make starts with two things: artistry in every detail and excellence in every delivery. The rest comes naturally: joy in the work, growth for everyone, and a team that has each other's backs. **What you'll do:** * **Creative Craft:** Develop high-level website concepts, landing pages, UI/UX systems, and conversion-focused digital designs, made with real artistry and the kind of detail people notice. * **Quality & Delivery:** Deliver responsive web designs, interactive layouts, and email templates that are polished, on-brand, and on time. You hold your work to a high bar before anyone else has to. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with design and development teams to turn briefs into high-performing web experiences, present design rationale clearly, share feedback openly, and keep projects moving (and fun). * **Problem Solving:** Optimize user journeys, resolve complex UI/UX layout roadblocks, and bridge design-to-development handoffs, finding fixes that last, not just quick patches. * **Learning & Tools:** Explore new tools, AI workflows, and techniques that help the team create better work. **Our ideal candidate:** * Has extensive experience in web and email design, with a strong portfolio showcasing landing pages, email marketing assets, and app interfaces. * Possesses deep expertise in design software and technologies (Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop). * Has a strong understanding of email marketing design principles, including responsive layouts, deliverability, and conversion optimization. * Has a great eye and cares how things look, feel, and work, not just whether they're finished. * Takes pride in the details and doesn't call it done until it's right. * Is naturally curious, always tinkering with a new tool, trick, or technique. * Communicates clearly, offers help, asks for it, and celebrates wins with the team. **Bonus Points for:** * Familiarity with Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, HTML/CSS for email template customizations. * Previous startup and/or design agency experience. * Experience handling design requests for MSMEs, large corporations, and entrepreneurial initiatives. **What We Offer:** * **Fully Remote Work:** Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment in an independent contractor setup. * **Paid Time Off & Benefits:** Generous paid time off and mental health leave. * **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive salary with yearly performance-based raises. * **Equipment Allowance:** Allowance provided to equip your home office. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunity to grow with a talented and collaborative team. **How we hire:** * **Let's get to know each other.** A relaxed first chat about how you work, how you communicate, and what makes work fun for you. * **Show us your craft.** This is the big one. A practical assessment where we look at your creativity, your attention to detail, and the polish of the final result. * **Final interview.** We'll talk through your work, how you tackle problems, and where you want to grow next. * **Job offer!** **Note:** We are currently not accepting meeting requests for this position through our website. Submit your application via this job ad.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Challenge** ----------------------- Are you ready to lead digital marketing strategies, strengthen brand positioning, and drive business growth in the automotive industry? As a **Digital Marketing Manager (Automotive R2)**, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, generate leads, and drive sales performance. You will oversee digital campaigns, manage online marketing channels, analyze market trends, and ensure all marketing initiatives align with business objectives. You will work closely with sales teams, business leaders, creative teams, and external partners to develop impactful campaigns, optimize customer engagement, and maximize marketing effectiveness. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Management, or a related field. * Minimum 5 years of experience in digital marketing, with at least 2 years in a managerial or leadership role; experience in the automotive industry is preferred. * Strong expertise in digital marketing strategy, SEO/SEM, social media marketing, paid advertising, content marketing, and lead generation. * Proven experience in managing digital campaigns, marketing budgets, performance analytics, and ROI optimization using tools such as Google Analytics and advertising platforms. * Excellent leadership, communication, analytical thinking, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with a strong understanding of digital consumer behavior and market trends. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop and execute digital marketing strategies and annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives, brand positioning, and sales targets. * Lead end-to-end digital campaigns across social media, search engines, websites, and other online channels to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and drive conversions. * Collaborate with sales teams, business leaders, creative teams, and external agencies to develop effective marketing campaigns and strengthen customer engagement. * Monitor and analyze campaign performance, digital marketing KPIs, lead generation, conversion rates, and marketing ROI to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. * Manage digital marketing budgets, oversee content and campaign execution, stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities, and ensure marketing initiatives deliver measurable business results. **Our Selection Procedure in a Nutshell** ----------------------------------------- Our interview process is straightforward—just a few conversations with HR and our Users. If you want to become part of our highly motivated and high-performing team, please click on the **"Apply for Position"** button to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you! 6FD1LSDYCm

Pengujian manual hanya digunakan untuk eksplorasi dan kasus baru, bukan untuk regresi. **Onsite Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Membangun pengujian otomatis *end-to-end* (misalnya dengan Playwright) dari *acceptance criteria* dengan bantuan agent. * Menelaah kode dan menemukan sumber bug, tidak sebatas mereproduksinya. * Memeriksa hasil agent testing dan memastikan setiap test benar-benar menguji sesuatu. * Melakukan pengujian eksploratif pada fitur dan kasus baru. Kualitas bukan tanggung jawab tim lain di belakang Anda. Kualitas adalah tanggung jawab Anda. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membangun automation yang digunakan oleh tim dan dapat menunjukkannya. * Mampu membaca kode dan menemukan letak bug. * Mampu mengarahkan agent untuk menyusun test dari *acceptance criteria*, serta mengenali test yang sebenarnya tidak menguji apa pun. * Memiliki naluri kuat dalam menemukan kesalahan dan berani menggantikan regresi manual dengan pengujian otomatis yang telah terbukti. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Pengalaman menulis test case di spreadsheet. * Sertifikasi QA. Kami menilai automation yang pernah Anda bangun. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman pengujian manual. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu automation yang Anda bangun dan telah digunakan oleh tim, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Quality yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu membangun pengujian otomatis, memeriksa hasil agent, dan menjaga kualitas produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding.
