Über Vestlane und die Rolle

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du willst sehen, wie ein B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen wirklich funktioniert – nicht aus der Folie, sondern aus dem Maschinenraum? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne den Umweg über drei Jahre Investment Banking? Du baust lieber einen Prozess, der ein Problem dauerhaft löst, als es jede Woche neu zu lösen? Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools und Automatisierung so selbstverständlich wie andere mit Excel? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Founders Associate arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Operations und Go-to-Market verantwortet. Du übernimmst die operativen Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Prozessen und Tooling über Finance und Compliance bis HR – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die das Unternehmen bewegt. Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins, direkter Draht zu Steuerberatung, Dienstleistern und Partnern, und ein Überblick über ein wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen, den dir kein Konzern bietet. 2–3 Tage pro Woche arbeitet ihr gemeinsam vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar, an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du von Anfang an mit aufbaust; den Rest flexibel aus dem Home-Office.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Die interne Maschine bauen (dein Schwerpunkt): Du dokumentierst, standardisierst und automatisierst unsere internen Abläufe – von einem Wiki, das tatsächlich gelesen wird, über KI-Agenten für wiederkehrende Aufgaben bis zur Verwaltung unserer Tool- und Vendorlandschaft (Verträge, Zugänge, Kosten). Du erkennst, wo wir Zeit verlieren, und beseitigst die Ursache.

  • Entscheidungen vorbereiten: Du baust Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für COO und CEO – Unit Economics, Markt- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen, Investorenreporting – und lieferst Zahlen statt Meinungen.

  • Finance und Accounting unterstützen: Du übernimmst die vorbereitende Buchhaltung, prüfst und stellst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor, arbeitest unserer Steuerberatung zu und hältst Kosten- und Liquiditätsübersichten aktuell.

  • Compliance-Operations am Laufen halten: Du pflegst Nachweise und Richtlinien für ISO 27001 und SOC 2, bereitest Audits vor und hältst unsere Subprozessorenliste und Fristen in Ordnung.

  • Hiring und HR mittragen: Du schreibst Stellenanzeigen, screenst Bewerbungen, koordinierst Interviews und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen sauber onboarded werden – von Arbeitsvertrag und Equipment bis zum ersten Tag. Daneben hältst du unsere HR-Prozesse und -Tools in Ordnung.

  • Verträge und Angebote im Griff behalten: Du bereitest Angebote vor, hältst unsere Pipeline in Salesforce aktuell und behältst Kunden-, Partner- und Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge im Blick – Versionen, Fristen, Unterschriften.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht oder vergleichbar) oder eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Ob frisch von der Uni oder mit ein bis zwei Jahren Erfahrung aus Startup, Beratung oder Finanzbranche: Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen, Haltung zählt mehr.

  • Sehr sicher in Excel/Google Sheets, strukturiert in Dokumentation und Projektmanagement. Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Buchhaltungs- oder Automatisierungstools (z. B. Zapier, Make, n8n) ist ein Plus.

jobs.title: KYC & AML Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

“KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform.

  • Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten.

  • Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können.

  • Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last.

  • Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts.

  • Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus.

  • Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung.

  • Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

jobs.title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer: Software Development & Applied AI (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fach abgeschlossen und willst Software nicht nur bauen, sondern direkt beim Kunden Wirkung erzeugen? Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse genauso gut wie Code und hast Lust, KI-Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz zu begleiten?

Als Junior Forward Deployed Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Softwareentwicklung, Applied AI und Beratung: Du bist nah am Kunden, verstehst seine Prozesse und Daten, entwickelst passende Lösungen und bringst sie in den produktiven Betrieb. Ein Teil deiner Zeit fließt außerdem in die Entwicklung unserer eigenen KI-Tools und Produkte.

Über DataClue

DataClue ist eine Unternehmensberatungs-Boutique mit Fokus auf Applied AI & Data Analytics und Execution & Transformation. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit messbarem Mehrwert. Unser interdisziplinäres Team vereint Business- und Entwicklungs-Know-how und begleitet Kunden: von Konzeption und Strategie über Projektmanagement bis zur Umsetzung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Backend-Services, Datenpipelines und KI-Agenten in Python

  • Umsetzung von Frontends und internen Tools mit TypeScript und React

  • Arbeit mit relationalen Datenbanken: Datenmodelle, SQL und Datenaufbereitung

  • Forward Engineering beim Kunden: Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen aufnehmen, Prototypen schnell bauen und iterativ in produktive Lösungen überführen

  • Integration von LLM-APIs und KI-Agenten in bestehende Systemlandschaften (z. B. ERP, CRM, Power BI, Microsoft 365)

  • Übersetzung von Geschäftsprozessen in technische Konzepte und Datenmodelle

  • Beratungsanteil: Workshops beim Kunden mitgestalten, Ergebnisse präsentieren und mit Stakeholdern abstimmen

  • Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete inkl. Tests, Dokumentation und Code-Reviews

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Data oder IT-Beratung (z. B. als Werkstudent:in, im Praktikum oder in einer ersten Festanstellung)

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie Erfahrung mit TypeScript und React

  • Sicherer Umgang mit SQL und relationalen Datenbanken

  • Eigene Projekte über Studium und Job hinaus (z. B. Tool, Bot, Web-App), idealerweise produktiv im Einsatz

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Modellen, LLM-APIs oder KI-gestützter Entwicklung

  • Gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Geschäftsprozesse

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Echte Projektarbeit statt Zuarbeit: Deine Lösungen kommen direkt beim Kunden zum Einsatz

  • Breites Profil aus Entwicklung, Applied AI und Beratung, eng begleitet von erfahrenen Entwicklern und Beratern

  • Moderne Entwicklungstools inkl. KI-gestützter Entwicklung

  • Flexible Home-Office- und Arbeitszeitmodelle

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Senior Engineer oder Consultant

  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit Raum für Eigeninitiative und Wachstum

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deinen CV und ein Projekt, auf das du stolz bist (GitHub-Link, Screenshots)

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) – B2B Kundenbetreuung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ProviPanda GmbH · Hamburg / Remote · Freelance oder Festanstellung · 30 Std./Woche · Start: sofort

Über ProviPanda GmbH

ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup aus dem Bereich Technology, Information and Internet und die größte Sales-Job-Plattform im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 15 Mitarbeitenden arbeitet daran, den Sales-HR-Markt zu revolutionieren und neu zu denken.

Deine Rolle

Du unterstützt unsere Customer Success Managerin und bist im Alltag die Person, die Kunden anruft, ihre Anliegen klärt und dafür sorgt, dass sie zufrieden sind und Erfolg mit ProviPanda haben. Du arbeitest eigenständig, trittst professionell auf und telefonierst gern.

Deine Aufgaben

Check-ins & Kundenbetreuung

  • Du terminierst Check-in-Calls mit unseren Kunden und hältst den Überblick über anstehende Termine

  • Du führst Check-ins selbst durch und rufst Kunden aktiv an

  • Du klärst Kundenanliegen schnell und lösungsorientiert, von Support-Fragen bis zu Success-Themen

Onboarding

  • Du übernimmst Kunden-Onboardings Schritt für Schritt und begleitest neue Kunden beim Start

  • Du berätst Kunden zur Nutzung der Plattform und dazu, wie sie das Beste aus ProviPanda herausholen

Zusammenarbeit & Prozesse

  • Du entlastest die Customer Success Managerin und springst ein, wenn Kapazität gebraucht wird

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenkontakte sauber und gibst Feedback ans Team weiter

  • Du nutzt AI-Tools, um deine Arbeit effizienter zu machen, zum Beispiel für Vorbereitung, Zusammenfassungen und Kommunikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine sehr gute, professionelle Kommunikation und Tonalität, am Telefon und in Google Meets

  • Ein ordentliches, souveränes Auftreten, eine gute Ausstrahlung und eine freundliche, lösungsorientierte Art

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefonieren, du rufst gern Kunden an

  • Täglicher Umgang mit AI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT & Co. und generell technisches Verständnis

  • Eine hohe Auffassungsgabe, Leistungsstärke und richtig Lust auf die Aufgabe

  • Erfahrung im Customer Success ist top, aber kein Muss, den Rest bringen wir dir bei

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung aus HR oder Vertrieb, denn wer selbst im Sales war, weiß, wie man Kunden berät

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gutes Englisch ist ein Plus

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • StartUp mit starkem Wachstum und ambitionierter Vision mit einem dynamischen Team

  • Flexibles Modell: Freelance oder Festanstellung, jeweils mit 30 Std-40Std./Woche

  • Gründliche Einarbeitung und direktes Feedback

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein motiviertes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Start ab sofort

Interesse?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum du genau die richtige Person bist. Gib bitte auch an, ob du als Freelancerin oder in Festanstellung starten möchtest und ab wann du verfügbar bist.

jobs.title: People Operations Working Student (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
  • Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.
  • Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus
  • You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours)
  • A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.
  • A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.
  • A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.
  • A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe.

jobs.title: Tacto Labs: Fast-Track Builder Program
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto's sales-led motion in DACH works: more than 300 industrial companies run on Tacto. Tacto Labs is where we build what comes nest: new products and wedges that don't scale linearly with headcount. Each bet starts on a whiteboard and either becomes a real business inside Tacto or gets killed fast.

 

What you'll do

  • Take a bet from idea to first paying users, working directly with our founders

  • Build it yourself with AI: prototype, landing pages, agents, outreach, whatever proves or kills the idea fastest

  • Talk to customers and suppliers until you know. more about the problem than anyone else in the company

  • Find the next compounding loop and scale what works

 

How it fits

Everybody in Tacto Labs is a Builder: same role, same bar, pointed at earlier stage problems. We believe in building over strategizing.

 

Who we're looking for

  • You've built something from zero: as a founder, early at a startup, or during a side project.

  • You want to found something someday. We're looking for people we'd back if they did.

  • You don't come from engineering? Great, as long as you build. If you've shipped something with with AI tools, you're technical enough to start and get better.

  • Extreme ownership, no ego.

  • Fluent in German; English is a strong plus.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

 

Your Profile

  • You've built something people relied on: software, automations, agents, or a technical project that real users used.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default, and you've built with LLMs against real, messy data.

  • You're hands-on with data. SQL and Python at working level, or the drive to get there fast with AI as leverage.

  • You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data and conflicting stakeholders don't stop you.

  • You earn customer trust. You explain technical decisions clearly, handle pushback, and don't over-promise.

  • Early in your career? Good. We bet on people with a steep learning curve, and our senior Builders spend real time making others faster.

  • Native-level German and fluent English, based in Munich, happy to travel across DACH.

 

What This Role Is, and Isn't

We want to be honest about what you are signing up for.

  • This is not an engineering role with customers kept at a safe distance. Customer contact is the job, not a tax on the job. If you want a ticket queue and clean requirements, this is the wrong role.

  • This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what the customer can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

  • It is deliberately broad. If you want to specialise narrowly you will be frustrated here.

jobs.title: Builder
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

What a week can look like

  • A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy

  • A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning

  • Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

  • You've built something people used and owned the outcome: as a founder, in a fast-growing product team, or with a side project that you launched.

  • You have commercial sense and product taste. Agency and taste are the main differentiators in today's AGI age.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise.

  • You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code.

  • You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. You are fluent in German; English is strong plus.

  • You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

  • Early in your career? Great. We love to bet on people with a steep learning curve.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Join a team building software for industrial R&D and laboratory workflows. You will serve as the technical partner in pre-sales, helping prospects see how modern data tools can improve research and product development.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical pre-sales engagements, from initial demonstrations through value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots around prospective customers' R&D workflows.

  • Partner with sales colleagues and customer stakeholders to communicate business value and support new customer growth.

  • Present technical evaluations and explain how digital R&D data management can support research and innovation.

  • Mentor junior team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write scripts and configure platform integrations for customer engagements as needed.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for prospect meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or leadership in R&D.

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or materials science, ideally with a focus on machine learning or computational methods.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows and laboratory informatics.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based pre-sales approach.

  • Experience in R&D leadership at a large chemical or materials organization is preferred.

  • Python scripting skills are helpful, as is experience in technical management consulting.

  • Fluent English and advanced proficiency in the relevant local language for European-based candidates.

  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly, and work authorization in the US, UK, or Germany.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual salary range: $120,000 to $150,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid role based in Munich, Germany. London, UK, or New York, NY, may also be considered.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Please submit your application in English

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Grafikdesign – Meta Ads & Canva (m/w/d) | Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über BeginnerBudget

Wir sind ein junges Startup aus Hamburg und suchen kreative Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung unserer Werbeanzeigen für Instagram und Facebook. Du hast ein gutes Auge für Design, arbeitest gerne mit Canva und nutzt KI als kreatives Werkzeug? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Die Stelle umfasst 20–30 Stunden pro Monat und ist 100 % remote.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du erstellst statische Bildgrafiken für unsere Meta Ads auf Instagram und Facebook.

  • Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Gestaltungsvarianten, damit wir verschiedene Motive und Botschaften testen können.

  • Du arbeitest mit Canva und nutzt ChatGPT sowie weitere KI-Tools für Ideen und die Umsetzung.

  • Du bringst eigene Gestaltungsideen ein und denkst mit: Was fällt auf, vermittelt die Botschaft klar und spricht unsere Zielgruppe an?

  • Du setzt Feedback um und entwickelst bestehende Grafiken weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Social-Media-Grafiken gesammelt, idealerweise auch mit Werbeanzeigen.

  • Du kannst sicher mit Canva umgehen und hast Erfahrung mit ChatGPT oder anderen KI-Tools.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Layout, Typografie und Bildsprache sowie ein erstes Verständnis dafür, worauf es bei Meta Ads ankommt.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig, stellst Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben.

  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und teilst deine Ideen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • 100 % Homeoffice arbeiten.

  • Einen überschaubaren Umfang von 20–30 Stunden pro Monat, gut neben dem Studium.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, unsere Werbegrafiken mitzugestalten.

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Grafikdesign für digitale Werbung und im Einsatz von KI-Tools.

  • Vergütung zum jeweils geltenden gesetzlichen Mindestlohn.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Vergütung

Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei 13,90€ pro Stunde.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns eine kurze Vorstellung und ein paar Arbeitsproben – gerne Social-Media-Grafiken, Anzeigenmotive oder Projekte aus deinem Studium. Uns interessiert vor allem, wie du gestaltest und an kreative Aufgaben herangehst.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Projekten und IT: Sie analysieren bestehende Projektabläufe und gestalten deren Integration in innovative IT-Systeme

  • KI-Integration: Sie identifizieren und implementieren KI-Lösungen zur Prozesserleichterung und Automatisierung

  • Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Systeme:

  • CAS CRM

  • Microsoft SharePoint

  • AutoiXpert

  • BookStack

  • Microsoft Office 365

  • Serverlandschaft & Infrastruktur: Wartung und Störungsbehebung von

  • Terminalserver

  • NAS

  • Ubiquiti-Netzwerkumgebung

  • Telefonanlage (Innovaphone)

  • Client-Management: Verwaltung und Support der Hardware-Clients unserer Nutzer:innen

  • Überwachung und Umsetzung von IT-Sicherheit

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration, Informatikstudium o. Ä.)

  • Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit den o. g. bzw. vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-Lösungen in Geschäftsprozessen von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Kommunikationsstärke

Ihre Vorteile

  • Profitieren Sie von einer privaten Krankenzusatzversicherung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie regelmäßigen Gutscheinen und Mitarbeiterrabatten.

  • Nutzen Sie flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und Remote-Arbeiten sowie eine vollständige Home-Office-Ausstattung.

  • Der Arbeitsplatz ist barrierefrei zugänglich.

  • Sie erhalten ein Firmenhandy und einen Firmenlaptop für Ihre tägliche Arbeit.

  • Erleben Sie eine lockere Kleiderordnung und regelmäßige Teamevents sowie Firmenfeiern.

Ihre ersten Monate bei uns

In den ersten Monaten lernen Sie unsere IT-Infrastruktur im Detail kennen und übernehmen schrittweise die Betreuung der Systeme. Sie arbeiten sich in unsere internen Abläufe ein und unterstützen das Team bei ersten technischen Projekten.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us!

👋 About the Role

We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features.

This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly.

You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it.

What you will do

  • Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment.

  • Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need.

  • Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers.

  • Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans.

  • Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it.

  • Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable.

  • Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language.

  • Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security.

How we work

These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements.

  • Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach.

  • Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services.

  • Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected.

  • Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH

Die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH ist ein unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung mit Sitz in Kiel. Mit rund 30 Kolleginnen und Kollegen planen und begleiten wir spannende und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation. Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich.

Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten!

Deine Aufgaben - hier gestaltest du mit:

  • Du bringst unsere Planungen in die Praxis: Als Bauleiter (m/w/d) begleitest du anspruchsvolle Projekte der Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten funktionierende Anlagen werden.

  • Du hältst auf der Baustelle die Fäden zusammen: Du koordinierst die beteiligten Gewerke, stimmst dich direkt mit Bauherren, Architekten und ausführenden Unternehmen ab und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen für die Herausforderungen im Baualltag.

  • Du behältst den Überblick: Qualität, Termine und Kosten hast du im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte fachgerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du weißt, wovon du sprichst: Ob Ingenieur, Techniker oder Meister – du hast eine passende Qualifikation im Bereich der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung und kennst dich mit Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik aus.

  • Du kennst das Baustellenleben: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Bauleitung oder Objektüberwachung mit, weißt, worauf es bei der Umsetzung ankommt, und findest auch dann Lösungen, wenn es mal nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und vertrittst deine Standpunkte mit fachlicher Kompetenz und einem sicheren Auftreten – ohne dabei das partnerschaftliche Miteinander aus den Augen zu verlieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Wir finden, dass gute Arbeit auch ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld verdient. Deshalb setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und ein Miteinander, bei dem sich alle wohlfühlen können.

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, den du brauchst.

  • Gut ausgestattet und mobil: Firmenwagen, Smartphone und Laptop gehören ebenso dazu wie die Möglichkeit zum Bike-Leasing und Zuschüsse für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Fortbildungen, gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch und die Erfahrung deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Wohlfühlen statt Kleiderordnung: Bei uns zählt, was du kannst, nicht was du trägst. Dich erwarten ein barrierefreies Büro, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind willkommen.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

If a good conversation energizes you and closing a deal feels like a win, read on. As a Sales Specialist, you'll connect with business owners, learn what they pay to take cards and run orders today, and show them a better fit that saves them money every month.

You'll get full training up front, a step-by-step process to follow, and teammates who pick up when you call. This is a full-time role, and your pay is tied to performance, with bonuses for strong months, so each account you bring on counts.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with business owners and get the conversation going
  • Ask the right questions about their setup and costs
  • Recommend a payment and point-of-sale solution that fits how they work
  • Handle concerns with confidence and close the account
  • Check in after setup so every client is happy and running
  • Track your activity and next steps in the CRM

What We're Looking For

  • Outgoing and persuasive, comfortable asking for the sale
  • Reliable self-starter who keeps a strong pace
  • Coachable, curious and quick to adapt
  • Sales, customer service, retail or hospitality experience is a plus

What's Offered

  • Full-time position
  • Hands-on training and weekly coaching
  • A clear step-by-step process and a team behind you
  • Performance-based pay with monthly bonuses
  • Advancement based on results

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:
• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
• Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
• An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
• Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity
We are recruiting for a Clinical Site Lead to join our field team for the Indianapolis, Cincinnati, and Columbus territories. The Clinical Site Lead drives study execution and operational excellence across Abbott Cardiovascular therapies (Vascular, Cardiac Rhythm Management, EP, Structural Heart, and Heart Failure). This new team member is a recognized resource in protocol execution, increasing product and disease state knowledge, procedure support (as needed), procedure outcomes and early indication of trends, clinical trial enrollment, and ICH-GCP and clinical research application.
Additionally, adheres to specified site nomination, qualification, and startup processes. In this role you will lead ongoing training/retraining of all site stakeholders to ensure protocol adherence as well as continuously review, manage, and influence all aspects of site’s recruitment and data collection performance (enrollment, discrepancy resolution, compliance, etc.). The individual proactively utilizes appropriate operational metrics to minimize screen failure, attrition rate, etc. and monitors to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice, and accuracy standards inclusive of site initiation, periodic, and close-out visits.
They may also be consulted in the following areas: study design, site payments, site audits, local document review, study documents preparation, and submission to site or competent authority/ethics committee.

With limited direction from leadership:

Identify, develop, and maintain sites capable of delivering start-up goals, study participation levels and required data quality.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

ShareGate est un outil de confiance, adoré des partenaires qui réalisent des migrations Microsoft 365, et on veut maintenant faire passer ces relations d'une logique produit à une logique stratégique. À titre de Gestionnaire de comptes indirects, tu prends en charge un portefeuille défini de partenaires Premier et Elite en Amérique du Nord et tu deviens la personne responsable de leur croissance avec ShareGate. C'est un rôle axé sur les ventes avant tout : on cherche une personne avec une mentalité de chasseur.euse, qui va chercher le revenu avec ses partenaires plutôt que de simplement entretenir des comptes.

  • Prendre en charge ton portefeuille de partenaires Premier et Elite en bâtissant un plan de croissance pour chacun (objectifs, actions conjointes, indicateurs de succès), pour que les partenaires les plus performants passent à la vitesse supérieure, que les partenaires à fort potentiel décollent et que les partenaires sous-performants deviennent des comptes de croissance ;
  • Faire évoluer les relations d'une logique produit à une logique stratégique en tissant des liens à plusieurs niveaux (ventes, technique, direction) et en devenant le.la Sherpa ShareGate de tes partenaires, pour que ShareGate devienne le fournisseur de choix pour faire croître leur entreprise ;
  • Outiller les partenaires pour vendre plus et conclure plus vite en animant de la formation en vente et des sessions techniques avec l'équipe d'enablement, en mobilisant les bonnes ressources internes (technique, RevOps, ventes directes) au bon moment et en créant de la demande avec le marketing de canal, pour que plus de partenaires concluent des ventes ShareGate de façon autonome et qu'aucune occasion ne s'enlise faute de soutien ;
  • Ouvrir de nouvelles sources de revenus avec tes partenaires en repérant des projets de migration plus grands et plus complexes, en développant la migration de boîtes courriel (y compris le remplacement d'outils concurrents) et l'adoption de Protect, et en accélérant l'adoption des nouveaux programmes de partenaires dès leur lancement ;
  • Utiliser l'IA au quotidien pour la recherche de comptes, la planification avec les partenaires, les prévisions et les communications, pour consacrer ton temps aux conversations qui font avancer les ventes plutôt qu'à la préparation.

Ton équipe

jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

We’re looking for a Tier 1 SOC Analyst to join our team and handle initial triage, monitoring, and investigation of security alerts across cloud and endpoint environments.

This is a client-facing role requiring strong English, excellent verbal communication skills, and the ability to clearly communicate findings and escalations. The position is intended for candidates with at least 1 year of hands-on SOC / Security Operations experience.

The role is based on morning shifts aligned with East Asia working hours.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor security alerts from SIEM, EDR, and cloud platforms
  • Perform initial triage and classification of alerts as true or false positives
  • Investigate suspicious activities across endpoints, identities, and cloud environments
  • Escalate confirmed incidents to Tier 2 / Incident Response teams with proper context
  • Analyze logs from multiple sources, including CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs, OS logs, and other relevant security data sources
  • Document findings clearly in tickets and investigation reports
  • Follow existing playbooks and contribute to improving detection logic over time
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and clients regarding alerts, findings, and escalations

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in SOC / Security Operations
  • Hands-on experience with EDR tools such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
  • Understanding of networking basics, including IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ports, and related concepts
  • Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
  • Ability to analyze logs and identify suspicious behavior
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken — mandatory
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, especially in client-facing situations

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Knowledge of GCP / Google Cloud Platform — significant advantage
  • Ability to investigate cloud activity, including IAM, API calls, and resource changes
  • Understanding of identity-based attacks, such as token abuse and privilege escalation
  • Experience with scripting in Python or Bash

jobs.title: MuleSoft Integration Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
MuleSoft Integration Architect

Job Location: Remote (U.S.- based)

Travel Expectations: 0%

Job Classification:Temporary (W2T); Contractor (1099)

Join Centric Consulting – A Culture You’ll Love

At Centric Consulting, we've cultivated a unique approach to business. Our business is built on three fundamental principles: Enjoy the people you work with, have fun, and do great work. These principles define our consulting model and have crafted one of the most vibrant cultures in the consulting industry – celebrating individuals, collaboration, and lifelong friendships.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise integration solutions across a complex application ecosystem.
  • Establish scalable integration patterns, frameworks, and best practices to support long-term business and technology objectives.
  • Drive API-led connectivity initiatives using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, enabling secure, reusable, and high-performing integration services.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, product teams, and developers to translate business requirements into effective integration solutions.
  • Define integration architecture standards, governance processes, and technical roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout the full solution lifecycle, including architecture, design reviews, development guidance, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Design and implement integrations across cloud, on-premises, SaaS, and third-party applications.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet security, scalability, reliability, performance, and compliance requirements.
  • Mentor developers and integration engineers by promoting engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, integration approaches, and architectural patterns to continuously improve the organization's integration capabilities.
  • Collaborate across technical and business teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased operational efficiency.
  • Support project planning, estimation, and delivery activities to ensure successful implementation of integration initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with global teams while maintaining availability during U.S. business hours.

Who You Are:

  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Strong understanding of API-led architecture, service-oriented architecture (SOA), event-driven architecture, and modern integration patterns.
  • Experience architecting integrations across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Deep knowledge of MuleSoft components, including API Manager, Runtime Manager, Exchange, Design Center, and Anypoint Studio.
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, web services, and middleware-based integration solutions.
  • Strong understanding of security, authentication, authorization, and API governance standards, including OAuth, JWT, and related technologies.

jobs.title: Remote Call Center Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are hiring Remote Call Center Representatives to join our customer support team. This role is perfect for individuals who are passionate about helping others, enjoy working from home, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, providing exceptional service and support.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries in a professional manner.
  • Resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • Document all interactions accurately in the CRM system.
  • Follow communication scripts and standard operating procedures.
  • Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department when necessary.
  • Meet or exceed performance metrics including call quality, response time, and customer satisfaction.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Must be 18 years or older
  • High school diploma/GED
  • 1+ year of experience in a call center or customer service role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a remote setting.
  • Proficient with computers and customer service software.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.

You will collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to develop scalable ServiceNow capabilities, streamline asset management processes, and strengthen integrations across enterprise systems. We are seeking an entrepreneurial International B2B Business Development Manager to drive regional expansion by opening industrial accounts, presenting specialized technical solutions, and converting opportunities into recurring regional revenue.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end commercial growth within your assigned territory—targeting HVAC, industrial equipment, facilities, and mechanical sectors. This position is tailored for a technical sales "hunter" capable of building a durable customer ecosystem from the ground up.

  • New Revenue Development: Prospect, cold-outreach, and open doors across industrial accounts to generate and convert coating-project opportunities into collected revenue.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
CFRA's global fundamental equity research team produces independent, actionable research trusted by institutional investors, wealth advisors, and regulators worldwide. We're growing that team and looking for an Equity Research Analyst who brings intellectual curiosity, strong analytical skills, and a passion for financial markets.
Our team is organized by sector and collaborates closely with CFRA's forensic accounting, policy/legal, and technical research groups to deliver comprehensive, differentiated insights. Analysts have access to a suite of proprietary tools, including fundamental dashboards, standardized DCF models, forensic accounting diagnostic reports, and technical signals.
In this role, you will conduct and publish fundamental equity research for a global client base spanning institutional investors, wealth advisors, insurance companies, regulators, and professional service firms. Your work will cover qualitative and quantitative analysis across valuation, financial performance, competitive positioning, quality of earnings, and free cash flow, resulting in stock rating recommendations, sector and industry outlooks, and in-depth thematic research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the equity research team to produce and publish analysis on companies and industries

  • Publish stock reports, research notes, and in-depth actionable thematic and industry research
  • Build and maintain DCF models and comparable company analyses to determine whether a company's stock is overvalued or undervalued
  • Present findings through internal and external webinars and live events

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 2+ years in equity research or a comparable financial role, ideally with exposure to the Industrials/Materials sector.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; CFA candidacy or MBA is a significant plus.
  • Strong equity valuation analysis and financial modeling skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal skills for publishing research and presenting findings.
  • High intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines in a collaborative environment.

Benefits

  • 20 days of Vacation
  • 8 Sick Days
  • 1 paid volunteer day
  • 10-11 Holidays a year
  • Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance
  • Annual Performance Bonus
The base salary range for this position is $80,000 - $97,000. Compensation is determined by factors including experience, skills, and business needs. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $175,000 to $200,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of v...

Company Description

Candidly was founded in 2016 to flip the script on what it means to plan, borrow, repay, and save for college. Today, we’re the category leader with the market’s most comprehensive AI-driven student debt and savings optimization platform. We partner with hundreds of top employers, financial institutions, and retirement record keepers, positioning Candidly to serve more than 35 million Americans.

We’re already achieving incredible results — to date, we’ve helped our users get on track to eliminate more than $1.8B in student debt and pay off their loans 175,000 years quicker — and we’re seeking movers, shakers, innovators, and problem solvers to help take our mission even further.

Candidly is a high-growth, Series B startup, funded by leading investors including Altos Ventures, Aflac, Salesforce Ventures, UBS, Equal Opportunity Ventures, Impact Engine, Rethink Impact, Unum, and Cercano Management. Our fully remote, international team of 70 (and counting) includes alumni from Google, UBS, Twitter, Plaid, Prudential, LendingTree, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, and more.

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and forecast honestly

About the Service

Our client delivers specialised trauma-informed services, including regulated provision, supporting individuals with complex mental health needs within safe, structured environments.

The service is built on the belief that everyone is supportable with the right approach and deserves to live in a safe, caring, and empowering setting. Individuals are seen as more than their diagnosis or past experiences, with support focused on dignity, independence, and meaningful progress.

About the Role

As a Support Worker within the Specialised Trauma Service, you will support individuals experiencing complex and enduring mental health needs, including personality disorders, trauma, PTSD, self-harm behaviours, bipolar disorder, eating disorders, and schizophrenia.

This is a highly rewarding yet challenging role requiring resilience, emotional intelligence, and a strong understanding of trauma-informed practice. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team while remaining self-motivated and accountable for delivering high-quality, person-centred support.

Your focus will be on promoting independence, supporting individuals to achieve personal goals, maintaining safe living environments, and ensuring compliance with licence conditions where applicable.

  • Experience supporting individuals who have experienced trauma

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for a Student Retention Specialist to support students in their learning journey and help them stay committed to their educational goals.

This role is responsible for driving student engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction by building meaningful relationships, identifying potential challenges, and providing proactive support. You will work closely with students to help them stay motivated, overcome obstacles, and successfully achieve their educational goals.

What you will do

  • Engage with students through retention-focused calls and chats, addressing refund and cancellation requests with empathy and professionalism.
  • Identify the underlying reasons behind student dissatisfaction and provide personalized solutions to improve their experience and commitment.
  • Manage renewal and recurring payment conversations, proactively reaching out to students before their current term ends to support extensions and continued enrollment.
  • Consistently meet or exceed weekly retention (save rate) and renewal performance goals.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of all student interactions within CRM systems.
  • Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and continuous development initiatives to enhance performance and student outcomes.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in Retention, Customer Success, Sales, or another customer-facing role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal, as you'll be supporting English-speaking students.
  • Strong empathy, active listening, and relationship-building skills, with a genuine desire to help others succeed.
  • Comfortable working in a target-driven environment and meeting performance goals.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to remain calm and solution-oriented during challenging conversations.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage customer interactions and maintain accurate records.

What we can offer you

  • Clear performance expectations, fast feedback loops, and full ownership of your work and results.
  • Join a mission-driven company helping thousands of people transform their careers through education and technology.
  • A fast-paced environment built on accountability, ownership, and impact—without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely with a high level of autonomy, trust, and minimal micromanagement.
  • Collaborate with talented professionals from diverse backgrounds across tech, ed-tech, and other industries.
  • Work with platforms like Notion, Miro, Google Workspace, and other digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
  • Your work will directly contribute to improving student retention, engagement, and long-term success.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Compensation: 1,500 USD fix + performance-based bonus per month.
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday.
  • Working Hours: Approximately 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM CET (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Colombia time).
  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote.

Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented VP, Chief Audit Executive (CAE) to join our team!

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The CAE is responsible for the company’s Internal Audit function and audits of the company’s business. The CAE establishes a systematic, objective, and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness and efficiency of risk management, internal controls, compliance, governance, and operational processes. Leverages artificial intelligence, big data analytics and other technologies to make audits more effective, efficient, and agile. In addition, the CAE serves as the leader of the company’s Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Program Management Office (PMO), ensuring an integrated approach between internal audit activities, enterprise risk management, internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), and regulatory compliance. The CAE oversees the planning, coordination, execution, and reporting of the SOX 404 compliance program across the enterprise. The CAE reports from a functional standpoint to the Chairperson of the Audit & Risk Committee of the company’s Board of Directors, and from an administrative standpoint to the Chief Financial Officer.

  • Determines whether the company’s network of risk management, internal controls, and operational and governance processes is functioning such that: financial statements and managerial information are accurate, reliable, and timely.
  • Determines whether the company’s network of risk management, internal controls, and operational and governance processes is functioning effectively and provides oversight of the SOX PMO to support the design, documentation, testing, certification, and continuous improvement of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR). Risks to company objectives are identified and managed; effective interaction exists among governance groups; actions are in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures; activities are free of fraud and abuse; and resources are economically acquired, efficiently used, and adequately protected.

  • Selects audit subjects and objectives; determines the scopes of work and techniques required to accomplish audit objectives; and establishes audit frequency, timing, duration, and resource requirements.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. At Abbott Electrophysiology (EP), we’ve been a leader for over 20 years, pioneering one of the first mapping systems, introducing the first contact force ablation catheter and creating a portfolio of products trusted in millions of procedures around the world. We have and will continue to redefine what’s possible in an evolving and challenging EP landscape.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

As a Clinical Associate on the U.S. Abbott EP team, you will provide clinical and technical support in a hospital setting, utilizing EP technology in the treatment of various cardiac arrhythmias. You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal ...
