jobs.title: Atlassian Migration Engineer III
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Migration Engineer at the Level IV level to modernize enterprise Jira and Confluence environments and connect work management to development delivery pipelines for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. This role combines technical migration execution, scripting, API integration, automation engineering, and validation to move complex workloads to Atlassian Cloud with reliable data and minimal disruption.

The Atlassian Migration Engineer will evaluate source environments, use approved migration tooling, reconcile users and permissions, transform incompatible data and configurations, and verify results through repeatable testing. The engineer will also implement Jira automations and integrations linking GitHub repositories, work items, builds, and deployment status, collaborating closely with cloud architects, administrators, and security and identity teams.

This is not a copy-and-move-only role. Success requires diagnosing legacy configuration constraints, selecting safe remediation approaches, proving that critical links and histories remain usable, and creating clear cutover and recovery evidence. The ideal candidate pairs strong troubleshooting and scripting skills with disciplined change control and attention to operational handover.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory legacy Jira/Confluence projects, spaces, workflows, identities, marketplace apps, and integrations to assess migration readiness.
  • Plan and execute phased migrations with Jira Cloud Migration Assistant and other approved Atlassian migration tools.
  • Write and test migration scripts, bulk transformations, reconciliation checks, and post-cutover remediation procedures.
  • Design Jira automation, REST API interfaces, and Forge or ScriptRunner extensions where appropriate.
  • Connect GitHub repositories to Jira, enabling issue linkage, smart commits, and build/deployment visibility using approved integrations and GitHub Actions.
  • Document test plans, validation evidence, fallback options, migration defects, and technical handover artifacts.
  • Resolve migration blockers with security, identity, architecture, and customer teams.
  • Develop migration runbooks, source-to-target mappings, data-quality checks, acceptance criteria, defect logs, and cutover or rollback checkpoints.
  • Test migrations in nonproduction environments where available; compare record counts, histories, attachments, relationships, permissions, and workflows against approved baselines.
  • Use approved APIs and scripts for bulk corrections, automation, link repair, integration health checks, and reconciliation of post-migration issues.
  • Implement and verify GitHub-to-JCC issue links, smart commits where supported, and CI/CD build and deploy signals while protecting credentials and secrets.
  • Coordinate technical releases with change authorities and document repeatable procedures, integration ownership, monitoring, and maintenance responsibilities.

End User Computing (EUC) Engineer

Job Title: End User Computing (EUC) Engineer
Location: Remote – United States
Job Type: Full-Time
Experience: 2–6 Years
Salary Range: $75,000 – $115,000 per year
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Industry: Information Technology

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize enterprise end-user computing environments. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with desktop management, endpoint security, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), device management, and enterprise IT support solutions.

You will be responsible for ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient computing experiences for employees across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, deploy, and maintain end-user computing environments.

  • Manage Windows and macOS desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.

  • Administer Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM), and Active Directory.

  • Support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solutions such as Citrix and VMware Horizon.

  • Manage software installations, updates, patches, and endpoint configurations.

  • Implement endpoint security policies and device compliance standards.

  • Support Microsoft 365 applications, Teams, Outlook, and OneDrive.

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM.

  • Experience with endpoint management and device deployment.

  • Familiarity with Citrix, VMware Horizon, or other VDI technologies.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and administration.

  • Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

  • Understanding of endpoint security, patch management, and device compliance.

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and mobile device management (MDM).

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

  • Experience with macOS device management.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Performance-based bonuses (where applicable).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary:

The Senior Clinical Data Manager is responsible and manages all aspects of the clinical trial data management process from study start up to post database lock for assigned projects. Standard Operating Procedures / Work Instructions (SOPs/WIs); regulatory directives; study specific plans and guidelines will be followed. This position will also oversee and/or perform database development and testing.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Primary Data Management (DM) contact (Lead DM role) for assigned clinical project(s) / program(s), ensuring that there is back-up, continuity, responsiveness, and that tasks are performed in a timely manner. May support another Lead DM as a back-up and/or team member. May include DM oversight of sponsor programs.
  • Oversee project data entry process including development of data entry guidelines, training, data entry quality and resourcing
  • May perform quality control of data entry
  • Provide input, assesses and manage timelines. Ensure that clinical data management deadlines are met with quality. Assess resource needs for assigned projects, as needed.
  • Develop CRF specifications from the clinical study protocol and coordinate the review/feedback from all stakeholders
  • May assist in building clinical databases
  • Conduct database build UAT and maintain quality controlled database build documentation. Oversee overall quality of the clinical database.
  • May specify requirements for all edit check types e.g. electronic, manual data review, edit checks, etc. Oversee development of the edit check specifications and manual data review specifications
  • Responsible for creating, revising, appropriate versioning and maintaining data management documentation. Oversee completeness of data management documentation for the Trial Master File.
  • Train clinical research personnel on the study specific CRF, EDC, and other project related items as needed.
  • Review and query clinical trial data according to the Data Management Plan
  • Perform line listing data review based on the guidance provided by the sponsor and/or Lead DM
  • Run patient and study level status and metric reporting
  • Perform medical coding of medical terms relative to each other in order to ensure medical logic and consistency
  • Coordinate SAE/AE reconciliation
  • Liaises with third-party vendors such as external data and EDC vendors in a project manager capacity in support of timelines and data-related deliverables
  • May assist with SAS programming and quality control of SAS programs used in the Data Management department
  • Identify and troubleshoot operational problems, issues, obstacles, and barriers for studies based on metrics data, audit reports, and input from project team members and other stakeholders
  • May assist in reviewing and providing feedback on protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), if required by the project
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corresponding process documentation related to data management and database management activities
  • May attend strategy meetings, bid defense prep meetings, bid defenses, capability presentations, potential client engagement meetings
  • May review Request for Proposals (RFP), proposals, provide project estimates
  • Provide leadership for cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, where applicable
  • Trains and ensures that all data management project team members have been sufficiently trained
  • Communicate with study sponsors, vendors and project teams as needed regarding data, database or other relevant project issues

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sr. Business Development Manager, Combatant Commands & Department of War

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & SALES

Location

Remote (U.S.). Must live within commuting distance of a named customer hub: DC metro, Huntsville AL, Tampa FL, Colorado Springs CO, Dayton OH, St. Louis MO, Norfolk VA, or Omaha NE.

Employment Type

Full-Time

Clearance

Active Secret required; TS/SCI strongly preferred

Department

Growth

Compensation

$150,000–185,000 base (market band; final pending Finance confirmation)

About EarthDaily Federal

EarthDaily Federal is a geospatial intelligence company at the intersection of space, AI, and national security. Our products power mission-critical insights for federal agencies and prime contractors across defense, intelligence, environmental monitoring, and disaster response.

About the Role

This is a hunter seat covering the combatant commands and the Department of War enterprise. You will build pipeline across COCOM and department-level customers, run early capture against operational and theater requirements, and carry a number in a fast-moving, mission-driven market.

What You'll Do

  • Own pipeline development across the combatant commands and the Department of War (formerly Department of Defense) enterprise
  • Engage operational and theater customers to shape geospatial requirements and competitive positioning
  • Build and manage a disciplined pipeline with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting
  • Run early-stage capture across COCOM and department-level pursuits
  • Develop account plans aligned to combatant command priorities and DoW enterprise initiatives
  • Coordinate with sales engineering and proposal teams to advance qualified pursuits
  • Represent the company at defense industry events and customer engagements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of federal business development experience selling into DoD/Department of War or combatant command customers
  • Demonstrated quota attainment and pipeline ownership
  • Working knowledge of the federal acquisition process and DoW contract vehicles
  • Established relationships across combatant commands or department-level geospatial customers
  • Experience at startups or smaller companies with strong track records

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • Prior military service or COCOM staff experience
  • Existing relationships at one or more combatant commands
  • Capture management training (Shipley or equivalent)

Security Notice

In the course of their duties, EarthDaily Federal personnel may or may not have access to classified national security information or controlled unclassified information (CUI). All employees, regardless of role or clearance status, are required to handle such information in strict accordance with applicable U.S. Government laws and regulations, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (32 CFR Part 117), company security policies, and the terms of any individual clearance or access authorization. Unauthorized access, handling, or disclosure of classified information or CUI is strictly prohibited and must be reported immediately to the Facility Security Officer.

Salary: 140000 - 180000

jobs.title: Principal Security Consultant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zensec is one of the UK's fastest-growing cyber security providers. As part of the award-winning Zenzero Group, recognised as a Top 8 Technology Company at the British Business Awards 2026, a Deloitte Best Managed Company, and featured in the Sunday Times Hundred in both 2025 and 2026, we're helping ambitious organisations strengthen their security posture in an increasingly complex digital world.

Our mission is simple: to make cyber security practical, proactive, and effective for mid-market businesses. From managed detection and response, security operations, and threat monitoring to governance, risk, compliance, and security consulting, we help organisations stay secure, resilient, and ready for what's next.

Demand for cyber security expertise has never been greater, and neither has our ambition. As a certified B Corp and Scale Up Award winner, we believe high growth and high standards go hand in hand. We're building a business where talented people can do meaningful work, make a real impact, and help shape the future of cyber security.

Fast growth. High standards. Real impact. If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to hear from you.


About the Role
As a Principal Security Consultant, you will lead high-impact digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) engagements for clients facing some of today's most challenging cyber threats, including ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), and ClickFix attacks. Acting as the senior technical lead throughout the incident lifecycle, you will guide investigations from initial triage through containment, forensic analysis, recovery, and final reporting.

Working within the DFIR Forensics team, you will collaborate with incident managers, SOC specialists, account teams, insurers, legal partners, and client leadership. This is an opportunity to shape investigation methodology, strengthen tooling, mentor consultants, and influence the development of a growing cyber security practice.

Success in this role means delivering exceptional client outcomes, providing trusted technical leadership during live incidents, developing team capability, and continuously improving forensic processes and services.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end incident response engagements involving ransomware, BEC, and ClickFix attacks.
  • Own forensic investigations across Windows environments, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure, and endpoint platforms.
  • Drive the production of executive-level and technical reports that clearly communicate root cause, attacker activity, and business impact.
  • Advise clients on containment strategies, recovery planning, and security improvement actions during live incidents.
  • Mentor and coach consultants and analysts, raising technical capability across the DFIR team.
  • Build and enhance forensic tooling, playbooks, investigation timelines, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned methodologies.
  • Partner with pre-sales and business development teams to support scoping discussions and client proposals.

Requirements

Essential
  • Proven ability to lead complex DFIR investigations and manage client-facing incident response engagements.
  • Deep understanding of ransomware intrusion lifecycles and adversary tradecraft.
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft 365 and BEC investigations, including audit log analysis and identity compromise scenarios.
  • Advanced knowledge of Windows host forensics, evidence collection, event log analysis, and memory analysis techniques.
  • Experience presenting technical findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, judgement, and decision-making skills under pressure.
  • Degree-level education in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.
Desirable
  • Experience supporting insurer-led or legally privileged investigations...

jobs.title: Senior ROR Product Technical Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior ROR Product Technical Support Engineer
Location: Remote

Note: Candidates must be willing and comfortable to work night shifts.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Product Technical Support Engineer with strong hands-on debugging and problem-solving skills to support and troubleshoot a large-scale Ruby on Rails monolithic application. You will work across the application, database, integrations, and hosting layers to diagnose complex production issues and ensure a reliable customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
· Troubleshoot complex production issues across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, background jobs, APIs, and third-party integrations using logs, stack traces, database queries, and debugging tools.
· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams to drive issues to resolution.
· Diagnose PostgreSQL issues including slow queries, data inconsistencies, database locks/deadlocks, connection issues, indexing, and data-related problems.
· Troubleshoot REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data synchronization, and third-party integrations, including Stripe and AWS S3.
· Support and troubleshoot applications hosted on Heroku, including dynos, workers, deployments, configuration/environment variables, logs, build failures, and application performance.
· Investigate Stripe payment, subscription, refund, and webhook-related issues, including discrepancies between Stripe and application data.
· Analyze customer-reported issues, trace problems through the application and database layers, reproduce issues, and provide appropriate fixes or workarounds.
· Make small-to-medium code fixes, SQL queries, scripts, configuration changes, and production fixes where required.
· Monitor recurring production issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve application stability, performance, monitoring, and support processes.
· Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and RCA reports.

Required Skills & Experience:
· 4+ years of experience in technical support, application support, production support, or a similar engineering role.
· Strong hands-on experience with Ruby/Ruby on Rails and debugging web applications.
· Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL, including query analysis and troubleshooting.
· Experience with Heroku or similar cloud application hosting platforms.
· Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
· Experience working with AWS S3 and cloud-based services.
· Familiarity with Stripe APIs, payments, subscriptions, and webhooks is highly desirable.
· Working knowledge of Git, background jobs, caching, Linux/Unix, and application performance troubleshooting.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
· Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams.

Good to Have:
· Experience supporting large monolithic Rails applications in production.
· Experience with monitoring/logging tools and production incident management.
· Familiarity with CI/CD, automated deployments, and application performance monitoring.
· Experience writing scripts or automation to reduce repetitive support and troubleshooting activities.

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Solution Architect at the Senior level to design secure, scalable enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) technology modernization initiatives. This role combines solution architecture, cloud migration strategy, identity and access integration, Jira and Confluence in Commercial Cloud governance, and technical leadership to establish sustainable platform standards for diverse teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
What's the Vibe?
Our founders started Creative Force with a single goal in mind: to build industry-leading software with really cool people.
As we’ve grown, we’ve stayed true to that vision. Our products are ushering in a new era of creative operations for some of the world’s largest brands and retailers.
And all along the way, hiring great people has remained a critical business priority...
...See, we have this crazy idea that effective collaboration is THE skill of the future and critical to our success. As a remote company with staff across the globe, we've seen firsthand how important it is for our teams to work well together.
And that's why we focus on hiring talented people who are also great to work with.
That means we don't always hire the people with the most experience. Some of us have PhDs. Others have spent multiple decades working at the top of our field. But we've also hired former tennis coaches, film students, photographers, hotel front desk workers, freelance travel agents, and fashion designers.
While our backgrounds are diverse, we all share a few important traits:
  • We love solving challenging problems.
  • We're passionate about the work we do.
  • And we're the kind of good humans who make you look forward to that morning coffee chat, who bring positive energy to every meeting, who go the extra mile to support one another, and who make work feel a little less like work.
But hey, there are lots of job posts out there that are cool and vibey and explain how unique their company culture is (look, a ping-pong table!). We know, we’ve seen them. Some might be truer than others. As for us, we think you’ll notice the good vibes the first time we chat.

What we offer YOU

  • A fast-growing, exciting, and fun scaleup environment — with multiple international Employer Awards — and not those awards you can pay for, but the kind of awards given based on Employee reviews. It just doesn’t get any better than that. 💜
  • A flat and transparent organizational structure — no bureaucratic red tape. Your ideas and initiatives will be heard and embraced!
  • True work-life balance — we see our team members as people, not numbers, and know that a balanced personal and professional life is critical to happiness and long-term fulfillment
  • A collaborative international environment with colleagues across Europe and USA
  • A growing Technical Success function with opportunities to influence processes, strategy, and customer experience
  • A vibrant work culture grounded in the belief that we’re better together
  • Company trips and events, and much more!

What’s the Role?

Still interested? Awesome. Here's the deal:

At Creative Force, we work with some of the world's biggest brands and retailers. Our customers operate at scale, move fast, and rely on our platform to power complex creative workflows across teams, regions, and markets.

And that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to become the trusted technical partner for our Enterprise customers throughout their entire journey with Creative Force.

jobs.title: PDF Accessibility Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: PDF Accessibility Specialist (Freelance / Independent Contractor)

Hours: 5–20 hours per week (Flexible / Remote – Philippines Timezone Preferred)

Overview:

Promet Source is seeking an Independent PDF Accessibility Specialist to consult with our clients on PDF accessibility best practices and remediate documents to meet WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA standards. This role ensures that all PDF content is fully usable by individuals relying on assistive technologies, including screen readers.

Responsibilities:

  • Remediate PDFs for accessibility, including tagging, reading order, alternative text, headings, tables, forms, and bookmarks.
  • Test documents using screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) and automated tools (Adobe Acrobat Accessibility Checker, PAC, CommonLook).
  • Convert scanned or image-based PDFs into accessible, searchable documents using OCR.
  • Review source files (Word, InDesign, PowerPoint) and recommend upstream accessibility fixes to streamline remediation.
  • Conduct accessibility audits and produce VPAT/ACR documentation as needed.
  • Track and prioritize remediation tasks across a document backlog while consistently meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Stay current on WCAG 2.1/2.2, Section 508, ADA, and PDF/UA requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience remediating PDFs for accessibility compliance.
  • In-depth working knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA guidelines and Section 508 standards.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat Pro, AEM Designer (tagging, reading order, form design), and automated accessibility testing tools.
  • Practical familiarity with screen reader testing and assistive technology.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high-volume document workload.
  • IAAP certification (CPACC, WAS, or CPWA) is highly preferred.

Preferred Experience:

  • Remediating complex structures, including interactive forms, multi-page tables, charts, and multi-column layouts.
  • Working with source authoring tools (Microsoft Word, Adobe InDesign, PowerPoint) using accessible-by-design principles.

We are an equal opportunity organization. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We are an organization of builders guided by deep technical density. You will use our Leadership Principles, like Dive Deep and Make it Great, to solve high-impact distribution problems and build the systems of our next decade.

We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. You will be at the forefront of our AI-First pivot, designing highly scalable, resilient systems capable of supporting low-latency conversational journeys, heavy microservices orchestration, and real-time ML processing.

Our Tech Stack: We work with Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Python, React, and more, primarily hosted on AWS. Our daily workflow also incorporates various AI tools, including Claude Code.

Don't worry if you haven't mastered our exact stack. We value strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and an engineering mindset over specific technology experience.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Be responsible for the entire software development lifecycle: definition, development, testing, production, and maintenance. Adopt an "owner's mindset", creating observability and taking proactive actions on post-mortems.
  • Quality Guardian: Be a guardian of your team's delivery quality by reinforcing the adoption of excellent software development practices, participating rigorously in code and design reviews.
  • Mentorship: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, raising the technical bar of your team and sharing knowledge across our teams.

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corps, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

Are you ready to make a meaningful impact in the solar industry? As a Customer Experience Specialist at Omnidian, you'll play a pivotal role in managing high-sentiment escalations and ensuring our customers receive a path to total system recovery. In this role, you will be the main point of contact for escalated customer escalations, helping them find a clear path to getting their solar systems back up and running. Combining deep technical solar expertise with empathetic communication. You will report to the Customer Experience Manager and act as a central hub, coordinating with internal teams to resolve routine friction and keep the planet’s energy assets performing at their best.

    • Technical Solar Expert

Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don’t just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself.

  • Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here.
  • Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here.
  • Learn more about our Core Values here.

Role Objective

The Sales Attorney is a client-facing role that sits at the intersection of legal expertise and consultative sales. This position is responsible for conducting strategy sessions with prospective clients, assessing their immigration situation, and guiding qualified individuals toward retaining the firm's services. The ideal candidate is a licensed attorney in Mexico with a strong command of immigration law, a genuine empathy for the communities we serve, and a proven ability to close.

This is not a traditional legal practice role - it is a client-facing position where legal expertise and genuine human connection work together. Success in this role means helping people understand their options clearly, building trust from the very first conversation, and guiding qualified individuals toward the support they need - same day.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Conduct strategy sessions as the primary daily activity (4–5 hours/day) - assess each client's immigration situation, explain available pathways, and present the firm's services with clarity and confidence.
  • Complete priming calls and proposal preparation before each strategy session to ensure readiness and maximize conversion.
  • Close contracts, collect payments, and book client onboarding appointments on the same day as hire - same-day close is the standard.
  • Execute timely follow-up calls on all pending and undecided clients from prior strategy sessions - no potential client is left without a follow-up.
  • Ensure complete and accurate handoff to the Legal team for every retained client - documentation, onboarding checklist, and case details transferred without gaps.
  • Maintain accurate records of all client interactions, session outcomes, and pipeline activity in the firm's CRM.
  • Meet and exceed individual session conversion targets and monthly retention goals.

Requirements

  • Licensed attorney in Mexico in good standing - required; Licenciatura en Derecho and Cédula Profesional required.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English - native-level Spanish required; strong English communication skills essential for collaboration with US-based leadership.
  • Knowledge of immigration law - ability to assess client eligibility, explain case types, and identify viable pathways with confidence.
  • Demonstrated success in a sales or client conversion role - track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a performance-based environment.

jobs.title: Sales Project
jobs.descriptionHtml: Tentang Perusahaan PT Sinar Lampu Indonesia (Sanwa Group) Merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Lampu Hias, Perusahaan melayani kebutuhan pelanggan baik untuk proyek maupun konsumen, serta berhubungan dengan berbagai pihak seperti kontraktor, developer, dan pelanggan potensial. Ini adalah posisi Sales di bidang desain interior dan renovasi, dengan fokus pada mencari pelanggan baru, menjaga hubungan dengan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta mengelola proyek di sektor perumahan, komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan :** 1. Mencari pelanggan baru, mempertahankan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta melakukan follow-up terhadap proyek perumahan, lokasi komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. 2. Mengunjungi lokasi proyek, melakukan pengukuran, mencatat kondisi ruangan dan pekerjaan, membuat penawaran harga (quotation), serta menangani pesanan. 3. Melayani pelanggan di showroom/pameran, memberikan pelayanan, serta mendampingi pelanggan untuk melihat sampel dan memilih produk. 4. Melakukan follow-up terhadap proses produksi, pemasangan/instalasi, dan masalah setelah penjualan (after-sales), serta segera melaporkannya kepada manajemen. 5. Membuat laporan pekerjaan harian, termasuk follow-up pelanggan, kondisi lokasi proyek, pelanggan baru yang diperoleh, serta rencana pekerjaan untuk hari berikutnya. 6. Menjaga kerahasiaan informasi pelanggan, sistem harga, dan materi/produk perusahaan. **Kualifikasi Pekerjaan :** 1. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK. 2. Memiliki pengalaman 1–3 tahun di bidang sales, lebih disukai yang memiliki pengalaman di bidang interior. 3. Memahami penjualan B2B dan B2C serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. 4. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile/outdoor (banyak bekerja di lapangan). 5. Bersedia lembur apabila diperlukan. 6. Jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

teknis untuk menyusun **Functional Specification Document (FSD)**. * Melakukan **analisis gap** antara kebutuhan bisnis dengan sistem yang ada. * Mendukung proses **UAT (User Acceptance Test)** jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.23 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000418* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical. Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** FINNS Beach Club is looking for a talented individual who is passionate about digital design, user experience, and visual craftsmanship. We are currently seeking a UI/UX Designer to join our growing marketing team and shape the digital presence of one of the world’s most iconic destinations. **Summary** FINNS World's Best Beach Club is not just a beach club; it's a destination where dreams come alive! We pride ourselves on creating exhilarating entertainment, vibrant energy, and unforgettable F&B experiences. Nestled along the breathtaking Bali coastline, we provide a one-of-a-kind party atmosphere that leaves our guests craving for more. **Responsibilities** * Craft intuitive, engaging, and visually stunning user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, bringing unique brand campaigns to life with strong visual craftsmanship. * Build, expand, and maintain scalable Design Systems and component libraries to ensure visual consistency across all digital touchpoints. * Collaborate closely with Web Developers, Marketing teams, and various departments across FINNS to ensure seamless design handoffs and technical feasibility. * Analyse feedback, analytics, and UI/UX trends to continually optimise digital journeys and conversion rates. * Establish design standards, guidelines, and best practices for the company's digital ecosystem. **Qualifications** * Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role. * Strong written and spoken communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Strong mastery of Figma, including advanced features such as Design Tokens, Auto-Layout, Components, and Prototyping. * Proven hands-on experience in building, documenting, and managing Design Systems and component libraries (Figma, tokens, auto-layout, etc.). * Solid understanding of user-centred design principles and responsive web design. * Basic-to-intermediate understanding of UX Writing, with the ability to write functional copy. * Basic understanding of HTML/CSS capabilities and technical constraints for smooth dev-handoffs. * Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design sense, end-to-end UX processes, and design system. * Excellent problem-solving skills, visual accuracy, and strong attention to detail. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. Work Location: In person

jobs.company: WowSuite, DFO Performance, OnPoint Health Media & Tech
jobs.descriptionHtml: **CONVERSION RATE OPTIMIZATION (CRO) SPECIALIST - AI FIRST** **Company:** WowSuite **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia **Type:** Full-time, Remote **Team:** CRO / Growth / Creative **THE ROLE** WowSuite is hiring a hands-on CRO Specialist to improve the commercial performance of ecommerce, lead-generation, subscription and telehealth funnels. We run Meta, Taboola and Outbrain style funnels, including presell pages, index pages, checkouts and upsells. Most of our traffic is paid and mobile. This is not a basic "button color" CRO role or a pure design role. You will use data, customer behavior, AI and experimentation to identify where funnels lose money, determine why, and decide what to test next. This is an AI-first role. AI should be part of your normal workflow for research, analytics, testing, QA and reporting. Copy and design skills are a strong bonus, but not the main requirement. **MAIN GOAL** Increase profitable revenue from the traffic we already have. jobs.title: Villa Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Location: Pecatu, Uluwatu - Bali Employment Type: Full Time About the Position: We are looking for a proactive, communicative, and hospitality-oriented Villa Sales, Reservation & Operations Officer to manage daily villa operations while supporting sales, reservations, OTA management, and guest relations. This position is suitable for someone who can work independently, is comfortable communicating with guests, and has a strong understanding of hospitality operations and online booking platforms. Key Responsibilities 1. OTA & Reservation Manage villa listings and reservations through OTA platforms such as Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Expedia, etc. Monitor room availability, rates, promotions, and inventory. Respond to guest inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle booking confirmations, cancellations, modifications, and special requests. Maintain an accurate reservation calendar and prevent double bookings. Follow up with potential guests to convert inquiries into bookings. Prepare daily/weekly reservation reports. 2. Sales & Revenue Generate direct bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram, website, referrals, and other channels. Follow up leads and potential customers. Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, and local partners. Promote villa packages and special offers. Upsell additional services such as airport transfers, breakfast, BBQ, tours, transportation, etc. Achieve agreed monthly occupancy and revenue targets. Monitor competitor rates and market conditions. 3. Guest Relations & Concierge Communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay. Coordinate check-in and check-out arrangements. Assist guests with transportation, restaurant reservations, tours, activities, and other requests. Handle guest complaints professionally and coordinate solutions. Ensure guests receive a positive and personalized experience. Follow up on guest feedback and online reviews. 4. Villa Operations Conduct daily villa readiness and operational checks. Ensure the villa and public areas are clean, presentable, and guest-ready. Coordinate with Housekeeping, Maintenance, Garden, and Pool teams. Monitor amenities, linen, guest supplies, and operational inventory. Report maintenance issues and follow up on completion. Ensure operational standards are maintained. Assist management in implementing SOPs and improving guest experience. 5. Public Area Monitoring Monitor cleanliness and presentation of entrance, pool area, garden, terrace, parking area, and other public areas. Coordinate cleaning and maintenance requirements. Ensure all public areas are safe, clean, and ready for guests. Requirements Minimum education: SMA/SMK/Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel, villa, resort, reservation, sales, or hospitality operations. Experience handling OTA platforms is preferred. Good knowledge of reservation processes and hospitality operations. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic Excel. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Able to coordinate multiple operational tasks. Target-oriented and willing to work with sales targets. Well-groomed, professional, friendly, and service-oriented. Willing to work weekends, public holidays, and according to villa operational requirements. Having a valid driving license and own transportation is an advantage. Key Skills Must Have OTA management Reservation handling Guest communication Basic sales skills English communication Microsoft Office / Google Workspace Problem solving Operational coordination Preferred Booking.com / Agoda / Airbnb experience PMS experience Revenue management knowledge Travel agent/networking experience Social media and digital marketing knowledge Experience in villa operations Work Location: In person

Posisi ini cocok bagi individu yang senang berinteraksi dengan orang lain, membangun hubungan baik dengan pelanggan, serta berkontribusi terhadap pertumbuhan bisnis perusahaan melalui aktivitas penjualan dan pelayanan pelanggan. Work Location: In person

Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We are here to help enterprise businesses transform the way people work— while growing top-line revenue for Apple. To realize this goal, we gain deep understandings of the businesses we manage—at all levels from tactical to strategic. jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it. At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey. The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap. The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core. Description Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation. Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities. Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations. Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification. Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments. Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership. Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews. Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption. Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners. Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation. jobs.title: Robotics Operator - Working Student (20hrs / week)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
sensmore is a Berlin/Potsdam-based robotics startup delivering production-proven automation for industries where the world’s raw materials are extracted, moved, and processed. Its automation system transforms heavy machines into intelligent, automated robots powered by Physical AI and vertically integrates them into the full production environment: from the machine and safety infrastructure to network infrastructure, site processes, and operational interfaces.

Co-developed with customers, sensmore is backed by Point Nine Capital, leading industry investors, the State of Brandenburg, and the European Union.

Responsibilities

Robot Operation & Safety Supervision:
Operate and supervise our autonomous machines during training and testing sessions, mainly remotely from the office and occasionally on site. Act as the safety supervisor, monitoring every run closely and stepping in when something doesn’t look right.

Readiness Checks & Documentation:
Complete pre-operation checklists to confirm each machine is safe and ready to run. Keep clear, accurate records of sessions, incidents and anomalies.

Technical Troubleshooting:
Monitor systems during operation, carry out first-line checks and collect the data our engineers need. Escalate issues with concise, well-structured reports.

Testing Support:
Help run test sessions, log results and feed your observations back to the engineering team to improve machine performance and test procedures.

What You Bring

  • Currently enrolled at a university

  • A valid driving licence, held for at least 2 years, and confidence behind the wheel (mandatory)

  • A responsible, safety-conscious approach to every task

  • Diligent, thorough and well organised, with a strong troubleshooting mindset

  • Technical understanding: you’re a PC power user

  • Flexibility on shift patterns, including evenings, fitting around your studies

Nice to have

  • Solid technical understanding: comfortable working in the terminal / Linux, ideally with experience of observability tools (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus)

  • Experience with heavy machinery or construction equipment

  • A deeper understanding of testing processes

  • Willingness to work night shifts

What We Offer:

  • Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

  • Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

  • Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

  • Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

  • Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment


Benefits:

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Commercial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

At ClickUp, we’re building an AI-powered workspace that brings tasks, docs, chat, and AI-enabled workflows together so teams can spend less time switching tools and more time making progress. Our mission is to make the world more productive. Within Solutions Engineering & Customer Enablement, this role connects complex customer needs to practical product solutions, helping prospects and customers evaluate how ClickUp can support their workflows and business goals.

 

As a customer-facing technical partner to Sales and Success, you’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, and turn technical questions into clear next steps. You’ll help customers see what’s possible with ClickUp while keeping recommendations grounded in real workflows, integration needs, and adoption considerations.

 

Mission

 

Help prospects and customers understand how ClickUp can solve meaningful workflow and productivity challenges through strong technical discovery, practical solution design, and credible guidance throughout the buying journey.

 

What You’ll Accomplish

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager | Integrations & AI Foundations (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for Integrations & AI Foundations, you're the product owner for bunch's integration and AI platform. You have two kinds of customers: external developers and fund-manager teams connecting to bunch, and the internal product teams building on top of what this team provides.

Integrations & AI Foundations is a new platform squad. It owns the infrastructure that lets data move securely between bunch and other systems, and lets every other product team build AI capabilities — extraction, retrieval, agents and evaluations — without each one solving the same hard problems again.

The team covers five connected areas:

  • Integrations / API layer — API contracts, authentication, versioning and deprecation, rate limits, uptime and SLA, and a Developer Portal

  • MCP layer — agent-callable tools built as thin wrappers over the same API contracts, including a customer-facing MCP offering

  • Document Parsing — a reusable ingestion, decomposition and extraction pipeline, with human-in-the-loop review and accuracy monitoring

  • Retrieval / RAG — chunking, embedding, vector store and retrieval, with access control enforced on every query, offered as a callable service

  • AI Agentic Layer — the agent framework, memory, guardrails, evaluation harness, observability and agent registry other teams use to ship their own agents

Document extraction, agent workflows, evaluations and multi-provider model fallback under EU data residency are already in production.

Fund managers don't want to retype data that already lives in their own systems, and they want to pull their bunch data into their own tools and their own AI. Customers and prospects ask for APIs, CRM and accounting syncs, automated exports of capital accounts, and MCP access.

You'll turn those signals into a coherent platform: one that customers integrate with, and that our own product teams build on, instead of a string of one-off builds.

You will:

  • Set platform strategy and sequencing across the five areas: decide how to slice the work and what ships first

  • Run APIs as a product: contracts, versioning and deprecation policy, rate limits, SLAs, Developer Portal and documentation, and time-to-integrate as a measure you actively drive down

  • Define and launch the customer-facing MCP offering: which capabilities get exposed, tool descriptions that agents actually invoke correctly, and a security review gate for anything customers touch

  • Generalise document parsing: the first use case is already live; your goal will be to take it over and generalise it so more teams can reuse its logic

Hast du schon mal eine Person eingestellt und gewusst: Diese eine Entscheidung verändert die ganze Firma?

Hast du schon mal erlebt, wie eine einzige falsche Besetzung ein kleines Team um Monate zurückwirft?

Und hast du dir schon mal gewünscht, nicht die 30. Rolle des Jahres abzuarbeiten, sondern bei jeder Einstellung wirklich mitzugestalten, wohin ein Unternehmen wächst?

Bei FINE DINE ist jede Einstellung genau das: ein Hebel. Wir sind heute 11 Leute und wachsen auf 15 bis 20. Bis 2030 wollen wir die FINE DINE Box in mehr als 100 Städte in Europa bringen. Jede Person, die du zu uns holst, entscheidet mit darüber, ob uns das gelingt. Du suchst aus, wer diesen Weg mit uns geht.

Was uns wirklich ausmacht: Wir drei Founder denken seit Jahren an kaum etwas anderes als an FINE DINE. Bei uns zählt das Ergebnis, nicht wie viele Stunden jemand im Büro sitzt oder wie schön eine Präsentation aussieht. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Wege sind kurz, und du arbeitest direkt mit uns Foundern zusammen. Du arbeitest People & Culture bei uns nicht in einem bestehenden System ab. Du baust es auf.

Bist du an Bord?

🇩🇪🇨🇭 Bereits in 17 Städten in Deutschland und der Schweiz vertreten.

👨‍🍳😋 Wir vermitteln jährlich mehr als 250.000 Restaurantbesuche.

👔✍🏻 Erfolgreiche Finanzierungsrunde 2022 mit renommierten Investoren.

🏢🗞️ Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Deutschlands größten Medienhäusern (Süddeutsche Zeitung, F.A.Z. etc.).

Aufgaben

  • Recruiting Ownership: Du verantwortest das Recruiting für ca. 5 Rollen pro Jahr, strategisch und operativ. Von der Bedarfsklärung mit uns Foundern über Stellenanzeigen und strukturierte Interviews bis zum Angebot.
  • Active Sourcing: Du findest Key-Hires per Direktansprache über LinkedIn und dein Netzwerk, in der Region Ulm und darüber hinaus.
  • Recruiting-System: Du baust das Fundament für schnelles und nachhaltiges Recruitment auf: Pipeline, Scorecards, Interviewleitfäden und KPIs wie Time-to-Hire, Response-Rate und Conversion.
  • Sparringspartner für die Founder: Du berätst deine Hiring Manager auf Augenhöhe und mit Daten.
  • Employer Branding & Content: Du machst FINE DINE als Arbeitgeber sichtbar. Du baust unsere LinkedIn-Präsenz von null auf, postest regelmäßig über Team, Kultur und unseren Alltag, holst das Team mit ins Boot und schreibst Stellenanzeigen, die zeigen, wer wir wirklich sind.
  • Onboarding & Ansprechperson: Du bist Ansprechperson für unser Team und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen schnell ankommen und ab Tag 1 produktiv sind.
  • People Operations: Du stimmst dich mit unserem Steuerbüro und der Lohnbuchhaltung ab und bist die erste Ansprechperson für alle HR-Themen im Team.

Qualifikation

  • Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Recruiting mit, idealerweise in-house in einem Start-up oder Scale-up in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern oder in einer Personalberatung.
  • Active Sourcing: Direktansprache ist dein Steckenpferd. Du schreibst Nachrichten, auf die Menschen antworten, und kennst deine Conversion-Raten von Outreach bis Hire.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst mehr als „nur“ Recruiting und hast Lust, dir neue Themen wie Employer Branding, Payroll oder Onboarding eigenständig zu erarbeiten.
  • Eigenverantwortung & Speed: Du arbeitest schnell, hands-on und eigenverantwortlich. Du lieferst in Tagen, nicht in Wochen, und misst dich an Ergebnissen statt an Aktivitäten.
  • Datenkompetenz & Kommunikation: Du steuerst nach Zahlen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl, und hast Zielwerte wie Time-to-Hire im Kopf.
  • Stressresistenz: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn mehrere Prozesse und Projekte parallel laufen und ein Wunschkandidat kurzfristig absagt.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du bist seit Jahren im Außendienst unterwegs und kennst jede Autobahnraststätte zwischen Hamburg und München?

Du weißt, wie man in fünf Minuten das Vertrauen eines Gastronomen gewinnt, der eigentlich keine Zeit hat?

Und du hast Lust, nicht mehr Kisten, Kühlschränke oder Regalplätze zu verkaufen, sondern ein Konzept, auf das sich Restaurants freuen?

Dann suchen wir genau dich. Bei FINE DINE gewinnst du die besten Restaurants und Hotels in ganz DACH als Partner für die FINE DINE Box. Jedes Jahr entsteht eine neue Edition mit 12 Partnerrestaurants und einem Hotelpartner pro Stadt. Aktuell sind wir in 17 Städten, nächstes Jahr sollen es 25 sein.

Bist du an Bord?

🎁🎟 Mit der FINE DINE® Box verbinden wir Top-Restaurants und Genießer.

🇩🇪🇨🇭 Bereits in 17 Städten in Deutschland und der Schweiz vertreten.

👨‍🍳😋 Wir vermitteln jährlich mehr als 250.000 Restaurantbesuche.

👔✍🏻 Erfolgreiche Finanzierungsrunde 2022 mit renommierten Investoren.

🏢🗞️ Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Deutschlands größten Medienhäusern (Süddeutsche Zeitung, F.A.Z. etc.).

Aufgaben

  • Aufbau der Edition: Du verantwortest den Aufbau der neuen Edition in deinen Städten
  • Bestandspartner & Verlängerungen: Du führst nachhaltige Beziehungen zu unseren Partnern und stellst Verlängerungen sicher
  • Akquise von neuen Partnern: Unser Backoffice vereinbart die Termine und du überzeugst neue Partner direkt vor Ort. Dabei triffst du auf die unterschiedlichsten Persönlichkeiten.
  • Außendienst von Februar bis Mai: In dieser Zeit überzeugst du unsere Partner persönlich vor Ort in den unterschiedlichen Städten, die du betreust.
  • B2B-Partnerschaften: Von Oktober bis Dezember gewinnst du große Unternehmen ab 500 Mitarbeitenden als Partner flexibel aus dem Büro oder Home Office.

Qualifikation

  • Außendiensterfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre im Außendienst oder Vertrieb mit vielen persönlichen Kundenterminen gearbeitet, z. B. im Getränkevertrieb, im FMCG-Bereich oder in der Betreuung von Handel oder Gastronomie.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Punktuell fünf Tage am Stück in einer anderen Stadt sein kennst du schon und freust dich darauf.
  • Neukunden & Bestandskunden: Du bringst sowohl Erfahrung in der Neukundenakquise als auch im kommerziellen Account Management mit
  • Überzeugungskraft: Du überzeugst mit guten Argumenten und einer starken Präsentation, nicht mit Druck.
  • Hartnäckigkeit & Resilienz: Du fasst auch zum zehnten Mal freundlich nach. Eine Absage ruiniert dir nicht den Tag.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du behältst bei vielen Terminen, Fahrzeiten und mehreren Städten den Überblick und pflegst dein CRM sauber.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch.

Benefits

  • Termine statt Klinkenputzen: Keine Lead-Recherche, keine Kaltbesuche bei Restaurants. Du gehst in vorbereitete Termine, viele davon mit Partnern, die uns schon kennen.
  • Starke Basis: Die Empfehlungen kommen von Gastronomie-Experten, die KI prüft vor und das Backoffice vereinbart deine Termine. Du konzentrierst dich auf die Gespräche.
  • Impact: Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle. Ohne Key Account Management kommt unser Produkt nicht zustande.
  • Team: Du arbeitest mit einem extrem ambitionierten Team und direkt mit den Foundern zusammen.

Du willst mit uns wachsen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Arbeite direkt mit unseren Gründern zusammen, treibe unser Geschäft weiter voran und komm in unser einzigartiges Team!

Wir freuen uns über deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Nachricht, in der du beschreibst, warum du Lust auf den Job hast.

jobs.title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground. We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems.

About the Role



We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany.

The position will support the CGSS project, an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions.

The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users.

This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning.

What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application.
  • Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development.
  • Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces.
  • Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions.
  • Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities.
  • Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests.
  • Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution.
  • Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases.
  • Contributing to technical and user documentation.
  • Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system.
  • Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment.
  • Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations.


What We Look For



You do not need to fulfil every requirement below. We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain.

Technical Experience

Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas:

  • Software engineering and the software development lifecycle.
  • Python development.
  • Development of web-based applications.
  • Software Verification & Validation, testing and quality assurance.
  • Requirements analysis and software documentation.
  • Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab.
  • CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes.
  • Linux-based development or operational environments.


Space Domain Experience

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable:

  • Satellite or spacecraft operations.
  • Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications.
  • Ground segment software and operational systems.
  • Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems....

Du willst mit relevantem Content die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchen steigern und gehst offen und proaktiv auf Kunden, Partner, Redaktionen und Creator zu? Dann könnte das genau das Richtige für dich sein.

jobs.title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Architrave

Architrave ist seit 13 Jahren die Plattform für Dokumenten- und Asset-Management im institutionellen Gewerbeimmobiliengeschäft. Kunden wie Deka, Segro und Swiss Life Asset Managers arbeiten täglich mit uns. Als schlankes, agiles Team und mit unserer innovativen AI-Plattform verändern wir, was Asset Management künftig heißt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest das Neukunden- und Erweiterungsziel für alle Produkte gegenüber dem CEO und machst aus Piloten Rollouts.

  • Ganz wichtig: Diese Rolle ist zu 70 Prozent Verkaufen und zu 30 Prozent Führen – nicht umgekehrt. Du sitzt selbst in den Calls, machst die Demos und führst die Verhandlungen auf Geschäftsführungsebene. Hands on!

  • Du baust den Vertriebsprozess in einen sauberen Funnel um, inklusive Qualifizierung, Pilot-Mechanik, Forecast und CRM-Disziplin in HubSpot.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und dem Lead AI Strategy & Innovation zusammen und vertrittst Architrave auf relevanten Branchenterminen wie der Expo Real oder MIPIM.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 7 Jahre B2B-Software-Vertrieb an Unternehmen mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung für sechsstellige Deals und Zyklen von 6 bis 12 Monaten.

  • Nachweisbare Abschlüsse bei institutionellen Immobilienunternehmen, Fondsgesellschaften, Versicherungen oder ein Netzwerk, das dir dort Türen öffnet.

  • Erfahrung darin, ein neues Produkt in einen Markt zu bringen, Piloten zu verkaufen und Referenzkunden aufzubauen.

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder eine sehr klare Vorstellung davon, wie du ein kleines Team führst und misst.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch.

  • Ein klares Hands-on-Mindset: Du delegierst Abschlüsse nicht, sondern sitzt selbst in den Calls und Verhandlungen.

Deine ersten Monate bei Architrave

Wir sind klein, schnell und erwarten, dass du in den ersten 90 Tagen direkt selbst beim Kunden sitzt. Du übernimmst einen Bestand mit Potenzial und baust daraus direkt die Pipeline, Abschlüsse und Referenzkunden für unsere neue AI-Plattform auf. Dabei wartet kein fertiger Vertriebsapparat auf dich, sondern ein CEO, der mit dir in die Termine geht.

Benefits

  • Verantwortung ohne Umweg: Du berichtest direkt an den CEO, sitzt im Management-Kreis und entscheidest mit.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Vorsprung sowie Zugang zu Bestandskunden, die zu den größten Adressen des Marktes gehören.

  • Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten zur besseren Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Freizeit.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge für deine finanzielle Absicherung.

  • Vorteile für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg durch ein Deutschlandticket support oder Jobrad leasing.

Vergütung

Ein solides Fixgehalt passend zu deiner Erfahrung und eine erfolgsbasierte, ungedeckelte Provision. Wir setzen auf starke Kundenbeziehungen und echte Mehrwerte – wer diese schafft und erfolgreich abschließt, wird dafür attraktiv beteiligt.

Bewerbung

Schick uns keinen Lebenslauf allein. Wir möchten auf einer halben Seite (cover letter) von dir wissen: Auf welchen Deal bist du am meisten stolz, warum war er so schwer zu knacken und wie gehst du deine ersten 90 Tage bei uns an?

Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen: Deine Bewerbung geht an Daniel, Head of People and Culture. Danach folgt ein Gespräch mit Maurice (CEO) und anschließend mit Marco (Co-Geschäftsführer, CFO). Die finale Entscheidung fällt innerhalb von einem Monat.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Erfolgreicher Facility-Service-Dienstleister sucht einen ambitionierten und persönlich überzeugenden Manager* zur gesamtverantwortlichen Betreuung seines internationalen Kunden aus der Halbleiterindustrie.

  • Verantwortung für die übergeordnete Führung und Steuerung eines leistungsstarken Teams (ca. 50 Mitarbeitende gesamt, 2 'Direct Reports‘ TGM / IFM), Personalauswahl, -einsatz, Einarbeitung, Personalentwicklung, Trainings und Schulungen etc.

Qualifikation

  • Praxiserfahrung in der Steuerung von Veränderungsprozessen wünschenswert

  • Ausgeprägte Qualitäts-, Service- u. Kundenorientierung - Sie sind ein Manager* mit hoher Lösungskompetenz und Hands-on-Mentalität und leben den 'Multiservice-Gedanken'

jobs.title: Berater:in für digitale Kundenprojekte (m/w/d) – Energiewirtschaft
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht
Redtree macht seit über 20 Jahren Stadtwerke und Energieversorger digital. Auf unserer Plattform, der io.suite, laufen ihre Websites, Bestellstrecken, Kundenportale und die Prozesse dahinter.

Unsere Kunden kommen mit konkreten Anliegen. Der Vertrieb braucht einen neuen Tarifrechner, der Kundenservice will einen Prozess im Portal vereinfachen, die Geschäftsführung fragt nach einer Lösung für ein neues Produkt. Du hörst zu, verstehst, was dahintersteckt, und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende genau das umgesetzt wird. Du stehst dabei auf der Seite des Kunden und denkst aus seiner Sicht. Kaltakquise und Umsatzziele gehören nicht zu deinem Job.

Das machst du

  • Du bist feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und kennst ihre Abläufe, Ziele und Eigenheiten.

  • Du klärst Aufträge sauber: Was will der Kunde erreichen, was gehört dazu, was nicht.

  • Du hältst die Anforderungen als User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien fest, so dass alle dasselbe darunter verstehen.

  • Du stimmst dich direkt mit unseren Entwicklern ab, schätzt mit ihnen den Aufwand und erstellst daraus Angebote.

  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung bis zum Go-live: Du hältst den Zeitplan im Blick, informierst den Kunden und triffst Entscheidungen mit ihm.

  • Vor der Abnahme prüfst du die Ergebnisse gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien.

  • Wenn ein Thema mehr Klärung braucht, setzt du dich auch mal für einen Workshop mit dem Kunden zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung oder im Projektmanagement digitaler Projekte, zum Beispiel bei einer Digitalagentur, einem IT-Dienstleister oder einem Softwareanbieter

  • Du verstehst schnell, wie ein Kunde tickt und was er wirklich braucht, auch wenn er es selbst noch nicht genau sagen kann

  • Erfahrung damit, Anforderungen strukturiert festzuhalten, idealerweise als User Stories mit Akzeptanzkriterien

  • Du hast Angebote erstellt und Projekte bis zum Abschluss begleitet

  • Du hast Spaß an digitalen Themen und kannst dich mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe austauschen. Programmieren musst du nicht.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Fachabteilung sicher auf

  • Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft oder von Stadtwerken sind ein Plus. Fehlen sie dir, bringen wir sie dir bei.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch

Das bieten wir
Kurze Wege direkt ins Entwicklungsteam, flache Hierarchien, Homeoffice, ein modernes Büro mit guter Anbindung (Hunde willkommen), Teamevents, Sachbezugskarte oder Urban Sports M, Essens- und Mobilitätszuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Mitarbeiterrabatte.

Interesse?
Dann bewerbe dich jetzt bei uns, wir freuen uns auf dich.

jobs.title: People & Culture Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Die steigenden Energiekosten treffen jeden Haushalt. Wir senken, was gerade am meisten wehtut.

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: Nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird – sondern wie, und mit wem. Bei steigenden Energiekosten helfen wir Haushalten durch die Installation der richtigen Wärmepumpen und PV-Anlagen jährlich um die 1.500€ einzusparen.

Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.

Die Fakten.

  • Start: Januar/Februar 2027
  • Gehalt: €40.000-50.000 brutto pro Jahr
  • Arbeitsort: Büro an der Spree (Schlesische Str. 26, 10997 Berlin)
  • Homeoffice Möglichkeiten
  • Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/w) und flexible Arbeitszeiten (spätester Beginn um 9:30 Uhr)
  • Benefits: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss; Betriebliche Altersvorsorge; Team-Events, die nicht langweilig werden

Du gestaltest mit mir, Daniel (People Lead) und meinem Kollegen die neuen Strukturen unseres People Departments. Dein erster Fokus wird das Recruiting verschiedener Rollen und ein starkes Onboarding sein.

  • End-to-End Recruiting
  • Active Sourcing: gezielte Direktansprache über LinkedIn Recruiter & weitere Kanäle
  • Erkunden von modernen Recruiting Kampagnen (Social Media & Funnels)
  • Recruiting-Ops in Personio: sauberer Prozess, klare Zahlen, verlässliches Reporting
  • Monatliche Check-ins mit verschiedenen Führungskräften zu KPIs und Personalthemen
  • Ansprechpartner für Mitarbeiter bei individuellen Personalthemen
  • Beantwortung von Briefen (wenn wir noch welche bekommen)

Was Du mitbringen solltest.

Ich mach's mal ganz ehrlich: Wenn du Bock hast auf Start-up und ein People Department mitaufzubauen, du in andere People Bereiche perspektivisch reinwachsen willst und Drive und Eigeninitiative mitbringst, dann möchte ich dich unbedingt kennenlernen!

  • Du bist proaktiv, denkst selber mit und kommst mit neuen Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschlägen
  • Mind. 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Recruiting/HR/People & Culture in einem wettbewerbsintensiven, schnelllebigen Umfeld
  • Erste Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Fließendes Deutsch (unsere Unternehmenssprache), gutes Englisch von Vorteil

Warum Du Dich jetzt bewerben solltest.

Bei uns zählen Eigenverantwortung, Exzellenz und Energie. Wir denken in Ergebnissen und fordern uns gegenseitig heraus, um Deutschlands führende Kraft in der Umsetzung von energetischen Sanierungen zu werden. Wenn dich das abholt, melde dich.

  • Das Timing ist perfekt. Werde jetzt Teil von einem der schnellst wachsenden Energie-Startups Deutschlands - finanziert von Europas bekanntesten Venture Capitals
  • Arbeite gemeinsam mit ambitionierten Kollegen in einem Umfeld mit spürbarem Momentum
  • Unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und vielseitige Aufstiegschancen
  • Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
  • Individuelles Benefit: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss

jobs.title: Brand & Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Markenentwicklung: Du entwickelst unsere bestehende visuelle Identität weiter und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Markenauftritt über alle Kanäle hinweg. Außerdem erstellst du Designrichtlinien und direkt nutzbare Vorlagen für Präsentationen, Dokumente und Social Media.

  • Digital Design: Du gestaltest unseren digitalen Markenauftritt für Investoren, Kunden und Partner. Dazu gehören unsere Website inklusive des bevorstehenden Launches sowie Präsentationen, Newsletter und digitale Datenräume – alles auf Basis eines konsistenten Designsystems.

  • Print & Merchandise: Du gestaltest Broschüren, Produktdatenblätter, Geschäftsausstattung und Beschilderungen für unsere Büros und Werkstätten. Auch Merchandise, das unser Team gerne trägt und nutzt – von Hoodies bis Stickern – gehört dazu.

  • Produktlaunch & Events: Du entwickelst Key Visuals und Kampagnenmaterialien für unseren bevorstehenden Produktlaunch und gestaltest Messestände, Banner und Displays. Dabei koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit mit Druckereien und Messebauern und unterstützt bei Bedarf den Aufbau vor Ort.

  • Social Media Design: Du erstellst Grafiken für LinkedIn, Instagram, X und YouTube – von Posts und Karussells über Stories bis hin zu Bannern und Thumbnails. Dabei passt du die Gestaltung an die jeweilige Plattform an und setzt unsere Roboter überzeugend in Szene.
