jobs.title: Senior AI & Automation Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € Umsatz wollen wir smarter, schneller und effizienter skalieren. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle machst du AI und Automatisierung zu unserem echten Wettbewerbsvorteil: Du findest die größten Effizienzhebel in allen Departments, baust die Lösungen selbst und bringst sie in den produktiven Alltag. Gemessen wird dein Erfolg nicht an koordinierten Projekten, sondern an eingesparter Zeit, besseren Prozessen und messbarem Impact. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Teamlead Strategy & Operations zusammen und treibst eigene Initiativen voran.

  • Du findest die größten AI- und Automatisierungspotenziale in unseren Departments und setzt sie konsequent um, vom ersten Test bis zum skalierten Rollout.

  • No-Code- und Low-Code-Automationen, AI-Workflows und Agents baust du eigenständig, etwa mit Claude, n8n oder Make.

  • Gemeinsam mit den Departments analysierst du operative Bottlenecks und gestaltest End-to-End-Workflows neu: vereinfachen, automatisieren oder ganz streichen.

  • Zeitersparnis, Qualität und Adoption deiner Lösungen misst du und optimierst so lange, bis sie wirklich funktionieren.

  • Teams befähigst du, AI selbstständig im Alltag einzusetzen. Auch Standards für AI Governance, Wissen und Onboarding gehören zu deinen Aufgaben.

  • Geht eine Lösung über No-Code hinaus, schreibst du die Anforderungen für unser Development-Team und bleibst für Umsetzung und Business Impact verantwortlich.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Operations, Business Process Automation oder Operational Excellence bringst du mit, idealerweise aus E-Commerce oder einem schnell wachsenden Scale-up.

  • Mindestens zwei selbst umgesetzte Automations- oder Transformationsprojekte kannst du konkret zeigen: mit Ausgangsproblem, deinem eigenen Beitrag und messbarem Ergebnis.

  • Mit AI-Tools wie Claude und No-Code- oder Low-Code-Plattformen wie n8n oder Make arbeitest du routiniert im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Workflows, Systemintegrationen, APIs und Datenflüsse verstehst du technisch sicher, ohne selbst Software zu entwickeln.

  • Neue Tools und Prozesse hast du schon über mehrere Abteilungen hinweg eingeführt und gegen Widerstände durchgesetzt.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager - Klaviyo & Automation/ E-Mail Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Für Klaviyo-Experten, die nicht verwalten wollen, sondern einen Millionen-Channel neu bauen.

Die meisten verschicken Newsletter, du baust eine Maschine. Du übernimmst Klaviyo mit 60+ Flows, Loyalty und Abo und machst aus dem Channel, der ein Drittel unseres Umsatzes trägt, den größten Wachstumshebel auf der Road to 100 Mio.

  • Du baust unsere gesamte Flow-Architektur neu auf: Post-Purchase, Second-Order, Winback und Subscription-Flows werden von Grund auf stark gemacht.

  • Eine Testing-Maschine etablieren gehört in deinen Verantwortungsbereich: ein sauberer A/B-Test pro Woche, dokumentierte Learnings, klare Rollout-Entscheidungen.

  • Kampagnen-Logik und Segmentierung liegen bei dir; wer bekommt was, wann und warum: Engagement-Segmente, Storytelling-Abfolgen, Neu- vs. Bestandskunden-Differenzierung.

  • Du machst Klaviyo AI und Predictive Features produktiv: Predictive CLV, Churn Risk und Next Order Date werden nicht nur aktiviert, sondern in Segmentierung und Flow-Logik eingebaut.

  • Unsere Agentur steuerst und challengest du fachlich, du bist die interne Instanz, die jede Empfehlung an Daten misst.

  • Abo- und Loyalty-Kommunikation baust du so aus, dass Wiederkaufraten messbar steigen.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre CRM-, Retention- oder Lifecycle-Erfahrung in einem D2C- oder E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit relevanter Skalierung. Du hast einen Channel verantwortet, nicht nur zugearbeitet.

  • Nachweisbare Klaviyo-Expertise: komplexe Flow-Architekturen, Segmentierungslogik, A/B-Testing-Setups, Deliverability-Management. Shopify-Stack-Erfahrung ist Pflicht, HTML/CSS-Grundkenntnisse ein Plus.

  • Analytische Tiefe ist für dich Alltag: Kohortenanalysen, Repeat-Rate-Strukturen, Attributionslogik und Incrementality-Denken, du liest Daten schneller, als andere Dashboards öffnen.

  • LLM-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT setzt du heute produktiv ein, für Analysen, Segmentlogik, Copy oder Prozessautomatisierung und kannst zeigen, was dadurch besser oder schneller wurde.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und sicheres Englisch bringst du mit.

jobs.title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d) - Befristet auf 12 Monate vorerst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social.
Die Stelle ist vorerst auf 12 Monate befristet.

  • Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen.

  • Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette.

  • Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops.

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS.

  • Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen).

  • Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen.

  • Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok).

  • Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards.

  • Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert.

  • Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Photoshop und Lightroom auf sehr hohem Niveau, mit Meta-Funnel-Logik im Schlaf (Hooks Sek. 1, Pattern Interrupt, Pacing).

  • Aus einem Shot 50 Assets zu machen, klingt für dich nach Chance statt Qualitätsverlust; Premium-Ästhetik ohne Kompromisse ist für dich selbstverständlich, AI-Output darf nie nach AI-Output aussehen.

  • Du liest Zahlen und übersetzt sie direkt in Creative-Entscheidungen, strukturiert, direkt, belastbar. Deutsch mind. C1.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Launch Manager - Beauty & Skin Care (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für neue Skincare-Produkte und Beauty Tools, vom Business Case über den Go-to-Market bis zur Performance nach dem Launch. Du verbindest Produkt, Customer Insight und Growth und arbeitest dafür eng mit Head of Product, Product Development, Marketing, E-Commerce und CEO zusammen. Dein Ziel sind nicht möglichst viele Launches, sondern Produkte, die Rosentals nächste Hero Products werden können. Du entwickelst für neue Produkte den kommerziellen Business Case, von Consumer Need und Marktpotenzial über Pricing, Target COGS und Marge bis zum Absatzpotenzial.

  • Customer Insights, Reviews sowie Markt- und Social-Trends übersetzt du in klare Hero-Product-Konzepte.

  • Den gesamten Go-to-Market-Prozess ownst du. Produkt, Packaging, Claims, Creative, Content, E-Commerce und Marketing greifen zum Launch nahtlos ineinander.

  • Cross-funktionale Launch-Pläne, Critical Paths und Milestones steuerst du so, dass mindestens 90 % aller Milestones fristgerecht erreicht werden.

  • Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Creative entstehen unter deiner Führung Product Stories, Hooks, Claims und Proof Points, die überzeugen und Performance treiben.

  • Mit dem Launch bist du nicht fertig: Die ersten 30/60/90 Tage analysierst du anhand von Umsatz, Conversion, Reviews, Repeat, Marge und Customer Feedback und leitest konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Management, Go-to-Market, Launch Management oder Growth im Beauty-, Skincare-, Consumer- oder D2C-Umfeld.

  • Mehrere physische Produkte hast du von der Idee bis zum Marktlaunch begleitet und kannst erklären, warum sie kommerziell funktioniert haben.

  • Consumer- und Product-Taste verbindest du mit solidem Verständnis für Pricing, Marge, Business Cases und Wachstum.

  • Komplexe cross-funktionale Projekte zu führen, Prioritäten zu setzen und Teams auf ein gemeinsames Ziel auszurichten, ist deine Stärke.

  • Du arbeitest hands-on, schnell und mit hoher Ownership und wartest nicht auf den nächsten Schritt von anderen.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1) und sehr gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (m/w/d) – Internal Tools & E-Commerce
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hinter dem Rosental-Shop läuft ein selbst gebautes Software-Ökosystem: ein Influencer-Operations-Tool mit automatisiertem Briefing-Versand, ein E-Com-Command-Center mit eigenem AI-Copilot und zwei Shopify-Storefronts für DE und NL. Bisher baut das im Kern eine Person, AI-first, in Produktionsqualität und mit mehreren Releases am Tag. Diese Rolle verdoppeln wir jetzt. Deine Features nutzt das Team noch am selben Tag.

  • Du baust interne Produkte end-to-end, vom Slack-Ping über die Root-Cause-Analyse in Produktionsdaten bis zum Fix, der kurz darauf live ist.

  • Unscharfe Anforderungen aus Influencer-Marketing, E-Com, Finance und Customer Care machst du zum richtigen Feature. Priorisieren, zuschneiden und weglassen liegt bei dir.

  • Cursor, Agents und LLM-Features sind dein Standard-Werkzeug, um schnell zu shippen, ohne dabei die Qualität aus den Augen zu verlieren.

  • Shopify Admin API, Zahlungs- und Affiliate-Systeme (z. B. GoAffPro), Resend und Analytics-Quellen bindest du an unsere internen Datenbanken an.

  • Auch die Weiterentwicklung unserer Shopify-Storefronts für DE und NL gehört in deinen Aufgabenbereich.

  • Monitoring, saubere Migrationen und „fail closed" bei Rechten und Versand liegen in deiner Verantwortung, denn in Produktion hängen echte Nutzer, Mails und Umsätze.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung bringst du mit, idealerweise mit TypeScript, React/ Next.js, Postgres (Supabase) und Vercel.

  • Du shippst nachweislich schneller dank AI-gestützter Entwicklung. Agents, Prompting und Review-Disziplin beherrschst du.

  • Als Product Owner, Founder oder in einer Hybrid-Rolle hast du bereits gearbeitet und erkennst, was hinter einer Anfrage wirklich steckt.

  • Begriffe wie CM3, Attribution, Draft Order oder Conversion kennst du, oder du baust dieses Wissen in den ersten vier Wochen auf.

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten ist für dich selbstverständlich: ohne Ticket-System und ohne zweites Dev-Team als Fallnetz.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und solides Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du willst Lieferketten nicht nur verwalten, sondern wirklich gestalten? Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die volle Ownership über unsere internationale Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterialien bis zu Produktkomponenten und baust die Prozesse auf, die unser Wachstum tragen.

  • Du stellst die permanente Verfügbarkeit aller Verpackungsmaterialien und Produktkomponenten sicher. Engpässe verhinderst du, bevor sie entstehen.

  • Du hältst eine stabile Bestandsreichweite von 1–6 Monaten für alle relevanten Produkte und passt sie kontinuierlich an den Forecast an.

  • Du verhandelst aktiv mit chinesischen Lieferanten und reduzierst die COGS nachhaltig durch starke Konditionen und strategische Partnerschaften.

  • Du baust belastbare Prozesse für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Lieferanten auf, inklusive vollständiger Compliance-Dokumentation und klarer Kommunikationswege.

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst klare SOPs und sorgst für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit allen internen Schnittstellen.

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verhandlung mit chinesischen Lieferanten. Du kennst die Hebel und holst das Beste für das Unternehmen heraus.

  • Du bringst interkulturelle Kompetenz im China-Kontext mit und weißt, wie Kommunikation dort funktioniert (und nutzt das als Vorteil).

  • Du erstellst stabile, datenbasierte Forecasts und Bestandsplanungen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in gängigen ERP- oder Planning-Tools.

  • Du behältst den Überblick über Bestände, Liefertermine und Produktionspläne, auch wenn viele Variablen gleichzeitig in Bewegung sind.

  • Du denkst in Prozessen: Du erkennst, was ineffizient läuft, gestaltest bessere Abläufe und bringst andere mit auf den Weg.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Englisch und Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Chinesisch ist ein klares Plus.

Unser Affiliate-Programm wächst, und du sorgst dafür, dass es dabei rund läuft.   • Mit Affiliates, Influencern und Kooperationspartnern kommunizierst du schnell, freundlich und professionell.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to CMO (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als Chief of Staff to CMO sorgst du direkt neben unserer CMO für Tempo und Klarheit im Marketing-Department. Du übernimmst Projekte, wie den Aufbau unserer Academy end-to-end, baust Prozesse dort auf, wo noch keine existieren und stellst sicher, dass Entscheidungen schnell, fundiert und nachvollziehbar getroffen werden. Diese Rolle ist zentral für unser weiteres Wachstum.

  • Neue High-Revenue-Initiativen wie den Academy-Aufbau verantwortest du end-to-end, von der ersten Idee bis zum profitablen Launch.

  • Prozesse baust du dort auf, wo noch keine existieren: dokumentiert, delegierbar und wiederholbar.

  • Du betreibst unser Decision Operating System: entscheidungsreife Vorlagen mit Optionen und Zahlen, Meeting-Agenden 48h im Voraus und konsequentes Nachhalten von Commitments.

  • Als Schnittstelle zwischen CMO, CEO, Finance, Agenturen und Team-Leads orchestrierst du das Stakeholder-Management auf C-Level.

  • Aus Zahlen wie CM3, Kohorten, Kampagnen-KPIs, leitest du klare Entscheidungsvorlagen und Empfehlungen ab.

  • Ziel im ersten Jahr: mindestens ein neues Revenue-Projekt live und profitabel, Entscheidungen im Department in max. 72 Stunden, Meetings pünktlich und mit Agenda.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung darin, Projekte ohne Vorlage zum Laufen zu bringen, vorzugsweise im Scale-up, in der Beratung oder im High-Growth-D2C-Umfeld.

  • Excel und Google Sheets beherrschst du fließend, Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Holistics ist ein Plus.

  • Strukturiertheit ist dein Naturell, du schaffst Ordnung und Klarheit für andere und arbeitest fehlerfrei und präzise.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsstärke bis auf C-Level zeichnen dich aus, das Ganze auch mindestens auf C1 Level in deutsch.

  • Du bist AI-native, nutzt Claude, ChatGPT & Co. täglich als Arbeitshebel und bewegst dich sicher in Asana, Google Workspace und Slack.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Ruhe in dynamischen Phasen und die Fähigkeit, über Klarheit statt Hierarchie zu führen, zeichnen dich aus.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens auf C1 Niveau) und gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
spark‘m ist die auf inhaber- und familiengeführte Mittelstandsunternehmen spezialisierte Personalberatungs-Boutique. Wir besetzen in Darmstadt/Südhessen Experten- und Führungskräftepositionen in der Festanstellung und im Interim Management. Wir finden für unsere Kunden und Kandidaten die beste Lösung. Zu unseren Mandanten gehören bekannte Marken und Hidden Champions als Beteiligungsunternehmen von Family Offices.

Aufgrund des nachhaltigen und stetigen Wachstums suchen wir einen „Office-Manager (m/w/d)“ mit Projektmanagement-Erfahrung zur Unterstützung für unseren Standort in Darmstadt.

Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen das professionelle Office-Management und stellen eine reibungslose Büroorganisation sicher
  • Sie unterstützen unser Team bei administrativen Tätigkeiten
  • Sie sind kompetenter und freundlicher Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Kandidat:innen
  • Sie planen und koordinieren Termine und Meetings
  • Sie begleiten Projekten und übernehmen eigenverantwortlich das Projektmanagement

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung
  • Sie verfügen über eine mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Assistenz bzw. Office Management
  • Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) ist für Sie selbstverständlich
  • Es zeichnet Sie ein hohes Maß an Vertraulichkeit und Loyalität aus
  • Sie sind eine aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit mit einer positiven Lebenseinstellung und besitzen eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung
  • Sie sind kommunikativ, organisationsstark mit strukturierter, ergebnisorientierter und selbstständiger Arbeitsweise
  • Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung und behalten motiviert in jeder Situation den Überblick.
  • Ihre sehr guten Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab

Wir bieten nicht nur einen Arbeitsplatz. Wir bieten eine andere Arbeitswelt. Wir kommen gerne montags zur Arbeit. Im Büro oder von zu Hause. Als wesentliches Mitglied eines erfolgreichen und erfahrenen Teams können Sie Strategien entwickeln, umsetzen und Erfolge gemeinsam mit uns feiern. Individuelle Trainings und Coaching geben Ihnen die Chance zur Weiterentwicklung Ihres Know-Hows und Ihrer Persönlichkeit. Unser Büro ist direkt in der Innenstadt von Darmstadt. Sie können aber auch immer wieder von zu Hause arbeiten. Oder Sylt. Oder München. Oder Paris. Oder Michelstadt.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Nachricht und lassen Sie uns gemeinsam herausfinden, ob wir in der Zukunft gemeinsam gerne montags zur Arbeit gehen.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As Director of Engineering Operations, you will build structured, repeatable operating capability across Mechanical, Electrical and Controls. You will own engineering planning and capacity reporting, configuration and release administration, supplier engineering readiness, and end-to-end engineering and supplier quality. This is a functional leadership role: you will set the processes that engineering must follow, while authorised engineers keep design approval, Systems Engineering keeps requirements governance, and Commercial Procurement keeps contracts.

What You'll Do

  • Own engineering planning, workload and capacity reporting so that commitments reflect real capacity.

  • Lead configuration and release administration, including Inventor licensing, Autodesk Vault and Jama administration, as a controlled and auditable capability.

  • Define and drive the planning, configuration, release and quality processes that Mechanical, Electrical and Controls are required to follow.

  • Ensure suppliers receive controlled, revision-correct technical information through readiness coordination with the Supply Chain Engineer.

  • Build a functioning supplier-quality and nonconformance process, and stand up the Engineering Quality Lead and Supplier Quality Engineer capability as it is approved.

  • Partner with Systems Engineering, the Systems Integration team, Commercial Procurement and the PMO to keep cross-functional handoffs clean and to give Integration trustworthy readiness evidence.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Experience in engineering configuration management, release control and change control in a hardware engineering environment.

  • Hands-on knowledge of engineering data and release tools such as Jama, Autodesk Vault or Inventor, or comparable PLM/PDM systems.

  • Experience running supplier technical coordination and quality or nonconformance processes, including auditable conformity records.

  • Proven ability to plan and manage engineering capacity and workload across multiple disciplines.

  • Leadership experience managing managers or senior specialists, and building process ownership within a team.

  • Clear, candid communication with senior leaders, with the judgement to escalate only genuine cross-functional trade-offs.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in systems engineering or systems integration on complex hardware programmes.

  • Experience standing up a new quality function from a small base, including supplier quality engineering.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Director (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As the Mechanical Engineering Director at Focused Energy, you will design, build, and lead the Mechanical Engineering department, establishing its organizational structure, operating model, engineering standards, and budget. You will oversee end-to-end mechanical capability across key delivery programs, managing peer Chief Mechanical Engineers. Your leadership will ensure that mechanical subsystems are rigorously designed, manufactured, verified, and delivered on schedule to Systems Integration.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Mechanical Engineering department's structure, headcount, budget forecasting, and capacity allocation across active delivery programs.

  • Lead and develop peer Chief Mechanical Engineers and emerging capability leads, defining delegated technical authority frameworks and clear accountability.

  • Scale and build out the five core mechanical capability areas in phased stages aligned with funded project workloads.

  • Enforce robust mechanical design review governance, ensuring all released designs contain verified load cases, tolerances, and interface evidence.

  • Establish manufacturing and supplier engineering capabilities early in the lifecycle to optimize design-for-manufacture, assembly, and test readiness.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Systems Integration, Engineering Operations, Procurement, Quality, and Facilities to ensure seamless subsystem handovers at readiness gates.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Extensive leadership experience building, structuring, and scaling engineering organizations, teams, and departmental budgets.

  • Strong background across the full mechanical engineering lifecycle, spanning initial concept, supplier manufacturing, assembly, testing, and integration handover.

  • Proven track record of establishing formal design review cadences, delegated authority models, and engineering release standards.

  • Experience managing engineering resource allocation and resolving capacity trade-offs across concurrent, complex technical programs.

  • Demonstrated capability in mentoring technical leads and creating distinct career progression pathways for both management and specialist individual contributors.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to communicate project risks, trade-offs, and commitments transparently to executive stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Technical familiarity with high-complexity domains such as vacuum systems, cryogenics, thermal management, fluids, or precision mechanical systems.

About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

As a Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation, you’ll perform engineering analysis and simulation work across Focused Energy projects, helping design and validate complex mechanical systems before hardware is committed. jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Low Carbon Technology Analyst - Energy and Sustainable Business Program*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia’s Energy and Sustainability Business (ESB) Portfolio works to advance reliable, clean energy while reducing carbon emissions and supporting economic development. Recognizing the interconnected nature of economic, social, and environmental goals, the program collaborates across disciplines, including with WRI’s cities, climate, and ocean teams to integrate low-carbon technologies, quantitative models, and policy tools. SETI is managed by a consortium including GIZ, WRI Indonesia, IESR, Yayasan Cerah, LPEM FEB UI, and Fraunhofer, serving as the project’s implementers. SETI project is divided into four focuses: policy support, sustainable finance, industrial energy lab, and built environment energy lab.WRI Indonesia is the main implementation partner for the industrial energy lab, thus responsible in providing technical assistance, capacity building, and research to accelerate energy transition in the industrial sector. **Job Highlight** The Low Carbon Technology Analyst will support WRI Indonesia ESB portfolio projects, specifically Sustainable Energy Transition in Indonesia (SETI) project, by supporting industries in implementing energy efficiency and/or renewable energy through technical assistance and consultations. This includes conducting and reviewing technical and techno-economic analysis, energy and emission savings potential calculations, and convening these messages to company management to support implementation decision making. The Analyst should have a solid understanding of energy efficiency and renewable energy technologies, electrical and heat related systems in industries, implementation considerations of companies for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects, as well as associated business models and techno-economic calculations. Moreover, this position will support the project planning and implementation activities through coordination with relevant personnels to ensure fulfilment of administrative requirement of project activities. This position will be based in Jakarta with office-flex working arrangement. Reporting directly to SETI Senior Lead while working collaboratively with the Senior Energy Efficiency Specialist, whilst supporting the Energy and Sustainable Business research team on research projects if needed. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About The Role** The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team. **What You Will Do** * Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments. * Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads. * Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them. * Diagnose and resolve database performance issues. * Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents. * Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders. * Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders. * Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; promote best practices and standards across the team. * Maintain documentation and process discipline for the systems and incidents you own. * Lead structured incident investigation, isolating server, database, and application layers with a metrics-first approach, including on-call during high-traffic events. **What Are We Looking For** * At least 4 years of experience in either SRE, DevOps, MLOps, or platform engineering, including senior-level scope at a high-traffic company. * Deep expertise in one major cloud provider (preferably AWS), with a proven ability to ramp up on the other quickly.Production experience & expertise with Kubernetes & Linux fundamentals * CI/CD & GitOps (ArgoCD or other equivalent stacks) * Database performance analysis & monitoring (MySQL, Postgres) * Observability tooling & standards (Datadog, OpenTelemetry) * Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) * Strong working English, verbal & written communication. Strong documentation and process discipline. * On-call & incident handling experience during high-traffic events. * Comfortable negotiating with stakeholders to propose technical compromises that meet business SLAs. * Demonstrated growth mindset and proven ability to own ambiguous scope.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer (SDE 3)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kredivo Group is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to lead day-to-day Enterprise Security work. This is a hands-on role. You will own the security of our endpoints, identity, SaaS, network and cloud, and you will guide junior security engineers on the team. You will deploy and run our security platforms, remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet, and harden our corporate environment using zero trust and secure-by-default principles. You will work with IT, DevOps and Engineering across Indonesia, and international, and support Cyber Defense during incidents. **About the Job**: Cyber Defense Strategy & Leadership * Enterprise Security BAU work and projects, and help set the team's roadmap. * Mentor and coach SDE-1 and SDE-2 engineers, and review their configurations, scripts and remediation work. * Set priorities by risk, and track and report security posture metrics (patch compliance, EDR coverage, vulnerability SLA, phishing click rate) to the Enterprise Security Lead. * Write, maintain and enforce IT and Security policies, standards and procedures. Endpoint, Vulnerability & Patch Management * Administer and tune the security platforms: EDR, VMDR, WAF and the Email Security Gateway. * Run vulnerability management end to end: scanning, prioritization (CVSS, CISA KEV, Ransomware), remediation and SLA tracking across Windows, macOS and Linux. * Build and safely deploy patch and remediation automation through MDM tools. * Keep endpoint security agents deployed and healthy across the fleet. Identity, SaaS & Cloud Hardening * Work with IT and DevOps to harden Cloud Directory, Google Workspace, VPN and other SaaS tools. * Design and review IAM controls: SSO (SAML, OAuth/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, MFA, conditional access, least privilege and access reviews. * Apply zero trust and secure-by-default models in architecture decisions for knowledge workers and developers. * Monitoring & Incident Support, Monitor internal and external systems for threats, triage alerts, and respond to them. * Support Cyber Defense during incidents with containment actions such as isolation, account suspension and blocking. * Run phishing simulations and security awareness programs, and measure the results. * Advise employees on how to keep endpoints, office AV and network infrastructure secure. * Automate security operations and reporting using Python, Bash or PowerShell. * Evaluate new security tools, including AI-assisted tools, and support AI Security initiatives. * Support ISO 27001:2022 and regulatory audits (e.g. OJK) by providing evidence, remediating gaps and maintaining controls. **About You:** * At least 5 years of cyberdefense security experience, preferably in a startup or fintech environment. * Hands-on experience deploying and managing EDR, vulnerability and patch management, DLP, network security and phishing simulation tools. * Strong knowledge of identity and access management frameworks and protocols (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM). * Experience securing Google Workspace, directory services, VPN and SaaS platforms. * Experience with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP). * Good scripting skills (Python, Bash or PowerShell). * Knowledge of modern adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (MITRE ATT&CK). * Experience mentoring engineers or leading small workstreams or projects. * Good English communication skills. #LI-AF1

jobs.title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations. This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction. You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle. A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure. You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization. **What You’ll Own** **Identity, Access & Credential Security** * Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems. * Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets. * Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding. * Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts. * Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence. **Security Monitoring & Incident Response** * Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints. * Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure. * Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks. * Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials. **Internal Systems & Workforce Security** * Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems. * Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations. * Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials. **What We’re Looking For** * 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role. * Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing. * Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management. * Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Strong understanding of Linu...

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Cloud and Platform Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About Amartha** Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth. Our Empowered to Grow culture guides how we work together. We Focus on Clarity, Take the Lead, and Grow Impact, empowering our people to take ownership and create meaningful, lasting impact. ### **About the role** Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. Our production platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes, and our security team is building the controls, detection, and automation that a regulated lender needs at that scale. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own cloud and platform security engineering. You will run the controls that detect and prevent misconfiguration and intrusion across our cloud and container estate, respond to what our detection stack surfaces, and turn manual security infrastructure into code. You will work alongside DevOps and platform engineering, and your work feeds directly into our ISO 27001 and regulator audit evidence. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a wide mandate. You will be the senior voice on cloud security in the team, and we expect you to set the technical direction for it rather than wait for a backlog. ### **What you will do** * Own container and cloud runtime security: workload isolation, Kubernetes hardening, and runtime threat detection. * Run and extend automated benchmark and configuration scanning across our cloud platform and productivity suite, and act on what it finds. * Build shift-left security into CI/CD: infrastructure-as-code scanning and misconfiguration gates before deployment. * Bring the security team's own cloud estate under infrastructure as code. Provisioning is manual and drift-prone today, and ending that is a named deliverable of this role. * Build and run the deployment pipeline for our security tooling, so security infrastructure ships the same way the product does. * Own the SIEM platform end to end: network isolation, version currency, configuration management, and detection coverage across critical workloads. * Respond to and review security alerts, tune detection rules, and cut false positives. * Manage edge and perimeter security: web application firewall rules, DNS and traffic visibility, and security event retention. * Manage the platform and console access paths that sit with security engineering. * Document what you build, to the standard where another engineer can operate it without you. Continuity is a measured outcome of this role, not a nice-to-have. * Share the information security on-call rotation, and help us establish it. * Produce the control evidence our auditors and regulators ask for, with the GRC team. ### **What you bring** * 5 or more years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, or SRE, with at least 3 years focused on cloud and container security. * Hands-on depth in public cloud and Kubernetes security: identity and access management, RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control, runtime detection, and secret management. Google Cloud is our primary platform. * Production experience with a SIEM, including deployment, detection rule authoring, and alert triage. * Infrastructure as code in practice, not in theory: reusable modules, state management, and deployment pipelines you built and operated yourself. * Experience embedding security scanni...

jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional** Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola. Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan. * Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan. * Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya. * Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas. * Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel. * Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting. * Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta. * Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial. **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik. * Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur. * Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan. * Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. * Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis. * Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga. * Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

Posisi ini merupakan peran kunci dalam mendistribusikan dan mempromosikan produk rokok kami kepada berbagai outlet ritel di seluruh wilayah. Sebagai Sales Motoris Rokok, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk membangun hubungan pelanggan yang kuat, meningkatkan penjualan, dan memastikan ketersediaan produk yang optimal di setiap titik penjualan. Jabatan ini bersifat fulltime dan memerlukan Anda untuk bekerja di lapangan dengan menggunakan kendaraan roda dua atau empat untuk mengunjungi pelanggan secara berkala. **Tanggung Jawab Utama** * Mengunjungi outlet ritel, minimarket, warung, dan lokasi penjualan lainnya secara rutin untuk menawarkan dan menjual produk rokok sesuai dengan target penjualan yang ditetapkan. * Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan bisnis yang baik dengan pemilik dan pengelola outlet untuk meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan dan meningkatkan repeat order. * Memastikan penempatan produk yang optimal di lokasi penjualan, termasuk penata letak display dan merchandising yang menarik. * Mengelola inventaris produk, mencatat stok yang tersedia, dan melaporkan kebutuhan pengisian ulang kepada manajemen. * Melakukan pencatatan penjualan harian dan menyiapkan laporan penjualan secara akurat dan tepat waktu. * Mempromosikan produk baru dan penawaran khusus kepada pelanggan untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek dan volume penjualan. * Menangani pembayaran dari pelanggan dan memastikan transaksi keuangan tercatat dengan benar. * Memberikan informasi produk dan mengatasi pertanyaan atau keluhan pelanggan pemahaman yang baik tentang manajemen stok dan merchandising. * Kemampuan komunikasi yang efektif dan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat untuk membangun hubungan dengan pelanggan. * Semangat tinggi, motivasi diri yang kuat, dan orientasi terhadap target penjualan. * Kemauan untuk bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan perjalanan ke berbagai lokasi secara konsisten. * Pengetahuan dasar tentang produk rokok dan regulasi terkait industri tembakau. * Kemampuan menggunakan perangkat mobile atau sistem pencatatan digital untuk melaporkan penjualan. * Memiliki kendaraan roda dua atau empat sendiri merupakan keuntungan. **Manfaat Utama Perusahaan** * Gaji dasar yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi berbasis pencapaian target penjualan. * Tunjangan kinerja dan bonus bulanan untuk pencapaian penjualan yang konsisten. * Tunjangan operasional untuk biaya bahan bakar dan pemeliharaan kendaraan. * Kesempatan pengembangan karier dengan pelatihan penjualan dan product knowledge yang berkelanjutan. * Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan dukungan tim manajemen yang responsif. * Fleksibilitas dalam pengelolaan rute penjualan dengan otonomi dalam mengatur jadwal kunjungan. * Asuransi kesehatan dasar untuk melindungi kesejahteraan Anda. **Tentang Kami** TANGGA AGENCY' adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri ritel dan distribusi produk konsumen yang berfokus pada menyediakan layanan Kami berkomitmen untuk membangun kemitraan jangka panjang dengan outlet ritel dan memastikan produk kami tersedia dengan mudah bagi konsumen. Dengan tim yang profesional dan berpengalaman, kami terus berinovasi dalam strategi pemasaran dan penjualan untuk mencapai pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. TANGGA AGENCY' menghargai dedikasi, integritas, dan kerja keras, dan kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan bersama adalah kunci untuk membangun bisnis yang kuat dan berkelanjutan...

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.descriptionHtml: * Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. * Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. * Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDE and an FDX, * **Forward Deployed Executives (FDX)** own the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs. * **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE)** embed with a client, map the client workflow, identify the business problem underneath it, design and build a working AI solution, present to the client, and transfer the knowledge to the client's team. Owns technical direction of the whole solution. * **Senior AI Engineer.** When an FDE comes back from the client with the business problem, you will help turn that into an agentic system that runs in production and will be responsible for evaluation, observability, and guardrails. You'll have real ownership of components and of the technical decisions inside them. ### **Requirements:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self-directed; you push for clarity rather than waiting for a ticket * Excellent communication and problem-solving skills * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. * B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams. **Technical depth** * 5+ years in software or ML engineering, with production systems you were accountable for. * Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes. * Shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks. * Agentic orchestration: multi-step workflows, graph-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure * Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks. * Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production. * Strong engineering fundamentals. Full-stack mindset, comfortable across AI, backend development, and cloud infrastructure. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase, you're productive. * Hands-on AWS in production: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus. * Cloud-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release. * Model and agent monitoring, drift detection. * Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs. * Hands-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus. * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience in one of the industries: financial service...

Provectus maintains industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a client in the same industry — so you begin from running code and tuning it to this client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Senior AI Engineer - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. **SCeNe Coalition** The SCeNe Coalition is aimed to develop Triple Benefit Tools and Website for Southeast Asia Climate and Nature-based Solution (SCeNe) Coalition. Triple Benefit Tool will help to identify high impact future NbS opportunities, ensuring a targeted pipeline of NbS supply that focus on geographies with the highest conservation, social development and carbon potential. This tool will also help to validate triple benefit quality, giving the projects additional scientific credibility; to ensure finance is flowing transparently; and to increase ecosystem participation. **Data Lab Indonesia** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The Senior AI Engineer will lead the technical development and evaluation of AI capabilities for the Dynamic Multilingual Translation and Document Generation initiative within the Nature-based Solutions (NbS) Tool. The role focuses on building reliable, source-grounded multilingual translation and AI-assisted document generation capabilities using existing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches. Working under the direct supervision of the Product and Engineering Manager, the Senior AI Engineer will working closely with the Product Manager and Backend Engineers, the consultant will evaluate suitable AI models, design and optimise AI pipelines, establish measurable quality standards, and provide technical guidance for integration into the NbS Tool. jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** VTL Travel is a Singapore-based travel company that operates as the parent brand for a family of niche travel sites, each targeting a distinct segment of the travel market. Under the VTL Travel umbrella sit three focused brands: Holidays From Singapore, which handles leisure travel, nearby getaways, cruises, visa-related services, and corporate trips; Tour Mount Bromo, which specializes in East Java tours covering Mount Bromo, Ijen, waterfalls, and private tour packages; and Batam Ferry Tickets, which focuses on Singapore-to-Batam ferry ticket bookings and promotions. **About the role** We're looking for a hands-on web developer to maintain and grow batamferrytickets.com — a custom built site — and to build and manage the API integrations that power our booking, payment, and ferry booking API features. This is a practical, execution-focused role: keeping the site fast, secure, and bug-free, while connecting it reliably to the third-party systems our bookings depend on. **Key responsibilities** * Maintain and troubleshoot website, including API Updates and theme updates, performance tuning, and uptime/security monitoring * Fix bugs, broken forms, layout issues, and mobile responsiveness problems as they arise * Implement design and content changes from the marketing team without breaking page speed or SEO structure * Manage staging-to-live deployment workflow to avoid downtime on a revenue-generating site * Build and maintain the integration between the site and the ferry ticketing/booking system (availability, pricing, seat/ticket confirmation) * Develop and maintain the hotel-booking module integration for combined ferry+hotel packages (hotel supplier or OTA API/feed) * Maintain the payment gateway integration (HitPay or Airwallex) and troubleshoot failed or stuck transactions * Connect and maintain WhatsApp Business API or click-to-WhatsApp flows for enquiry handling * Set up and maintain GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking (events, server-side tagging where needed) so booking data flows correctly for marketing reporting * Handle webhook endpoints and scheduled sync jobs (e.g. inventory/price sync) reliably, with logging and error alerts **About you** * 2+ years of experience Web Developer (PHP, custom functions, child themes, Payment Gateway Integration) * Proven experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs, handling JSON, authentication (API keys, OAuth), and webhooks * Good Practical skillset in API integration * Experience with payment gateway integrations (HitPay, Stripe, PayNow, or similar) * Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads conversion tracking * Solid understanding of website security (SSL, backups, firewall rules, malware cleanup) * Familiar with git-based deployment workflows and staging environments * Able to debug independently and document fixes clearly Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** Kami mencari **DevSecOps Engineer** yang tangguh untuk membangun, mengamankan, dan mengotomatiskan jalur rilis serta infrastruktur aplikasi berbasis *container* di PT Mitra Cakra Digital. Di peran ini, Anda adalah garda terdepan yang memastikan sistem kami beroperasi secara stabil, aman, dan *high-availability*. Hasil kerja Anda—mulai dari *pipeline* CI/CD, otomatisasi GitOps, hingga *observability stack*—akan menjadi fondasi utama yang diandalkan oleh seluruh tim pengembang kami. **Apa yang akan Anda lakukan:** * Membangun, mengotomatiskan, dan memelihara *pipeline* CI/CD yang cepat, andal, dan terintegrasi dengan kontrol keamanan. * Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan infrastruktur *container* serta orkestrasinya menggunakan Kubernetes dan Helm. * Menerapkan pengelolaan kredensial (*secret management*) dan *security policy* pada jalur rilis untuk mencegah kebocoran data. * Membangun dan mengelola sistem pemantauan (*observability*), pencatatan *log*, serta *distributed tracing* (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry). * Mengonfigurasi API Gateway, menyusun kebijakan akses (*access policy*), serta menetapkan *rate limiting* untuk menjaga keamanan dan beban server. **Yang kami cari (Kualifikasi):** * Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang DevOps, DevSecOps, atau *Site Reliability Engineering* (SRE). * Penguasaan mendalam dalam orkestrasi **Kubernetes** dan pengelolaan **Helm** *charts*. * Menguasai *tooling* CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, atau setara) dan pendekatan **GitOps** (ArgoCD atau setara). * *Hands-on* dalam *Secret Management* menggunakan **HashiCorp Vault** (atau setara). * Menguasai *observability stack*: **Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, dan OpenTelemetry**. * Mahir dalam **Docker** beserta penerapan praktik *container security hardening*. **Soft Skill unggulan:** Memiliki kesadaran tinggi bahwa infrastruktur yang dibangun adalah fondasi bagi tim pengembang lain, **tetap tenang dan taktis saat menangani insiden di bawah tekanan**, serta memiliki dorongan alami untuk selalu mendokumentasikan dan mengotomatiskan pekerjaan yang berulang. **Nilai tambah:** * Memiliki sertifikasi Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) atau Cloud Architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Pengalaman mengintegrasikan *tools* SAST/DAST/Container Scanning (seperti Trivy, SonarQube, Snyk) ke dalam *pipeline*. * Pengalaman kerja di lingkungan IT Consulting atau *System Integrator*. **Skema Bekerja:** **On-Site** **(Work From Office)** -- Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Bogor Regency. **Kenapa MCD?** Kami adalah tim berbudaya kinerja tinggi **GROWTH** — *Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony*. Di sini, tim didorong untuk bereksperimen, selalu mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital adalah pemberi kerja yang berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan. Seluruh kandidat dinilai berdasarkan kompetensi dan kesesuaian dengan peran. Work Location: In person

You will act as the technical bridge between customers and our regional/HQ team, supporting the sales cycle with technical solutions in the Kubernetes, container platform, and DevOps space. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide customers with on-site guidance and training for product trials, help customers solve technical problems, become a technical communication bridge between customers and the company, and maintain good customer relations. * Cooperate with the sales team to identify business opportunities, provide solutions and pre-sales technical support. Responsible for the preparation of project proposals, bids, test reports, implementation plans and other technical documents. * Collect and sort out the needs from the client and the market, and provide more accurate and timely information for back-end products and R&D. * Participate in relevant marketing activities and keynote speeches. * Carry out technical exchanges and cooperation with partners. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 2 - 5 years of experience in pre-sales, R&D, or operations/maintenance in cloud computing or IT * Familiar with mainstream cloud-native/container platform products, especially Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes * Experience at IT / Internet companies is preferred * Excellent communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences * Able to work independently and in a team * Strong problem-solving and analytical skills * Professional English; conversational Mandarin preferred * Willing to visit client sites, remote for the rest of the time **Nice to Have** * Red Hat certifications (RHCSA, RHCE, OpenShift EX280/EX288) or CKA/CKAD * Experience at Red Hat or a Red Hat partner/system integrator * Experience working with Chinese companies or teams If you meet the above qualifications and are passionate about cloud native technologies, DevOps practices, Kubernetes, and container platform technology, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Pre-sales Engineer in the cloud native, DevOps, Kubernetes, and container platform area. jobs.title: MANAGER PURCHASING (Retail) - Jakarta Barat
jobs.descriptionHtml: * **Sourcing & Supplier Management:** Mencari vendor/pemasok, melakukan negosiasi harga (COGS), *margin*, serta kesepakatan *trade term* (seperti diskon, *listing fee*, atau kriteria retur). * **Inventory & Stock Availability:** Menjaga tingkat ketersediaan barang (*stock availability*) di gerai/gudang agar tidak terjadi *out of stock* (OOS) maupun *overstock*. * **Cost Control & Profitability:** Memastikan pembelian barang sesuai dengan anggaran (*budget*), serta memaksimalkan profitabilitas produk yang dijual di ritel. * **Vendor Performance & Relationship:** Mengawasi performa pengiriman vendor (*On-Time In-Full* / OTIF), kualitas produk, dan kepatuhan terhadap kontrak kerja sama. penempatan Jakarta Barat * **Pendidikan:** D3/S1 Semua Jurusan (diutamakan Manajemen, Logistik/Rantai Pasok, Teknik Industri, atau Bisnis). * **Pengalaman:** Minimal 3–5 tahun di bidang *Procurement* / *Purchasing* / *Category Management*, wajib memiliki latar belakang industri **Retail / FMCG**. * **Keahlian Negosiasi:** Kemampuan negosiasi tingkat tinggi (*margin*, *trade terms*, *credit term*, diskon volume, dan kerja sama promosi). * **Pemahaman Rantai Pasok (Supply Chain):** Paham manajemen stok, kalkulasi *turnover* barang (FIFO/FEFO), estimasi *lead time*, dan penanganan *fast-moving vs slow-moving inventory*. * **Analisis Data & Sistem:** Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (Pivot, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, kalkulasi margin) serta terbiasa menggunakan sistem ERP (seperti SAP, Oracle, atau sistem POS/Inventaris ritel). * **Jaringan Supplier:** Memiliki relasi dan jaringan distributor/prinsipal FMCG yang luas. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Admin
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kualifikasi Pekerjaan * Minimal SMA/SMK (diutamakan SMK Jurusan Administrasi Perkantoran, Manajemen Logistik, Akuntansi, atau Teknik) / D3/S1 semua jurusan. * Pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai Admin Produksi, Admin PPIC, atau Admin Gudang di industri manufaktur (terbuka untuk *fresh graduate* berpotensi tinggi dengan pemahaman alur manufaktur). * Mahir mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (khususnya **Microsoft Excel** fungsi VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Table, dan formula dasar) serta terbiasa menggunakan sistem ERP/SAP/sistem inventaris manufaktur. * Memiliki ketelitian tinggi terhadap detail data angka, mampu bekerja sistematis, serta memiliki kemampuan problem-solving administratif yang baik. * Memiliki keterampilan komunikasi yang baik, proaktif, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim di lingkungan manufaktur yang dinamis. * Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan terbiasa bekerja dengan *deadline* ketat. Tanggung Jawab Utama * Mencatat dan memperbarui laporan harian produksi (*Daily Production Report*), termasuk jumlah *output*, penggunaan bahan baku, jam kerja line produksi, dan data *downtime* mesin. * Memantau ketersediaan stok bahan baku, bahan penolong, dan barang jadi (*finish goods*) serta melakukan rekonsiliasi data inventaris fisik dengan sistem. * Membuat dan mendistribusikan *Work Order* (WO), *Surat Perintah Kerja* (SPK), serta dokumen pengeluaran/penerimaan barang dari gudang ke area produksi. * Berkoordinasi dengan tim *Procurement*, *Warehouse*, *Quality Control* (QC), dan *Maintenance* untuk memastikan alur pasokan bahan baku serta jadwal produksi berjalan lancar tanpa kendala. * Membantu Supervisor Produksi dalam memantau pencapaian target harian/mingguan dan menjadwalkan alokasi tenaga kerja harian di area manufaktur. * Mengelola pendokumentasian berkas produksi, laporan cacat produk (*reject/rework*), serta memastikan kearsipan data berjalan teratur dan mudah diakses untuk audit harian atau bulanan. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Specialist - Mechanical
jobs.descriptionHtml: JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally. Monitoring and controlling critical infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, energy efficiency, and 24/7 operational reliability. **Responsibilities:** **Environmental Control:** Manages precise temperature and humidity levels throughout server rooms, cold aisles, and hot aisles. Controls HVAC systems, chillers, air handlers, and cooling distribution to maintain optimal operating conditions for IT equipment. Monitors airflow patterns and adjusts cooling strategies based on real-time heat loads. **Power Management:** Monitors electrical distribution from utility feeds through UPS systems, generators, and power distribution units (PDUs). Tracks power consumption, load balancing, and power usage effectiveness (PUE). Manages automatic transfer switches and generator start sequences during power events. **Fire and Safety Systems:** Integrates fire detection, suppression systems, and emergency response protocols. Manages pre-action sprinkler systems, gas suppression zones, and smoke detection throughout the facility. Coordinates with security systems for access control and emergency evacuation procedures. **Monitoring and Alarming:** Provides real-time monitoring of thousands of data points including temperature sensors, power meters, flow rates, and equipment status. Generates automated alerts for threshold violations, equipment failures, or environmental deviations. Maintains historical data for trend analysis and predictive maintenance. **Energy Optimization:** Implements intelligent control strategies for cooling optimization, free cooling utilization, and load management. Analyzes operational data to identify efficiency opportunities and reduce operational costs while maintaining service level agreements. **Qualifications :** Minimum D3 in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, controls engineering, or related technical field. Experience with server hardware, networking equipment, and critical facility systems. Minimum 3-5 years’ experience with building automation systems in critical facilities. Data center or mission-critical environment experience strongly preferred. If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. About JLL – We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. jobs.title: Head of Business & Growth - GoPay Later
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** As Head of Business & Growth for GoPay Later, you’ll own the growth of product by combining business understanding, data, and customer insights to find where the next wave of growth and opportunity will come from. You’ll turn those opportunities into go-to-market plans across product and marketing and drive them from strategy through execution and measurement, with clear accountability. Lead the team, set clear direction, and develop people to deliver aspirational goals. ### **What You Will Do** * Own GoPay Later’s growth strategy and targets for users, transactions, and GTV, and translate them into a clear strategy of prioritized initiatives. * Identify new growth opportunities through data analysis, customer research, and market understanding, including new user segments, use cases, merchants, and ecosystem touchpoints. * Develop go-to-market plans for new and existing initiatives, marketing campaigns, and partnership levers. * Develop the product roadmap, leveraging customer insights and data to decide which features and improvements to build and in the right order of priority. * Drive cross-functional execution with Marketing, Product, Risk, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, aligning priorities and removing blockers to get initiatives live. * Work with the credit risk team to balance growth with credit quality, ensuring initiatives grow the portfolio responsibly. * Lead and develop a high-performing team. ### **What You Will Need** * 8+ years of experience in business growth, strategy, or product/business management roles in the BNPL or consumer lending industry. * Proven track record of driving measurable growth in user, transaction, or revenue metrics for a consumer product. * Solid understanding of credit products and the trade-off between growth and risk. * Strong data analytical skills; comfortable working hands-on with data to find insights, size opportunities, and evaluate impact. * Experience taking initiatives end to end, from opportunity identification and GTM planning to execution and post-launch measurement. * Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders. **About the Team** You’ll be part of the GoPayLater team, which builds and grows BNPL products within the GoTo ecosystem. Our mission is to make flexible, responsible credit accessible to millions of Indonesians, many of whom are underserved by traditional financial institutions. We are a tight-knit group who are bonded by two things: our genuine desire to add value to the lives of our consumers and the growth mindset and passion to make an impact. Our team enjoys what we do since we get to see the impact of our work reflected in our consumer's everyday lives. Come join our family to see what we mean! **About GoTo Group** GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago. **About Gojek** Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market. **About GoTo Financial** GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve bus...
