jobs.title: Brand Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About Us** MAGI Group started in 2020 selling acrylic printed merchandise. Since then, we’ve grown into a merchandise house that ships internationally on a regular basis, with two brands under one roof: * **Magihae** — merchandise for the IP, creator, and fandom world. We work with artists, creators, publishers, IP owners, and IP-focused and premium brands. * **Magi** — a merchandise partner for corporates and brands, from corporate gifting to campaign merchandise, trusted by leading names across retail, beauty, and F&B. Behind both is our own production facility in Jakarta, with in-house UV printing, digital printing, laser cutting, and fiber marking. **Why This Role Matters** People already know us for merchandise, and it sells. What we want next is for our brands to feel more like culture: more creative, more collaborative, and more present in the conversations that matter to creators and brands. Our goal is to become the trusted merchandise partner for Southeast Asia’s creative industry. You’ll lead how we get there. **Why Join Us?** * **Join at the right moment.** We’re growing with strong organic traction. What we need now is a captain to set the direction and lead the team. * **Build something that doesn’t exist yet.** The creative industry in Indonesia and Southeast Asia is growing fast, but no merchandise brand is top of mind yet. We plan to build that from our own niche. * **Compete on value, not price.** Our market rewards quality, creativity, and craft over who’s cheapest. That makes the work harder, and a lot more fun. * **Work with a team that keeps innovating.** Our product team runs active R&D, and we’re often early adopters of new production technology and market trends, so there’s always something new to bring to market. * **Turn ideas into real products, fast.** With in-house production, a campaign idea can become a physical product with fast iteration. * **Work directly with the founder** and have real ownership over where both brands go next. **What You’ll Do** * Plan and lead brand campaigns and activations, from concept to measurable results. * Manage collaborations with KOLs, artists, and creators across Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. * Develop the promotion calendar and content strategy across our brands. * Define product positioning and make sure brand communication stays consistent. * Lead and coordinate a small team and freelancers, and report on performance weekly. **What We’re Looking For** * Around 3–5 years of experience in brand, marketing, or product marketing, with a proven track record of leading campaigns end-to-end. * Experience coordinating small teams and freelancers, especially for content and creator-related projects. * Experience working with KOLs and creators, from sourcing and negotiation to briefing and performance measurement. * Comfortable working with budgets and target margins, and with approval and payment processes through Finance. * Strong creative taste combined with commercial sense: you care about how things look *and* whether they sell. * Familiarity with fandom culture (anime, K-pop, comics) is a plus, along with the ability to reach creative audiences beyond fandom communities. * Understanding of merchandise, printing, or IP licensing is a strong plus. * Strong written and presentation skills in both Indonesian and English. **How to Apply** Send your CV and portfolio to bit.ly/Brandmarketing2026 Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Pertanyaan Lamaran: * Ekspektasi Salary Pengalaman: * brand & marketing: 3 tahun (Diwajibkan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (Indonesian Only)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About Us** TokenMinds helps established businesses raise capital through a token offering, without giving up equity. If you run a real company with real revenue, you already have the asset crypto investors are looking for: credibility. What you are missing is everything between the idea and a credible launch. Tokenomics (how your token is allocated, priced and released), audit, whitepaper, investor network and a qualified crypto audience. We handle that end to end. We become your Web3 department. Not a vendor selling hours, but a senior team that designs the best-fitting solution for your business and executes it: from token structure and compliance to investor and media outreach, public token sale and exchange listing. We have been doing this since the 2017 ICO boom. Nearly a decade of market cycles, 200+ companies supported worldwide, from microcaps and family-owned businesses to regulated enterprises and financial institutions. That track record is the judgment you are buying. **About the Role** **Digital Marketing Manager** **Role Overview** TokenMinds is looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to plan, run, and measure the digital marketing that grows TokenMinds and our clients' Web3 projects. This is a fully remote role, based in Indonesia. This is not a role for someone who only posts content or boosts ads. We need a data-driven, crypto-native marketer who understands how Web3 audiences discover, trust, and join projects, and who can turn that understanding into campaigns that deliver measurable results. This person will own digital marketing across two fronts: TokenMinds' own brand and lead generation, and marketing campaigns for our clients' token launches and Web3 products. They will work across paid and performance campaigns, SEO and content, social media and community on X, Telegram, and Discord, KOL and influencer campaigns, and email, and work closely with our sales, token launch, design, and development teams. At TokenMinds, this role is ultimately accountable for one thing: turning digital marketing into measurable growth for TokenMinds and our clients. **Key Responsibilities** * Plan and run digital marketing for TokenMinds itself, building brand awareness and generating qualified leads for our services. * Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for client token launches, token sales, and Web3 products, aligned with each launch timeline. * Run performance and paid campaigns across crypto-friendly ad networks, search, and social platforms, from targeting and creative to bidding and optimization. * Own SEO and content: keyword research, on-page optimization, blog articles, landing pages, and content calendars that bring in organic traffic. * Manage social media channels on X and LinkedIn, and grow and moderate communities on Telegram and Discord together with community managers. * Plan and manage KOL and influencer campaigns: sourcing, vetting, briefing, negotiating, scheduling, and tracking results. * Build and run email marketing, including newsletters, lead nurturing flows, and launch announcements. * Set up tracking, analytics, and attribution, and report on KPIs such as traffic, leads, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, community growth, and engagement. * Turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations, and keep testing and improving what works. * Manage the marketing tool stack, including analytics, ad platforms, SEO tools, scheduling, email, and community bots. * Plan, allocate, and track marketing budgets for TokenMinds and client campaigns, and make sure spend delivers results. * Brief and coordinate designers, copywriters, video editors, and freelancers to produce campaign assets on time. * Keep up with Web3 marketing trends, platform policies, and new channels, and bring fresh ideas to the team. **What This Person Will Be Accountable For** * Growing TokenMinds' brand visibility and generating a steady flow of qualified leads from digital channels. * Delivering client...

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Revit
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Revit** is one of the brands in the Belkins group of companies. In 3 years, we’ve grown to a team of 25+ people located all over the world, and so far we’ve made a positive impact on more than 150 clients who trusted our team with their growth and outbound (emails, LinkedIn, cold calling). At Revit, we show up every day because we love selling ideas, creating new business relationships, solving challenges that might seem impossible, and getting results where others couldn’t — so that like-minded clients who trust us with their outbound and growth can become our years-long partners. With more extensive support from the other companies in the Belkins group, our 2027 goal is to grow 2x in size and find a way to keep scaling while keeping quality high across the board — from having the best people on the team to onboarding the right clients who match our values and value proposition. Back in 2017, **Belkins** started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast forward to today, and we’ve transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. Among our successes are ambitious start-ups like **Revit**, which have evolved into standalone powerhouses, as well as innovative products such as **Folderly**. This is not a place for everyone, but if you’re looking for a world-class culture and an opportunity to grow, build your career, and make an impact, you’re likely to enjoy being part of Revit and building the future together with us! And now we’re looking for a **Head of Sales**: someone who wants to own the number, not just manage the team, and who’d rather be on the call than read about it in a report. #### **The role** Revit sells outbound, so our own sales team is measured by the same thing we promise clients: real conversations that turn into real deals. You’ll take over the sales team and the number behind it, with one clear goal for 2027 — help us grow 2x: * Double MRR by the end of 2027; * Double our close rate; * Actively support marketing as we double the pipeline. You’ll work side by side with Nick, our Co-Founder/CEO, the core team across all verticals, and the other brands in Belkins Group. ### **What you’ll do:** * **Making 3 AEs better every week.** You’ll do call reviews, give feedback, sit in on deals, and jump in to close when it matters. * **Owning the number.** You’ll handle MRR, forecasts, and monthly plans, and know where we stand and why before anyone asks. * **Building the system.** You’ll build a sales process that’s clear enough for a new AE to follow, with data that shows exactly where deals get stuck. * **Growing the close rate.** You’ll find where we lose deals between the first call and the signature, and fix it. * **Designing KPIs and incentives** that reward the results we actually want. * **Being marketing’s closest partner.** You’ll shape ICPs and messaging together, so a bigger pipeline turns into revenue, not just a fuller calendar. * **Scaling the team** as we grow, including bringing in fractional AEs when it makes sense. ### **What you bring:** A sales leader who wants to own our growth. You’re still hands-on and still on calls, and you can build a team and a process around you. * **Sales leadership:** 1–2+ years leading a team of 3–4+ people, with numbers that show what changed while you led it. * **Digital marketing services:** agency-side experience, not a SaaS/product or software development company. * **US market:** you’ve sold to US clients and know how they buy. * **Close rate:** ideally 15%+, or a clear story behind your numbers. * **Revenue ownership:** planning, forecasting, and explaining MRR. * **Sales process:** you’ve built or run a structured process and improved it with data. * **High pace:** you get things done and are driven by results. * **Good communicator:** you listen well, give specific answers, and build relationships quickly. * **Curious:** ...

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Business Development Associate – AI Visibility Services** Job Type: Full-Time | Fully Remote Compensation: IDR 3,000,000 monthly base salary + commission **Job Overview** UK Creative Ventures is looking for a motivated Business Development Associate to help introduce our AI Visibility services to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand and Australia. As more people use ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered platforms to find businesses and services, online visibility is changing. Our AI Visibility service helps businesses understand how they appear in AI search results and identify opportunities to improve their online presence. This role involves finding potential clients, starting conversations, presenting our services and developing business relationships. It is ideal for someone who is confident with outreach, enjoys communicating with business owners and can work independently. **Key Responsibilities** - Research and identify potential SME clients across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand, Australia and international markets. - Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels. - Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce our services. - Explain the benefits of the AI Visibility Snapshot and convert prospects into paying clients. - Follow up with potential clients and maintain an organised sales pipeline. - Identify opportunities to introduce clients to our Growth & AI Audit and wider marketing, recruitment and education services. - Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients. - Share market feedback and prospect insights to help improve our sales approach. - Prospect lists, messaging frameworks and service guidance will be provided. **Requirements** - Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition. - Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing or telephone prospecting. - Good written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to explain services clearly, particularly to people unfamiliar with AI search. - Strong organisation, follow-up and time-management skills. - Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable working remotely. - Experience in digital marketing, recruitment, SaaS or B2B services is an advantage. You do not need to be an AI expert. Training and guidance on our AI Visibility services will be provided. **Compensation and Benefits** Base salary: IDR 3,000,000 per month. 20% commission on AI Visibility service sales. 20% commission on Marketing, Recruitment and Education service sales. - Uncapped earning potential through additional commissions. - Fully remote working arrangement. - Opportunity to develop within a growing service line and contribute to the company's business development. - Commission is earned in addition to the monthly base salary, subject to the company's commission and payment terms. **About UK Creative Ventures** UK Creative Ventures is a UK-based business growth agency supporting startups, SMEs and established businesses across the UK and internationally. Our services include digital marketing, recruitment, education consultancy and AI search visibility. We help businesses strengthen their online presence, attract customers, find talent and identify opportunities for growth. We're expanding our AI Visibility services to help businesses adapt to changes in how customers discover and research companies online. To apply: click on the apply link or send a short message with your sales background and why this excites you to ***Lina@ukcreativeventures.co.uk*** Application Question(s): * Are you comfortable with the starting salary mentioned above? Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

We are looking for a **Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing** to join our leadership team at Hotel Indigo Bintan and Holiday Inn Resort Bintan. As Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing, you will provide strategic leadership and direction for the overall commercial performance of both properties. You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here: https://www.xtremax.com/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Project Implementation Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Project Implementation Assistant - Cities Program*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** Under the support of the Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC), WRI Indonesia is supporting the establishment and operationalization of the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to strengthen Indonesia’s capacity to design, coordinate, and implement policies and actions to reduce super pollutants, including short-lived climate pollutants (SLCPs). WRI Indonesia serves as the administrator of the Unit. This institutional arrangement is designed to enable sustained engagement with senior government leadership while strengthening operational coordination across key technical directorates, including Waste Management, Climate Change, Air Quality, and Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV). Acting as Indonesia’s national coordination platform for super pollutant mitigation, the Unit will convene relevant ministries, along with state-owned enterprises, development partners, and subnational governments. Through this platform, the Unit will promote coherent policy development, strengthen integrated data and knowledge systems, mobilize financial and technical resources, and mainstream super pollutant mitigation into Indonesia’s national development and climate policy frameworks. **Job Highlight** The Project Implementation Assistant will provide administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to facilitate the effective delivery of its projects and activities. The position will primarily focus on providing and coordinating administrative and operational support including , maintaining project documentation, track implementation progress and deliverables, and facilitate stakeholder engagement activities by preparing materials, documenting key results and follow-up action, and preparing materials to support project report.. The role also requires a good understanding of super pollutant issues and the Unit’s program priorities to effectively support the preparation of briefing notes, meeting materials, presentations, and other documents requiring technical or substantive inputs. Working closely with the Technical Unit Senior Lead and relevant technical experts, the Project Implementation Assistant will help consolidate technical inputs, organize relevant information, and ensure that program materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned with the Unit’s priorities., The role will also support follow up on agreed actions and outstanding tasks to facilitate smooth program coordination and implementation. The Project Implementation Assistant will report directly to the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead and coordinate with relevant WRI Indonesia teams, government counterparts, technical experts, and development partners as required to support the implementation of the Unit’s activities. This position is based in Jakarta with flexible working arrangements and domestic and international travel as required. jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Apple is now seeking an extraordinary Facilities Manager to support the growing team in Indonesia. The Facilities Manager is the culmination of all the skills and resources of a validated facility professional with additional cross-functional administration expertise and exceptional customer experience skills. As a Facilities Manager, you will hold a strong emphasis on running site operations critical to ensuring consistent delivery and the highest performance levels for Soft & Hard Services. You will have the ability to harmonize with Apple corporate business functions & customers at all levels and provide multiple structured and/or ad-hoc, timely and accurate status reports. Description Responsible for the delivery, management, and maintenance of services within offices and academies in Indonesia, including: - Hands-on provision of site Soft & Hard Services - Collaborating with Apple's LOB, RE&D and their nominated internal/external vendors/partners - Input to in-GEO OPEX planning and budgets - Handle Places commercial obligations, e.g., Lease, Utility & Vendor payments - Drive consistency in Places site services and resources as directed - Create and sustain Best Practices for the Facility Team - Run single to multiple, simple to complex Facility initiatives, programs, and projects - Adherence to the use of established protocols, tools & processes - Follow up with Apple customers on site services delivery tracking, issues, risks, and results - Ensure vendors' compliance with agreed SLAs and KPIs - Implement tools, standards, policies, guidelines, and processes - Input on Facility Management improvement programs - Advising and driving improvement changes in Places Facility Management services at the Site level - Support site OH&S compliance - Manage office occupancy report and space planning Minimum Qualifications * 3-5 years of experience in Facility Management or related roles in the high-end corporate office environment * Degree qualified in related fields * Contract/Operations management experience * Must have professional fluency in written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English Preferred Qualifications * Experience with space management/churn project management an advantage * IFMA certification desirable but not required * Passionate about customer services and end-user experience * Self-starter and capable individual contributor * Ability to connect with dispersed internal/external teams * Excellent communication and presentation skills At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace
